name: exists_pow_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pow_lt₀ {G : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [MulArchimedean G]
    {a : G} (ha : a < 1) (b : Gˣ) : ∃ n : ℕ, a ^ n < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha'
  · use 1
    simp
  · lift a to Gˣ using IsUnit.mk0 _ ha'
    simpa using! exists_pow_lt ha b

name: Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton_iff_existsUnique_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive /
of integer multiples of the element, such that each multiple is a unique element.
This is the stronger version of `AddSubgroup.mem_closure_singleton`. -/]
lemma Subgroup.mem_closure_singleton_iff_existsUnique_zpow {G : Type*}
    [CommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] {a b : G} (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    b ∈ closure {a} ↔ ∃! k : ℤ, a ^ k = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_closure_singleton]
  constructor
  · suffices Function.Injective (a ^ · : ℤ → G) by
      rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨m, rfl, fun k hk ↦ this hk⟩
    rcases ha.lt_or_gt with ha | ha
    · exact (zpow_right_strictAnti ha).injective
    · exact (zpow_right_strictMono ha).injective
  · exact fun h ↦ h.exists

name: Int.addEquiv_eq_refl_or_neg
statement: lemma Int.addEquiv_eq_refl_or_neg (e : ℤ ≃+ ℤ) : e = .refl _ ∨ e = .neg _
proof:
:= by
  suffices e 1 = 1 ∨ -e 1 = 1 by simpa [AddEquiv.ext_int_iff, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]
  have he : ¬IsOfFinAddOrder (e 1) :=
    not_isOfFinAddOrder_of_isAddTorsionFree ((AddEquiv.map_ne_zero_iff e).mpr Int.one_ne_zero)
  rw [← AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_zmultiples_iff he]
  simpa [e.surjective, eq_comm] using (e : ℤ →+ ℤ).map_zmultiples 1

name: Int.univ_addEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Int.univ_addEquiv :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (ℤ ≃+ ℤ)) = .cons (.neg ℤ) {.refl ℤ} (by simp [AddEquiv.ext_int_iff])
proof:

name: Int.card_fintype_addEquiv
statement: @[simp] lemma Int.card_fintype_addEquiv : Fintype.card (ℤ ≃+ ℤ) = 2
proof: := rfl

name: Subgroup.isLeast_of_closure_iff_eq_mabs
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma Subgroup.isLeast_of_closure_iff_eq_mabs {a b : G} :
    IsLeast {y : G | y ∈ closure ({a} : Set G) ∧ 1 < y} b ↔ b = |a|ₘ ∧ 1 < b
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · have := Subgroup.cyclic_of_min h
    have ha : a ∈ closure ({b} : Set G) := by
      simp [← this]
    rw [mem_closure_singleton] at ha
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ha
    have := h.left
    simp only [mem_closure_singleton, mem_ofPred_eq] at this
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := this.left
    have key : m * n = 1 := by
      rw [← zpow_right_inj this.right, zpow_mul', hm, zpow_one]
    rw [Int.mul_eq_one_iff_eq_one_or_neg_one] at key
    rw [eq_comm]
    rcases key with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
    simp [this.right.le, this.right, mabs]
  · wlog ha : 1 ≤ a generalizing a
    · convert! @this (a⁻¹) ?_ (by simpa using le_of_not_ge ha) using 4
      · simp
      · rwa [mabs_inv]
    rw [mabs, sup_eq_left.mpr ((inv_le_one'.mpr ha).trans ha)] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, h⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h]
    · intro x
      simp only [mem_closure_singleton, mem_ofPred_eq, and_imp, forall_exists_index]
      rintro k rfl hk
      rw [← zpow_one b, ← zpow_mul, one_mul, zpow_le_zpow_iff_right h, ← zero_add 1,
          ← Int.lt_iff_add_one_le]
      contrapose! hk
      rw [← Left.one_le_inv_iff, ← zpow_neg]
      exact one_le_zpow ha (by simp [hk])

name: LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.discrete_or_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.discrete_or_denselyOrdered (G : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [Archimedean G] :
    Nonempty (G ≃+o ℤ) ∨ DenselyOrdered G
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! H : ∃ x, IsLeast {y : G | 0 < y} x
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := H
    exact Or.inl ⟨(int_orderAddMonoidIso_of_isLeast_pos hx)⟩
  · refine Or.inr ⟨?_⟩
    intro x y hxy
    specialize H (y - x)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : G, 0 < z ∧ z < y - x := by
      contrapose! H
      refine ⟨by simp [hxy], fun _ ↦ H _⟩
    refine ⟨x + z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hz.left]
    · simpa [lt_sub_iff_add_lt'] using hz.right

name: LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered (G : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [Archimedean G] :
    Nonempty (G ≃+o ℤ) ↔ ¬ DenselyOrdered G
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ (_ : G ≃+o ℤ), ¬ DenselyOrdered G by
    rcases LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.discrete_or_denselyOrdered G with ⟨⟨h⟩⟩ | h
    · simpa [this h] using ⟨h⟩
    · simp only [h, not_true_eq_false, iff_false, not_nonempty_iff]
      exact ⟨fun H ↦ (this H) h⟩
  intro e H
  rw [denselyOrdered_iff_of_orderIsoClass e] at H
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := exists_between (one_pos (α := ℤ))
  lia

name: LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.isAddCyclic_iff_not_denselyOrdered
proof:
:= by
  rw [← discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered, isAddCyclic_iff_nonempty_equiv_int]

name: LinearOrderedCommGroup.discrete_or_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroup.discrete_or_denselyOrdered :
    Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ) ∨ DenselyOrdered G

name: LinearOrderedCommGroup.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroup.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered :
    Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ) ↔ ¬ DenselyOrdered G
proof:

statement:

name: LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_or_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_or_denselyOrdered (G : Type*)
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Nontrivial Gˣ] [MulArchimedean G] :
    Nonempty (G ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰) ∨ DenselyOrdered G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← denselyOrdered_units_iff]
  refine (LinearOrderedCommGroup.discrete_or_denselyOrdered Gˣ).imp_left ?_
  intro ⟨f⟩
  exact ⟨OrderMonoidIso.withZeroUnits.symm.trans f.withZero⟩

name: LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered (G : Type*)
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Nontrivial Gˣ] [MulArchimedean G] :
    Nonempty (G ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰) ↔ ¬ DenselyOrdered G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← denselyOrdered_units_iff,
      ← LinearOrderedCommGroup.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered]
  refine Nonempty.congr ?_ ?_ <;> intro f
  · refine ⟨MulEquiv.withZero.symm (withZeroUnitsEquiv.trans f), ?_⟩
    intros
    simp only [MulEquiv.withZero, withZeroUnitsEquiv, MulEquiv.trans_apply,
      MulEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, recZeroCoe_coe, OrderMonoidIso.coe_mulEquiv,
      MulEquiv.symm_trans_apply, MulEquiv.symm_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, map_eq_zero, coe_ne_zero,
      ↓reduceDIte, unzero_coe, MulEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, EquivLike.coe_coe]
    rw [← Units.val_le_val, ← map_le_map_iff f, ← coe_le_coe, coe_unzero, coe_unzero]
  · refine ⟨withZeroUnitsEquiv.symm.trans (MulEquiv.withZero f), ?_⟩
    intros
    simp only [withZeroUnitsEquiv, MulEquiv.symm_mk, MulEquiv.withZero,
      MulEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe, Equiv.toFun_as_coe, EquivLike.coe_coe,
      MulEquiv.trans_apply, MulEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
    split_ifs <;>
    simp_all [← Units.val_le_val]

name: LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [Nontrivial G] {g : G} :
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G | g ≤ x} (· < ·) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃+o ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G | 0 ≤ x} (· < ·) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃+o ℤ) by
    rw [← this]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (· + g) ?_).mono' ?_, fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (· - g) ?_).mono' ?_⟩ <;>
    · try intro
      simp [Function.onFun]
  constructor
  · intro h
    replace h : WellFounded (α := {x : G | 0 ≤ x}) (· < ·) := h
    rw [WellFounded.wellFounded_iff_has_min] at h
    by_cases! H : ∀ (x : G) {y}, 0 < y → ∃ n : ℕ, x ≤ n • y 
    · replace H : Archimedean G := ⟨H⟩
      rw [LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.discrete_iff_not_denselyOrdered]
      intro hd
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ne (0 : G)
      wlog! hy' : 0 < y generalizing y
      · refine this (-y) ?_ ?_
        · simp [hy]
        · simp [lt_of_le_of_ne hy' hy]
      obtain ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hz', hz''⟩ := h ({x | ⟨0, le_rfl⟩ < x}) ⟨⟨y, hy'.le⟩, hy'⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩ := exists_between hz'
      exact hz'' ⟨w, hw.le⟩ hw hw'
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨x, y, hy0, H⟩ := H
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hz⟩ :=
        h (Set.range (fun n : ℕ ↦ ⟨x - n • y, sub_nonneg.mpr (H _).le⟩)) (range_nonempty _)
      refine hz ⟨x - (n + 1) • y, sub_nonneg.mpr (H _).le⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩ ?_
      simp [add_smul, hy0]
  · rintro ⟨f⟩
    have : LocallyFiniteOrder G := LocallyFiniteOrder.ofOrderIsoClass f
    exact BddBelow.wellFoundedOn_lt ⟨0, by simp [mem_lowerBounds]⟩

name: LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete
    {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [Nontrivial G] (g : G) :
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G | x ≤ g} (· > ·) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃+o ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete (g := -g)]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (- ·) ?_).mono' ?_, fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (- ·) ?_).mono' ?_⟩ <;>
  · intro
    simp [Function.onFun, neg_le]

name: LinearOrderedCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete
    {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] [Nontrivial G] {g : G} :
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G | g ≤ x} (· < ·) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let e : G ≃o Additive G := OrderIso.refl G
  suffices Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G | g ≤ x} (· < ·) ↔ Set.WellFoundedOn {x | e g ≤ x} (· < ·) by
    rw [this, LinearOrderedAddCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete,
      OrderAddMonoidIso.toMultiplicativeRight.nonempty_congr]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo e.symm fun _ ↦ e.le_symm_apply.mpr).mono' ?_,
    fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo e fun _ ↦ ?_).mono' ?_⟩ <;>
  simp [Function.onFun]

name: LinearOrderedCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete
    {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] [Nontrivial G] (g : G) :
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G | x ≤ g} (· > ·) ↔ Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete (g := g⁻¹)]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (·⁻¹) ?_).mono' ?_, fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (·⁻¹) ?_).mono' ?_⟩ <;>
  · intro
    simp [Function.onFun, inv_le']

name: LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete_of_ne_zero
    {G₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G₀] [Nontrivial G₀ˣ] {g : G₀} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G₀ | g ≤ x} (· < ·) ↔ Nonempty (G₀ ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰)
proof:
:= by
  suffices Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G₀ | g ≤ x} (· < ·) ↔
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G₀ˣ | Units.mk0 g hg ≤ x} (· < ·) by
    rw [this, LinearOrderedCommGroup.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete]
    refine Nonempty.congr (fun f ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩) (fun f ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
    · exact WithZero.withZeroUnitsEquiv.symm.trans f.withZero
    · intro a b
      rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
      · simp [WithZero.withZeroUnitsEquiv]
      rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with rfl | hb
      · simp [WithZero.withZeroUnitsEquiv]
      simp [WithZero.withZeroUnitsEquiv, ha, hb, ← Units.val_le_val]
    · exact MulEquiv.withZero.symm (WithZero.withZeroUnitsEquiv.trans f)
    · intros
      rw [← WithZero.coe_le_coe]
      simp
  rw [← Set.wellFoundedOn_sdiff_singleton (a := 0)]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo Units.val ?_).mono' ?_,
    fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo ?_ ?_).mono' ?_⟩
  · intro
    simp [← Units.val_le_val]
  · simp [Function.onFun]
  · exact fun x ↦ if h : x = 0 then 1 else Units.mk0 x h
  · simp +contextual [← Units.val_le_val, MapsTo]
  · simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_singleton_iff, Function.onFun, and_imp]
    intro _ _ ha0 _ _ hb0 h
    simp [ha0, hb0, ← Units.val_lt_val, h]

name: LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero.wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_ge_gt_iff_nonempty_discrete_of_ne_zero
    {G₀ : Type*} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G₀] [Nontrivial G₀ˣ] {g : G₀} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    Set.WellFoundedOn {x : G₀ | x ≤ g} (· > ·) ↔ Nonempty (G₀ ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰)
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : g⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by simp [hg]
  rw [← wellFoundedOn_setOfPred_le_lt_iff_nonempty_discrete_of_ne_zero hg',
    ← Set.wellFoundedOn_sdiff_singleton (a := 0)]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (·⁻¹) ?_).mono' ?_, fun h ↦ (h.mapsTo (·⁻¹) ?_).mono' ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
    · simp [hg]
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_sdiff, mem_singleton_iff, inv_eq_zero, hx, not_false_eq_true,
      and_true]
    refine (inv_le_comm₀ ?_ ?_).mp <;>
    simp [zero_lt_iff, hg, hx]
  · simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, Function.onFun, gt_iff_lt]
    intro a ha b _
    refine inv_strictAnti₀ ?_
    contrapose! ha
    simp only [le_zero_iff] at ha
    simp [zero_lt_iff, ha, hg]
  · intro x
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_singleton_iff, and_imp]
    intro hxg hx
    refine inv_anti₀ ?_ hxg
    simp [zero_lt_iff, hx]
  · simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_singleton_iff, gt_iff_lt, Function.onFun, and_imp]
    intro a _ _ b _ hb0
    refine inv_strictAnti₀ ?_
    simp [zero_lt_iff, hb0]

name: OrderMonoidIso.mulArchimedean
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma OrderMonoidIso.mulArchimedean {α β}
    [CommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [CommMonoid β] [PartialOrder β]
    (e : α ≃*o β) [MulArchimedean α] : MulArchimedean β
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y hxy
  replace hxy : 1 < e.symm y := by simp [← map_lt_map_iff e, hxy]
  refine (MulArchimedean.arch (e.symm x) hxy).imp ?_
  simp [← map_pow, ← map_le_map_iff e]

name: map
statement:
@[to_additive /
surjective homomorphism. -/]
protected theorem map {N : Subgroup G} (hN : N.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated)
    {f : G →* H} (hf : Function.Surjective f) : (N.map f).IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSfinite, hSclosure⟩ := hN
  refine ⟨f '' S, hSfinite.image _, ?_⟩
  rw [← hSclosure, Subgroup.map_normalClosure _ _ hf]

name: of_FG
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem of_FG (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] [h : Group.FG N] : N.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, rfl, hS⟩ := N.fg_iff.mp ((Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg N).mp h)
  exact ⟨S, hS, le_antisymm (normalClosure_le_normal subset_closure) closure_le_normalClosure⟩

name: comap
statement:
@[to_additive /
homomorphism with a finitely generated kernel is finitely generated. -/]
protected theorem comap {N : Subgroup H} (hN : N.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated)
    {f : G →* H} (hf : Surjective f) (hf' : f.ker.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated) :
    (N.comap f).IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS_fin, hS⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨T, hT_fin, hT⟩ := hf'
  have : ∃ S', S'.Finite ∧ f '' S' = S :=
    ⟨surjInv hf '' S, hS_fin.image _, by rw [← image_comp, comp_surjInv, image_id]⟩
  clear hS_fin
  obtain ⟨S, hS_fin, rfl⟩ := this
  refine ⟨S ∪ T, hS_fin.union hT_fin, ?_⟩
  rw [← hS, ← map_normalClosure S f hf, comap_map_eq, ← hT, normalClosure_union]

name: bot
statement: protected theorem bot : (⊥ : Subgroup G).IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated
proof: := of_FG _

name: equiv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, φ, hφsurj, hNC⟩ := h
  refine ⟨n, (iso : G →* H).comp φ, iso.surjective.comp hφsurj, ?_⟩
  rwa [φ.ker_mulEquiv_comp iso]

name: of_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive /
homomorphism whose kernel is finitely generated as a normal subgroup is finitely presented. -/]
theorem of_surjective [hG : IsFinitelyPresented G] (f : G →* H)
    (hf_surj : Function.Surjective f) (hf_ker : f.ker.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated) :
    IsFinitelyPresented H
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, φ, hφ_surj, hφ_ker⟩ := hG.out
  refine ⟨n, f.comp φ, hf_surj.comp hφ_surj, ?_⟩
  rw [← MonoidHom.comap_ker]
  exact hf_ker.comap hφ_surj hφ_ker

name: quotient
statement:
@[to_additive /
which is finitely generated as a normal subgroup is finitely presented. -/]
theorem quotient [hG : IsFinitelyPresented G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (hN : N.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated) : IsFinitelyPresented (G ⧸ N)
proof:
:=
  of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N)
    ((QuotientGroup.ker_mk' N).symm ▸ hN)

name: exists_mulEquiv_presentedGroup
statement:
theorem exists_mulEquiv_presentedGroup [hg : IsFinitelyPresented G] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ s : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)), Set.Finite s ∧ Nonempty (G ≃* PresentedGroup s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, φ, hφ, s, hs, hsφ⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨n, s, hs, ⟨(quotientKerEquivOfSurjective φ hφ).symm.trans (quotientMulEquivOfEq hsφ.symm)⟩⟩

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one
statement: theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one : IsPGroup p G ↔ ∀ g : G, ∃ k, g ^ p ^ k = 1
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_orderOf_dvd_pow
statement: theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_orderOf_dvd_pow : IsPGroup p G ↔ ∀ g : G, ∃ k, orderOf g ∣ p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: iff_orderOf
statement: theorem iff_orderOf [Fact p.Prime] : IsPGroup p G ↔ ∀ g : G, ∃ k, orderOf g = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPGroup_iff_orderOf_dvd_pow, Nat.dvd_prime_pow Fact.out]
  exact forall_congr' fun g ↦ ⟨by grind, .imp <| by grind⟩

name: of_card_dvd_pow
statement: theorem of_card_dvd_pow {n : ℕ} (hG : Nat.card G ∣ p ^ n) : IsPGroup p G
proof:
:= by
  refine fun g ↦ ⟨n, ?_⟩
  grw [← orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, ← hG, orderOf_dvd_natCard]

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_card_dvd_pow
statement: theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_card_dvd_pow [Finite G] : IsPGroup p G ↔ ∃ n, Nat.card G ∣ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ of_card_dvd_pow hn⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.card G, Nat.dvd_pow_self_iff NeZero.out hp |>.mpr fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  have ⟨hqp, hqdvd, _⟩ := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hq
  have ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' q (hp := ⟨hqp⟩) hqdvd
  have ⟨k, hk⟩ := h.exists_orderOf_dvd_pow g
  exact Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hqp, hqp.dvd_of_dvd_pow <| hg ▸ hk, hp⟩

name: dvd_orderOf
statement: theorem dvd_orderOf [Fact p.Prime] (hG : IsPGroup p G) {g : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) : p ∣ orderOf g
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨k, hk⟩ := hG.exists_orderOf_eq_pow g
  rw [hk]
  refine dvd_pow_self _ fun hk0 ↦ hg ?_
  rw [← orderOf_eq_one_iff, hk, hk0, pow_zero]

name: of_card
statement: theorem of_card {n : ℕ} (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ n) : IsPGroup p G
proof:
:=
  of_card_dvd_pow hG.dvd

name: of_subsingleton
statement: theorem of_subsingleton [Subsingleton G] : IsPGroup p G
proof:
:=
  of_card (n := 0) (by simp)

name: of_bot
statement: theorem of_bot : IsPGroup p (⊥ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  .of_subsingleton p _

name: zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zero : IsPGroup 0 G
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: _root_.isPGroup_one_iff_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.isPGroup_one_iff_subsingleton : IsPGroup 1 G ↔ Subsingleton G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ .of_subsingleton 1 G⟩
  simpa [isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one] using subsingleton_of_forall_eq 1

name: card
statement: protected theorem card : IsPGroup (Nat.card G) G
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
protected theorem mono {q : ℕ} (hpq : p ∣ q) (hp : IsPGroup p G) : IsPGroup q G
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPGroup_iff_orderOf_dvd_pow] at hp ⊢
  exact fun g ↦ (hp g).imp fun k hk ↦ hk.trans <| pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hpq k

name: of_pow
statement: theorem of_pow {n : ℕ} (h : IsPGroup (p ^ n) G) : IsPGroup p G
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ (h g).imp' (n * ·) <| by simp [pow_mul]

name: iff_card
statement: theorem iff_card [Fact p.Prime] [Finite G] : IsPGroup p G ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, Nat.card G = p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPGroup_iff_card_dvd_pow, Nat.dvd_prime_pow Fact.out]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨n, k, _, hk⟩ ↦ ⟨k, hk⟩, fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, n, le_rfl, hn⟩⟩

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_exists_orderOf_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_exists_orderOf_dvd_pow [Finite G] :
    IsPGroup p G ↔ ∃ k, ∀ g : G, orderOf g ∣ p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  refine isPGroup_iff_orderOf_dvd_pow.trans ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ fun g ↦ ⟨k, hk g⟩⟩
  choose k hk using h
  have := Fintype.ofFinite G
  have ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image .univ k Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨k g, fun g' ↦ ?_⟩
  grw [← Nat.pow_dvd_pow p <| hg g' <| Finset.mem_univ g']
  exact hk g'

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_exists_pow_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_exists_pow_pow_eq_one [Finite G] :
    IsPGroup p G ↔ ∃ k, ∀ g : G, g ^ p ^ k = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPGroup_iff_exists_orderOf_dvd_pow, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: of_exponent_dvd_pow
statement: theorem of_exponent_dvd_pow {n : ℕ} (h : Monoid.exponent G ∣ p ^ n) : IsPGroup p G
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ ⟨n, Monoid.exponent_dvd_iff_forall_pow_eq_one.mp h g⟩

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_exponent_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_exponent_dvd_pow [Finite G] :
    IsPGroup p G ↔ ∃ n, Monoid.exponent G ∣ p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPGroup_iff_exists_orderOf_dvd_pow, Monoid.exponent_dvd]

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_exponent_eq_pow
statement:
theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_exponent_eq_pow [Finite G] [Fact p.Prime] :
    IsPGroup p G ↔ ∃ n, Monoid.exponent G = p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isPGroup_iff_exponent_dvd_pow, Nat.dvd_prime_pow Fact.out]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨n, k, _, hk⟩ ↦ ⟨k, hk⟩, fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, n, le_rfl, hn⟩⟩

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_isPGroup_prod_primeFactors
statement:
theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_isPGroup_prod_primeFactors (h : p ≠ 0) :
    IsPGroup p G ↔ IsPGroup (p.primeFactors.prod id) G
proof:
:=
  ⟨(.of_pow <| ·.mono <| p.dvd_prod_primeFactors_pow_self h), .mono p.prod_primeFactors_dvd⟩

name: _root_.isPGroup_iff_primeFactors_card_subset
statement:
theorem _root_.isPGroup_iff_primeFactors_card_subset [Finite G] (h : p ≠ 0) :
    IsPGroup p G ↔ (Nat.card G).primeFactors ⊆ p.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  refine isPGroup_iff_card_dvd_pow.trans ⟨fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ?_, fun hG ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn0)
    · simp_all
    grw [← Nat.primeFactors_pow p hn0, Nat.primeFactors_mono hn <| pow_ne_zero n h]
  · refine ⟨Nat.card G, Nat.dvd_prod_primeFactors_pow_self NeZero.out |>.trans ?_⟩
    grw [Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ (·) hG, p.prod_primeFactors_dvd]

name: of_injective
statement:
theorem of_injective {H : Type*} [Group H] (ϕ : H →* G) (hϕ : Function.Injective ϕ) :
    IsPGroup p H
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsPGroup, ← hϕ.eq_iff, ϕ.map_pow, ϕ.map_one]
  exact fun h => hG (ϕ h)

name: to_subgroup
statement: theorem to_subgroup (H : Subgroup G) : IsPGroup p H
proof:
:=
  hG.of_injective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective

name: of_surjective
statement:
theorem of_surjective {H : Type*} [Group H] (ϕ : G →* H) (hϕ : Function.Surjective ϕ) :
    IsPGroup p H
proof:
:= by
  refine fun h => Exists.elim (hϕ h) fun g hg => Exists.imp (fun k hk => ?_) (hG g)
  rw [← hg, ← ϕ.map_pow, hk, ϕ.map_one]

name: to_quotient
statement: theorem to_quotient (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] : IsPGroup p (G ⧸ H)
proof:
:=
  hG.of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' H) Quotient.mk''_surjective

name: of_equiv
statement: theorem of_equiv {H : Type*} [Group H] (ϕ : G ≃* H) : IsPGroup p H
proof:
:=
  hG.of_surjective ϕ.toMonoidHom ϕ.surjective

name: isOfFinOrder
statement: theorem isOfFinOrder (hp : p ≠ 0) (g : G) : IsOfFinOrder g
proof:
:=
  hG g |>.elim (isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨_, pow_ne_zero · hp |>.pos, ·⟩)

name: orderOf_coprime
statement: theorem orderOf_coprime {n : ℕ} (hn : p.Coprime n) (g : G) : (orderOf g).Coprime n
proof:
:=
  let ⟨k, hk⟩ := hG g
  (hn.pow_left k).coprime_dvd_left (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hk)

name: powEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (hn : p.Coprime n) (g : G) : hG.powEquiv hn g = g ^ n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: powEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (hn : p.Coprime n) (g : G) :
    (hG.powEquiv hn).symm g = g ^ (orderOf g).gcdB n
proof: := by rw [← Nat.card_zpowers]; rfl

name: index
statement: theorem index (H : Subgroup G) [H.FiniteIndex] : ∃ n : ℕ, H.index = p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := iff_card.mp (hG.to_quotient H.normalCore)
  obtain ⟨k, _, hk2⟩ :=
    (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp.out).mp
      ((congr_arg _ (H.normalCore.index_eq_card.trans hn)).mp
        (Subgroup.index_dvd_of_le H.normalCore_le))
  exact ⟨k, hk2⟩

name: card_eq_or_dvd
statement: theorem card_eq_or_dvd : Nat.card G = 1 ∨ p ∣ Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  cases finite_or_infinite G
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := iff_card.mp hG
    rw [hn]
    rcases n with - | n
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨p ^ n, by rw [pow_succ']⟩
  · rw [Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite]
    exact Or.inr ⟨0, rfl⟩

name: nontrivial_iff_card
statement: theorem nontrivial_iff_card [Finite G] : Nontrivial G ↔ ∃ n > 0, Nat.card G = p ^ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hGnt =>
    let ⟨k, hk⟩ := iff_card.1 hG
    ⟨k,
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hk0 => by
        rw [hk0, pow_zero] at hk; exact Finite.one_lt_card.ne' hk,
      hk⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hk0, hk⟩ =>
    Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.1 <|
      hk.symm ▸ one_lt_pow₀ (Fact.out (p := p.Prime)).one_lt (ne_of_gt hk0)⟩

name: card_orbit
statement: theorem card_orbit (a : α) [Finite (orbit G a)] : ∃ n : ℕ, Nat.card (orbit G a) = p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let ϕ := orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer G a
  have := Finite.of_equiv (orbit G a) ϕ
  have := (stabilizer G a).finiteIndex_of_finite_quotient
  rw [Nat.card_congr ϕ]
  exact hG.index (stabilizer G a)

name: card_modEq_card_fixedPoints
statement: theorem card_modEq_card_fixedPoints : Nat.card α ≡ Nat.card (fixedPoints G α) [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite α
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (fixedPoints G α)
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  classical
    calc
      card α = card (Σ y : Quotient (orbitRel G α), { x // Quotient.mk'' x = y }) :=
        card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv (@Quotient.mk'' _ (orbitRel G α))).symm
      _ = ∑ a : Quotient (orbitRel G α), card { x // Quotient.mk'' x = a } := card_sigma
      _ ≡ ∑ _a : fixedPoints G α, 1 [MOD p] := ?_
      _ = _ := by simp
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ p, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_sum]
    have key :
      ∀ x,
        card { y // (Quotient.mk'' y : Quotient (orbitRel G α)) = Quotient.mk'' x } =
          card (orbit G x) :=
      fun x => by simp only [Quotient.eq'']; congr
    refine
      Eq.symm
        (Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero (fun a _ _ => Quotient.mk'' a.1) (fun _ _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
          (fun a₁ _ _ a₂ _ _ h =>
            Subtype.ext (mem_fixedPoints'.mp a₂.2 a₁.1 (Quotient.exact' h)))
          (fun b => Quotient.inductionOn' b fun b _ hb => ?_) fun a ha _ => by
          rw [key, mem_fixedPoints_iff_card_orbit_eq_one.mp a.2])
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hG.card_orbit b
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at hk
    have : k = 0 := by
      contrapose! hb
      simp [key, hk, hb]
    exact
      ⟨⟨b, mem_fixedPoints_iff_card_orbit_eq_one.2 <| by rw [hk, this, pow_zero]⟩,
        Finset.mem_univ _, ne_of_eq_of_ne Nat.cast_one one_ne_zero, rfl⟩

name: nonempty_fixed_point_of_prime_not_dvd_card
statement:
theorem nonempty_fixed_point_of_prime_not_dvd_card (α) [MulAction G α] (hpα : ¬p ∣ Nat.card α) :
    (fixedPoints G α).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  have : Finite α := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (fun h ↦ (h ▸ hpα) (dvd_zero p))
  @Set.Nonempty.of_subtype _ _
    (by
      rw [← Finite.card_pos_iff, pos_iff_ne_zero]
      contrapose hpα
      rw [← Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd, ← hpα]
      exact hG.card_modEq_card_fixedPoints α)

name: exists_fixed_point_of_prime_dvd_card_of_fixed_point
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_point_of_prime_dvd_card_of_fixed_point (hpα : p ∣ Nat.card α) {a : α}
    (ha : a ∈ fixedPoints G α) : ∃ b, b ∈ fixedPoints G α ∧ a ≠ b
proof:
:= by
  have hpf : p ∣ Nat.card (fixedPoints G α) :=
    Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mp ((hG.card_modEq_card_fixedPoints α).symm.trans hpα.modEq_zero_nat)
  have hα : 1 < Nat.card (fixedPoints G α) :=
    (Fact.out (p := p.Prime)).one_lt.trans_le (Nat.le_of_dvd (Finite.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨⟨a, ha⟩⟩) hpf)
  rw [Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial] at hα
  exact
    let ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, hba⟩ := exists_ne (⟨a, ha⟩ : fixedPoints G α)
    ⟨b, hb, fun hab => hba (by simp_rw [hab])⟩

name: center_nontrivial
statement: theorem center_nontrivial [Nontrivial G] [Finite G] : Nontrivial (Subgroup.center G)
proof:
:= by
  have := (hG.of_equiv ConjAct.toConjAct).exists_fixed_point_of_prime_dvd_card_of_fixed_point G
  rw [ConjAct.fixedPoints_eq_center] at this
  have dvd : p ∣ Nat.card G := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn0, hn⟩ := hG.nontrivial_iff_card.mp inferInstance
    exact hn.symm ▸ dvd_pow_self _ (ne_of_gt hn0)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := this dvd (Subgroup.center G).one_mem
  exact ⟨⟨1, ⟨g, hg.1⟩, mt Subtype.ext_iff.mp hg.2⟩⟩

name: bot_lt_center
statement: theorem bot_lt_center [Nontrivial G] [Finite G] : ⊥ < Subgroup.center G
proof:
:= by
  have := center_nontrivial hG
  exact
      bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr ((Subgroup.center G).one_lt_card_iff_ne_bot.mp Finite.one_lt_card)

name: to_le
statement: theorem to_le {H K : Subgroup G} (hK : IsPGroup p K) (hHK : H ≤ K) : IsPGroup p H
proof:
:=
  hK.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion hHK) fun a b h =>
    Subtype.ext (by
      change ((Subgroup.inclusion hHK) a : G) = (Subgroup.inclusion hHK) b
      apply Subtype.ext_iff.mp h)

name: to_inf_left
statement: theorem to_inf_left {H K : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) : IsPGroup p (H ⊓ K : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  hH.to_le inf_le_left

name: to_inf_right
statement: theorem to_inf_right {H K : Subgroup G} (hK : IsPGroup p K) : IsPGroup p (H ⊓ K : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  hK.to_le inf_le_right

name: map
statement:
theorem map {H : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) {K : Type*} [Group K] (ϕ : G →* K) :
    IsPGroup p (H.map ϕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← H.range_subtype, MonoidHom.map_range]
  exact hH.of_surjective (ϕ.domRestrict H).rangeRestrict (ϕ.domRestrict H).rangeRestrict_surjective

name: comap_of_ker_isPGroup
statement:
theorem comap_of_ker_isPGroup {H : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) {K : Type*} [Group K]
    (ϕ : K →* G) (hϕ : IsPGroup p ϕ.ker) : IsPGroup p (H.comap ϕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hH ⟨ϕ g.1, g.2⟩
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, H.coe_pow, Subtype.coe_mk, ← ϕ.map_pow] at hj
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hϕ ⟨g.1 ^ p ^ j, hj⟩
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, ϕ.ker.coe_pow, Subtype.coe_mk, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add] at hk
  exact ⟨j + k, by rwa [Subtype.ext_iff, (H.comap ϕ).coe_pow]⟩

name: ker_isPGroup_of_injective
statement:
theorem ker_isPGroup_of_injective {K : Type*} [Group K] {ϕ : K →* G} (hϕ : Function.Injective ϕ) :
    IsPGroup p ϕ.ker
proof:
:=
  (congr_arg (fun Q : Subgroup K => IsPGroup p Q) (ϕ.ker_eq_bot hϕ)).mpr IsPGroup.of_bot

name: comap_of_injective
statement:
theorem comap_of_injective {H : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) {K : Type*} [Group K] (ϕ : K →* G)
    (hϕ : Function.Injective ϕ) : IsPGroup p (H.comap ϕ)
proof:
:=
  hH.comap_of_ker_isPGroup ϕ (ker_isPGroup_of_injective hϕ)

name: comap_subtype
statement:
theorem comap_subtype {H : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) {K : Subgroup G} :
    IsPGroup p (H.comap K.subtype)
proof:
:=
  hH.comap_of_injective K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective

name: to_sup_of_normal_right
statement:
theorem to_sup_of_normal_right {H K : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) (hK : IsPGroup p K)
    [K.Normal] : IsPGroup p (H ⊔ K : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← QuotientGroup.ker_mk' K, ← Subgroup.comap_map_eq]
  apply (hH.map (QuotientGroup.mk' K)).comap_of_ker_isPGroup
  rwa [QuotientGroup.ker_mk']

name: to_sup_of_normal_left
statement:
theorem to_sup_of_normal_left {H K : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) (hK : IsPGroup p K)
    [H.Normal] : IsPGroup p (H ⊔ K : Subgroup G)
proof: := sup_comm H K ▸ to_sup_of_normal_right hK hH

name: to_sup_of_normal_right'
statement:
theorem to_sup_of_normal_right' {H K : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) (hK : IsPGroup p K)
    (hHK : H ≤ Subgroup.normalizer K) : IsPGroup p (H ⊔ K : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  let hHK' :=
    to_sup_of_normal_right (hH.of_equiv (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe hHK).symm)
      (hK.of_equiv (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe Subgroup.le_normalizer).symm)
  ((congr_arg (fun H : Subgroup (Subgroup.normalizer K) => IsPGroup p H)
            ((Subgroup.subgroupOf_sup hHK Subgroup.le_normalizer).symm)).mp
        hHK').of_equiv
    (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe (sup_le hHK Subgroup.le_normalizer))

name: to_sup_of_normal_left'
statement:
theorem to_sup_of_normal_left' {H K : Subgroup G} (hH : IsPGroup p H) (hK : IsPGroup p K)
    (hHK : K ≤ Subgroup.normalizer H) : IsPGroup p (H ⊔ K : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  sup_comm H K ▸ to_sup_of_normal_right' hK hH hHK

name: coprime_card_of_ne
statement:
theorem coprime_card_of_ne {G₂ : Type*} [Group G₂] (p₁ p₂ : ℕ) [hp₁ : Fact p₁.Prime]
    [hp₂ : Fact p₂.Prime] (hne : p₁ ≠ p₂) (H₁ : Subgroup G) (H₂ : Subgroup G₂) [Finite H₁]
    [Finite H₂] (hH₁ : IsPGroup p₁ H₁) (hH₂ : IsPGroup p₂ H₂) :
    Nat.Coprime (Nat.card H₁) (Nat.card H₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₁, heq₁⟩ := iff_card.mp hH₁; rw [heq₁]; clear heq₁
  obtain ⟨n₂, heq₂⟩ := iff_card.mp hH₂; rw [heq₂]; clear heq₂
  exact Nat.coprime_pow_primes _ _ hp₁.elim hp₂.elim hne

name: disjoint_of_coprime
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_coprime {p₁ p₂ : ℕ} {H₁ H₂ : Subgroup G} (hH₁ : IsPGroup p₁ H₁)
    (hH₂ : IsPGroup p₂ H₂) (h : p₁.Coprime p₂) : Disjoint H₁ H₂
proof:
:= by
  refine Subgroup.disjoint_def.mpr fun {g} hg₁ hg₂ ↦ ?_
  have ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := hH₁ ⟨g, hg₁⟩
  have hg₁ := Subgroup.orderOf_mk g _ ▸ orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hk₁
  have ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := hH₂ ⟨g, hg₂⟩
  have hg₂ := Subgroup.orderOf_mk g _ ▸ orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hk₂
  exact orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp <| Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes (h.pow k₁ k₂) hg₁ hg₂

name: disjoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_ne (p₁ p₂ : ℕ) [hp₁ : Fact p₁.Prime] [hp₂ : Fact p₂.Prime] (hne : p₁ ≠ p₂)
    (H₁ H₂ : Subgroup G) (hH₁ : IsPGroup p₁ H₁) (hH₂ : IsPGroup p₂ H₂) : Disjoint H₁ H₂
proof:
:=
  disjoint_of_coprime hH₁ hH₂ <| Nat.coprime_primes hp₁.elim hp₂.elim |>.mpr hne

name: le_or_disjoint_of_coprime
statement:
theorem le_or_disjoint_of_coprime [hp : Fact p.Prime] {P : Subgroup G} (hP : IsPGroup p P)
    {H : Subgroup G} [H.Normal] (h_cop : (Nat.card H).Coprime H.index) :
    P ≤ H ∨ Disjoint H P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : Nat.card H = 0
  · rw [h1, Nat.coprime_zero_left, Subgroup.index_eq_one] at h_cop
    rw [h_cop]
    exact Or.inl le_top
  by_cases h2 : H.index = 0
  · rw [h2, Nat.coprime_zero_right, Subgroup.card_eq_one] at h_cop
    rw [h_cop]
    exact Or.inr disjoint_bot_left
  have : Finite G := by
    apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
    rw [← H.card_mul_index]
    exact mul_ne_zero h1 h2
  have h3 : (Nat.card H).Coprime (Nat.card P) ∨ H.index.Coprime (Nat.card P) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hP.exists_card_eq
    refine hk ▸ Or.imp hp.out.coprime_pow_of_not_dvd hp.out.coprime_pow_of_not_dvd ?_
    contrapose! h_cop
    exact Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mpr ⟨p, hp.out, h_cop⟩
  refine h3.symm.imp (fun h4 ↦ ?_) (fun h4 ↦ ?_)
  · rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one]
    exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes h4 (H.relIndex_dvd_index_of_normal P)
      (Subgroup.relIndex_dvd_card H P)
  · exact Subgroup.disjoint_of_coprime_natCard h4

name: card_center_eq_prime_pow
statement:
theorem card_center_eq_prime_pow (hGpn : Nat.card G = p ^ n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ k > 0, Nat.card (center G) = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite G := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (hGpn ▸ pow_ne_zero n (NeZero.ne p))
  have hcG := to_subgroup (of_card hGpn) (center G)
  rcases iff_card.1 hcG with _
  have : Nontrivial G := (nontrivial_iff_card <| of_card hGpn).2 ⟨n, hn, hGpn⟩
  exact (nontrivial_iff_card hcG).mp (center_nontrivial (of_card hGpn))

name: cyclic_center_quotient_of_card_eq_prime_sq
statement:
theorem cyclic_center_quotient_of_card_eq_prime_sq (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 2) :
    IsCyclic (G ⧸ center G)
proof:
:= by
  apply isCyclic_of_card_dvd_prime (p := p)
  rw [← mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (NeZero.ne p), ← sq, ← hG, ← (center G).card_mul_index]
  apply mul_dvd_mul_right
  rcases card_center_eq_prime_pow hG zero_lt_two with ⟨k, hk0, hk⟩
  rw [hk]
  exact dvd_pow_self p hk0.ne'

name: isMulCommutative_of_card_eq_prime_sq
statement: theorem isMulCommutative_of_card_eq_prime_sq (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 2) : IsMulCommutative G
proof:
:=
  let := cyclic_center_quotient_of_card_eq_prime_sq hG
  isMulCommutative_of_isCyclic_quotient_center_self G

name: commutative_of_card_eq_prime_sq
statement:
@[deprecated isMulCommutative_of_card_eq_prime_sq (since := "2026-05-26")]
theorem commutative_of_card_eq_prime_sq (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 2) : ∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a
proof:
:=
  isMulCommutative_of_card_eq_prime_sq hG |>.is_comm.comm

name: isPGroup_multiplicative
statement: lemma isPGroup_multiplicative : IsPGroup n (Multiplicative G)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [IsPGroup, Multiplicative.forall] using
    fun _ ↦ ⟨1, by simp [← ofAdd_nsmul, ZModModule.char_nsmul_eq_zero]⟩

name: eq_one_of_noncommProd_eq_one_of_iSupIndep
statement:
@[to_additive /
This generalizes (one direction of) `AddSubgroup.disjoint_iff_add_eq_zero`. -/]
theorem eq_one_of_noncommProd_eq_one_of_iSupIndep {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → G) (comm)
    (K : ι → Subgroup G) (hind : iSupIndep K) (hmem : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ∈ K x)
    (heq1 : s.noncommProd f comm = 1) : ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
    revert heq1
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert i s hnotMem ih =>
      have hcomm := comm.mono (Finset.coe_subset.2 <| Finset.subset_insert _ _)
      simp only [Finset.forall_mem_insert] at hmem
      have hmem_bsupr : s.noncommProd f hcomm ∈ ⨆ i ∈ (s : Set ι), K i := by
        refine Subgroup.noncommProd_mem _ _ ?_
        intro x hx
        have : K x ≤ ⨆ i ∈ (s : Set ι), K i := le_iSup₂ (f := fun i _ => K i) x hx
        exact this (hmem.2 x hx)
      intro heq1
      rw [Finset.noncommProd_insert_of_notMem _ _ _ _ hnotMem] at heq1
      have hnotMem' : i ∉ (s : Set ι) := by simpa
      obtain ⟨heq1i : f i = 1, heq1S : s.noncommProd f _ = 1⟩ :=
        Subgroup.disjoint_iff_mul_eq_one.mp (hind.disjoint_biSup hnotMem') hmem.1 hmem_bsupr heq1
      intro i h
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at h
      rcases h with (rfl | h)
      · exact heq1i
      · refine ih hcomm hmem.2 heq1S _ h

name: noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (y : N i) :
    noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm (Pi.mulSingle i y) = ϕ i y
proof:
:= by
  change Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun j => ϕ j (Pi.mulSingle i y j)) (fun _ _ _ _ h => hcomm h _ _)
    = ϕ i y
  rw [← Finset.insert_erase (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [Finset.noncommProd_insert_of_notMem _ _ _ _ (Finset.notMem_erase i _)]
  rw [Pi.mulSingle_eq_same]
  rw [Finset.noncommProd_eq_pow_card]
  · rw [one_pow]
    exact mul_one _
  · intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase] at hj
    simp [hj]

name: noncommPiCoprod_mrange
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem noncommPiCoprod_mrange :
    MonoidHom.mrange (noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm) = ⨆ i : ι, MonoidHom.mrange (ϕ i)
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq ι
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, rfl⟩
    refine Submonoid.noncommProd_mem _ _ _ (fun _ _ _ _ h => hcomm h _ _) (fun i _ => ?_)
    apply Submonoid.mem_sSup_of_mem
    · use i
    simp
  · refine iSup_le ?_
    rintro i x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Pi.mulSingle i y, noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle _ _ _⟩

name: commute_noncommPiCoprod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma commute_noncommPiCoprod {m : M}
    (comm : ∀ i (x : N i), Commute m ((ϕ i x))) (h : (i : ι) → N i) :
    Commute m (MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm h)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]
  apply Finset.noncommProd_induction
  · exact fun x y ↦ Commute.mul_right
  · exact Commute.one_right _
  · exact fun x _ ↦ comm x (h x)

name: noncommPiCoprod_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma noncommPiCoprod_apply (h : (i : ι) → N i) :
    MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm h = Finset.noncommProd Finset.univ (fun i ↦ ϕ i (h i))
      (Pairwise.set_pairwise (fun ⦃i j⦄ a ↦ hcomm a (h i) (h j)) _)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]

name: comp_noncommPiCoprod
statement:
@[to_additive /
Given additive monoid morphisms `φᵢ : Nᵢ → M` and `f : M → P`, if we have sufficient commutativity,
then `f ∘ (∐ᵢ φᵢ) = ∐ᵢ (f ∘ φᵢ)` -/]
theorem comp_noncommPiCoprod {P : Type*} [Monoid P] {f : M →* P}
    (hcomm' : Pairwise fun i j => ∀ x y, Commute (f.comp (ϕ i) x) (f.comp (ϕ j) y) :=
      Pairwise.mono hcomm (fun i j ↦ forall_imp (fun x h y ↦ by
        simp only [MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Commute.map (h y) f]))) :
    f.comp (MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm) =
      MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod (fun i ↦ f.comp (ϕ i)) hcomm'
proof:
:=
  MonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by
    simp only [MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod, MonoidHom.coe_comp, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk,
      Function.comp_apply, Finset.map_noncommProd]

name: noncommPiCoprod_range
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem noncommPiCoprod_range [Fintype ι]
    {hcomm : Pairwise fun i j : ι => ∀ (x : H i) (y : H j), Commute (ϕ i x) (ϕ j y)} :
    (noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm).range = ⨆ i : ι, (ϕ i).range
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq ι
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨f, rfl⟩
    refine Subgroup.noncommProd_mem _ (fun _ _ _ _ h => hcomm h _ _) ?_
    intro i _hi
    apply Subgroup.mem_sSup_of_mem
    · use i
    simp
  · refine iSup_le ?_
    rintro i x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Pi.mulSingle i y, noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle _ _ _⟩

name: injective_noncommPiCoprod_of_iSupIndep
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem injective_noncommPiCoprod_of_iSupIndep [Fintype ι]
    {hcomm : Pairwise fun i j : ι => ∀ (x : H i) (y : H j), Commute (ϕ i x) (ϕ j y)}
    (hind : iSupIndep fun i => (ϕ i).range)
    (hinj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (ϕ i)) : Function.Injective (noncommPiCoprod ϕ hcomm)
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  intro f heq1
  have : ∀ i, i ∈ Finset.univ → ϕ i (f i) = 1 :=
    Subgroup.eq_one_of_noncommProd_eq_one_of_iSupIndep _ _ (fun _ _ _ _ h => hcomm h _ _)
      _ hind (by simp) heq1
  ext i
  apply hinj
  simp [this i (Finset.mem_univ i)]

name: independent_range_of_coprime_order
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem independent_range_of_coprime_order
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j : ι => ∀ (x : H i) (y : H j), Commute (ϕ i x) (ϕ j y))
    [Finite ι] [∀ i, Fintype (H i)]
    (hcoprime : Pairwise fun i j => Nat.Coprime (Fintype.card (H i)) (Fintype.card (H j))) :
    iSupIndep fun i => (ϕ i).range
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  let := Classical.decEq ι
  rintro i
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  rintro f ⟨hxi, hxp⟩
  dsimp at hxi hxp
  rw [iSup_subtype', ← noncommPiCoprod_range] at hxp
  rotate_left
  · intro _ _ hj
    apply hcomm
    exact hj ∘ Subtype.ext
  obtain ⟨g, hgf⟩ := hxp
  obtain ⟨g', hg'f⟩ := hxi
  have hxi : orderOf f ∣ Fintype.card (H i) := by
    rw [← hg'f]
    exact (orderOf_map_dvd _ _).trans orderOf_dvd_card
  have hxp : orderOf f ∣ ∏ j : { j // j ≠ i }, Fintype.card (H j) := by
    rw [← hgf, ← Fintype.card_pi]
    exact (orderOf_map_dvd _ _).trans orderOf_dvd_card
  change f = 1
  rw [← pow_one f, ← orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Nat.dvd_gcd hxp hxi
  use c
  rw [← hc]
  symm
  rw [← Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Nat.coprime_fintype_prod_left_iff, Subtype.forall]
  intro j h
  exact hcoprime h

name: commute_subtype_of_commute
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commute_subtype_of_commute
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j : ι => ∀ x y : G, x ∈ H i → y ∈ H j → Commute x y) (i j : ι)
    (hne : i ≠ j) :
    ∀ (x : H i) (y : H j), Commute ((H i).subtype x) ((H j).subtype y)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact hcomm hne x y hx hy

name: independent_of_coprime_order
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem independent_of_coprime_order
    (hcomm : Pairwise fun i j : ι => ∀ x y : G, x ∈ H i → y ∈ H j → Commute x y)
    [Finite ι] [∀ i, Fintype (H i)]
    (hcoprime : Pairwise fun i j => Nat.Coprime (Fintype.card (H i)) (Fintype.card (H j))) :
    iSupIndep H
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    MonoidHom.independent_range_of_coprime_order (fun i => (H i).subtype)
      (commute_subtype_of_commute hcomm) hcoprime

name: noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle [DecidableEq ι]
    {hcomm : Pairwise fun i j : ι => ∀ x y : G, x ∈ H i → y ∈ H j → Commute x y} (i : ι) (y : H i) :

name: noncommPiCoprod_range
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem noncommPiCoprod_range

name: injective_noncommPiCoprod_of_iSupIndep

theorem injective_noncommPiCoprod_of_iSupIndep

theorem noncommPiCoprod_apply (comm) (u : (i : ι) → H i) :

name: induction_left
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_left {motive : CoprodI M → Prop} (m : CoprodI M) (one : motive 1)
    (mul : ∀ {i} (m : M i) x, motive x → motive (of m * x)) : motive m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Submonoid.induction_of_closure_eq_top_left mclosure_iUnion_range_of with
  | one => exact one
  | mul_left x hx y ihy =>
    obtain ⟨i, m, rfl⟩ : ∃ (i : ι) (m : M i), of m = x := by simpa using hx
    exact mul m y ihy

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {motive : CoprodI M → Prop} (m : CoprodI M) (one : motive 1)
    (of : ∀ (i) (m : M i), motive (of m))
    (mul : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x * y)) : motive m
proof:
:=
  induction_left m one fun {_} _ _ ↦ mul _ _ (of _ _)

name: inv_def
statement:
theorem inv_def (x : CoprodI G) :
    x⁻¹ =
      MulOpposite.unop
        (lift (fun i => (of : G i →* _).op.comp (MulEquiv.inv' (G i)).toMonoidHom) x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: lift_range_le
statement:
theorem lift_range_le {N} [Group N] (f : ∀ i, G i →* N) {s : Subgroup N}
    (h : ∀ i, (f i).range ≤ s) : (lift f).range ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  induction x using CoprodI.induction_on with
  | one => exact s.one_mem
  | of i x =>
    simp only [lift_of]
    exact h i (Set.mem_range_self x)
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    simp only [map_mul]
    exact s.mul_mem hx hy

name: range_eq_iSup
statement: theorem range_eq_iSup {N} [Group N] (f : ∀ i, G i →* N) : (lift f).range = ⨆ i, (f i).range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (lift_range_le _ f fun i => le_iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range (f i)) i)
  apply iSup_le _
  rintro i _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨of x, by simp only [lift_of]⟩

name: prod_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_empty : prod (empty : Word M) = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: fstIdx_ne_iff
statement:
theorem fstIdx_ne_iff {w : Word M} {i} :
    fstIdx w ≠ some i ↔ ∀ l ∈ w.toList.head?, i ≠ Sigma.fst l
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mp <| by simp [fstIdx]

name: fstIdx_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fstIdx_cons {i} (m : M i) (w : Word M) (hmw : w.fstIdx ≠ some i) (h1 : m ≠ 1) :
    fstIdx (cons m w hmw h1) = some i
proof: := by simp [cons, fstIdx]

name: prod_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_cons (i) (m : M i) (w : Word M) (h1 : m ≠ 1) (h2 : w.fstIdx ≠ some i) :
    prod (cons m w h2 h1) = of m * prod w
proof:
:= by
  simp [cons, prod, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]

name: prod_rcons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_rcons {i} (p : Pair M i) : prod (rcons p) = of p.head * prod p.tail
proof:
:=
  if hm : p.head = 1 then by rw [rcons, dite_eq_left hm, hm, map_one, one_mul]
  else by rw [rcons, dite_eq_right hm, cons, prod, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, prod]

name: rcons_inj
statement: theorem rcons_inj {i} : Function.Injective (rcons : Pair M i → Word M)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨m, w, h⟩ ⟨m', w', h'⟩ he
  by_cases hm : m = 1 <;> by_cases hm' : m' = 1
  · simp only [rcons, dite_eq_left hm, dite_eq_left hm'] at he
    simp_all
  · exfalso
    simp only [rcons, dite_eq_left hm, dite_eq_right hm'] at he
    rw [he] at h
    exact h rfl
  · exfalso
    simp only [rcons, dite_eq_left hm', dite_eq_right hm] at he
    rw [← he] at h'
    exact h' rfl
  · have : m = m' ∧ w.toList = w'.toList := by
      simpa [cons, rcons, dite_eq_right hm, dite_eq_right hm', eq_self_iff_true, Subtype.mk_eq_mk,
        heq_iff_eq, ← Subtype.ext_iff] using he
    rcases this with ⟨rfl, h⟩
    congr
    exact Word.ext h

name: mem_rcons_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rcons_iff {i j : ι} (p : Pair M i) (m : M j) :
    ⟨_, m⟩ ∈ (rcons p).toList ↔ ⟨_, m⟩ ∈ p.tail.toList ∨
      m ≠ 1 ∧ (∃ h : i = j, m = h ▸ p.head)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rcons, cons, ne_eq]
  grind

name: consRecOn_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem consRecOn_empty {motive : Word M → Sort*} (h_empty : motive empty)
    (h_cons : ∀ (i) (m : M i) (w) h1 h2, motive w → motive (cons m w h1 h2)) :
    consRecOn empty h_empty h_cons = h_empty
proof: := rfl

name: consRecOn_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem consRecOn_cons {motive : Word M → Sort*} (i) (m : M i) (w : Word M) h1 h2
    (h_empty : motive empty)
    (h_cons : ∀ (i) (m : M i) (w) h1 h2, motive w → motive (cons m w h1 h2)) :
    consRecOn (cons m w h1 h2) h_empty h_cons = h_cons i m w h1 h2
      (consRecOn w h_empty h_cons)
proof: := rfl

name: equivPair_symm
statement: theorem equivPair_symm (i) (p : Pair M i) : (equivPair i).symm p = rcons p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: equivPair_eq_of_fstIdx_ne
statement:
theorem equivPair_eq_of_fstIdx_ne {i} {w : Word M} (h : fstIdx w ≠ some i) :
    equivPair i w = ⟨1, w, h⟩
proof:
:=
  (equivPair i).eq_symm_apply.mp <| Eq.symm (dite_eq_left rfl)

name: mem_equivPair_tail_iff
statement:
theorem mem_equivPair_tail_iff {i j : ι} {w : Word M} (m : M i) :
    (⟨i, m⟩ ∈ (equivPair j w).tail.toList) ↔ ⟨i, m⟩ ∈ w.toList.tail
      ∨ i ≠ j ∧ ∃ h : w.toList ≠ [], w.toList.head h = ⟨i, m⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equivPair, equivPairAux, ne_eq, Equiv.coe_fn_mk]
  induction w using consRecOn with
  | empty => simp
  | cons k g tail h1 h2 ih =>
    simp only [consRecOn_cons]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst k
      by_cases hij : j = i <;> simp_all
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst i; simp_all [@eq_comm _ m g, @eq_comm _ k j, or_comm]
      · simp [hik, Ne.symm hik]

name: mem_of_mem_equivPair_tail
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_equivPair_tail {i j : ι} {w : Word M} (m : M i) :
    (⟨i, m⟩ ∈ (equivPair j w).tail.toList) → ⟨i, m⟩ ∈ w.toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_equivPair_tail_iff]
  rintro (h | h)
  · exact List.mem_of_mem_tail h
  · revert h; cases w.toList <;> simp +contextual

name: equivPair_head
statement:
theorem equivPair_head {i : ι} {w : Word M} :
    (equivPair i w).head =
      if h : ∃ (h : w.toList ≠ []), (w.toList.head h).1 = i
      then h.snd ▸ (w.toList.head h.1).2
      else 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equivPair, equivPairAux]
  induction w using consRecOn with
  | empty => simp
  | cons head =>
    by_cases hi : i = head
    · subst hi; simp
    · simp [hi, Ne.symm hi]

name: smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def {i} (m : M i) (w : Word M) :
    m • w = rcons { equivPair i w with head := m * (equivPair i w).head }
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: of_smul_def
statement:
theorem of_smul_def (i) (w : Word M) (m : M i) :
    of m • w = rcons { equivPair i w with head := m * (equivPair i w).head }
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: equivPair_smul_same
statement:
theorem equivPair_smul_same {i} (m : M i) (w : Word M) :
    equivPair i (of m • w) = ⟨m * (equivPair i w).head, (equivPair i w).tail,
      (equivPair i w).fstIdx_ne⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_smul_def, ← equivPair_symm]
  simp

name: equivPair_tail
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivPair_tail {i} (p : Pair M i) :
    equivPair i p.tail = ⟨1, p.tail, p.fstIdx_ne⟩
proof:
:=
  equivPair_eq_of_fstIdx_ne _

name: smul_eq_of_smul
statement:
theorem smul_eq_of_smul {i} (m : M i) (w : Word M) :
    m • w = of m • w
proof: := rfl

name: mem_smul_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smul_iff {i j : ι} {m₁ : M i} {m₂ : M j} {w : Word M} :
    ⟨_, m₁⟩ ∈ (of m₂ • w).toList ↔
      (¬i = j ∧ ⟨i, m₁⟩ ∈ w.toList)
      ∨ (m₁ ≠ 1 ∧ ∃ (hij : i = j), (⟨i, m₁⟩ ∈ w.toList.tail) ∨
        (∃ m', ⟨j, m'⟩ ∈ w.toList.head? ∧ m₁ = hij ▸ (m₂ * m')) ∨
        (w.fstIdx ≠ some j ∧ m₁ = hij ▸ m₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_smul_def, mem_rcons_iff, mem_equivPair_tail_iff, equivPair_head, or_assoc]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    simp only [not_true, ne_eq, false_and, exists_prop, true_and, false_or]
    by_cases hw : ⟨j, m₁⟩ ∈ w.toList.tail
    · simp [hw, show m₁ ≠ 1 from w.ne_one _ (List.mem_of_mem_tail hw)]
    · simp only [hw, false_or, Option.mem_def, and_congr_right_iff]
      intro hm1
      split_ifs with h
      · rcases h with ⟨hnil, rfl⟩
        simp only [List.head?_eq_some_head hnil, Option.some.injEq]
        constructor
        · rintro rfl
          exact Or.inl ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩
        · rintro (⟨_, h, rfl⟩ | hm')
          · simp only [Sigma.ext_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and] at h
            subst h
            rfl
          · simp only [fstIdx, Option.map_eq_some_iff, Sigma.exists,
              exists_and_right, exists_eq_right, not_exists] at hm'
            exact (hm'.1 (w.toList.head hnil).2 (by rw [List.head?_eq_some_head])).elim
      · revert h
        rw [fstIdx]
        cases w.toList
        · simp
        · simp +contextual [Sigma.ext_iff]
  · rcases w with ⟨_ | _, _, _⟩ <;>
    simp [or_comm, hij, Ne.symm hij, eq_comm]

name: mem_smul_iff_of_ne
statement:
theorem mem_smul_iff_of_ne {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) {m₁ : M i} {m₂ : M j} {w : Word M} :
    ⟨_, m₁⟩ ∈ (of m₂ • w).toList ↔ ⟨i, m₁⟩ ∈ w.toList
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_smul_iff, *]

name: cons_eq_smul
statement:
theorem cons_eq_smul {i} {m : M i} {ls h1 h2} :
    cons m ls h1 h2 = of m • ls
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_smul_def, equivPair_eq_of_fstIdx_ne _]
  · simp [cons, rcons, h2]
  · exact h1

name: rcons_eq_smul
statement:
theorem rcons_eq_smul {i} (p : Pair M i) :
    rcons p = of p.head • p.tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [of_smul_def]

name: equivPair_head_smul_equivPair_tail
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivPair_head_smul_equivPair_tail {i : ι} (w : Word M) :
    of (equivPair i w).head • (equivPair i w).tail = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rcons_eq_smul, ← equivPair_symm, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: equivPair_tail_eq_inv_smul
statement:
theorem equivPair_tail_eq_inv_smul {G : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (G i)] {i} (w : Word G) :
    (equivPair i w).tail = (of (equivPair i w).head)⁻¹ • w
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| inv_smul_eq_iff.2 (equivPair_head_smul_equivPair_tail w).symm

name: smul_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem smul_induction {motive : Word M → Prop} (empty : motive empty)
    (smul : ∀ (i) (m : M i) (w), motive w → motive (of m • w)) (w : Word M) : motive w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using consRecOn with
  | empty => exact empty
  | cons _ _ _ _ _ ih =>
    rw [cons_eq_smul]
    exact smul _ _ _ ih

name: prod_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_smul (m) : ∀ w : Word M, prod (m • w) = m * prod w
proof:
:= by
  induction m using CoprodI.induction_on with
  | one =>
    intro
    rw [one_smul, one_mul]
  | of _ =>
    intros
    rw [of_smul_def, prod_rcons, of.map_mul, mul_assoc, ← prod_rcons, ← equivPair_symm,
      Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    intro w
    rw [mul_smul, hx, hy, mul_assoc]

name: toList_ne_nil
statement: theorem toList_ne_nil {i j} (w : NeWord M i j) : w.toList ≠ List.nil
proof:
:= by
  induction w
  · rintro ⟨rfl⟩
  · apply List.append_ne_nil_of_left_ne_nil
    assumption

name: toList_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_head? {i j} (w : NeWord M i j) : w.toList.head? = Option.some ⟨i, w.head⟩
proof:
:= by
  fun_induction toList with grind [head]

name: toList_getLast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_getLast? {i j} (w : NeWord M i j) : w.toList.getLast? = Option.some ⟨j, w.last⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Option.mem_def]
  induction w
  · rw [Option.mem_def]
    rfl
  · exact List.mem_getLast?_append_of_mem_getLast? (by assumption)

name: of_word
statement: theorem of_word (w : Word M) (h : w ≠ empty) : ∃ (i j : _) (w' : NeWord M i j), w'.toWord = w
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ (i j : _) (w' : NeWord M i j), w'.toWord.toList = w.toList by
    rcases this with ⟨i, j, w, h⟩
    refine ⟨i, j, w, ?_⟩
    ext
    rw [h]
  obtain ⟨l, hnot1, hchain⟩ := w
  induction l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons x l hi =>
    rw [List.forall_mem_cons] at hnot1
    rcases l with - | ⟨y, l⟩
    · refine ⟨x.1, x.1, singleton x.2 hnot1.1, ?_⟩
      simp [toWord]
    · rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hchain
      specialize hi hnot1.2 hchain.2 (by rintro ⟨rfl⟩)
      obtain ⟨i, j, w', hw' : w'.toList = y::l⟩ := hi
      obtain rfl : y = ⟨i, w'.head⟩ := by simpa [hw'] using w'.toList_head?
      refine ⟨x.1, j, append (singleton x.2 hnot1.1) hchain.1 w', ?_⟩
      simpa [toWord] using hw'

name: singleton_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleton_head {i} (x : M i) (hne_one : x ≠ 1) : (singleton x hne_one).head = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: singleton_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleton_last {i} (x : M i) (hne_one : x ≠ 1) : (singleton x hne_one).last = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: prod_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_singleton {i} (x : M i) (hne_one : x ≠ 1) : (singleton x hne_one).prod = of x
proof:
:= by
  simp [toWord, prod, Word.prod]

name: append_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_head {i j k l} {w₁ : NeWord M i j} {hne : j ≠ k} {w₂ : NeWord M k l} :
    (append w₁ hne w₂).head = w₁.head
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: append_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_last {i j k l} {w₁ : NeWord M i j} {hne : j ≠ k} {w₂ : NeWord M k l} :
    (append w₁ hne w₂).last = w₂.last
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: append_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_prod {i j k l} {w₁ : NeWord M i j} {hne : j ≠ k} {w₂ : NeWord M k l} :
    (append w₁ hne w₂).prod = w₁.prod * w₂.prod
proof: := by simp [toWord, prod, Word.prod]

name: replaceHead_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem replaceHead_head {i j : ι} (x : M i) (hnotone : x ≠ 1) (w : NeWord M i j) :
    (replaceHead x hnotone w).head = x
proof:
:= by
  induction w
  · rfl
  · simp [*, replaceHead]

name: mulHead_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulHead_head {i j : ι} (w : NeWord M i j) (x : M i) (hnotone : x * w.head ≠ 1) :
    (mulHead w x hnotone).head = x * w.head
proof:
:= by
  induction w
  · rfl
  · simp [*, mulHead]

name: mulHead_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulHead_prod {i j : ι} (w : NeWord M i j) (x : M i) (hnotone : x * w.head ≠ 1) :
    (mulHead w x hnotone).prod = of x * w.prod
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulHead
  induction w with
  | singleton => simp [replaceHead]
  | append _ _ _ w_ih_w₁ w_ih_w₂ =>
    specialize w_ih_w₁ _ hnotone
    simp only [replaceHead, append_prod, ← mul_assoc]
    congr 1

name: inv_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_prod {i j} (w : NeWord G i j) : w.inv.prod = w.prod⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction w <;> simp [inv, *]

name: inv_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_head {i j} (w : NeWord G i j) : w.inv.head = w.last⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction w <;> simp [inv, *]

name: inv_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_last {i j} (w : NeWord G i j) : w.inv.last = w.head⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction w <;> simp [inv, *]

name: lift_word_ping_pong
statement:
theorem lift_word_ping_pong {i j k} (w : NeWord H i j) (hk : j ≠ k) :
    lift f w.prod • X k ⊆ X i
proof:
:= by
  induction w generalizing k with
  | singleton x hne_one => simpa using hpp hk _ hne_one
  | @append i j k l w₁ hne w₂ hIw₁ hIw₂ =>
    calc
      lift f (NeWord.append w₁ hne w₂).prod • X k = lift f w₁.prod • lift f w₂.prod • X k := by
        simp [mul_smul]
      _ ⊆ lift f w₁.prod • X _ := smul_set_subset_smul_set_iff.mpr (hIw₂ hk)
      _ ⊆ X i := hIw₁ hne

name: lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_other_i
statement:
theorem lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_other_i {i j k} (w : NeWord H i j) (hhead : k ≠ i)
    (hlast : k ≠ j) : lift f w.prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro heq1
  have : X k ⊆ X i := by simpa [heq1] using lift_word_ping_pong f X hpp w hlast.symm
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hXnonempty k
  exact (hXdisj hhead).le_bot ⟨hx, this hx⟩

name: lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_eq_last
statement:
theorem lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_eq_last {i} (w : NeWord H i i) :
    lift f w.prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_ne i
  exact lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_other_i f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w hk hk

name: lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_card
statement:
theorem lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_card {i j} (w : NeWord H i j)
    (hcard : 3 ≤ #(H i)) (hheadtail : i ≠ j) : lift f w.prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hn1, hnh⟩ := Cardinal.exists_ne_ne_of_three_le hcard 1 w.head⁻¹
  have hnot1 : h * w.head ≠ 1 := by
    rw [← div_inv_eq_mul]
    exact div_ne_one_of_ne hnh
  let w' : NeWord H i i :=
    NeWord.append (NeWord.mulHead w h hnot1) hheadtail.symm
      (NeWord.singleton h⁻¹ (inv_ne_one.mpr hn1))
  have hw' : lift f w'.prod ≠ 1 :=
    lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_eq_last f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w'
  intro heq1
  apply hw'
  simp [w', heq1]

name: lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_not_empty
statement:
theorem lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_not_empty {i j} (w : NeWord H i j) :
    lift f w.prod ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcard with hcard | hcard
  · obtain ⟨i, h1, h2⟩ := Cardinal.exists_ne_ne_of_three_le hcard i j
    exact lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_other_i f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨k, hcard⟩ := hcard
    by_cases hh : i = k <;> by_cases hl : j = k
    · subst hh
      subst hl
      exact lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_eq_last f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w
    · subst hh
      change j ≠ i at hl
      exact lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_card f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w hcard hl.symm
    · subst hl
      change i ≠ j at hh
      have : lift f w.inv.prod ≠ 1 :=
        lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_head_card f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w.inv hcard hh.symm
      intro heq
      apply this
      simpa using heq
    · change i ≠ k at hh
      change j ≠ k at hl
      exact lift_word_prod_nontrivial_of_other_i f X hXnonempty hXdisj hpp w hh.symm hl.symm

name: empty_of_word_prod_eq_one
statement:
theorem empty_of_word_prod_eq_one {w : Word H} (h : lift f w.prod = 1) :
    w = Word.empty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnotempty

name: lift_injective_of_ping_pong
statement: theorem lift_injective_of_ping_pong : Function.Injective (lift f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one (lift f)).mpr
    rw [(CoprodI.Word.equiv).forall_congr_left]

name: _root_.FreeGroup.injective_lift_of_ping_pong
statement: theorem _root_.FreeGroup.injective_lift_of_ping_pong : Function.Injective (FreeGroup.lift a)
proof:
:= by
  
  have : FreeGroup.lift a =
      (CoprodI.lift fun i => FreeGroup.lift fun _ => a i).comp
        (@freeGroupEquivCoprodI ι).toMonoidHom := by
    ext i
    simp
  rw [this, MonoidHom.coe_comp]
  clear this
  refine Function.Injective.comp ?_ (MulEquiv.injective freeGroupEquivCoprodI)
  
  change Function.Injective (lift fun i : ι => FreeGroup.lift fun _ => a i)
  
  let H : ι → Type _ := fun _i => FreeGroup Unit
  let f : ∀ i, H i →* G := fun i => FreeGroup.lift fun _ => a i
  let X' : ι → Set α := fun i => X i ∪ Y i
  apply lift_injective_of_ping_pong f _ X'
  · show ∀ i, (X' i).Nonempty
    exact fun i => Set.Nonempty.inl (hXnonempty i)
  · show Pairwise (Disjoint on X')
    intro i j hij
    simp only [X']
    apply Disjoint.union_left <;> apply Disjoint.union_right
    · exact hXdisj hij
    · exact hXYdisj i j
    · exact (hXYdisj j i).symm
    · exact hYdisj hij
  · change Pairwise fun i j => ∀ h : H i, h ≠ 1 → f i h • X' j ⊆ X' i
    rintro i j hij
    
    refine FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.forall_congr_left.mpr ?_
    intro n hne1
    change FreeGroup.lift (fun _ => a i) (FreeGroup.of () ^ n) • X' j ⊆ X' i
    simp only [map_zpow, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    change a i ^ n • X' j ⊆ X' i
    have hnne0 : n ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      apply hne1
      simp [H, FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt]
    clear hne1
    simp only [X']
    
    rcases (lt_or_gt_of_ne hnne0).symm with hlt | hgt
    · have h1n : 1 ≤ n := hlt
      calc
        a i ^ n • X' j ⊆ a i ^ n • (Y i)ᶜ :=
          smul_set_mono ((hXYdisj j i).union_left <| hYdisj hij.symm).subset_compl_right
        _ ⊆ X i := by
          clear hnne0 hlt
          induction n, h1n using Int.leInduction with
          | base => rw [zpow_one]; exact hX i
          | succ n _hle hi =>
            calc
              a i ^ (n + 1) • (Y i)ᶜ = (a i ^ n * a i) • (Y i)ᶜ := by rw [zpow_add, zpow_one]
              _ = a i ^ n • a i • (Y i)ᶜ := mul_smul _ _ _
              _ ⊆ a i ^ n • X i := smul_set_mono <| hX i
              _ ⊆ a i ^ n • (Y i)ᶜ := smul_set_mono (hXYdisj i i).subset_compl_right
              _ ⊆ X i := hi
        _ ⊆ X' i := Set.subset_union_left
    · have h1n : n ≤ -1 := by
        apply Int.le_of_lt_add_one
        simpa using hgt
      calc
        a i ^ n • X' j ⊆ a i ^ n • (X i)ᶜ :=
          smul_set_mono ((hXdisj hij.symm).union_left (hXYdisj i j).symm).subset_compl_right
        _ ⊆ Y i := by
          clear hnne0 hgt
          induction n, h1n using Int.leInductionDown with
          | base => rw [zpow_neg, zpow_one]; exact hY i
          | pred n hle hi =>
            calc
              a i ^ (n - 1) • (X i)ᶜ = (a i ^ n * (a i)⁻¹) • (X i)ᶜ := by rw [zpow_sub, zpow_one]
              _ = a i ^ n • (a i)⁻¹ • (X i)ᶜ := mul_smul _ _ _
              _ ⊆ a i ^ n • Y i := smul_set_mono <| hY i
              _ ⊆ a i ^ n • (X i)ᶜ := smul_set_mono (hXYdisj i i).symm.subset_compl_right
              _ ⊆ Y i := hi
        _ ⊆ X' i := Set.subset_union_right
  show _ ∨ ∃ i, 3 ≤ #(H i)
  inhabit ι
  right
  use Inhabited.default
  simp only [H]
  rw [FreeGroup.freeGroupUnitEquivInt.cardinal_eq, Cardinal.mk_denumerable]
  exact natCast_le_aleph0

name: iff_eq_top_or_exists
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma iff_eq_top_or_exists :
    IsSubnormal H ↔ H = ⊤ ∨ ∃ K, H < K ∧ IsSubnormal K ∧ (H.subgroupOf K).Normal where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    induction h with
    | top => simp
    | step H K HK hS hN ih =>
      obtain rfl | ⟨K', HK', hS', hN'⟩ := ih
      · obtain rfl | hH := eq_or_ne H ⊤
        · simp
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⊤, by simp [hH.lt_top , *]⟩
      right
      obtain rfl | hH := eq_or_ne H K
      · use K'
      · exact ⟨K, by simpa [*] using HK.lt_of_ne hH⟩
  mpr h := by
    obtain rfl | ⟨K, HK, Ksn, h⟩ := h
    · exact top
    · exact step _ _ HK.le Ksn h

name: exists_normal_and_le_and_lt_top_of_ne

subgroup. -/]
lemma exists_normal_and_le_and_lt_top_of_ne (hN : H.IsSubnormal) (ne_top : H ≠ ⊤) :

proof:

  | top => contradiction
  | step H K h_le hSubn hN ih =>

    · grind

proof:

  · simp
  · grind only [iff_eq_top_or_exists, exists_normal_and_le_and_lt_top_of_ne]

name: isSubnormal_iff
statement:
@[to_additive /
subgroups, each normal in the following one.

The sequence stabilises once it reaches `⊤`, which is guaranteed at the asserted `n`. -/]
lemma isSubnormal_iff : H.IsSubnormal ↔
    ∃ n, ∃ f : ℕ → Subgroup G,
    (Monotone f) ∧ (∀ i, ((f i).subgroupOf (f (i + 1))).Normal) ∧
      f 0 = H ∧ f n = ⊤ where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    induction h with
    | top =>
      use 0, fun _ ↦ ⊤, ?_, (by simp)
      exact monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun _ ↦ le_top
    | step H K h_le hSubn hN ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, f, hf, f0, fn⟩ := ih
      use n + 1, fun | 0 => H | n + 1 => f n, ?_, ?_
      · grind
      · refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ ?_
        grind only [monotone_iff_forall_lt]
      · grind
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨n, hyps⟩
    revert H
    induction n with
    | zero => simp_all
    | succ n ih =>
      rintro J ⟨F, hF, H_le, rfl, ih1⟩
      refine step _ _ (hF <| Nat.le_add_right 0 1) ?_ (H_le _)
      refine ih ⟨fun n ↦ F (n + 1), ?_⟩
      grind only [Monotone, monotone_iff_forall_lt]

name: trans'
statement:
@[to_additive /

This version involves an explicit `subtype`; the version `IsSubnormal.trans` does not. -/]
protected
lemma trans' {H : Subgroup K} (Hsn : IsSubnormal H) (Ksn : IsSubnormal K) :
    IsSubnormal (H.map K.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  induction Hsn with
  | top =>
    rwa [Subgroup.map_top, range_subtype]
  | step A B h_le hSubn hN ih =>
    refine step (A.map K.subtype) (B.map K.subtype) (map_mono h_le) ih ?_
    rw [normal_subgroupOf_iff_le_normalizer h_le] at hN
    rw [normal_subgroupOf_iff_le_normalizer (map_mono h_le)]
    exact le_trans (map_mono hN) (le_normalizer_map _)

name: trans

@[to_additive /
additive subgroup of `G`, then `H` is a subnormal additive subgroup of `G`. -/]

name: is_descending_rev_series_of_is_ascending
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem is_descending_rev_series_of_is_ascending {H : ℕ → Subgroup G} {n : ℕ} (hn : H n = ⊤)
    (hasc : IsAscendingCentralSeries H) : IsDescendingCentralSeries fun m : ℕ => H (n - m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, hH⟩ := hasc
  refine ⟨hn, fun x m hx g => ?_⟩
  dsimp at hx
  by_cases! hm : n ≤ m
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_of_le hm, h0, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hx
    subst hx
    rw [commutatorElement_one_left]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · apply hH
    convert! hx using 1
    rw [tsub_add_eq_add_tsub (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm), Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_add_right]

name: is_ascending_rev_series_of_is_descending
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem is_ascending_rev_series_of_is_descending {H : ℕ → Subgroup G} {n : ℕ} (hn : H n = ⊥)
    (hdesc : IsDescendingCentralSeries H) : IsAscendingCentralSeries fun m : ℕ => H (n - m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, hH⟩ := hdesc
  refine ⟨hn, fun x m hx g => ?_⟩
  dsimp only at hx ⊢
  by_cases! hm : n ≤ m
  · have hnm : n - m = 0 := tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mpr hm
    rw [hnm, h0]
    exact mem_top _
  · convert! hH x _ hx g using 1
    rw [tsub_add_eq_add_tsub (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm), Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_add_right]

name: nilpotent_iff_finite_descending_central_series

which reaches the trivial group in a finite time. -/]

proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotent_iff_finite_ascending_central_series]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, H, hH, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, fun m => H (n - m), is_descending_rev_series_of_is_ascending G hn hH, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [tsub_self]
    exact hH.1
  · rintro ⟨n, H, hH, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, fun m => H (n - m), is_ascending_rev_series_of_is_descending G hn hH, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [tsub_self]
    exact hH.1

statement:

theorem lowerCentralSeries_succ (n : ℕ) :
    S.lowerCentralSeries (n + 1) = ⁅S.lowerCentralSeries n, S⁆
proof: := rfl

name: top_lowerCentralSeries_one
statement:
@[to_additive top_lowerCentralSeries_one]
theorem top_lowerCentralSeries_one : (⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries 1 = _root_.commutator G
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_lowerCentralSeries_succ_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mem_lowerCentralSeries_succ_iff (n : ℕ) (q : G) :
    q ∈ S.lowerCentralSeries (n + 1) ↔
    q ∈ closure { x | ∃ p ∈ S.lowerCentralSeries n, ∃ q ∈ S, ⁅p, q⁆ = x }
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: self_le_normalizer_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem self_le_normalizer_lowerCentralSeries :
    ∀ n, S ≤ Subgroup.normalizer (S.lowerCentralSeries n : Set G)
  | 0 => Subgroup.le_normalizer
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ]
    apply normalizer_commutator_ge_right

@[to_additive]

name: lowerCentralSeries_antitone
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_antitone : Antitone S.lowerCentralSeries
proof:
:= by
  refine antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun n => ?_
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, ← le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_left]

name: map_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
theorem map_lowerCentralSeries {K : Type*} [Group K] (f : G →* K) (n : ℕ) :
    (S.lowerCentralSeries n).map f = (S.map f).lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d hd =>
    rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, lowerCentralSeries_succ, Subgroup.map_commutator, hd]

name: top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
coincides with the lower central series of `H` viewed as its own additive group, mapped back
to `G`. -/]
theorem top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries (H : Subgroup G) (n : ℕ) :
    (lowerCentralSeries ⊤ n).map H.subtype = H.lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_lowerCentralSeries, Subgroup.map_top, subtype_range]

name: isNilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
@[to_additive /
vanishes. -/]
theorem isNilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries :
    Group.IsNilpotent S ↔ ∃ n, S.lowerCentralSeries n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotent_iff_finite_descending_central_series]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, H, hH, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have h1 := descending_central_series_ge_lower H hH n
    rw [hn, le_bot_iff] at h1
    rw [← top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries, h1, Subgroup.map_bot]
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨n, lowerCentralSeries ⊤, lowerCentralSeries_isDescendingCentralSeries, ?_⟩
    rwa [← map_subtype_inj, map_bot, top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries]

name: nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries
statement:
@[to_additive /
reaches the trivial additive subgroup. -/]
theorem nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries :
    IsNilpotent G ↔ ∃ n, lowerCentralSeries (⊤ : Subgroup G) n = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Group.isNilpotent_top.symm.trans (isNilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries ⊤)

name: Group.nilpotencyClass_of_not_nilpotent
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Group.nilpotencyClass_of_not_nilpotent (hG : ¬ IsNilpotent G) :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G = 0
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right hG

name: Group.nilpotencyClass_def
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Group.nilpotencyClass_def :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G = Nat.find (IsNilpotent.nilpotent G)
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left hG

name: upperCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem upperCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass :
    upperCentralSeries G (Group.nilpotencyClass G) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nilpotencyClass_def, Nat.find_spec (IsNilpotent.nilpotent G)]

name: upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le {n : ℕ} :
    upperCentralSeries G n = ⊤ ↔ Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [nilpotencyClass_def]
    exact Nat.find_le h
  · intro h
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← upperCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass]
    exact upperCentralSeries_mono _ h

name: least_ascending_central_series_length_eq_nilpotencyClass
statement:
@[to_additive /
ascending central series reaches `G` in its `n`-th term. -/]
theorem least_ascending_central_series_length_eq_nilpotencyClass :
    Nat.find ((nilpotent_iff_finite_ascending_central_series G).mp hG) =
    Group.nilpotencyClass G
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotencyClass_def]
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.find_mono ?_) (Nat.find_mono ?_)
  · intro n hn
    exact ⟨upperCentralSeries G, upperCentralSeries_isAscendingCentralSeries G, hn⟩
  · rintro n ⟨H, ⟨hH, hn⟩⟩
    rw [← top_le_iff, ← hn]
    exact ascending_central_series_le_upper H hH n

name: least_descending_central_series_length_eq_nilpotencyClass
statement:
@[to_additive /
descending central series reaches `⊥` in its `n`-th term. -/]
theorem least_descending_central_series_length_eq_nilpotencyClass :
    Nat.find ((nilpotent_iff_finite_descending_central_series G).mp hG) =
    Group.nilpotencyClass G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← least_ascending_central_series_length_eq_nilpotencyClass]
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.find_mono ?_) (Nat.find_mono ?_)
  · rintro n ⟨H, ⟨hH, hn⟩⟩
    refine ⟨fun m => H (n - m), is_descending_rev_series_of_is_ascending G hn hH, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [tsub_self]
    exact hH.1
  · rintro n ⟨H, ⟨hH, hn⟩⟩
    refine ⟨fun m => H (n - m), is_ascending_rev_series_of_is_descending G hn hH, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [tsub_self]
    exact hH.1

name: lowerCentralSeries_length_eq_nilpotencyClass
statement:
@[to_additive /
central series. -/]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_length_eq_nilpotencyClass :
    Nat.find (nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries.mp hG) = Group.nilpotencyClass (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← least_descending_central_series_length_eq_nilpotencyClass]
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.find_mono ?_) (Nat.find_mono ?_)
  · rintro n ⟨H, ⟨hH, hn⟩⟩
    rw [← le_bot_iff, ← hn]
    exact descending_central_series_ge_lower H hH n
  · rintro n h
    exact ⟨lowerCentralSeries ⊤, ⟨lowerCentralSeries_isDescendingCentralSeries, h⟩⟩

name: lowerCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass :
    lowerCentralSeries (⊤ : Subgroup G) (Group.nilpotencyClass G) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← lowerCentralSeries_length_eq_nilpotencyClass]
  exact Nat.find_spec (nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries.mp hG)

name: lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le {n : ℕ} :
    lowerCentralSeries (⊤ : Subgroup G) n = ⊥ ↔ Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← lowerCentralSeries_length_eq_nilpotencyClass]
    exact Nat.find_le h
  · intro h
    rw [eq_bot_iff, ← lowerCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass]
    exact lowerCentralSeries_antitone _ h

name: lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_upperCentralSeries_eq_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_upperCentralSeries_eq_top {n : ℕ} :
    lowerCentralSeries (G := G) ⊤ n = ⊥ ↔ upperCentralSeries G n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · have : IsNilpotent G := nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries.mpr ⟨n, h⟩
    rwa [upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le,
      ← lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le]
  · have : IsNilpotent G := ⟨n, h⟩
    rwa [lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le,
      ← upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le]

name: lowerCentralSeries_le_self
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_le_self (S : Subgroup G) (n : ℕ) :
    S.lowerCentralSeries n ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  simpa using S.lowerCentralSeries_antitone (Nat.zero_le n)

name: lowerCentralSeries_mono
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_mono (n : ℕ) :
    Monotone (fun S : Subgroup G => S.lowerCentralSeries n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => intro S T h; simpa
  | succ d hd => intro S T h; simp only [lowerCentralSeries_succ]; exact commutator_mono (hd h) h

name: lowerCentralSeries_map_subtype_le
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := deprecated "Use `top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries` and \
  `lowerCentralSeries_mono` instead." (since := "2026-05-27"))]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_map_subtype_le (H : Subgroup G) (n : ℕ) :
    ((⊤ : Subgroup H).lowerCentralSeries n).map H.subtype ≤ lowerCentralSeries ⊤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries]
