name: lowerCentralSeries.map
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := deprecated "Use `map_lowerCentralSeries` and \
  `lowerCentralSeries_mono` instead." (since := "2026-05-28"))]
theorem lowerCentralSeries.map {K : Type*} [Group K] (f : G →* K) (n : ℕ) :
    ((⊤ : Subgroup G).lowerCentralSeries n).map f ≤ (⊤ : Subgroup K).lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_lowerCentralSeries]
  exact lowerCentralSeries_mono n le_top

name: nilpotencyClass_le
statement:
@[to_additive /
class of the additive group. -/]
theorem nilpotencyClass_le (H : Subgroup G) [hG : IsNilpotent G] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass H ≤ Group.nilpotencyClass G
proof:
:= by
  repeat rw [← lowerCentralSeries_length_eq_nilpotencyClass]
  classical apply Nat.find_mono
  intro n hG
  rw [← map_subtype_inj, map_bot, top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries, eq_bot_iff, ← hG]
  exact H.lowerCentralSeries_mono n le_top

name: isNilpotent_of_lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot
proof:
:=
  (isNilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries S).mpr ⟨n, h⟩

name: lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_of_nilpotencyClass_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_of_nilpotencyClass_le {S : Subgroup G}
    [Group.IsNilpotent S] {n : ℕ} (hn : Group.nilpotencyClass S ≤ n) :
    S.lowerCentralSeries n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← top_subtype_lowerCentralSeries,
    lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le.mpr hn, map_bot]

name: upperCentralSeries.map
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem upperCentralSeries.map {H : Type*} [Group H] {f : G →* H} (h : Function.Surjective f)
    (n : ℕ) : Subgroup.map f (upperCentralSeries G n) ≤ upperCentralSeries H n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d hd =>
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx : x ∈ upperCentralSeries G d.succ, rfl⟩ y'
    rcases h y' with ⟨y, rfl⟩
    simpa using! hd (mem_map_of_mem f (hx y))

name: lowerCentralSeries_succ_eq_bot
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lowerCentralSeries_succ_eq_bot (S : Subgroup G) {n : ℕ}
    (h : S.lowerCentralSeries n ≤ center G) :
    S.lowerCentralSeries (n + 1) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, commutator_def, closure_eq_bot_iff, Set.subset_singleton_iff]
  rintro x ⟨y, hy1, z, _, rfl⟩
  rw [commutatorElement_def, mul_assoc, ← mul_inv_rev, mul_inv_eq_one, eq_comm]
  exact mem_center_iff.mp (h hy1) z

name: isNilpotent_of_ker_le_center
statement:
@[to_additive /
homomorphism is contained in the center. -/]
theorem isNilpotent_of_ker_le_center {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (hf1 : f.ker ≤ center G)
    [IsNilpotent H] : IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries]
  rcases nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries.mp ‹_› with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n + 1, lowerCentralSeries_succ_eq_bot ⊤
    (le_trans ((Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff _).mp ?_) hf1)⟩
  rw [map_lowerCentralSeries, ← le_bot_iff]
  exact hn ▸ Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono n le_top

name: nilpotencyClass_le_of_ker_le_center
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem nilpotencyClass_le_of_ker_le_center {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H)
    (hf1 : f.ker ≤ center G) [IsNilpotent H] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ Group.nilpotencyClass H + 1
proof:
:= by
  have : IsNilpotent G := isNilpotent_of_ker_le_center f hf1
  rw [← lowerCentralSeries_length_eq_nilpotencyClass]
  classical apply Nat.find_min'
  refine lowerCentralSeries_succ_eq_bot ⊤
    (le_trans ((Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff _).mp ?_) hf1)
  rw [map_lowerCentralSeries, ← le_bot_iff,
    ← lowerCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass (G := H)]
  exact Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_mono _ le_top

name: nilpotent_of_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive /
nilpotent. -/]
theorem nilpotent_of_surjective {G' : Type*} [Group G'] [h : IsNilpotent G] (f : G →* G')
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsNilpotent G'
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨n, hn⟩
  use n
  apply eq_top_iff.mpr
  calc
    ⊤ = f.range := symm (f.range_eq_top_of_surjective hf)
    _ = Subgroup.map f ⊤ := MonoidHom.range_eq_map _
    _ = Subgroup.map f (upperCentralSeries G n) := by rw [hn]
    _ ≤ upperCentralSeries G' n := upperCentralSeries.map hf n

name: nilpotencyClass_le_of_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive /
nilpotent additive group is less or equal the nilpotency class of the domain. -/]
theorem nilpotencyClass_le_of_surjective {G' : Type*} [Group G'] (f : G →* G')
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) [h : IsNilpotent G] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G' ≤ Group.nilpotencyClass G
proof:
:= by
  have := nilpotent_of_surjective _ hf
  rw [nilpotencyClass_def, nilpotencyClass_def]
  classical apply Nat.find_mono
  intro n hn
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  calc
    ⊤ = f.range := symm (f.range_eq_top_of_surjective hf)
    _ = Subgroup.map f ⊤ := MonoidHom.range_eq_map _
    _ = Subgroup.map f (upperCentralSeries G n) := by rw [hn]
    _ ≤ upperCentralSeries G' n := upperCentralSeries.map hf n

name: nilpotent_of_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem nilpotent_of_mulEquiv {G' : Type*} [Group G'] [_h : IsNilpotent G] (f : G ≃* G') :
    IsNilpotent G'
proof:
:=
  nilpotent_of_surjective f.toMonoidHom (MulEquiv.surjective f)

name: nilpotencyClass_quotient_le
statement:
@[to_additive /
of `G`. -/]
theorem nilpotencyClass_quotient_le (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] [_h : IsNilpotent G] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass (G ⧸ H) ≤ Group.nilpotencyClass G
proof:
:=
  nilpotencyClass_le_of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' H) QuotientGroup.mk_surjective

name: comap_center_subst
proof: := by subst h; rfl

name: comap_upperCentralSeries_quotient_center
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem comap_upperCentralSeries_quotient_center (n : ℕ) :
    comap (mk' (center G)) (upperCentralSeries (G ⧸ center G) n) = upperCentralSeries G n.succ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [upperCentralSeries_zero, MonoidHom.comap_bot, ker_mk',
      (upperCentralSeries_one G).symm]
  | succ n ih =>
    let Hn := upperCentralSeries (G ⧸ center G) n
    calc
      comap (mk' (center G)) (upperCentralSeriesStep Hn) =
          comap (mk' (center G)) (comap (mk' Hn) (center ((G ⧸ center G) ⧸ Hn))) := by
        rw [upperCentralSeriesStep_eq_comap_center]
      _ = comap (mk' (comap (mk' (center G)) Hn)) (center (G ⧸ comap (mk' (center G)) Hn)) :=
        QuotientGroup.comap_comap_center
      _ = comap (mk' (upperCentralSeries G n.succ)) (center (G ⧸ upperCentralSeries G n.succ)) :=
        (comap_center_subst ih)
      _ = upperCentralSeriesStep (upperCentralSeries G n.succ) :=
        symm (upperCentralSeriesStep_eq_comap_center _)

name: nilpotencyClass_zero_iff_subsingleton
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem nilpotencyClass_zero_iff_subsingleton [IsNilpotent G] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G = 0 ↔ Subsingleton G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Group.nilpotencyClass_def, Nat.find_eq_zero, upperCentralSeries_zero,
    subsingleton_iff_bot_eq_top, Subgroup.subsingleton_iff]

name: of_quotient_center_nilpotent
statement: theorem of_quotient_center_nilpotent (h : IsNilpotent (G ⧸ center G)) : IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.nilpotent
  use n.succ
  simp [← comap_upperCentralSeries_quotient_center, hn]

name: nilpotencyClass_quotient_center
statement:
theorem nilpotencyClass_quotient_center :
    Group.nilpotencyClass (G ⧸ center G) = Group.nilpotencyClass G - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hH : IsNilpotent G; swap
  · rw [nilpotencyClass_of_not_nilpotent hH, zero_tsub, nilpotencyClass_of_not_nilpotent]
    exact mt of_quotient_center_nilpotent hH
  generalize hn : Group.nilpotencyClass G = n
  rcases n with (rfl | n)
  · simp only [nilpotencyClass_zero_iff_subsingleton, zero_tsub] at *
    exact Quotient.instSubsingletonQuotient (leftRel (center G))
  · suffices Group.nilpotencyClass (G ⧸ center G) = n by simpa
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le.mp
      apply comap_injective (f := (mk' (center G))) Quot.mk_surjective
      rw [comap_upperCentralSeries_quotient_center, comap_top, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← hn]
      exact upperCentralSeries_nilpotencyClass
    · apply le_of_add_le_add_right
      calc
        n + 1 = Group.nilpotencyClass G := hn.symm
        _ ≤ Group.nilpotencyClass (G ⧸ center G) + 1 :=
          nilpotencyClass_le_of_ker_le_center _ (le_of_eq (ker_mk' _))

name: nilpotencyClass_eq_quotient_center_plus_one
statement:
@[to_additive /
by the center -/]
theorem nilpotencyClass_eq_quotient_center_plus_one [hH : IsNilpotent G] [Nontrivial G] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G = Group.nilpotencyClass (G ⧸ center G) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotencyClass_quotient_center]
  rcases h : Group.nilpotencyClass G with ⟨⟩
  · exfalso
    rw [nilpotencyClass_zero_iff_subsingleton] at h
    apply false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton G
  · simp

name: nilpotent_center_quotient_ind
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim) /
The base case is a trivial group (`subsingleton G`), and in the induction step, one can assume the
hypothesis for the additive group quotiented by its center. -/]
theorem nilpotent_center_quotient_ind {P : ∀ (G) [Group G] [IsNilpotent G], Prop}
    (G : Type*) [Group G] [IsNilpotent G]
    (hbase : ∀ (G) [Group G] [Subsingleton G], P G)
    (hstep : ∀ (G) [Group G] [IsNilpotent G], P (G ⧸ center G) → P G) : P G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, h⟩ : ∃ n, Group.nilpotencyClass G = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  induction n generalizing G with
  | zero =>
    have := nilpotencyClass_zero_iff_subsingleton.mp h
    exact hbase _
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : Group.nilpotencyClass (G ⧸ center G) = n := by
      simp [nilpotencyClass_quotient_center, h]
    exact hstep _ (ih _ hn)

name: Subgroup.derived_le_lower_central
statement:
theorem Subgroup.derived_le_lower_central (n : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries G n ≤ lowerCentralSeries ⊤ n

  | succ i ih => apply commutator_mono ih; simp

name: Subgroup.upperCentralSeries_one_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.upperCentralSeries_one_eq_top_iff :
    upperCentralSeries G 1 = ⊤ ↔ IsMulCommutative G

name: Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_one_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_one_eq_bot_iff :
    lowerCentralSeries (G := G) ⊤ 1 = ⊥ ↔ IsMulCommutative G

name: Group.IsNilpotent.nilpotencyClass_le_one_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Group.IsNilpotent.nilpotencyClass_le_one_iff [IsNilpotent G] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass G ≤ 1 ↔ IsMulCommutative G

name: CommGroup.nilpotencyClass_le_one

theorem CommGroup.nilpotencyClass_le_one {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] :

name: upperCentralSeries.eq_ge_of_eq_succ
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma upperCentralSeries.eq_ge_of_eq_succ {a b : ℕ} (ab : a ≤ b)
    (hn : upperCentralSeries G a = upperCentralSeries G (a + 1)) :
    upperCentralSeries G a = upperCentralSeries G b
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_induction rfl ?_ b ab
  grind only [eq_def, upperCentralSeriesAux.eq_def]

name: upperCentralSeries.eq_ge_of_eq_gt
statement:
@[to_additive /
are equal, then they are all equal, starting from the smaller index. -/]
lemma upperCentralSeries.eq_ge_of_eq_gt {a b c : ℕ} (ab : a ≠ b) (ac : a ≤ c)
    (hn : upperCentralSeries G a = upperCentralSeries G b) :
    upperCentralSeries G a = upperCentralSeries G c
proof:
:= by
  wlog ab : a < b
  · grind
  refine eq_ge_of_eq_succ ac (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
  · exact upperCentralSeries_mono _ <| Nat.le_succ ..
  · rw [hn]
    exact upperCentralSeries_mono _ (by grind)

name: upperCentralSeries.eq_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma upperCentralSeries.eq_top [IsNilpotent G] {a b : ℕ} (ab : a ≠ b)
    (hn : upperCentralSeries G a = upperCentralSeries G b) :
    upperCentralSeries G a = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  grind only [IsNilpotent.nilpotent', IsNilpotent.nilpotent,
    upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le, eq_ge_of_eq_gt]

name: nilpotencyClass_le_of_upperCentralSeries_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma nilpotencyClass_le_of_upperCentralSeries_eq {a b : ℕ} (ab : a < b)
    (hn : upperCentralSeries G a = upperCentralSeries G b) :
    nilpotencyClass G ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hG : IsNilpotent G
  · grind only [IsNilpotent.nilpotent', IsNilpotent.nilpotent, upperCentralSeries.eq_top,
      upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le]
  · rw [nilpotencyClass_of_not_nilpotent hG]
    apply Nat.zero_le

name: upperCentralSeries.StrictMonoOn
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma upperCentralSeries.StrictMonoOn :
    StrictMonoOn (upperCentralSeries G) (Set.Iic (nilpotencyClass G))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hG : IsNilpotent G
  · intros a ha b hb ab
    simp only [Set.mem_Iic] at ha hb
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne
    · exact upperCentralSeries_mono _ ab.le
    · grind only [IsNilpotent.nilpotent', IsNilpotent.nilpotent, eq_top,
        upperCentralSeries_eq_top_iff_nilpotencyClass_le]
  · rw [nilpotencyClass_of_not_nilpotent hG, ← Nat.bot_eq_zero, Set.Iic_bot]
    apply Set.strictMonoOn_singleton

name: upperCentralSeries.card_image_eq_of_le_nilpotencyClass
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma upperCentralSeries.card_image_eq_of_le_nilpotencyClass {a : ℕ}
    (h2 : a ≤ nilpotencyClass G) :
    (upperCentralSeries G '' (Set.Iic a)).ncard = a + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ncard_eq_of_bijective (fun _ => upperCentralSeries G ·) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · grind
  · grind
  · intros i j hi hj
    refine (upperCentralSeries.StrictMonoOn G).injOn ?_ ?_ <;> grind

name: Group.IsNilpotent.inf_center_ne_bot_of_normal
statement:
@[to_additive /
nontrivially. -/]
theorem Group.IsNilpotent.inf_center_ne_bot_of_normal [Group.IsNilpotent G]
    {H : Subgroup G} [H.Normal] (hH : H ≠ ⊥) : H ⊓ center G ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hk : ∃ n, H ⊓ lowerCentralSeries ⊤ n ≠ ⊥ ∧ H ⊓ lowerCentralSeries ⊤ (n + 1) = ⊥ := by
    have : H ⊓ lowerCentralSeries ⊤ 0 ≠ ⊥ := by simpa
    have key : ∃ k, H ⊓ lowerCentralSeries ⊤ k = ⊥ := ⟨nilpotencyClass G, by simp⟩
    exact ⟨Nat.find key - 1, by grind [Nat.find_min key]⟩
  obtain ⟨k, k_min, k_spec⟩ := hk
  refine ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot k_min (le_inf inf_le_left ?_)
  rw [← commutator_top_right_eq_bot_iff_le_center, eq_bot_iff, ← k_spec, lowerCentralSeries_succ]
  exact le_inf ((commutator_le_left _ _).trans inf_le_left) (commutator_mono inf_le_right le_rfl)

name: Group.IsNilpotent.center_ne_bot
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Group.IsNilpotent.center_ne_bot [Nontrivial G] [IsNilpotent G] : center G ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inf_center_ne_bot_of_normal top_ne_bot

name: Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_prod (S₁ : Subgroup G₁) (S₂ : Subgroup G₂) (n : ℕ) :
    (S₁.prod S₂).lowerCentralSeries n =
      (S₁.lowerCentralSeries n).prod (S₂.lowerCentralSeries n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp_rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, ih, commutator_prod_prod]

name: Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod
statement:
theorem Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_prod (n : ℕ) :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (G₁ × G₂)).lowerCentralSeries n =
      ((⊤ : Subgroup G₁).lowerCentralSeries n).prod ((⊤ : Subgroup G₂).lowerCentralSeries n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lowerCentralSeries_prod, top_prod_top]

name: Group.nilpotencyClass_prod
statement:
@[to_additive /
factors. -/]
theorem Group.nilpotencyClass_prod [IsNilpotent G₁] [IsNilpotent G₂] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass (G₁ × G₂) =
    max (Group.nilpotencyClass G₁) (Group.nilpotencyClass G₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun k => ?_
  simp only [max_le_iff, ← lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le,
    top_lowerCentralSeries_prod, prod_eq_bot_iff]

name: Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_pi_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_pi_le (Ss : ∀ i, Subgroup (Gs i)) (n : ℕ) :
    (Subgroup.pi Set.univ Ss).lowerCentralSeries n ≤ Subgroup.pi Set.univ
      fun i => (Ss i).lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ]
    grw [commutator_mono ih le_rfl, commutator_pi_pi_le]

name: Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_pi_le
statement:
theorem Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_pi_le (n : ℕ) :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (∀ i, Gs i)).lowerCentralSeries n ≤ Subgroup.pi Set.univ
      fun i => (⊤ : Subgroup (Gs i)).lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pi_top (I := Set.univ)]
  exact lowerCentralSeries_pi_le _ _

name: Group.isNilpotent_pi_of_bounded_class
statement:
@[to_additive /
bounded. -/]
theorem Group.isNilpotent_pi_of_bounded_class [∀ i, IsNilpotent (Gs i)] (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, Group.nilpotencyClass (Gs i) ≤ n) : IsNilpotent (∀ i, Gs i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotent_iff_lowerCentralSeries]
  refine ⟨n, eq_bot_iff.mpr <| (top_lowerCentralSeries_pi_le _).trans ?_⟩
  rw [le_bot_iff, pi_eq_bot_iff]
  exact fun i => lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le.mpr (h i)

name: Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_pi_of_finite
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.lowerCentralSeries_pi_of_finite [Finite η] (Ss : ∀ i, Subgroup (Gs i)) (n : ℕ) :
    (Subgroup.pi Set.univ Ss).lowerCentralSeries n = Subgroup.pi Set.univ
      fun i => (Ss i).lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp_rw [lowerCentralSeries_succ, ih, commutator_pi_pi_of_finite]

name: Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_pi_of_finite
statement:
theorem Subgroup.top_lowerCentralSeries_pi_of_finite [Finite η] (n : ℕ) :
    (⊤ : Subgroup (∀ i, Gs i)).lowerCentralSeries n = Subgroup.pi Set.univ
      fun i => (⊤ : Subgroup (Gs i)).lowerCentralSeries n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pi_top (I := Set.univ), lowerCentralSeries_pi_of_finite]

name: Group.nilpotencyClass_pi
statement:
@[to_additive /
the factors. -/]
theorem Group.nilpotencyClass_pi [Fintype η] [∀ i, IsNilpotent (Gs i)] :
    Group.nilpotencyClass (∀ i, Gs i) = Finset.univ.sup fun i => Group.nilpotencyClass (Gs i)
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_forall_ge_iff
  intro k
  simp only [Finset.sup_le_iff, ← lowerCentralSeries_eq_bot_iff_nilpotencyClass_le,
    top_lowerCentralSeries_pi_of_finite, pi_eq_bot_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_imp_iff]

name: nilpotencyClass_le_one_of_isSimple_of_isNilpotent
statement:
lemma nilpotencyClass_le_one_of_isSimple_of_isNilpotent [IsSimpleGroup G] [IsNilpotent G] :
    nilpotencyClass G ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  CommGroup.nilpotencyClass_le_one

name: normalizerCondition_of_isNilpotent
statement: theorem normalizerCondition_of_isNilpotent [h : IsNilpotent G] : NormalizerCondition G
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [normalizerCondition_iff_only_full_group_self_normalizing]
  apply @nilpotent_center_quotient_ind _ G _ _ <;> clear! G
  · intro G _ _ H _
    exact @Subsingleton.elim _ Unique.instSubsingleton _ _
  · intro G _ _ ih H hH
    have hch : center G ≤ H := Subgroup.center_le_normalizer H |>.trans (le_of_eq hH)
    have hkh : (mk' (center G)).ker ≤ H := by simpa using hch
    have hsur : Function.Surjective (mk' (center G)) := Quot.mk_surjective
    let H' := H.map (mk' (center G))
    have hH' : normalizer H' = H' := by
      apply comap_injective hsur
      rw [comap_normalizer_eq_of_surjective _ hsur, comap_map_eq_self hkh]
      exact hH
    apply map_injective_of_ker_le (mk' (center G)) hkh le_top
    exact (ih H' hH').trans (symm (map_top_of_surjective _ hsur))

name: IsNilpotent.commute_of_orderOf_coprime
statement:
@[to_additive /
coprime. -/]
theorem IsNilpotent.commute_of_orderOf_coprime [IsNilpotent G] {x y : G}
    (h : (orderOf x).Coprime (orderOf y)) : Commute x y
proof:
:= by
  revert x y
  apply @nilpotent_center_quotient_ind _ G _ _ (by simp +contextual)
  intro G _ _ ih x y h
  have hcomm : ∀ g : G, Commute g ⁅x, y⁆ := by
    simp_rw [commute_iff_eq, ← mem_center_iff, ← eq_one_iff, ← mk'_apply,
      map_commutatorElement, commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute]
    apply ih <| h.of_dvd ?_ ?_ <;> apply orderOf_map_dvd
  rw [← commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute, ← orderOf_eq_one_iff, ← Nat.dvd_one, ← h.gcd_eq_one,
    Nat.dvd_gcd_iff, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one,
    (hcomm x).commutatorElement_pow_left, (hcomm y).commutatorElement_pow_right]
  simp

name: IsPGroup.isNilpotent
statement:
theorem IsPGroup.isNilpotent [Finite G] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (h : IsPGroup p G) :
    IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  induction G using Finite.induction_subsingleton_or_nontrivial generalizing hG with
  | hbase => infer_instance
  | hstep G ih =>
    have hcq : Nat.card (G ⧸ center G) < Nat.card G := by
      rw [card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup (center G)]
      apply lt_mul_of_one_lt_right Nat.card_pos
      exact (Subgroup.one_lt_card_iff_ne_bot _).mpr (ne_of_gt h.bot_lt_center)
    have hnq : IsNilpotent (G ⧸ center G) := ih _ hcq (h.to_quotient (center G))
    exact of_quotient_center_nilpotent hnq

name: Group.isNilpotent_of_product_of_sylow_group
statement:
theorem Group.isNilpotent_of_product_of_sylow_group
    (e : (∀ p : (Nat.card G).primeFactors, ∀ P : Sylow p G, (↑P : Subgroup G)) ≃* G) :
    IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  let ps := (Nat.card G).primeFactors
  have : ∀ (p : ps) (P : Sylow p G), IsNilpotent (↑P : Subgroup G) := by
    intro p P
    have : Fact (Nat.Prime ↑p) := Fact.mk <| Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.2
    exact P.isPGroup'.isNilpotent
  exact nilpotent_of_mulEquiv e

name: Group.isNilpotent_of_finite_tfae
statement:
theorem Group.isNilpotent_of_finite_tfae :
    List.TFAE
      [IsNilpotent G, NormalizerCondition G, ∀ H : Subgroup G, IsCoatom H → H.Normal,
        ∀ (p : ℕ) (_hp : Fact p.Prime) (P : Sylow p G), (↑P : Subgroup G).Normal,
        Nonempty
          ((∀ p : (Nat.card G).primeFactors, ∀ P : Sylow p G, (↑P : Subgroup G)) ≃* G)]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := @normalizerCondition_of_isNilpotent _ _
  tfae_have 2 → 3
  | h, H => NormalizerCondition.normal_of_coatom H h
  tfae_have 3 → 4
  | h, p, _, P => Sylow.normal_of_all_max_subgroups_normal h _
  tfae_have 4 → 5
  | h => Nonempty.intro (Sylow.directProductOfNormal fun {p hp hP} => h p hp hP)
  tfae_have 5 → 1
  | ⟨e⟩ => isNilpotent_of_product_of_sylow_group e
  tfae_finish

name: Group.IsNilpotent.prime_dvd_card_center
statement:
lemma Group.IsNilpotent.prime_dvd_card_center [IsNilpotent G] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (hcard : p ∣ Nat.card G) : p ∣ Nat.card (center G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain P : Sylow p G := Classical.arbitrary ..
  refine dvd_trans ?_ <| (↑P ⊓ center G).card_dvd_of_le inf_le_right
  have hnt := mt (eq_bot_iff_card _).mpr (inf_center_ne_bot_of_normal (P.ne_bot_of_dvd_card hcard))
  exact P.isPGroup'.to_inf_left.card_eq_or_dvd.resolve_left hnt

name: Group.IsNilpotent.exists_normal_index_eq_of_dvd_card
statement:
theorem Group.IsNilpotent.exists_normal_index_eq_of_dvd_card [IsNilpotent G] {k : ℕ}
    (hdvd : k ∣ Nat.card G) : ∃ H : Subgroup G, H.index = k ∧ H.Normal
proof:
:= by
  induction hm : Nat.card G using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing k G with | h m ih =>
  have ⟨m', hmul⟩ := hdvd
  by_cases hm1 : m' = 1
  · refine ⟨⊥, by simp [hmul, hm1], normal_bot⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, m'', rfl⟩ : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ m' := m'.ne_one_iff_exists_prime_dvd.mp hm1
    obtain ⟨N, hNcard, hN⟩ : ∃ N : Subgroup G, Nat.card N = p ∧ N.Normal := by
      suffices ∃ (H : Subgroup G), Nat.card H = p ^ 1 ∧ ⊥ ≤ H ∧ H ≤ center G by
        grind [normal_of_le_center]
      refine Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime_le_le hp (by simp) ?_ bot_le
      exact prime_dvd_card_center (hp := ⟨by simpa⟩) ⟨k * m'', by grind⟩
    obtain ⟨K, hKcard, hK⟩ : ∃ K : Subgroup (G ⧸ N), K.index = k ∧ K.Normal := by
      refine ih (Nat.card (G ⧸ N)) ?_ ?_ rfl
      · rw [← hm, N.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup, hNcard]
        exact lt_mul_right Nat.card_pos hp.one_lt
      · refine ⟨m'', Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hp.pos ?_⟩
        grind [N.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup]
    use K.comap (QuotientGroup.mk' N)
    simp [index_comap, normal_comap, hKcard]

name: Group.IsNilpotent.exists_normal_card_eq_of_dvd_card
statement:
theorem Group.IsNilpotent.exists_normal_card_eq_of_dvd_card [IsNilpotent G] {n : ℕ}
    (hdvd : n ∣ Nat.card G) : ∃ H : Subgroup G, Nat.card H = n ∧ H.Normal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  obtain ⟨H, hind, hH⟩ := exists_normal_index_eq_of_dvd_card (Dvd.intro_left n hk.symm)
  refine ⟨H, ?_, hH⟩
  rwa [← H.card_mul_index, ← hind, Nat.mul_left_inj FiniteIndex.index_ne_zero] at hk

name: lift_apply_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply_of (x : α) : lift f (of x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  convert! Abelianization.lift_apply_of (FreeGroup.lift f (β := Multiplicative β)) (FreeGroup.of x)
  exact (FreeGroup.lift_apply_of (β := Multiplicative β)).symm

name: lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (g : FreeAbelianGroup α →+ β) (hg : ∀ x, g (of x) = f x) {x} :
    g x = lift f x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (lift.symm_apply_eq.mp (funext hg : g ∘ of = f)) _

name: lift_ext
statement:
@[ext high]
theorem lift_ext (g h : FreeAbelianGroup α →+ β) (H : ∀ x, g (of x) = h (of x)) : g = h
proof:
:=
  lift.symm.injective <| funext H

name: lift_comp_apply
statement:
theorem lift_comp_apply {α β γ} [AddCommGroup β] [AddCommGroup γ]
    (a : FreeAbelianGroup α) (f : α → β) (g : β →+ γ) : lift (g ∘ f) a = g (lift f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply g (lift f)]
  refine (lift_unique _ _ ?_).symm
  intro a
  change g ((lift f) (of a)) = g (f a)
  simp only [lift_apply_of]

name: of_injective
statement: theorem of_injective : Function.Injective (of : α → FreeAbelianGroup α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact fun x y hoxy ↦ Classical.by_contradiction fun hxy : x ≠ y ↦
    let f : FreeAbelianGroup α →+ ℤ := lift fun z ↦ if x = z then (1 : ℤ) else 0
    have hfx1 : f (of x) = 1 := (lift_apply_of _ _).trans <| ite_eq_left rfl
    have hfy1 : f (of y) = 1 := hoxy ▸ hfx1
    have hfy0 : f (of y) = 0 := (lift_apply_of _ _).trans <| ite_eq_right hxy
    one_ne_zero <| hfy1.symm.trans hfy0

name: of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_ne_zero (x : α) : of x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let f : FreeAbelianGroup α →+ ℤ := lift 1
  have hfx : f (of x) = 1 := lift_apply_of _ _
  have hf0 : f (of x) = 0 := by rw [h, map_zero]
  exact one_ne_zero <| hfx.symm.trans hf0

name: zero_ne_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_ne_of (x : α) : 0 ≠ of x
proof: := of_ne_zero _ |>.symm

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on
    {motive : FreeAbelianGroup α → Prop} (z : FreeAbelianGroup α) (zero : motive 0)
    (of : ∀ x, motive (of x)) (neg : ∀ x, motive (.of x) → motive (-.of x))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive z
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn' z fun x ↦ Quot.inductionOn x fun L ↦
    List.recOn L zero fun ⟨x, b⟩ _ ih ↦ Bool.recOn b (add _ _ (neg _ (of x)) ih) (add _ _ (of x) ih)

name: lift_add_apply
statement:
theorem lift_add_apply [AddCommGroup G] (f g : α → G) (a : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    lift (f + g) a = lift f a + lift g a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [(lift _).map_zero, zero_add]
  | of x => simp only [lift_apply_of, Pi.add_apply]
  | neg x => simp only [map_neg, lift_apply_of, Pi.add_apply, neg_add]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [(lift _).map_add, hx, hy, add_add_add_comm]

name: lift_add
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_add [AddCommGroup G] (f g : α → G) : lift (f + g) = lift f + lift g
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext <| lift_add_apply _ _

name: lift_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_neg [AddCommGroup G] (f : α → G) : lift (-f) = -lift f
proof: := liftAddEquiv.map_neg f

name: lift_neg_apply
statement:
lemma lift_neg_apply [AddCommGroup G] (f : α → G) (a : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    lift (-f) a = -lift f a
proof: := congr($(lift_neg f) a)

name: induction_on'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on'
    {motive : FreeAbelianGroup α → Prop} (z : FreeAbelianGroup α) (zero : motive 0)
    (pure : ∀ x, motive <| pure x) (neg : ∀ x, motive (Pure.pure x) → motive (-Pure.pure x))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive z
proof:
:=
  FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on z zero pure neg add

name: map_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pure (f : α → β) (x : α) : f <$> (pure x : FreeAbelianGroup α) = pure (f x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_zero (f : α → β) : f <$> (0 : FreeAbelianGroup α) = 0
proof:
:=
  (lift (of ∘ f)).map_zero

name: map_add
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_add (f : α → β) (x y : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    f <$> (x + y) = f <$> x + f <$> y
proof:
:=
  (lift _).map_add _ _

name: map_neg
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_neg (f : α → β) (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) : f <$> (-x) = -f <$> x
proof:
:=
  map_neg (lift <| of ∘ f) _

name: map_sub
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_sub (f : α → β) (x y : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    f <$> (x - y) = f <$> x - f <$> y
proof:
:=
  map_sub (lift <| of ∘ f) _ _

name: map_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_of (f : α → β) (y : α) : f <$> of y = of (f y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: pure_bind
statement: theorem pure_bind (f : α → FreeAbelianGroup β) (x) : pure x >>= f = f x
proof:
:=
  lift_apply_of _ _

name: zero_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_bind (f : α → FreeAbelianGroup β) : 0 >>= f = 0
proof:
:=
  (lift f).map_zero

name: add_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_bind (f : α → FreeAbelianGroup β) (x y : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    x + y >>= f = (x >>= f) + (y >>= f)
proof:
:=
  (lift _).map_add _ _

name: neg_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_bind (f : α → FreeAbelianGroup β) (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) : -x >>= f = -(x >>= f)
proof:
:=
  map_neg (lift f) _

name: sub_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_bind (f : α → FreeAbelianGroup β) (x y : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    x - y >>= f = (x >>= f) - (y >>= f)
proof:
:=
  map_sub (lift f) _ _

name: pure_seq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pure_seq (f : α → β) (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) : pure f <*> x = f <$> x
proof:
:=
  pure_bind _ _

name: zero_seq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_seq (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) : (0 : FreeAbelianGroup (α → β)) <*> x = 0
proof:
:=
  zero_bind _

name: add_seq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_seq (f g : FreeAbelianGroup (α → β)) (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    f + g <*> x = (f <*> x) + (g <*> x)
proof:
:=

name: neg_seq

name: lift_comp
statement:
theorem lift_comp {α} {β} {γ} [AddCommGroup γ] (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) :
    lift (g ∘ f) x = lift g (map f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | of => simp only [lift_apply_of, map, Function.comp]
  | neg _ h => simp only [h, map_neg]
  | add _ _ h₁ h₂ => simp only [h₁, h₂, map_add]

name: map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map id = AddMonoidHom.id (FreeAbelianGroup α)
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <|
    lift_ext _ _ fun _ ↦ lift_unique of (AddMonoidHom.id _) fun _ ↦ AddMonoidHom.id_apply _ _

name: map_id_apply

proof:

name: map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} : map (g ∘ f) = (map g).comp (map f)
proof:

name: map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem map_comp_apply {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} (x : FreeAbelianGroup α) :

name: of_mul

name: mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero (s : ℕ+) : mk (0 : M) s = 0
proof: := by simp [mk]

name: ind
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator]
theorem ind {motive : DivisibleHull M → Prop} (mk : ∀ num den, motive (.mk num den)) :
    ∀ x, motive x
proof:
:=
  LocalizedModule.induction_on fun m s ↦ mk m (↑ⁿ.symm s)

name: mk_eq_mk
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk {m m' : M} {s s' : ℕ+} :
    mk m s = mk m' s' ↔ ∃ u : ℕ+, u.val • s'.val • m = u.val • s.val • m'
proof:
:= by
  unfold mk
  rw [LocalizedModule.mk_eq, ↑ⁿ.exists_congr_left]
  rfl

name: liftOn_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftOn_mk {α : Type*} (m : M) (s : ℕ+)
    (f : M → ℕ+ → α)
    (h : ∀ (m m' : M) (s s' : ℕ+), mk m s = mk m' s' → f m s = f m' s') :
    liftOn (mk m s) f h = f m s
proof: := rfl

name: liftOn
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftOn₂_mk {α : Type*} (m m' : M) (s s' : ℕ+)
    (f : M → ℕ+ → M → ℕ+ → α)
    (h : ∀ (m n m' n' : M) (s t s' t' : ℕ+),
      mk m s = mk m' s' → mk n t = mk n' t' → f m s n t = f m' s' n' t') :
    liftOn₂ (mk m s) (mk m' s') f h = f m s m' s'
proof: := rfl

name: mk_add_mk
statement:
theorem mk_add_mk {m1 m2 : M} {s1 s2 : ℕ+} :
    mk m1 s1 + mk m2 s2 = mk (s2.val • m1 + s1.val • m2) (s1 * s2)
proof: := LocalizedModule.mk_add_mk

name: mk_add_mk_left
statement:
theorem mk_add_mk_left {m1 m2 : M} {s : ℕ+} :
    mk m1 s + mk m2 s = mk (m1 + m2) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_add_mk, mk_eq_mk]
  exact ⟨1, by simp [smul_smul]⟩

name: coe_add
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_add {m1 m2 : M} : ↑(m1 + m2) = (↑m1 + ↑m2 : DivisibleHull M)
proof: := by simp [mk_add_mk_left]

name: nsmul_mk
statement: theorem nsmul_mk (a : ℕ) (m : M) (s : ℕ+) : a • mk m s = mk (a • m) s
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n h => simp [add_nsmul, mk_add_mk_left, h]

name: nnqsmul_mk
statement:
theorem nnqsmul_mk (a : ℚ≥0) (m : M) (s : ℕ+) :
    a • mk m s = mk (a.num • m) (⟨a.den, a.den_pos⟩ * s)
proof:
:= by
  convert! LocalizedModule.mk'_smul_mk ℚ≥0 a.num m ⟨a.den, by simp⟩ (↑ⁿ s)
  simp [IsLocalization.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq]

name: mk_eq_mk_iff_smul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff_smul_eq_smul {m m' : M} {s s' : ℕ+} :
    mk m s = mk m' s' ↔ s'.val • m = s.val • m'
proof:
:= by
  aesop (add simp [mk_eq_mk, nsmul_right_inj])

name: mk_left_injective
statement: theorem mk_left_injective (s : ℕ+) : Function.Injective (fun (m : M) ↦ mk m s)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  simp_rw [mk_eq_mk_iff_smul_eq_smul] at h
  exact nsmul_right_injective (by simp) h

name: coe_injective
statement: theorem coe_injective : Function.Injective ((↑) : M → DivisibleHull M)
proof:
:=
  mk_left_injective 1

name: coe_inj
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_inj {m m' : M} : (m : DivisibleHull M) = ↑m' ↔ m = m'
proof:
:=
  coe_injective.eq_iff

name: neg_mk
statement: theorem neg_mk (m : M) (s : ℕ+) : -mk m s = mk (-m) s
proof:
:=
  (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by simp [mk_add_mk_left])).symm

name: qsmul_def
statement:
theorem qsmul_def (a : ℚ) (x : DivisibleHull M) :
    a • x = (SignType.sign a : ℤ) • (show ℚ≥0 from ⟨|a|, abs_nonneg _⟩) • x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: zero_qsmul
statement: theorem zero_qsmul (x : DivisibleHull M) : (0 : ℚ) • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [qsmul_def]

name: qsmul_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem qsmul_of_nonneg {a : ℚ} (h : 0 ≤ a) (x : DivisibleHull M) :
    a • x = (show ℚ≥0 from ⟨a, h⟩) • x
proof:
:= by
  have := h.eq_or_lt
  aesop (add simp [qsmul_def, abs_of_pos])

name: qsmul_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem qsmul_of_nonpos {a : ℚ} (h : a ≤ 0) (x : DivisibleHull M) :
    a • x = -((show ℚ≥0 from ⟨-a, Left.nonneg_neg_iff.mpr h⟩) • x)
proof:
:= by
  have := h.eq_or_lt
  aesop (add simp [qsmul_def, abs_of_neg])

name: qsmul_mk
statement:
theorem qsmul_mk (a : ℚ) (m : M) (s : ℕ+) :
    a • mk m s = mk (a.num • m) (⟨a.den, a.den_pos⟩ * s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := le_total 0 a
  · rw [qsmul_of_nonneg h, nnqsmul_mk, ← natCast_zsmul]
    congr
    simpa using h
  · rw [qsmul_of_nonpos h]
    have : a.num.natAbs • m = -a.num • m := by
      rw [← natCast_zsmul]
      congr
      simpa using h
    simp [nnqsmul_mk, this, ← neg_mk]

name: zsmul_mk
statement: theorem zsmul_mk (a : ℤ) (m : M) (s : ℕ+) : a • mk m s = mk (a • m) s
proof:
:= by
  simp [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ a, qsmul_mk]

name: lift_aux
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_mk_iff_smul_eq_smul] at h h'
  rw [propext_iff, ← nsmul_le_nsmul_iff_right (mul_ne_zero s'.ne_zero t'.ne_zero)]
  convert! (nsmul_le_nsmul_iff_right (M := M) (mul_ne_zero s.ne_zero t.ne_zero)) using 2
  · simp_rw [smul_smul, mul_rotate s'.val, ← smul_smul, h, smul_smul]
    ring_nf
  · simp_rw [smul_smul, ← mul_rotate s'.val, ← smul_smul, ← h', smul_smul]
    ring_nf

name: mk_le_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_le_mk {m m' : M} {s s' : ℕ+} :
    mk m s ≤ mk m' s' ↔ s'.val • m ≤ s.val • m'
proof: := by rfl

name: mk_lt_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_lt_mk {m m' : M} {s s' : ℕ+} : mk m s < mk m' s' ↔ s'.val • m < s.val • m'
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [lt_iff_not_ge, mk_le_mk]

name: archimedeanClassMk_mk_eq
statement:
theorem archimedeanClassMk_mk_eq (m : M) (s s' : ℕ+) :
    ArchimedeanClass.mk (mk m s) = ArchimedeanClass.mk (mk m s')
proof:
:= by
  suffices (s : ℤ) • mk m s = (s' : ℤ) • mk m s' by
    apply_fun ArchimedeanClass.mk at this
    rw [ArchimedeanClass.mk_smul _ (by simp)] at this
    rw [ArchimedeanClass.mk_smul _ (by simp)] at this
    exact this
  simp_rw [zsmul_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff_smul_eq_smul, natCast_zsmul, smul_smul, mul_comm s'.val]

name: aux_archimedeanClassMk_mk
statement:
private theorem aux_archimedeanClassMk_mk (m : M) (s : ℕ+) :
    ArchimedeanClass.mk (mk m s) = archimedeanClassOrderHom M (ArchimedeanClass.mk m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [archimedeanClassOrderHom, ArchimedeanClass.orderHom_mk, coeOrderAddMonoidHom_apply]
  apply archimedeanClassMk_mk_eq

name: aux_archimedeanClassOrderHom_injective
statement:
private theorem aux_archimedeanClassOrderHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (archimedeanClassOrderHom M)
proof:
:=
  ArchimedeanClass.orderHom_injective coe_injective

name: archimedeanClassOrderIso_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem archimedeanClassOrderIso_apply (a : ArchimedeanClass M) :
    archimedeanClassOrderIso M a = ArchimedeanClass.orderHom (coeOrderAddMonoidHom M) a
proof: := rfl

name: archimedeanClassOrderIso_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem archimedeanClassOrderIso_symm_apply (m : M) (s : ℕ+) :
    (archimedeanClassOrderIso M).symm (ArchimedeanClass.mk (mk m s)) = ArchimedeanClass.mk m
proof: := rfl

name: derivedSeries_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedSeries_zero : derivedSeries G 0 = ⊤
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: derivedSeries_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedSeries_succ (n : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries G (n + 1) = ⁅derivedSeries G n, derivedSeries G n⁆
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: derivedSeries_normal
statement: theorem derivedSeries_normal (n : ℕ) : (derivedSeries G n).Normal
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (⊤ : Subgroup G).normal_of_characteristic
  | succ n ih => exact Subgroup.commutator_normal (derivedSeries G n) (derivedSeries G n)

name: derivedSeries_one
statement:
@[simp 1100]
theorem derivedSeries_one : derivedSeries G 1 = commutator G
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: derivedSeries_antitone
statement: theorem derivedSeries_antitone : Antitone (derivedSeries G)
proof:
:=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun n => (derivedSeries G n).commutator_le_self

name: map_derivedSeries_le_derivedSeries
statement:
theorem map_derivedSeries_le_derivedSeries (n : ℕ) :
    (derivedSeries G n).map f ≤ derivedSeries G' n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact le_top
  | succ n ih => simp only [derivedSeries_succ, map_commutator, commutator_mono, ih]

name: derivedSeries_le_map_derivedSeries
statement:
theorem derivedSeries_le_map_derivedSeries (hf : Function.Surjective f) (n : ℕ) :
    derivedSeries G' n ≤ (derivedSeries G n).map f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (map_top_of_surjective f hf).ge
  | succ n ih => exact commutator_le_map_commutator ih ih

name: map_derivedSeries_eq
statement:
theorem map_derivedSeries_eq (hf : Function.Surjective f) (n : ℕ) :
    (derivedSeries G n).map f = derivedSeries G' n
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (map_derivedSeries_le_derivedSeries f n) (derivedSeries_le_map_derivedSeries hf n)

name: isSolvable_of_comm
statement:
theorem isSolvable_of_comm {G : Type*} [hG : Group G] (h : ∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a) :
    IsSolvable G
proof:
:= by
  let hG' : CommGroup G := { hG with mul_comm := h }
  cases hG
  infer_instance

name: isSolvable_of_top_eq_bot
statement: theorem isSolvable_of_top_eq_bot (h : (⊤ : Subgroup G) = ⊥) : IsSolvable G

name: isSolvable_of_ker_le_range
statement:
theorem isSolvable_of_ker_le_range {G' G'' : Type*} [Group G'] [Group G''] (f : G' →* G)
    (g : G →* G'') (hfg : g.ker ≤ f.range) [hG' : IsSolvable G'] [hG'' : IsSolvable G''] :
    IsSolvable G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := id hG''
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := id hG'
  refine ⟨⟨n + m, le_bot_iff.mp (Subgroup.map_bot f ▸ hm ▸ ?_)⟩⟩
  clear hm
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    exact f.range_eq_map ▸ ((derivedSeries G n).map_eq_bot_iff.mp
      (le_bot_iff.mp ((map_derivedSeries_le_derivedSeries g n).trans hn.le))).trans hfg
  | succ m hm => exact commutator_le_map_commutator hm hm

name: isSolvable_of_isSolvable_injective
statement:
theorem isSolvable_of_isSolvable_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) [IsSolvable G'] :
    IsSolvable G
proof:
:=
  isSolvable_of_ker_le_range (1 : G' →* G) f ((f.ker_eq_bot hf).symm ▸ bot_le)

name: isSolvable_of_surjective
statement: theorem isSolvable_of_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) [IsSolvable G] : IsSolvable G'
proof:
:=
  isSolvable_of_ker_le_range f (1 : G' →* G) (f.range_eq_top_of_surjective hf ▸ le_top)

name: isSolvable_iff_subgroup_quotient
statement:
theorem isSolvable_iff_subgroup_quotient (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] :
    IsSolvable G ↔ IsSolvable H ∧ IsSolvable (G ⧸ H)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, fun ⟨_, _⟩ ↦
    isSolvable_of_ker_le_range H.subtype (QuotientGroup.mk' H) (by simp)⟩

name: IsSolvable.commutator_lt_top_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem IsSolvable.commutator_lt_top_of_nontrivial [hG : IsSolvable G] [Nontrivial G] :
    commutator G < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hG
  contrapose! hn
  refine ne_of_eq_of_ne ?_ top_ne_bot
  induction n with
  | zero => exact derivedSeries_zero G
  | succ n h => rwa [derivedSeries_succ, h]

name: IsSolvable.commutator_lt_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem IsSolvable.commutator_lt_of_ne_bot [IsSolvable G] {H : Subgroup G} (hH : H ≠ ⊥) :
    ⁅H, H⁆ < H
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nontrivial_iff_ne_bot] at hH
  rw [← H.range_subtype, MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← map_commutator, map_subtype_lt_map_subtype]
  exact commutator_lt_top_of_nontrivial H

name: isSolvable_iff_commutator_lt
statement:
theorem isSolvable_iff_commutator_lt [WellFoundedLT (Subgroup G)] :
    IsSolvable G ↔ ∀ H : Subgroup G, H ≠ ⊥ → ⁅H, H⁆ < H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ ↦ IsSolvable.commutator_lt_of_ne_bot, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  suffices h : IsSolvable (⊤ : Subgroup G) from
    isSolvable_of_surjective (MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mp (range_subtype ⊤))
  induction (⊤ : Subgroup G) using WellFoundedLT.induction with | ind H hH
  rcases eq_or_ne H ⊥ with rfl | h'
  · infer_instance
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hH ⁅H, H⁆ (h H h')
    use n + 1
    rw [← map_subtype_inj, Subgroup.map_bot] at hn ⊢
    rw [← hn]
    clear hn
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [derivedSeries_succ, derivedSeries_zero, derivedSeries_zero, map_commutator,
        Subgroup.map_top, Subgroup.map_top, range_subtype, range_subtype]
    | succ n ih => rw [derivedSeries_succ, map_commutator, ih, derivedSeries_succ, map_commutator]

name: IsSimpleGroup.derivedSeries_succ
statement: theorem IsSimpleGroup.derivedSeries_succ {n : ℕ} : derivedSeries G n.succ = commutator G
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact derivedSeries_one G
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [_root_.derivedSeries_succ, ih, _root_.commutator]
    rcases (commutator_normal (⊤ : Subgroup G) (⊤ : Subgroup G)).eq_bot_or_eq_top with h | h
    · rw [h, commutator_bot_left]
    · rwa [h]

name: IsSimpleGroup.comm_iff_isSolvable
statement: theorem IsSimpleGroup.comm_iff_isSolvable : (∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a) ↔ Group.IsSolvable G
proof:
:=
  ⟨Group.isSolvable_of_comm, fun ⟨⟨n, hn⟩⟩ => by
    cases n
    · intro a b
      refine (mem_bot.1 ?_).trans (mem_bot.1 ?_).symm <;>
        · rw [← hn]
          exact mem_top _
    · rw [IsSimpleGroup.derivedSeries_succ] at hn
      intro a b
      rw [← mul_inv_eq_one, mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, ← mem_bot, ← hn, commutator_eq_closure]
      exact subset_closure ⟨a, b, rfl⟩⟩

name: not_isSolvable_of_mem_derivedSeries
statement:
theorem not_isSolvable_of_mem_derivedSeries {g : G} (h1 : g ≠ 1)
    (h2 : ∀ n : ℕ, g ∈ derivedSeries G n) : ¬Group.IsSolvable G
proof:
:=
  mt (Group.isSolvable_def _).mp
    (not_exists_of_forall_not fun n h =>
      h1 (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp ((congr_arg (g ∈ ·) h).mp (h2 n))))

name: Equiv.Perm.not_isSolvable_fin_5
statement: theorem Equiv.Perm.not_isSolvable_fin_5 : ¬Group.IsSolvable (Equiv.Perm (Fin 5))
proof:
:= by
  let x : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) := ⟨![1, 2, 0, 3, 4], ![2, 0, 1, 3, 4], by decide, by decide⟩
  let y : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) := ⟨![3, 4, 2, 0, 1], ![3, 4, 2, 0, 1], by decide, by decide⟩
  let z : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) := ⟨![0, 3, 2, 1, 4], ![0, 3, 2, 1, 4], by decide, by decide⟩
  have key : x = z * ⁅x, y * x * y⁻¹⁆ * z⁻¹ := by unfold x y z; decide
  refine not_isSolvable_of_mem_derivedSeries (show x ≠ 1 by decide) fun n => ?_
  induction n with
  | zero => exact mem_top x
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [key, (derivedSeries_normal _ _).mem_comm_iff, inv_mul_cancel_left]
    exact commutator_mem_commutator ih ((derivedSeries_normal _ _).conj_mem _ ih _)

name: Equiv.Perm.not_isSolvable
statement:
theorem Equiv.Perm.not_isSolvable (X : Type*) (hX : 5 ≤ Cardinal.mk X) :
    ¬Group.IsSolvable (Equiv.Perm X)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have key : Nonempty (Fin 5 ↪ X) := by
    rwa [← Cardinal.lift_mk_le, Cardinal.mk_fin, Cardinal.lift_natCast, Cardinal.lift_id]
  exact
    Equiv.Perm.not_isSolvable_fin_5 (Group.isSolvable_of_isSolvable_injective
      (Equiv.Perm.viaEmbeddingHom_injective (Nonempty.some key)))

name: isComplement_iff_bijective
statement:
theorem isComplement_iff_bijective {S : Type*} [SetLike S G] (s t : S) :
    IsComplement (G := G) s t ↔ Function.Bijective fun x : s × t => (x.1 : G) * (x.2 : G)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: isComplement'_def
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement'_def : IsComplement' H K ↔ IsComplement (H : Set G) (K : Set G)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: isComplement_iff_existsUnique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_iff_existsUnique :
    IsComplement S T ↔ ∀ g : G, ∃! x : S × T, x.1.1 * x.2.1 = g
proof:
:=
  Function.bijective_iff_existsUnique _

name: IsComplement.existsUnique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsComplement.existsUnique (h : IsComplement S T) (g : G) :
    ∃! x : S × T, x.1.1 * x.2.1 = g
proof:
:=
  isComplement_iff_existsUnique.mp h g

name: IsComplement'.symm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsComplement'.symm (h : IsComplement' H K) : IsComplement' K H
proof:
:= by
  let ϕ : H × K ≃ K × H :=
    Equiv.mk (fun x => ⟨x.2⁻¹, x.1⁻¹⟩) (fun x => ⟨x.2⁻¹, x.1⁻¹⟩)
      (fun x => Prod.ext (inv_inv _) (inv_inv _)) fun x => Prod.ext (inv_inv _) (inv_inv _)
  let ψ : G ≃ G := Equiv.mk (fun g : G => g⁻¹) (fun g : G => g⁻¹) inv_inv inv_inv
  suffices hf : (ψ ∘ fun x : H × K => x.1.1 * x.2.1) = (fun x : K × H => x.1.1 * x.2.1) ∘ ϕ by
    rwa [isComplement'_def, isComplement_iff_bijective, ← Equiv.bijective_comp ϕ, ← hf,
      ψ.comp_bijective]
  exact funext fun x => mul_inv_rev _ _

name: isComplement'_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement'_comm : IsComplement' H K ↔ IsComplement' K H
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsComplement'.symm, IsComplement'.symm⟩

name: isComplement_univ_singleton
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_univ_singleton {g : G} : IsComplement (univ : Set G) {g}
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ h => Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (mul_right_cancel h)) rfl, fun x =>
    ⟨⟨⟨x * g⁻¹, ⟨⟩⟩, g, rfl⟩, inv_mul_cancel_right x g⟩⟩

name: isComplement_singleton_univ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_singleton_univ {g : G} : IsComplement ({g} : Set G) univ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, _⟩ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, _⟩ h => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (mul_left_cancel h)), fun x =>
    ⟨⟨⟨g, rfl⟩, g⁻¹ * x, ⟨⟩⟩, mul_inv_cancel_left g x⟩⟩

name: isComplement_singleton_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_singleton_left {g : G} : IsComplement {g} S ↔ S = univ
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_, fun h => (congr_arg _ h).mpr isComplement_singleton_univ⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨z, rfl : z = g⟩, y, _⟩, hy⟩ := h.2 (g * x)
  rwa [← mul_left_cancel hy]

name: isComplement_singleton_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_singleton_right {g : G} : IsComplement S {g} ↔ S = univ
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_, fun h => h ▸ isComplement_univ_singleton⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h.2 (x * g)
  conv_rhs at hy => rw [← show y.2.1 = g from y.2.2]
  rw [← mul_right_cancel hy]
  exact y.1.2

name: isComplement_univ_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_univ_left : IsComplement univ S ↔ ∃ g : G, S = {g}
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => Set.exists_eq_singleton_iff_nonempty_subsingleton.mpr ⟨?_, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := h.2 1
    exact ⟨a.2.1, a.2.2⟩
  · have : (⟨⟨_, mem_top a⁻¹⟩, ⟨a, ha⟩⟩ : (⊤ : Set G) × S) = ⟨⟨_, mem_top b⁻¹⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ :=
      h.1 ((inv_mul_cancel a).trans (inv_mul_cancel b).symm)
    exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp this).2
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact isComplement_univ_singleton

name: isComplement_univ_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement_univ_right : IsComplement S univ ↔ ∃ g : G, S = {g}
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => Set.exists_eq_singleton_iff_nonempty_subsingleton.mpr ⟨?_, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := h.2 1
    exact ⟨a.1.1, a.1.2⟩
  · have : (⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨_, mem_top a⁻¹⟩⟩ : S × (⊤ : Set G)) = ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, ⟨_, mem_top b⁻¹⟩⟩ :=
      h.1 ((mul_inv_cancel a).trans (mul_inv_cancel b).symm)
    exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp (Prod.ext_iff.mp this).1
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact isComplement_singleton_univ

name: IsComplement.mul_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsComplement.mul_eq (h : IsComplement S T) : S * T = univ
proof:
:=
  eq_univ_of_forall fun x ↦ by simpa [mem_mul] using (h.existsUnique x).exists

name: not_isComplement_empty_left
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma not_isComplement_empty_left : ¬ IsComplement ∅ T
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simpa [eq_comm (a := ∅)] using h.mul_eq

name: not_isComplement_empty_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma not_isComplement_empty_right : ¬ IsComplement S ∅
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simpa [eq_comm (a := ∅)] using h.mul_eq

name: IsComplement.nonempty_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsComplement.nonempty_left (hst : IsComplement S T) : S.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hst; simp [hst]

name: IsComplement.nonempty_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsComplement.nonempty_right (hst : IsComplement S T) : T.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hst; simp [hst]

name: IsComplement.pairwiseDisjoint_smul
statement:
@[to_additive] lemma IsComplement.pairwiseDisjoint_smul (hst : IsComplement S T) :
    S.PairwiseDisjoint (· • T)
proof:
:= fun a ha b hb hab ↦ disjoint_iff_forall_ne.2 <| by
  rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
  exact hst.1.ne (a₁ := (⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨c, hc⟩)) (a₂ := (⟨b, hb⟩, ⟨d, hd⟩)) (by simp [hab])

name: IsComplement.card_mul_card
statement:
@[to_additive AddSubgroup.IsComplement.card_mul_card]
lemma IsComplement.card_mul_card (h : IsComplement S T) : Nat.card S * Nat.card T = Nat.card G
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_prod _ _).symm.trans <| Nat.card_congr <| Equiv.ofBijective _ h

name: isComplement'_top_bot
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement'_top_bot : IsComplement' (⊤ : Subgroup G) ⊥
proof:
:=
  isComplement_univ_singleton

name: isComplement'_bot_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isComplement'_bot_top : IsComplement' (⊥ : Subgroup G) ⊤
proof:
:=
  isComplement_singleton_univ

name: isComplement'_bot_left
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem isComplement'_bot_left : IsComplement' ⊥ H ↔ H = ⊤
proof:
:=
  isComplement_singleton_left.trans coe_eq_univ

name: isComplement'_bot_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem isComplement'_bot_right : IsComplement' H ⊥ ↔ H = ⊤
proof:
:=
  isComplement_singleton_right.trans coe_eq_univ

name: isComplement'_top_left
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem isComplement'_top_left : IsComplement' ⊤ H ↔ H = ⊥
proof:
:=
  isComplement_univ_left.trans coe_eq_singleton

name: isComplement'_top_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem isComplement'_top_right : IsComplement' H ⊤ ↔ H = ⊥
proof:
:=
  isComplement_univ_right.trans coe_eq_singleton

name: isComplement_iff_existsUnique_inv_mul_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_iff_existsUnique_inv_mul_mem :
    IsComplement S T ↔ ∀ g, ∃! s : S, (s : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  convert! isComplement_iff_existsUnique with g
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩
  · exact ⟨(x, ⟨_, hx⟩), by simp, by aesop⟩
  · exact ⟨x.1, by simp [← hx], fun y hy ↦ (Prod.ext_iff.1 <| by simpa using hx' (y, ⟨_, hy⟩)).1⟩

name: isComplement_iff_existsUnique_mul_inv_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_iff_existsUnique_mul_inv_mem :
    IsComplement S T ↔ ∀ g, ∃! t : T, g * (t : G)⁻¹ ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  convert! isComplement_iff_existsUnique with g
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩
  · exact ⟨(⟨_, hx⟩, x), by simp, by aesop⟩
  · exact ⟨x.2, by simp [← hx], fun y hy ↦ (Prod.ext_iff.1 <| by simpa using hx' (⟨_, hy⟩, y)).2⟩

name: isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_existsUnique_quotientGroupMk
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_existsUnique_quotientGroupMk :
    IsComplement S H ↔ ∀ q : G ⧸ H, ∃! s : S, QuotientGroup.mk s.1 = q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isComplement_iff_existsUnique_inv_mul_mem, SetLike.mem_coe, ← QuotientGroup.eq,
    QuotientGroup.forall_mk]

name: isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_existsUnique_quotientMk''
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_existsUnique_quotientMk'' :
    IsComplement H T ↔
      ∀ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H), ∃! t : T, Quotient.mk'' t.1 = q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isComplement_iff_existsUnique_mul_inv_mem, SetLike.mem_coe,
    ← QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply, ← Quotient.eq'', Quotient.forall]

name: isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_bijective
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_bijective :
    IsComplement S H ↔ Bijective (S.domRestrict (QuotientGroup.mk : G → G ⧸ H))
proof:
:=
  isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_existsUnique_quotientGroupMk.trans
    (bijective_iff_existsUnique (S.domRestrict QuotientGroup.mk)).symm

name: isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_bijective
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_bijective :
    IsComplement H T ↔
      Bijective (T.domRestrict (Quotient.mk'' : G → Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)))
proof:
:=
  isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_existsUnique_quotientMk''.trans
    (bijective_iff_existsUnique (T.domRestrict Quotient.mk'')).symm

name: IsComplement.card_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsComplement.card_left (h : IsComplement S H) : Nat.card S = H.index
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr <| .ofBijective _ <| isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_bijective.mp h

name: IsComplement.ncard_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsComplement.ncard_left (h : IsComplement S H) : S.ncard = H.index
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, h.card_left]

name: IsComplement.card_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsComplement.card_right (h : IsComplement H T) : Nat.card T = H.index
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr <| (Equiv.ofBijective _ <| isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_bijective.mp h).trans <|
    QuotientGroup.quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel H

name: IsComplement.ncard_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsComplement.ncard_right (h : IsComplement H T) : T.ncard = H.index
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, h.card_right]

name: isComplement_range_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isComplement_range_left {f : G ⧸ H → G} (hf : ∀ q, ↑(f q) = q) :
    IsComplement (range f) H
proof:
:= by
  rw [isComplement_subgroup_right_iff_bijective]
  refine ⟨?_, fun q ↦ ⟨⟨f q, q, rfl⟩, hf q⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨-, q₁, rfl⟩ ⟨-, q₂, rfl⟩ h
  exact Subtype.ext <| congr_arg f <| ((hf q₁).symm.trans h).trans (hf q₂)

name: isComplement_range_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [isComplement_subgroup_left_iff_bijective]
  refine ⟨?_, fun q ↦ ⟨⟨f q, q, rfl⟩, hf q⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨-, q₁, rfl⟩ ⟨-, q₂, rfl⟩ h
  exact Subtype.ext <| congr_arg f <| ((hf q₁).symm.trans h).trans (hf q₂)

name: exists_isComplement_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma exists_isComplement_left (H : Subgroup G) (g : G) : ∃ S, IsComplement S H ∧ g ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Set.range (Function.update Quotient.out _ g), isComplement_range_left fun q ↦ ?_,
    QuotientGroup.mk g, Function.update_self (Quotient.mk'' g) g Quotient.out⟩
  by_cases hq : q = Quotient.mk'' g
  · exact hq.symm ▸ congr_arg _ (Function.update_self (Quotient.mk'' g) g Quotient.out)
  · simp [Function.update, dite_eq_right hq, q.out_eq']

name: exists_isComplement_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma exists_isComplement_right (H : Subgroup G) (g : G) :
    ∃ T, IsComplement H T ∧ g ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨Set.range (Function.update Quotient.out _ g), isComplement_range_right fun q ↦ ?_,
    Quotient.mk'' g, Function.update_self (Quotient.mk'' g) g Quotient.out⟩
  by_cases hq : q = Quotient.mk'' g
  · exact hq.symm ▸ congr_arg _ (Function.update_self (Quotient.mk'' g) g Quotient.out)
  · simp [Function.update, dite_eq_right hq, q.out_eq']

name: exists_left_transversal_of_le
statement:
lemma exists_left_transversal_of_le {H' H : Subgroup G} (h : H' ≤ H) :
    ∃ S : Set G, S * H' = H ∧ Nat.card S * Nat.card H' = Nat.card H
proof:
:= by
  let H'' : Subgroup H := H'.comap H.subtype
  have : H' = H''.map H.subtype := by simp [H'', h]
  rw [this]
  obtain ⟨S, cmem, -⟩ := H''.exists_isComplement_left 1
  refine ⟨H.subtype '' S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : H.subtype '' (S * H'') = H.subtype '' S * H''.map H.subtype := image_mul H.subtype
    rw [← this, cmem.mul_eq]
    simp
  · rw [← cmem.card_mul_card]
    refine congr_arg₂ (· * ·) ?_ ?_ <;>
      exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.Set.image _ _ <| subtype_injective H).symm

name: exists_right_transversal_of_le
statement:
lemma exists_right_transversal_of_le {H' H : Subgroup G} (h : H' ≤ H) :
    ∃ S : Set G, H' * S = H ∧ Nat.card H' * Nat.card S = Nat.card H
proof:
:= by
  let H'' : Subgroup H := H'.comap H.subtype
  have : H' = H''.map H.subtype := by simp [H'', h]
  rw [this]
  obtain ⟨S, cmem, -⟩ := H''.exists_isComplement_right 1
  refine ⟨H.subtype '' S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : H.subtype '' (H'' * S) = H''.map H.subtype * H.subtype '' S := image_mul H.subtype
    rw [← this, cmem.mul_eq]
    simp
  · have : Nat.card H'' * Nat.card S = Nat.card H := cmem.card_mul_card
    rw [← this]
    refine congr_arg₂ (· * ·) ?_ ?_ <;>
      exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.Set.image _ _ <| subtype_injective H).symm

name: equiv_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem equiv_symm_apply (x : S × T) : (hST.equiv.symm x : G) = x.1.1 * x.2.1
proof: := rfl

name: equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd (g : G) : ↑(hST.equiv g).fst * (hST.equiv g).snd = g
proof:
:=
  (Equiv.ofBijective (fun x : S × T => x.1.1 * x.2.1) hST).right_inv g

name: equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv
statement: theorem equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv (g : G) : ↑(hST.equiv g).fst = g * ((hST.equiv g).snd : G)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq (hST.equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd g)

name: equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul
statement: theorem equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul (g : G) : ↑(hST.equiv g).snd = ((hST.equiv g).fst : G)⁻¹ * g
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_mul_of_mul_eq (hST.equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd g)

name: equiv_fst_eq_iff_leftCosetEquivalence
statement:
theorem equiv_fst_eq_iff_leftCosetEquivalence {g₁ g₂ : G} :
    (hSK.equiv g₁).fst = (hSK.equiv g₂).fst ↔ LeftCosetEquivalence K g₁ g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [LeftCosetEquivalence, leftCoset_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← hSK.equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd g₂, ← hSK.equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd g₁, ← h,
      mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_right, ← coe_inv, ← coe_mul]
    exact Subtype.property _
  · intro h
    apply (isComplement_iff_existsUnique_inv_mul_mem.1 hSK g₁).unique
    · 
      rw [equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv]; simp
    · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← mul_mem_cancel_right h]
      
      rw [equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv]; simp [← mul_assoc]

name: equiv_snd_eq_iff_rightCosetEquivalence
statement:
theorem equiv_snd_eq_iff_rightCosetEquivalence {g₁ g₂ : G} :
    (hHT.equiv g₁).snd = (hHT.equiv g₂).snd ↔ RightCosetEquivalence H g₁ g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [RightCosetEquivalence, rightCoset_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← hHT.equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd g₂, ← hHT.equiv_fst_mul_equiv_snd g₁, ← h,
      mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_left, ← coe_inv, ← coe_mul]
    exact Subtype.property _
  · intro h
    apply (isComplement_iff_existsUnique_mul_inv_mem.1 hHT g₁).unique
    · 
      rw [equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul]; simp
    · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← mul_mem_cancel_left h]
      
      rw [equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul, mul_assoc]; simp

name: leftCosetEquivalence_equiv_fst
statement:
theorem leftCosetEquivalence_equiv_fst (g : G) :
    LeftCosetEquivalence K g ((hSK.equiv g).fst : G)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv]; simp [LeftCosetEquivalence, leftCoset_eq_iff]

name: rightCosetEquivalence_equiv_snd
statement:
theorem rightCosetEquivalence_equiv_snd (g : G) :
    RightCosetEquivalence H g ((hHT.equiv g).snd : G)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [RightCosetEquivalence, rightCoset_eq_iff, equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul]; simp

name: equiv_fst_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_fst_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ T) (hg : g ∈ S) :
    (hST.equiv g).fst = ⟨g, hg⟩
proof:
:= by
  have : hST.equiv.symm (⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨1, h1⟩) = g := by
    rw [equiv, Equiv.ofBijective]; simp
  conv_lhs => rw [← this, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: equiv_snd_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_snd_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ S) (hg : g ∈ T) :
    (hST.equiv g).snd = ⟨g, hg⟩
proof:
:= by
  have : hST.equiv.symm (⟨1, h1⟩, ⟨g, hg⟩) = g := by
    rw [equiv, Equiv.ofBijective]; simp
  conv_lhs => rw [← this, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: equiv_snd_eq_one_of_mem_of_one_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_snd_eq_one_of_mem_of_one_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ T) (hg : g ∈ S) :
    (hST.equiv g).snd = ⟨1, h1⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul, equiv_fst_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem _ h1 hg, inv_mul_cancel]

name: equiv_fst_eq_one_of_mem_of_one_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_fst_eq_one_of_mem_of_one_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ S) (hg : g ∈ T) :
    (hST.equiv g).fst = ⟨1, h1⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv, equiv_snd_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem _ h1 hg, mul_inv_cancel]

name: equiv_mul_right
statement:
theorem equiv_mul_right (g : G) (k : K) :
    hSK.equiv (g * k) = ((hSK.equiv g).fst, (hSK.equiv g).snd * k)
proof:
:= by
  have : (hSK.equiv (g * k)).fst = (hSK.equiv g).fst :=
    hSK.equiv_fst_eq_iff_leftCosetEquivalence.2
      (by simp [LeftCosetEquivalence, leftCoset_eq_iff])
  ext
  · rw [this]
  · rw [coe_mul, equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul, this, equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul, mul_assoc]

name: equiv_mul_right_of_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_mul_right_of_mem {g k : G} (h : k ∈ K) :
    hSK.equiv (g * k) = ((hSK.equiv g).fst, (hSK.equiv g).snd * ⟨k, h⟩)
proof:
:=
  equiv_mul_right _ g ⟨k, h⟩

name: equiv_mul_left
statement:
theorem equiv_mul_left (h : H) (g : G) :
    hHT.equiv (h * g) = (h * (hHT.equiv g).fst, (hHT.equiv g).snd)
proof:
:= by
  have : (hHT.equiv (h * g)).2 = (hHT.equiv g).2 := hHT.equiv_snd_eq_iff_rightCosetEquivalence.2 ?_
  · ext
    · rw [coe_mul, equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv, this, equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc]
    · rw [this]
  · simp [RightCosetEquivalence, ← smul_smul]

name: equiv_mul_left_of_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_mul_left_of_mem {h g : G} (hh : h ∈ H) :
    hHT.equiv (h * g) = (⟨h, hh⟩ * (hHT.equiv g).fst, (hHT.equiv g).snd)
proof:
:=
  equiv_mul_left _ ⟨h, hh⟩ g

name: equiv_one
statement:
theorem equiv_one (hs1 : 1 ∈ S) (ht1 : 1 ∈ T) :
    hST.equiv 1 = (⟨1, hs1⟩, ⟨1, ht1⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Equiv.eq_symm_apply]; simp [equiv]

name: equiv_fst_eq_self_iff_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_fst_eq_self_iff_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ T) :
    ((hST.equiv g).fst : G) = g ↔ g ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact Subtype.prop _
  · intro h
    rw [hST.equiv_fst_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem h1 h]

name: equiv_snd_eq_self_iff_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_snd_eq_self_iff_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ S) :
    ((hST.equiv g).snd : G) = g ↔ g ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact Subtype.prop _
  · intro h
    rw [hST.equiv_snd_eq_self_of_mem_of_one_mem h1 h]

name: coe_equiv_fst_eq_one_iff_mem
statement:
theorem coe_equiv_fst_eq_one_iff_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ S) :
    ((hST.equiv g).fst : G) = 1 ↔ g ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  rw [equiv_fst_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_eq_one, eq_comm, equiv_snd_eq_self_iff_mem _ h1]

name: coe_equiv_snd_eq_one_iff_mem
statement:
theorem coe_equiv_snd_eq_one_iff_mem {g : G} (h1 : 1 ∈ T) :
    ((hST.equiv g).snd : G) = 1 ↔ g ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [equiv_snd_eq_inv_mul, inv_mul_eq_one, equiv_fst_eq_self_iff_mem _ h1]

name: finite_left_iff
statement: theorem finite_left_iff (h : IsComplement S H) : Finite S ↔ H.FiniteIndex
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.leftQuotientEquiv.finite_iff]
  exact ⟨fun _ ↦ finiteIndex_of_finite_quotient, fun _ ↦ finite_quotient_of_finiteIndex⟩

name: finite_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finite_left [H.FiniteIndex] (hS : IsComplement S H) : S.Finite
proof: := hS.finite_left_iff.2 ‹_›

name: quotientGroupMk_leftQuotientEquiv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem quotientGroupMk_leftQuotientEquiv (hS : IsComplement S H) (q : G ⧸ H) :
    Quotient.mk'' (leftQuotientEquiv hS q : G) = q
proof:
:=
  hS.leftQuotientEquiv.symm_apply_apply q

name: leftQuotientEquiv_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem leftQuotientEquiv_apply {f : G ⧸ H → G} (hf : ∀ q, (f q : G ⧸ H) = q) (q : G ⧸ H) :
    (leftQuotientEquiv (isComplement_range_left hf) q : G) = f q
proof:
:= by
  refine (Subtype.ext_iff.mp ?_).trans (Subtype.coe_mk (f q) ⟨q, rfl⟩)
  exact (leftQuotientEquiv (isComplement_range_left hf)).eq_symm_apply.mp (hf q).symm

name: inv_toLeftFun_mul_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem inv_toLeftFun_mul_mem (hS : IsComplement S H) (g : G) :
    (toLeftFun hS g : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ H
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp <| Quotient.exact' <| quotientGroupMk_leftQuotientEquiv _ _

name: inv_mul_toLeftFun_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem inv_mul_toLeftFun_mem (hS : IsComplement S H) (g : G) :
    g⁻¹ * toLeftFun hS g ∈ H
proof:
:=
  (congr_arg (· ∈ H) (by rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv])).mp (H.inv_mem (inv_toLeftFun_mul_mem hS g))

name: finite_right_iff
statement: theorem finite_right_iff (h : IsComplement H T) : Finite T ↔ H.FiniteIndex
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.rightQuotientEquiv.finite_iff,
    (QuotientGroup.quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel H).finite_iff]
  exact ⟨fun _ ↦ finiteIndex_of_finite_quotient, fun _ ↦ finite_quotient_of_finiteIndex⟩

name: finite_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finite_right [H.FiniteIndex] (hT : IsComplement H T) : T.Finite
proof: := hT.finite_right_iff.2 ‹_›

name: mk''_rightQuotientEquiv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk''_rightQuotientEquiv (hT : IsComplement H T)
     (q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) : Quotient.mk'' (rightQuotientEquiv hT q : G) = q
proof:
:=
  (rightQuotientEquiv hT).symm_apply_apply q

name: rightQuotientEquiv_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem rightQuotientEquiv_apply {f : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) → G}
    (hf : ∀ q, Quotient.mk'' (f q) = q) (q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) :
    (rightQuotientEquiv (isComplement_range_right hf) q : G) = f q
proof:
:= by
  refine (Subtype.ext_iff.mp ?_).trans (Subtype.coe_mk (f q) ⟨q, rfl⟩)
  exact (rightQuotientEquiv (isComplement_range_right hf)).eq_symm_apply.1 (hf q).symm

name: mul_inv_toRightFun_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mul_inv_toRightFun_mem (hT : IsComplement H T) (g : G) :
    g * (toRightFun hT g : G)⁻¹ ∈ H
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply.mp <| Quotient.exact' <| mk''_rightQuotientEquiv _ _

name: toRightFun_mul_inv_mem
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toRightFun_mul_inv_mem (hT : IsComplement H T) (g : G) :
    (toRightFun hT g : G) * g⁻¹ ∈ H
proof:
:=
  (congr_arg (· ∈ H) (by rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv])).mp (H.inv_mem (mul_inv_toRightFun_mem hT g))

name: encard_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem encard_left [H.FiniteIndex] (h : IsComplement S H) : S.encard = H.index
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.finite_left.cast_ncard_eq, h.ncard_left]

name: encard_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem encard_right [H.FiniteIndex] (h : IsComplement H T) : T.encard = H.index
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.finite_right.cast_ncard_eq, h.ncard_right]

name: smul_toLeftFun
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem smul_toLeftFun (f : F) (S : H.LeftTransversal) (g : G) :
    (f • (S.2.toLeftFun g : G)) = (f • S).2.toLeftFun (f • g)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext_iff.mp <| @ExistsUnique.unique (↥(f • (S : Set G))) (fun s => (↑s)⁻¹ * f • g ∈ H)
    (isComplement_iff_existsUnique_inv_mul_mem.mp (f • S).2 (f • g))
    ⟨f • (S.2.toLeftFun g : G), Set.smul_mem_smul_set (Subtype.coe_prop _)⟩
      ((f • S).2.toLeftFun (f • g))
    (QuotientAction.inv_mul_mem f (S.2.inv_toLeftFun_mul_mem g))
      ((f • S).2.inv_toLeftFun_mul_mem (f • g))

name: smul_leftQuotientEquiv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem smul_leftQuotientEquiv (f : F) (S : H.LeftTransversal) (q : G ⧸ H) :
    f • (S.2.leftQuotientEquiv q : G) = (f • S).2.leftQuotientEquiv (f • q)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn' q fun g => smul_toLeftFun f S g

name: smul_apply_eq_smul_apply_inv_smul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem smul_apply_eq_smul_apply_inv_smul (f : F) (S : H.LeftTransversal) (q : G ⧸ H) :
    ((f • S).2.leftQuotientEquiv q : G) = f • (S.2.leftQuotientEquiv (f⁻¹ • q) : G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_leftQuotientEquiv, smul_inv_smul]

name: IsComplement'.isCompl
statement: theorem IsComplement'.isCompl (h : IsComplement' H K) : IsCompl H K
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨disjoint_iff_inf_le.mpr fun g ⟨p, q⟩ =>
        let x : H × K := ⟨⟨g, p⟩, 1⟩
        let y : H × K := ⟨1, g, q⟩
        Subtype.ext_iff.mp
          (Prod.ext_iff.mp (show x = y from h.1 ((mul_one g).trans (one_mul g).symm))).1,
      codisjoint_iff_le_sup.mpr fun g _ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨h, k⟩, rfl⟩ := h.2 g
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem_sup h.2 k.2

name: IsComplement'.sup_eq_top
statement: theorem IsComplement'.sup_eq_top (h : IsComplement' H K) : H ⊔ K = ⊤
proof:
:=
  h.isCompl.sup_eq_top

name: IsComplement'.disjoint
statement: theorem IsComplement'.disjoint (h : IsComplement' H K) : Disjoint H K
proof:
:=
  h.isCompl.disjoint

name: IsComplement'.index_eq_card
statement: theorem IsComplement'.index_eq_card (h : IsComplement' H K) : K.index = Nat.card H
proof:
:=
  h.card_left.symm

name: IsComplement'.card_mul_card
statement:
theorem IsComplement'.card_mul_card (h : IsComplement' H K) :
    Nat.card H * Nat.card K = Nat.card G
proof:
:=
  IsComplement.card_mul_card h

name: isComplement'_of_disjoint_and_mul_eq_univ
statement:
theorem isComplement'_of_disjoint_and_mul_eq_univ (h1 : Disjoint H K)
    (h2 : ↑H * ↑K = (Set.univ : Set G)) : IsComplement' H K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mul_injective_of_disjoint h1, fun g => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hh, k, hk, hg⟩ := Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mp h2 g
  exact ⟨(⟨h, hh⟩, ⟨k, hk⟩), hg⟩

name: isComplement'_of_card_mul_and_disjoint
statement:
theorem isComplement'_of_card_mul_and_disjoint [Finite G]
    (h1 : Nat.card H * Nat.card K = Nat.card G) (h2 : Disjoint H K) :
    IsComplement' H K
proof:
:=
  (Nat.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr
    ⟨mul_injective_of_disjoint h2, (Nat.card_prod H K).trans h1⟩

name: isComplement'_iff_card_mul_and_disjoint
statement:
theorem isComplement'_iff_card_mul_and_disjoint [Finite G] :
    IsComplement' H K ↔ Nat.card H * Nat.card K = Nat.card G ∧ Disjoint H K
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.card_mul_card, h.disjoint⟩, fun h => isComplement'_of_card_mul_and_disjoint h.1 h.2⟩

name: isComplement'_of_coprime
statement:
theorem isComplement'_of_coprime [Finite G]
    (h1 : Nat.card H * Nat.card K = Nat.card G)
    (h2 : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card H) (Nat.card K)) : IsComplement' H K
proof:
:=
  isComplement'_of_card_mul_and_disjoint h1 <| disjoint_of_coprime_natCard h2

name: isComplement'_stabilizer
statement:
theorem isComplement'_stabilizer {α : Type*} [MulAction G α] (a : α)
    (h1 : ∀ h : H, h • a = a → h = 1) (h2 : ∀ g : G, ∃ h : H, h • g • a = a) :
    IsComplement' H (MulAction.stabilizer G a)
proof:
:= by
  refine isComplement_iff_existsUnique.mpr fun g => ?_
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := h2 g
  have hh' : (↑h * g) • a = a := by rwa [mul_smul]
  refine ⟨⟨h⁻¹, h * g, hh'⟩, inv_mul_cancel_left ↑h g, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨h', g, hg : g • a = a⟩ rfl
  specialize h1 (h * h') (by rwa [mul_smul, smul_def h', ← hg, ← mul_smul, hg])
  refine Prod.ext (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1) (Subtype.ext ?_)
  rwa [Subtype.ext_iff, coe_one, coe_mul, ← right_eq_mul, mul_assoc (↑h) (↑h') g] at h1

name: rank_spec
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_spec [h : FG G] : ∃ S : Finset G, S.card = rank G ∧ .closure S = (⊤ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  @Nat.find_spec _ (Classical.decPred _) (fg_iff'.mp h)

name: rank_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_le [h : FG G] {S : Finset G} (hS : .closure S = (⊤ : Subgroup G)) : rank G ≤ S.card
proof:
:=
  @Nat.find_le _ _ (Classical.decPred _) (fg_iff'.mp h) ⟨S, rfl, hS⟩

name: rank_eq_zero
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := nontriviality)]
theorem rank_eq_zero [Subsingleton G] : rank G = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_zero_iff, ← Finset.card_empty]
  exact rank_le (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: rank_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem rank_eq_zero_iff [FG G] : rank G = 0 ↔ Subsingleton G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ rank_eq_zero G⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := rank_spec G
  rw [h, Finset.card_eq_zero] at hs
  simpa [hs, subsingleton_iff_bot_eq_top] using hs'

name: rank_pos
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem rank_pos [Nontrivial G] [FG G] : 0 < rank G
proof:
:= by
  rwa [pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, rank_eq_zero_iff, not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]

name: rank_le_of_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_le_of_surjective [FG G] [FG H] (f : G →* H) (hf : Surjective f) : rank H ≤ rank G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS1, hS2⟩ := rank_spec G
  trans (S.image f).card
  · apply rank_le
    rw [Finset.coe_image, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hS2, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective f hf]
  · exact Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq hS1

name: rank_range_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_range_le [FG G] {f : G →* H} : rank f.range ≤ rank G
proof:
:=
  rank_le_of_surjective f.rangeRestrict f.rangeRestrict_surjective

name: rank_congr
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_congr [FG G] [FG H] (e : G ≃* H) : rank G = rank H
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (rank_le_of_surjective e.symm e.symm.surjective)
    (rank_le_of_surjective e e.surjective)

name: rank_congr
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_congr {H K : Subgroup G} [Group.FG H] [Group.FG K] (h : H = K) : rank H = rank K
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: rank_closure_finset_le_card
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_closure_finset_le_card (s : Finset G) : rank (closure (s : Set G)) ≤ s.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t : Finset (closure (s : Set G)) := s.preimage Subtype.val Subtype.coe_injective.injOn
  have ht : closure (t : Set (closure (s : Set G))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Finset.coe_preimage]
    exact closure_preimage_eq_top (s : Set G)
  apply (rank_le ht).trans
  suffices H : Set.InjOn Subtype.val (t : Set (closure (s : Set G))) by
    rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn H, Finset.image_preimage]
    apply Finset.card_filter_le
  apply Subtype.coe_injective.injOn

name: rank_closure_finite_le_nat_card
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma rank_closure_finite_le_nat_card (s : Set G) [Finite s] : rank (closure s) ≤ Nat.card s
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite s
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← s.toFinset_card, ← rank_congr (congr_arg _ s.coe_toFinset)]
  exact rank_closure_finset_le_card s.toFinset

name: nat_card_centralizer_nat_card_stabilizer
statement:
lemma nat_card_centralizer_nat_card_stabilizer (g : G) :
    Nat.card (centralizer {g}) = Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer (ConjAct G) g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centralizer_eq_comap_stabilizer]; rfl

name: commutatorMap_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem commutatorMap_apply [Div G] (g : G) : commutatorMap φ g = g / φ g
proof: := rfl

name: commutatorMap_injective
statement: theorem commutatorMap_injective (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) : Function.Injective (commutatorMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun x y h ↦ inv_mul_eq_one.mp <| hφ _ ?_
  rwa [map_mul, map_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq, ← mul_assoc, ← eq_div_iff_mul_eq', ← division_def]

name: commutatorMap_surjective
statement: theorem commutatorMap_surjective (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) : Function.Surjective (commutatorMap φ)
proof:
:=
  Finite.surjective_of_injective hφ.commutatorMap_injective

name: prod_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem prod_pow_eq_one (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) {n : ℕ} (hn : φ^[n] = _root_.id) (g : G) :
    ((List.range n).map (fun k ↦ φ^[k] g)).prod = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := commutatorMap_surjective hφ g
  simp only [commutatorMap_apply, iterate_map_div, ← Function.iterate_succ_apply]
  rw [List.prod_range_div', Function.iterate_zero_apply, hn, Function.id_def, div_self']

name: coe_eq_inv_of_sq_eq_one
statement: theorem coe_eq_inv_of_sq_eq_one (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) (h2 : φ^[2] = _root_.id) : ⇑φ = (·⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  have key : g * φ g = 1 := by simpa [List.range_succ] using hφ.prod_pow_eq_one h2 g
  rwa [← inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one, eq_comm] at key

name: coe_eq_inv_of_involutive
statement:
theorem coe_eq_inv_of_involutive (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) (h2 : Function.Involutive φ) :
    ⇑φ = (·⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  coe_eq_inv_of_sq_eq_one hφ (funext h2)

name: commute_all_of_involutive
statement:
theorem commute_all_of_involutive (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) (h2 : Function.Involutive φ) (g h : G) :
    Commute g h
proof:
:= by
  have key := map_mul φ g h
  rwa [hφ.coe_eq_inv_of_involutive h2, inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, inv_inv] at key

name: orderOf_ne_two_of_involutive
statement:
theorem orderOf_ne_two_of_involutive (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) (h2 : Function.Involutive φ) (g : G) :
    orderOf g ≠ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro hg
  have key : φ g = g := by
    rw [hφ.coe_eq_inv_of_involutive h2, inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one, ← sq, ← hg, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
  rw [hφ g key, orderOf_one] at hg
  contradiction

name: odd_card_of_involutive
statement:
theorem odd_card_of_involutive (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) (h2 : Function.Involutive φ) :
    Odd (Nat.card G)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite G
  by_contra h
  rw [Nat.not_odd_iff_even, even_iff_two_dvd, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card 2 h
  exact hφ.orderOf_ne_two_of_involutive h2 g hg

name: odd_orderOf_of_involutive
statement:
theorem odd_orderOf_of_involutive (hφ : FixedPointFree φ) (h2 : Function.Involutive φ) (g : G) :
    Odd (orderOf g)
proof:
:=
  Odd.of_dvd_nat (hφ.odd_card_of_involutive h2) (orderOf_dvd_natCard g)

name: sum_conjClasses_card_eq_card
statement:
theorem sum_conjClasses_card_eq_card [Fintype <| ConjClasses G] [Fintype G]
    [∀ x : ConjClasses G, Fintype x.carrier] :
    ∑ x : ConjClasses G, x.carrier.toFinset.card = Fintype.card G
proof:
:= by
  suffices (Σ x : ConjClasses G, x.carrier) ≃ G by simpa using! (Fintype.card_congr this)
  simpa [carrier_eq_preimage_mk] using! Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv ConjClasses.mk

name: Group.sum_card_conj_classes_eq_card
statement:
theorem Group.sum_card_conj_classes_eq_card [Finite G] :
    ∑ᶠ x : ConjClasses G, x.carrier.ncard = Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype G
  simp [← sum_conjClasses_card_eq_card, finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype]

name: Group.nat_card_center_add_sum_card_noncenter_eq_card
statement:
theorem Group.nat_card_center_add_sum_card_noncenter_eq_card [Finite G] :
    Nat.card (Subgroup.center G) + ∑ᶠ x ∈ noncenter G, Nat.card x.carrier = Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype G
  rw [@Nat.card_eq_fintype_card G, ← sum_conjClasses_card_eq_card, ←
    Finset.sum_sdiff (ConjClasses.noncenter G).toFinset.subset_univ]
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Set.toFinset_card]
  congr 1
  swap
  · convert! finsum_cond_eq_sum_of_cond_iff _ _
    simp [Set.mem_toFinset]
  calc
    Fintype.card (Subgroup.center G) = Fintype.card ((noncenter G)ᶜ : Set _) :=
      Fintype.card_congr ((mk_bijOn G).equiv _)
    _ = Finset.card (Finset.univ \ (noncenter G).toFinset) := by
      rw [← Set.toFinset_card, Set.toFinset_compl, Finset.compl_eq_univ_sdiff]
    _ = _ := ?_
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
