theorem orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one (hn : 0 < n) (h : x ^ n = 1) : orderOf x ≤ n
proof:
:=
  IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_le hn (by rwa [isPeriodicPt_mul_iff_pow_eq_one])

name: orderOf_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem orderOf_one : orderOf (1 : G) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf, ← minimalPeriod_id (x := (1 : G)), ← one_mul_eq_id]

name: orderOf_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) AddMonoid.addOrderOf_eq_one_iff]
theorem orderOf_eq_one_iff : orderOf x = 1 ↔ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf, minimalPeriod_eq_one_iff_isFixedPt, IsFixedPt, mul_one]

name: pow_mod_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) mod_addOrderOf_nsmul]
lemma pow_mod_orderOf (x : G) (n : ℕ) : x ^ (n % orderOf x) = x ^ n
proof:
:=
  calc
    x ^ (n % orderOf x) = x ^ (n % orderOf x + orderOf x * (n / orderOf x)) := by
        simp [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
    _ = x ^ n := by rw [Nat.mod_add_div]

name: orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (h : x ^ n = 1) : orderOf x ∣ n
proof:
:=
  IsPeriodicPt.minimalPeriod_dvd ((isPeriodicPt_mul_iff_pow_eq_one _).mpr h)

name: orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one {n : ℕ} : orderOf x ∣ n ↔ x ^ n = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← pow_mod_orderOf, Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h, _root_.pow_zero],
    orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one⟩

name: exists_pow_eq_pow_two_mul
statement:
@[to_additive /
multiple of `x`. -/]
theorem exists_pow_eq_pow_two_mul {p : ℕ} (hx : x ^ p = 1) (hp : Odd p) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m, x ^ n = x ^ (2 * m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hp
  have key : x ^ (2 * (r + 1)) = x := by
    have h2 : 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [h2, pow_succ, hx, one_mul]
  exact ⟨(r + 1) * n, by rw [← mul_assoc, pow_mul, key]⟩

name: orderOf_pow_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive addOrderOf_smul_dvd]
theorem orderOf_pow_dvd (n : ℕ) : orderOf (x ^ n) ∣ orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, pow_right_comm, pow_orderOf_eq_one, one_pow]

name: pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf : (Set.Iio <| orderOf x).InjOn (x ^ ·)

name: IsOfFinOrder.mem_powers_iff_mem_range_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected lemma IsOfFinOrder.mem_powers_iff_mem_range_orderOf [DecidableEq G]
    (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
    y ∈ Submonoid.powers x ↔ y ∈ (Finset.range (orderOf x)).image (x ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_range_iff_mem_finset_range_of_mod_eq' hx.orderOf_pos <| pow_mod_orderOf _

name: IsOfFinOrder.powers_eq_image_range_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected lemma IsOfFinOrder.powers_eq_image_range_orderOf [DecidableEq G] (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
    (Submonoid.powers x : Set G) = (Finset.range (orderOf x)).image (x ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ ↦ hx.mem_powers_iff_mem_range_orderOf

name: pow_eq_pow_of_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_eq_pow_of_modEq {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≡ b [MOD n]) (hx : x ^ n = 1) : x ^ a = x ^ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain hle | hle := le_total a b
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hle
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : n ∣ c := by simpa using h
    simp [pow_add, pow_mul, hx]

name: pow_eq_one_iff_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_eq_one_iff_modEq : x ^ n = 1 ↔ n ≡ 0 [MOD orderOf x]
proof:
:= by
  rw [modEq_zero_iff_dvd, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: orderOf_map_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_map_dvd {H : Type*} [Monoid H] (ψ : G →* H) (x : G) :
    orderOf (ψ x) ∣ orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  apply orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one
  rw [← map_pow, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
  apply map_one

name: exists_pow_eq_self_of_coprime
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem exists_pow_eq_self_of_coprime (h : n.Coprime (orderOf x)) : ∃ m : ℕ, (x ^ n) ^ m = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : orderOf x = 0
  · rw [h0, coprime_zero_right] at h
    exact ⟨1, by rw [h, pow_one, pow_one]⟩
  by_cases h1 : orderOf x = 1
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp h1, one_pow, one_pow]⟩
  obtain ⟨m, -, h⟩ := exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime h (by lia)
  exact ⟨m, by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mod_orderOf, h, pow_one]⟩

name: orderOf_eq_of_pow_and_pow_div_prime
statement:
@[to_additive addOrderOf_eq_of_nsmul_and_div_prime_nsmul /
all prime factors `p` of `n`, then `x` has order `n` in `G`. -/]
theorem orderOf_eq_of_pow_and_pow_div_prime (hn : 0 < n) (hx : x ^ n = 1)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ n → x ^ (n / p) ≠ 1) : orderOf x = n
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_eq_mul_right_of_dvd (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hx)
  suffices a = 1 by simp [this, ha]
  
  by_contra h
  have a_min_fac_dvd_p_sub_one : a.minFac ∣ n := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ, a = b * a.minFac := exists_eq_mul_left_of_dvd a.minFac_dvd
    rw [hb, ← mul_assoc] at ha
    exact Dvd.intro_left (orderOf x * b) ha.symm
  
  refine hd a.minFac (Nat.minFac_prime h) a_min_fac_dvd_p_sub_one ?_
  rw [← orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, Nat.dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd a_min_fac_dvd_p_sub_one, ha, mul_comm,
    Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (IsOfFinOrder.orderOf_pos _)]
  · exact Nat.minFac_dvd a
  · rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]
    exact Exists.intro n (id ⟨hn, hx⟩)

name: orderOf_eq_orderOf_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_eq_orderOf_iff {H : Type*} [Monoid H] {y : H} :
    orderOf x = orderOf y ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, x ^ n = 1 ↔ y ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← isPeriodicPt_mul_iff_pow_eq_one, ← minimalPeriod_eq_minimalPeriod_iff, orderOf]

name: orderOf_injective
statement:
theorem orderOf_injective {H : Type*} [Monoid H] (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Injective f) (x : G) :
    orderOf (f x) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [orderOf_eq_orderOf_iff, ← f.map_pow, ← f.map_one, hf.eq_iff, forall_const]

name: MulEquiv.orderOf_eq
statement:
lemma MulEquiv.orderOf_eq {H : Type*} [Monoid H] (e : G ≃* H) (x : G) :
    orderOf (e x) = orderOf x
proof:
:=
  orderOf_injective e.toMonoidHom e.injective x

name: Function.Injective.isOfFinOrder_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Function.Injective.isOfFinOrder_iff [Monoid H] {f : G →* H} (hf : Injective f) :
    IsOfFinOrder (f x) ↔ IsOfFinOrder x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orderOf_pos_iff, orderOf_injective f hf x, ← orderOf_pos_iff]

name: orderOf_submonoid
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := norm_cast, simp)]
theorem orderOf_submonoid {H : Submonoid G} (y : H) : orderOf (y : G) = orderOf y
proof:
:=
  orderOf_injective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective y

name: orderOf_units
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := norm_cast)]
theorem orderOf_units {y : Gˣ} : orderOf (y : G) = orderOf y
proof:
:=
  orderOf_injective (Units.coeHom G) Units.val_injective y

name: IsUnit.orderOf_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsUnit.orderOf_eq_one [Subsingleton Gˣ] {x : G} (h : IsUnit x) :
    orderOf x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [isUnit_iff_eq_one.mp h]

name: Units.isOfFinOrder_val
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := norm_cast)]
theorem Units.isOfFinOrder_val {u : Gˣ} : IsOfFinOrder (u : G) ↔ IsOfFinOrder u
proof:
:=
  Units.coeHom_injective.isOfFinOrder_iff

name: IsOfFinOrder.isUnit
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.isUnit {M} [Monoid M] {x : M} (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) : IsUnit x
proof: := ⟨hx.unit, rfl⟩

name: orderOf_pow'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_pow' (h : n ≠ 0) : orderOf (x ^ n) = orderOf x / Nat.gcd (orderOf x) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold orderOf
  rw [← minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd h, mul_left_iterate]

name: orderOf_pow_of_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma orderOf_pow_of_dvd {x : G} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (dvd : n ∣ orderOf x) :
    orderOf (x ^ n) = orderOf x / n
proof: := by rw [orderOf_pow' _ hn, Nat.gcd_eq_right dvd]

name: orderOf_pow_orderOf_div
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma orderOf_pow_orderOf_div {x : G} {n : ℕ} (hx : orderOf x ≠ 0) (hn : n ∣ orderOf x) :
    orderOf (x ^ (orderOf x / n)) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf_pow_of_dvd _ (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hn), Nat.div_div_self hn hx]
  rw [← Nat.div_mul_cancel hn] at hx; exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hx

name: IsOfFinOrder.orderOf_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected lemma IsOfFinOrder.orderOf_pow (h : IsOfFinOrder x) :
    orderOf (x ^ n) = orderOf x / Nat.gcd (orderOf x) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold orderOf
  rw [← minimalPeriod_iterate_eq_div_gcd' h, mul_left_iterate]

name: Nat.Coprime.orderOf_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma Nat.Coprime.orderOf_pow (h : (orderOf y).Coprime m) : orderOf (y ^ m) = orderOf y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hg : IsOfFinOrder y
  · rw [hg.orderOf_pow y m, h.gcd_eq_one, Nat.div_one]
  · rw [m.coprime_zero_left.1 (orderOf_eq_zero hg ▸ h), pow_one]

name: IsOfFinOrder.natCard_powers_le_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.natCard_powers_le_orderOf (ha : IsOfFinOrder a) :
    Nat.card (powers a : Set G) ≤ orderOf a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [ha.powers_eq_image_range_orderOf, Finset.card_range, Nat.Iio_eq_range]
    using Finset.card_image_le (s := Finset.range (orderOf a))

name: IsOfFinOrder.finite_powers
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.finite_powers (ha : IsOfFinOrder a) : (powers a : Set G).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [ha.powers_eq_image_range_orderOf]; exact Finset.finite_toSet _

name: orderOf_mul_dvd_lcm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_mul_dvd_lcm (h : Commute x y) :
    orderOf (x * y) ∣ Nat.lcm (orderOf x) (orderOf y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf, ← comp_mul_left]
  exact Function.Commute.minimalPeriod_of_comp_dvd_lcm h.function_commute_mul_left

name: orderOf_dvd_lcm_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_dvd_lcm_mul (h : Commute x y) :
    orderOf y ∣ Nat.lcm (orderOf x) (orderOf (x * y))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : orderOf x = 0
  · rw [h0, lcm_zero_left]
    apply dvd_zero
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [← one_mul y, ← pow_orderOf_eq_one x, ← succ_pred_eq_of_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0),
      _root_.pow_succ, mul_assoc]
  exact
    (((Commute.refl x).mul_right h).pow_left _).orderOf_mul_dvd_lcm.trans
      (Nat.lcm_dvd_iff.2 ⟨(orderOf_pow_dvd _).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _), Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _⟩)

name: orderOf_mul_dvd_mul_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive addOrderOf_add_dvd_mul_addOrderOf]
theorem orderOf_mul_dvd_mul_orderOf (h : Commute x y) :
    orderOf (x * y) ∣ orderOf x * orderOf y
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans h.orderOf_mul_dvd_lcm (Nat.lcm_dvd_mul _ _)

name: orderOf_mul_eq_mul_orderOf_of_coprime
statement:
@[to_additive addOrderOf_add_eq_mul_addOrderOf_of_coprime]
theorem orderOf_mul_eq_mul_orderOf_of_coprime (h : Commute x y)
    (hco : (orderOf x).Coprime (orderOf y)) : orderOf (x * y) = orderOf x * orderOf y
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf, ← comp_mul_left]
  exact h.function_commute_mul_left.minimalPeriod_of_comp_eq_mul_of_coprime hco

name: orderOf_mul_eq_right_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive /
theorem isOfFinOrder_mul (h : Commute x y) (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) (hy : IsOfFinOrder y) :
    IsOfFinOrder (x * y) :=
  orderOf_pos_iff.mp <|
    pos_of_dvd_of_pos h.orderOf_mul_dvd_mul_orderOf <| mul_pos hx.orderOf_pos hy.orderOf_pos

/
  with `y`, then `x * y` has the same order as `y`. -/
@[to_additive addOrderOf_add_eq_right_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd
  /
  `addOrderOf x` has higher multiplicity in `addOrderOf y`, and `x` commutes with `y`,
  then `x + y` has the same order as `y`. -/]
theorem orderOf_mul_eq_right_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd (h : Commute x y) (hy : IsOfFinOrder y)
    (hdvd : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ orderOf x → p * orderOf x ∣ orderOf y) :
    orderOf (x * y) = orderOf y
proof:
:= by
  have hoy := hy.orderOf_pos
  have hxy := dvd_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd hdvd
  apply orderOf_eq_of_pow_and_pow_div_prime hoy <;> simp only [Ne, ← orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]
  · exact h.orderOf_mul_dvd_lcm.trans (Nat.lcm_dvd hxy dvd_rfl)
  refine fun p hp hpy hd => hp.ne_one ?_
  rw [← Nat.dvd_one, ← mul_dvd_mul_iff_right hoy.ne', one_mul, ← dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hpy]
  refine (orderOf_dvd_lcm_mul h).trans (Nat.lcm_dvd ((dvd_div_iff_mul_dvd hpy).2 ?_) hd)
  by_cases h : p ∣ orderOf x
  exacts [hdvd p hp h, (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 h).mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd hpy hxy]

name: orderOf_mul_eq_left_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd
statement:
@[to_additive addOrderOf_add_eq_left_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd
  /
  `addOrderOf y` has higher multiplicity in `addOrderOf x`, and `x` commutes with `y`,
  then `x + y` has the same order as `x`. -/]
theorem orderOf_mul_eq_left_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd (h : Commute x y) (hx : IsOfFinOrder x)
    (hdvd : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ orderOf y → p * orderOf y ∣ orderOf x) :
    orderOf (x * y) = orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [h.eq] using
    orderOf_mul_eq_right_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd (x := y) (y := x) h.symm hx hdvd

name: orderOf_eq_prime_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_eq_prime_iff : orderOf x = p ↔ x ^ p = 1 ∧ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf, minimalPeriod_eq_prime_iff, isPeriodicPt_mul_iff_pow_eq_one, IsFixedPt, mul_one]

name: orderOf_eq_prime_pow
statement:
@[to_additive /
theorem orderOf_eq_prime (hg : x ^ p = 1) (hg1 : x ≠ 1) : orderOf x = p :=
  orderOf_eq_prime_iff.mpr ⟨hg, hg1⟩

@[to_additive addOrderOf_eq_prime_pow]
theorem orderOf_eq_prime_pow (hnot : ¬x ^ p ^ n = 1) (hfin : x ^ p ^ (n + 1) = 1) :
    orderOf x = p ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply minimalPeriod_eq_prime_pow <;> rwa [isPeriodicPt_mul_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: exists_orderOf_eq_prime_pow_iff
statement:
@[to_additive exists_addOrderOf_eq_prime_pow_iff]
theorem exists_orderOf_eq_prime_pow_iff :
    (∃ k : ℕ, orderOf x = p ^ k) ↔ ∃ m : ℕ, x ^ (p : ℕ) ^ m = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ⟨k, by rw [← hk, pow_orderOf_eq_one]⟩, fun ⟨_, hm⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp.elim).mp (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hm)
    exact ⟨k, hk⟩⟩

name: orderOf_neg_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderOf_neg_one {R} [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] :
    orderOf (-1 : R) = if ringChar R = 2 then 1 else 2
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [neg_one_eq_one_iff.2 h, orderOf_one]
  apply orderOf_eq_prime
  · simp
  simpa [neg_one_eq_one_iff] using h

name: CharP.orderOf_eq_two_iff
statement:
lemma CharP.orderOf_eq_two_iff {R} [Ring R] [Nontrivial R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p ≠ 2) [CharP R p] {x : R} : orderOf x = 2 ↔ x = -1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderOf_eq_prime_iff, sq_eq_one_iff, ne_eq, or_and_right, and_not_self, false_or,
    and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  rintro rfl
  exact fun h ↦ hp ((ringChar.eq R p) ▸ (neg_one_eq_one_iff.1 h))

name: finEquivPowers_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma finEquivPowers_apply {x : G} (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) {n : Fin (orderOf x)} :
    finEquivPowers hx n = ⟨x ^ (n : ℕ), n, rfl⟩
proof: := rfl

name: finEquivPowers_symm_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma finEquivPowers_symm_apply {x : G} (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) (n : ℕ) :
    (finEquivPowers hx).symm ⟨x ^ n, _, rfl⟩ = ⟨n % orderOf x, Nat.mod_lt _ hx.orderOf_pos⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq, finEquivPowers_apply, Subtype.mk_eq_mk, ← pow_mod_orderOf, Fin.val_mk]

name: IsOfFinOrder.pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOfFinOrder.pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n ≡ m [MOD orderOf x]
proof:
:= by
  wlog hmn : m ≤ n generalizing m n
  · rw [eq_comm, ModEq.comm, this (le_of_not_ge hmn)]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
  rw [pow_add, (hx.isUnit.pow _).mul_eq_left, pow_eq_one_iff_modEq]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ Nat.ModEq.add_left _ h, fun h ↦ Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' _ h⟩

name: IsOfFinOrder.pow_inj_mod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.pow_inj_mod {n m : ℕ} : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n % orderOf x = m % orderOf x
proof:
:=
  hx.pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq

name: pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n ≡ m [MOD orderOf x]
proof:
:= by
  wlog hmn : m ≤ n generalizing m n
  · rw [eq_comm, ModEq.comm, this (le_of_not_ge hmn)]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
  rw [← mul_one (x ^ m), pow_add, mul_left_cancel_iff, pow_eq_one_iff_modEq]
  exact ⟨fun h => Nat.ModEq.add_left _ h, fun h => Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' _ h⟩

name: injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder : Injective (fun n : ℕ ↦ x ^ n) ↔ ¬IsOfFinOrder x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => not_isOfFinOrder_of_injective_pow h, fun h n m hnm => ?_⟩
  rwa [pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq, orderOf_eq_zero_iff.mpr h, modEq_zero_iff] at hnm

name: pow_inj_mod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma pow_inj_mod {n m : ℕ} : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n % orderOf x = m % orderOf x
proof: := pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq

name: pow_inj_iff_of_orderOf_eq_zero
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_inj_iff_of_orderOf_eq_zero (h : orderOf x = 0) {n m : ℕ} : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq, h, modEq_zero_iff]

name: infinite_not_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem infinite_not_isOfFinOrder {x : G} (h : ¬IsOfFinOrder x) :
    { y : G | ¬IsOfFinOrder y }.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  let s := { n | 0 < n }.image fun n : ℕ => x ^ n
  have hs : s ⊆ { y : G | ¬IsOfFinOrder y } := by
    rintro - ⟨n, hn : 0 < n, rfl⟩ (contra : IsOfFinOrder (x ^ n))
    apply h
    rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one] at contra ⊢
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := contra
    exact ⟨n * m, mul_pos hn hm, by rwa [pow_mul]⟩
  suffices s.Infinite by exact this.mono hs
  contrapose! h
  have : ¬Injective fun n : ℕ => x ^ n := by
    have := Set.not_injOn_infinite_finite_image (Set.Ioi_infinite 0) h
    contrapose this
    exact Set.injOn_of_injective this
  rwa [injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder, Classical.not_not] at this

name: finite_powers
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma finite_powers : (powers a : Set G).Finite ↔ IsOfFinOrder a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, IsOfFinOrder.finite_powers⟩
  obtain ⟨m, n, hmn, ha⟩ := h.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := fun n : ℕ ↦ a ^ n)
    (fun n ↦ by simp [mem_powers_iff])
  refine isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.2 ⟨n - m, tsub_pos_iff_lt.2 hmn, ?_⟩
  rw [← mul_left_cancel_iff (a := a ^ m), ← pow_add, add_tsub_cancel_of_le hmn.le, ha, mul_one]

name: infinite_powers
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma infinite_powers : (powers a : Set G).Infinite ↔ ¬ IsOfFinOrder a
proof: := finite_powers.not

name: Nat.card_submonoidPowers
statement: lemma Nat.card_submonoidPowers : Nat.card (powers a) = orderOf a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsOfFinOrder a
  · exact (Nat.card_congr (finEquivPowers ha).symm).trans <| by simp
  · have := (infinite_powers.2 ha).to_subtype
    rw [orderOf_eq_zero ha, Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite]

name: pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n ≡ m [MOD orderOf x]
proof:
:= by
  wlog hmn : m ≤ n generalizing m n
  · rw [eq_comm, Nat.ModEq.comm, this (le_of_not_ge hmn)]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hk : x ^ k = 1 := by
      apply (mul_right_cancel_iff (a := x ^ m)).1
      calc
        x ^ k * x ^ m = x ^ (k + m) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
        _ = x ^ (m + k) := by simp [Nat.add_comm]
        _ = x ^ m := h
        _ = 1 * x ^ m := by simp
    exact by simpa using Nat.ModEq.add_left m (pow_eq_one_iff_modEq.1 hk)
  · intro h
    have hk : x ^ k = 1 := by
      apply pow_eq_one_iff_modEq.2
      exact Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' m (by simpa using h)
    calc
      x ^ (m + k) = x ^ m * x ^ k := by rw [pow_add]
      _ = x ^ m := by simp [hk]

name: injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ ↦ x ^ n) ↔
    ¬IsOfFinOrder x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => not_isOfFinOrder_of_injective_pow h, fun h n m hnm => ?_⟩
  rwa [pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq, orderOf_eq_zero_iff.mpr h, Nat.modEq_zero_iff] at hnm

name: pow_inj_mod
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma pow_inj_mod {n m : ℕ} : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n % orderOf x = m % orderOf x
proof:
:=
  pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq

name: pow_inj_iff_of_orderOf_eq_zero
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem pow_inj_iff_of_orderOf_eq_zero (h : orderOf x = 0) {n m : ℕ} : x ^ n = x ^ m ↔ n = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq, h, Nat.modEq_zero_iff]

name: infinite_not_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem infinite_not_isOfFinOrder {x : G} (h : ¬IsOfFinOrder x) :
    { y : G | ¬IsOfFinOrder y }.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  let s := { n | 0 < n }.image fun n : ℕ => x ^ n
  have hs : s ⊆ { y : G | ¬IsOfFinOrder y } := by
    rintro - ⟨n, hn : 0 < n, rfl⟩ (contra : IsOfFinOrder (x ^ n))
    apply h
    rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one] at contra ⊢
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := contra
    exact ⟨n * m, mul_pos hn hm, by rwa [pow_mul]⟩
  suffices s.Infinite by exact this.mono hs
  contrapose! h
  have : ¬Function.Injective fun n : ℕ => x ^ n := by
    have := Set.not_injOn_infinite_finite_image (Set.Ioi_infinite 0) h
    contrapose this
    exact Set.injOn_of_injective this
  rwa [injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder, Classical.not_not] at this

name: finite_powers
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma finite_powers : (powers a : Set G).Finite ↔ IsOfFinOrder a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, IsOfFinOrder.finite_powers⟩
  obtain ⟨m, n, hmn, ha⟩ := h.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := fun n : ℕ ↦ a ^ n)
    (fun n ↦ by simp [mem_powers_iff])
  refine isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.2 ⟨n - m, tsub_pos_iff_lt.2 hmn, ?_⟩
  apply (mul_right_cancel_iff (a := a ^ m)).1
  calc
    a ^ (n - m) * a ^ m = a ^ (n - m + m) := (pow_add _ _ _).symm
    _ = a ^ n := by simp [tsub_add_cancel_of_le hmn.le]
    _ = a ^ m := ha.symm
    _ = 1 * a ^ m := by simp

name: infinite_powers
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma infinite_powers : (powers a : Set G).Infinite ↔ ¬ IsOfFinOrder a
proof: := finite_powers.not

name: Nat.card_submonoidPowers
statement: lemma Nat.card_submonoidPowers : Nat.card (powers a) = orderOf a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsOfFinOrder a
  · exact (Nat.card_congr (finEquivPowers ha).symm).trans <| by simp
  · have := (infinite_powers.2 ha).to_subtype
    rw [orderOf_eq_zero ha, Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite]

name: isOfFinOrder_inv_iff
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /
have finite additive order. -/]
theorem isOfFinOrder_inv_iff {x : G} : IsOfFinOrder x⁻¹ ↔ IsOfFinOrder x
proof:
:= by
  simp [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one : (orderOf x : ℤ) ∣ i ↔ x ^ i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg i with ⟨i, rfl | rfl⟩
  · rw [Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one, zpow_natCast]
  · rw [dvd_neg, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, zpow_neg, inv_eq_one, zpow_natCast,
      orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: orderOf_inv
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem orderOf_inv (x : G) : orderOf x⁻¹ = orderOf x
proof: := by simp [orderOf_eq_orderOf_iff]

name: orderOf_dvd_sub_iff_zpow_eq_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_dvd_sub_iff_zpow_eq_zpow {a b : ℤ} : (orderOf x : ℤ) ∣ a - b ↔ x ^ a = x ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one, zpow_sub, mul_inv_eq_one]

name: isSelfInv_iff_isOfFinOrder_and_orderOf_le_two
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isSelfInv_iff_isOfFinOrder_and_orderOf_le_two {a : G} :
    IsSelfInv a ↔ IsOfFinOrder a ∧ orderOf a ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSelfInv_iff_sq_eq_one]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨2, zero_lt_two, h⟩,
    orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one zero_lt_two h⟩, fun ⟨hfin, _⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  have : orderOf a = 1 ∨ orderOf a = 2 := by grind [hfin.orderOf_pos]
  rcases this with h₁ | h₂
  · simp [orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp h₁]
  · rw [← h₂, pow_orderOf_eq_one a]

name: IsOfFinOrder.isSelfInv_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOfFinOrder.isSelfInv_iff {a : G} (h : IsOfFinOrder a) :
    IsSelfInv a ↔ orderOf a ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSelfInv_iff_isOfFinOrder_and_orderOf_le_two, and_iff_right h]

name: orderOf_coe
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := norm_cast)]
lemma orderOf_coe (a : H) : orderOf (a : G) = orderOf a
proof:
:=
  orderOf_injective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective _

name: orderOf_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma orderOf_mk (a : G) (ha) : orderOf (⟨a, ha⟩ : H) = orderOf a
proof: := (orderOf_coe _).symm

name: zpow_mod_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive mod_addOrderOf_zsmul]
lemma zpow_mod_orderOf (x : G) (z : ℤ) : x ^ (z % (orderOf x : ℤ)) = x ^ z
proof:
:=
  calc
    x ^ (z % (orderOf x : ℤ)) = x ^ (z % orderOf x + orderOf x * (z / orderOf x) : ℤ) := by
        simp [zpow_add, zpow_mul, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
    _ = x ^ z := by rw [Int.emod_add_mul_ediv]

name: zpow_pow_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) zsmul_smul_addOrderOf]
theorem zpow_pow_orderOf : (x ^ i) ^ orderOf x = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOfFinOrder x
  · rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, pow_orderOf_eq_one, one_zpow]
  · rw [orderOf_eq_zero h, _root_.pow_zero]

name: IsOfFinOrder.zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOfFinOrder.zpow (h : IsOfFinOrder x) {i : ℤ} : IsOfFinOrder (x ^ i)
proof:
:=
  isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨orderOf x, h.orderOf_pos, zpow_pow_orderOf⟩

name: IsOfFinOrder.of_mem_zpowers
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsOfFinOrder.of_mem_zpowers (h : IsOfFinOrder x) (h' : y ∈ Subgroup.zpowers x) :
    IsOfFinOrder y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp h'
  exact h.zpow

name: orderOf_dvd_of_mem_zpowers
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_dvd_of_mem_zpowers (h : y ∈ Subgroup.zpowers x) : orderOf y ∣ orderOf x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp h
  rw [orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]
  exact zpow_pow_orderOf

name: smul_eq_self_of_mem_zpowers
statement:
theorem smul_eq_self_of_mem_zpowers {α : Type*} [MulAction G α] (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers y)
    {a : α} (hs : y • a = a) : x • a = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hx
  rw [← MulAction.toPerm_apply, ← MulAction.toPermHom_apply, map_zpow _ y k,
    MulAction.toPermHom_apply]
  exact Function.IsFixedPt.perm_zpow (by exact hs) k

name: vadd_eq_self_of_mem_zmultiples
statement:
theorem vadd_eq_self_of_mem_zmultiples {G : Type*} [AddGroup G] {x y : G} {α : Type*}
    [AddAction G α] (hx : x ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples y) {a : α} (hs : y +ᵥ a = a) : x +ᵥ a = a
proof:
:=
  @smul_eq_self_of_mem_zpowers (Multiplicative G) _ _ _ α _ hx a hs

name: IsOfFinOrder.mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
    y ∈ powers x ↔ y ∈ zpowers x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, by simp_all⟩, fun ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨(i % orderOf x).natAbs, by
    dsimp only
    rwa [← zpow_natCast, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg <| Int.emod_nonneg _ <|
      Int.natCast_ne_zero_iff_pos.2 <| hx.orderOf_pos, zpow_mod_orderOf]⟩⟩

name: IsOfFinOrder.powers_eq_zpowers
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.powers_eq_zpowers (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) : (powers x : Set G) = zpowers x
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ ↦ hx.mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers

name: IsOfFinOrder.mem_zpowers_iff_mem_range_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsOfFinOrder.mem_zpowers_iff_mem_range_orderOf [DecidableEq G] (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
    y ∈ zpowers x ↔ y ∈ (Finset.range (orderOf x)).image (x ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  hx.mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.symm.trans hx.mem_powers_iff_mem_range_orderOf

name: Subgroup.closure_toSubmonoid_of_isOfFinOrder
statement:
lemma Subgroup.closure_toSubmonoid_of_isOfFinOrder {s : Set G} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, IsOfFinOrder x) :
    (closure s).toSubmonoid = Submonoid.closure s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_closure_toSubmonoid s)
  rw [closure_toSubmonoid]
  refine Submonoid.closure_le.mpr <| Set.union_subset Submonoid.subset_closure
    fun x (hx : x⁻¹ ∈ s) ↦ ?_
  apply Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (Submonoid.subset_closure hx)
  simp [(hs _ hx).mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers]

name: finEquivZPowers_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finEquivZPowers_apply (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) {n : Fin (orderOf x)} :
    finEquivZPowers hx n = ⟨x ^ (n : ℕ), n, zpow_natCast x n⟩
proof: := rfl

name: finEquivZPowers_symm_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma finEquivZPowers_symm_apply (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) (n : ℕ) :
    (finEquivZPowers hx).symm ⟨x ^ n, ⟨n, by simp⟩⟩ =
    ⟨n % orderOf x, Nat.mod_lt _ hx.orderOf_pos⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [finEquivZPowers, Equiv.symm_trans_apply]; exact finEquivPowers_symm_apply _ n

name: pow_finEquivZPowers_symm_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma pow_finEquivZPowers_symm_apply (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) (a : Subgroup.zpowers x) :
    x ^ ((finEquivZPowers hx).symm a : ℕ) = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finEquivZPowers_apply] using
    congr_arg Subtype.val ((finEquivZPowers hx).apply_symm_apply a)

name: IsOfFinOrder.mul
statement: theorem IsOfFinOrder.mul (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) (hy : IsOfFinOrder y) : IsOfFinOrder (x * y)
proof:
:=
  (Commute.all x y).isOfFinOrder_mul hx hy

name: isMulTorsionFree_iff_not_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isMulTorsionFree_iff_not_isOfFinOrder :
    IsMulTorsionFree G ↔ ∀ ⦃a : G⦄, a ≠ 1 → ¬ IsOfFinOrder a where
  mp _ _
proof:
:= not_isOfFinOrder_of_isMulTorsionFree
  mpr hG := by
    refine ⟨fun n hn a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← div_eq_one] at hab ⊢
    simp only [← div_pow, isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one] at hab hG
    exact of_not_not fun hab' ↦ hG hab' ⟨n, hn.bot_lt, hab⟩

name: not_isMulTorsionFree_iff_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma not_isMulTorsionFree_iff_isOfFinOrder :
    ¬ IsMulTorsionFree G ↔ ∃ a ≠ (1 : G), IsOfFinOrder a
proof:
:= by
  simp [isMulTorsionFree_iff_not_isOfFinOrder]

name: zpowers_mabs
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma zpowers_mabs [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] (g : G) : zpowers |g|ₘ = zpowers g
proof:
:= by
  rcases mabs_cases g with h | h <;> simp only [h, zpowers_inv]

name: IsMulTorsionFree.orderOf_le_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsMulTorsionFree.orderOf_le_one [IsMulTorsionFree G] (g : G) :
    orderOf g ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne g 1
  · simp
  · rw [ne_eq, ← isOfFinOrder_iff_eq_one, ← orderOf_eq_zero_iff] at ha
    simp [ha]

name: sum_card_orderOf_eq_card_pow_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  refine (Finset.card_biUnion ?_).symm.trans ?_
  · simp +contextual [Set.PairwiseDisjoint, Set.Pairwise, disjoint_iff, Finset.ext_iff]
  · congr; ext; simp [hn, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]

name: orderOf_le_card_univ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_le_card_univ [Fintype G] : orderOf x ≤ Fintype.card G
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_card_of_inj_on_range (x ^ ·) (fun _ _ ↦ Finset.mem_univ _) pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf

name: orderOf_le_card
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_le_card [Finite G] : orderOf x ≤ Nat.card G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟩ := nonempty_fintype G
  simpa using orderOf_le_card_univ

name: isOfFinOrder_of_finite
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma isOfFinOrder_of_finite (x : G) : IsOfFinOrder x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h; exact infinite_not_isOfFinOrder h <| Set.toFinite _

name: orderOf_pos
statement:
@[to_additive /
assumption since this is automatic in case of a finite cancellative additive monoid. -/]
lemma orderOf_pos (x : G) : 0 < orderOf x
proof: := (isOfFinOrder_of_finite x).orderOf_pos

name: orderOf_pow
statement:
@[to_additive /
`addOrderOf_nsmul` but with one assumption less which is automatic in the case of a
finite cancellative additive monoid. -/]
theorem orderOf_pow (x : G) : orderOf (x ^ n) = orderOf x / Nat.gcd (orderOf x) n
proof:
:=
  (isOfFinOrder_of_finite _).orderOf_pow ..

name: mem_powers_iff_mem_range_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mem_powers_iff_mem_range_orderOf [DecidableEq G] :
    y ∈ powers x ↔ y ∈ (Finset.range (orderOf x)).image (x ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_range_iff_mem_finset_range_of_mod_eq' (orderOf_pos x) <| pow_mod_orderOf _

name: powersEquivPowers_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem powersEquivPowers_apply (h : orderOf x = orderOf y) (n : ℕ) :
    powersEquivPowers h ⟨x ^ n, n, rfl⟩ = ⟨y ^ n, n, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [powersEquivPowers, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, finEquivPowers_symm_apply, ←
    Equiv.eq_symm_apply, finEquivPowers_symm_apply]
  simp [h]

name: orderOf_eq_card_powers
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma orderOf_eq_card_powers : orderOf x = Fintype.card (powers x : Submonoid G)
proof:
:=
  (Fintype.card_fin (orderOf x)).symm.trans <|
    Fintype.card_eq.2 ⟨finEquivPowers <| isOfFinOrder_of_finite _⟩

name: isOfFinOrder_iff_isUnit
statement: lemma isOfFinOrder_iff_isUnit [Monoid G] [Finite Gˣ] {x : G} : IsOfFinOrder x ↔ IsUnit x
proof:
:= by
  use IsOfFinOrder.isUnit
  rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
  rw [Units.isOfFinOrder_val]
  apply isOfFinOrder_of_finite

name: orderOf_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma orderOf_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero {G₀ : Type*} [GroupWithZero G₀] [Finite G₀] {a : G₀} :
    orderOf a = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have : Finite G₀ˣ := .of_injective _ Units.val_injective
  simp [isOfFinOrder_iff_isUnit]

name: orderOf_pow_natAbs
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_pow_natAbs (x : G) (n : ℤ) : orderOf (x ^ n.natAbs) = orderOf (x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n <;> simp

name: orderOf_zpow'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem orderOf_zpow' (x : G) {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    orderOf (x ^ n) = orderOf x / (orderOf x).gcd n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orderOf_pow' _ (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr h), orderOf_pow_natAbs]

name: zpow_eq_one_iff_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem zpow_eq_one_iff_modEq {n : ℤ} : x ^ n = 1 ↔ n ≡ 0 [ZMOD orderOf x]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd, orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one]

name: zpow_eq_zpow_iff_modEq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem zpow_eq_zpow_iff_modEq {m n : ℤ} : x ^ m = x ^ n ↔ m ≡ n [ZMOD orderOf x]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_inv_eq_one, ← zpow_sub, zpow_eq_one_iff_modEq, Int.modEq_iff_dvd, Int.modEq_iff_dvd,
    zero_sub, neg_sub]

name: injective_zpow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem injective_zpow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder : (Injective fun n : ℤ => x ^ n) ↔ ¬IsOfFinOrder x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h n m hnm => ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]
    rintro h ⟨n, hn, hx⟩
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn.ne' (h <| by simpa using hx)
  rwa [zpow_eq_zpow_iff_modEq, orderOf_eq_zero_iff.2 h, Nat.cast_zero, Int.modEq_zero_iff] at hnm

name: Subgroup.zpowers_eq_zpowers_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma Subgroup.zpowers_eq_zpowers_iff {x y : G} (hx : ¬IsOfFinOrder x) :
    zpowers x = zpowers y ↔ x = y ∨ x⁻¹ = y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp⟩
  have hx_mem : x ∈ zpowers y := by simp [← h]
  have hy_mem : y ∈ zpowers x := by simp [h]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_zpowers_iff.mp hy_mem
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := mem_zpowers_iff.mp hx_mem
  rw [← zpow_mul] at hl
  nth_rewrite 2 [← zpow_one x] at hl
  have h1 := (injective_zpow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder.mpr hx) hl
  rcases (Int.mul_eq_one_iff_eq_one_or_neg_one).mp h1 with (h | h) <;> simp [h.1]

name: mem_zpowers_zpow_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mem_zpowers_zpow_iff {g : G} {k : ℤ} :

proof:
:= by

name: orderOf_dvd_natCard

name: Submonoid.orderOf_le_card

theorem image_range_orderOf [DecidableEq G] :

name: smul_eq_of_le_smul
proof:
:= by
  have key := smul_mono_right g (le_pow_smul h (Nat.card G - 1))

name: orderOf_abs_ne_one
statement: theorem orderOf_abs_ne_one (h : |x| ≠ 1) : orderOf x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf_eq_zero_iff']
  intro n hn hx
  replace hx : |x| ^ n = 1 := by simpa only [abs_one, abs_pow] using congr_arg abs hx
  rcases h.lt_or_gt with h | h
  · exact ((pow_lt_one₀ (abs_nonneg x) h hn.ne').ne hx).elim
  · exact ((one_lt_pow₀ h hn.ne').ne' hx).elim

name: LinearOrderedRing.orderOf_le_two

proof:
:= by
  rcases ne_or_eq |x| 1 with h | h
  · simp [orderOf_abs_ne_one h]
  rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_abs_eq h with (rfl | rfl)
  · simp
  exact orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one zero_lt_two (by simp)

name: CharP.addOrderOf_one
statement:
lemma CharP.addOrderOf_one : CharP R (addOrderOf (1 : R)) where
  cast_eq_zero_iff n
proof: := by rw [← Nat.smul_one_eq_cast, addOrderOf_dvd_iff_nsmul_eq_zero]

name: charP_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma charP_of_ne_zero (hn : card R = p) (hR : ∀ i < p, (i : R) = 0 → i = 0) : CharP R p where
  cast_eq_zero_iff n
proof:
:= by
    have H : (p : R) = 0 := by rw [← hn, Nat.cast_card_eq_zero]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n p, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, H, zero_mul, add_zero] at h
      rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
      apply hR _ (Nat.mod_lt _ _) h
      rw [← hn, Fintype.card_pos_iff]
      exact ⟨0⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, H, zero_mul]

name: charP_of_prime_pow_injective
statement:
lemma charP_of_prime_pow_injective (R) [Ring R] [Fintype R] (p n : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (hn : card R = p ^ n) (hR : ∀ i ≤ n, (p : R) ^ i = 0 → i = n) : CharP R (p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := CharP.exists R
  have hcpn : c ∣ p ^ n := by rw [← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R c, ← hn, Nat.cast_card_eq_zero]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ : ∃ i ≤ n, c = p ^ i := by rwa [Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp.1] at hcpn
  obtain rfl : i = n := hR i hi <| by rw [← Nat.cast_pow, CharP.cast_eq_zero]
  assumption

name: le_minOrder
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma le_minOrder {n : ℕ∞} :
    n ≤ minOrder α ↔ ∀ ⦃a : α⦄, a ≠ 1 → IsOfFinOrder a → n ≤ orderOf a
proof: := by simp [minOrder]

name: minOrder_le_orderOf

lemma minOrder_le_orderOf (ha : a ≠ 1) (ha' : IsOfFinOrder a) : minOrder α ≤ orderOf a
proof:

name: le_minOrder_iff_forall_subgroup
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma le_minOrder_iff_forall_subgroup {n : ℕ∞} :
    n ≤ minOrder G ↔ ∀ ⦃s : Subgroup G⦄, s ≠ ⊥ → (s : Set G).Finite → n ≤ Nat.card s
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_minOrder]
  refine ⟨fun h s hs hs' ↦ ?_, fun h a ha ha' ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, has, ha⟩ := s.bot_or_exists_ne_one.resolve_left hs
    exact
      (h ha <| finite_zpowers.1 <| hs'.subset <| zpowers_le.2 has).trans
        (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 <| s.orderOf_le_card hs' has)
  · simpa using h (zpowers_ne_bot.2 ha) ha'.finite_zpowers

lemma minOrder_le_natCard (hs : s ≠ ⊥) (hs' : (s : Set G).Finite) : minOrder G ≤ Nat.card s

name: minOrder
statement:
@[simp]
protected lemma minOrder {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hn₁ : n ≠ 1) : minOrder (ZMod n) = n.minFac
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨one_lt_iff_ne_zero_and_ne_one.mpr ⟨hn, hn₁⟩⟩
  have : (↑(n / n.minFac) : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ringChar.spec, ringChar.eq (ZMod n) n]
    exact
      not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.div_pos (minFac_le hn.bot_lt) n.minFac_pos)
        (div_lt_self hn.bot_lt (minFac_prime hn₁).one_lt)
  refine ((minOrder_le_natCard (zmultiples_eq_bot.not.2 this) <| toFinite _).trans ?_).antisymm <|
    le_minOrder_iff_forall_addSubgroup.2 fun s hs _ ↦ ?_
  · rw [Nat.card_zmultiples, ZMod.addOrderOf_coe _ hn,
      gcd_eq_right (div_dvd_of_dvd n.minFac_dvd), Nat.div_div_self n.minFac_dvd hn]
  · have : Nontrivial s := s.bot_or_nontrivial.resolve_left hs
    exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 <| minFac_le_of_dvd Finite.one_lt_card <|
      (card_addSubgroup_dvd_card _).trans n.card_zmod.dvd

name: card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup

theorem card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup (s : Subgroup α) :

proof:

name: card_mul_eq_card_subgroup_mul_card_quotient

lemma card_mul_eq_card_subgroup_mul_card_quotient (s : Subgroup α) (t : Set α) :
    Nat.card (t * s : Set α) = Nat.card s * Nat.card (t.image (↑) : Set (α ⧸ s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_congr]
  apply Equiv.trans _ (QuotientGroup.preimageMkEquivSubgroupProdSet _ _)
  rw [QuotientGroup.preimage_image_mk]
  convert! Equiv.refl ↑(t * s)
  aesop (add simp [Set.mem_mul])

subgroup divides the order of its ambient additive group. -/]

name: card_dvd_of_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem card_dvd_of_injective (f : α →* H) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Nat.card α ∣ Nat.card H
proof:
:= by
  calc
      Nat.card α = Nat.card (f.range : Subgroup H) := Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofInjective f hf)
      _ ∣ Nat.card H := card_subgroup_dvd_card _

name: card_dvd_of_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem card_dvd_of_le {H K : Subgroup α} (hHK : H ≤ K) : Nat.card H ∣ Nat.card K
proof:
:=
  card_dvd_of_injective (inclusion hHK) (inclusion_injective hHK)

name: card_comap_dvd_of_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem card_comap_dvd_of_injective (K : Subgroup H) (f : α →* H)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : Nat.card (K.comap f) ∣ Nat.card K
proof:
:=
  calc Nat.card (K.comap f) = Nat.card ((K.comap f).map f) :=
      Nat.card_congr (equivMapOfInjective _ _ hf).toEquiv
    _ ∣ Nat.card K := card_dvd_of_le (map_comap_le _ _)

name: mem_leftCoset

theorem mem_leftCoset {s : Set α} {x : α} (a : α) (hxS : x ∈ s) : a * x ∈ a • s

name: leftCosetEquivalence_rel

name: mem_leftCoset_iff
statement:
@[to_additive mem_leftAddCoset_iff]
theorem mem_leftCoset_iff (a : α) : x ∈ a • s ↔ a⁻¹ * x ∈ s
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro (fun ⟨b, hb, h⟩ => by simp [h.symm, hb]) fun h => ⟨a⁻¹ * x, h, by simp⟩

name: mem_rightCoset_iff

name: leftCoset_mem_leftCoset
statement:
@[to_additive leftAddCoset_mem_leftAddCoset]
theorem leftCoset_mem_leftCoset {a : α} (ha : a ∈ s) : a • (s : Set α) = s
proof:

name: rightCoset_mem_rightCoset

name: orbit_subgroup_eq_rightCoset
statement:

proof:

name: normal_of_eq_cosets

proof:

  ⟨fun a ha g =>
    show g * a * g⁻¹ ∈ (s : Set α) by rw [← mem_rightCoset_iff, ← h]; exact mem_leftCoset g ha⟩

statement:

  ⟨@eq_cosets_of_normal _ _ s, normal_of_eq_cosets s⟩

name: leftCoset_eq_iff
statement:
@[to_additive leftAddCoset_eq_iff]
theorem leftCoset_eq_iff {x y : α} : x • (s : Set α) = y • s ↔ x⁻¹ * y ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ext_iff]
  simp_rw [mem_leftCoset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (h y).mpr
    rw [inv_mul_cancel]
    exact s.one_mem
  · intro h z
    rw [← mul_inv_cancel_right x⁻¹ y]
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact s.mul_mem_cancel_left h

name: rightCoset_eq_iff
statement:
@[to_additive rightAddCoset_eq_iff]
theorem rightCoset_eq_iff {x y : α} : op x • (s : Set α) = op y • s ↔ y * x⁻¹ ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ext_iff]
  simp_rw [mem_rightCoset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (h y).mpr
    rw [mul_inv_cancel]
    exact s.one_mem
  · intro h z
    rw [← inv_mul_cancel_left y x⁻¹]
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact s.mul_mem_cancel_right h

name: strictMono_comap_prod_image
statement:
@[to_additive QuotientAddGroup.strictMono_comap_prod_image /
the function that sends an additive subgroup `t` to the pair consisting of
its intersection with `s` and its image in the quotient `α ⧸ s`
is strictly monotone, even though it is not injective in general. -/]
theorem strictMono_comap_prod_image :
    StrictMono fun t : Subgroup α ↦ (t.comap s.subtype, mk (s := s) '' t)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun t₁ t₂ h ↦ ⟨⟨Subgroup.comap_mono h.1, Set.image_mono h.1⟩,
    mt (fun ⟨le1, le2⟩ a ha ↦ ?_) h.2⟩
  obtain ⟨a', h', eq⟩ := le2 ⟨_, ha, rfl⟩
  convert t₁.mul_mem h' (@le1 ⟨_, QuotientGroup.eq.1 eq⟩ <| t₂.mul_mem (t₂.inv_mem <| h.1 h') ha)
  simp

name: leftRel_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem leftRel_apply {x y : α} : leftRel s x y ↔ x⁻¹ * y ∈ s
proof:
:=
  calc
    (∃ a : s.op, y * MulOpposite.unop a = x) ↔ ∃ a : s, y * a = x :=
      s.equivOp.symm.exists_congr_left
    _ ↔ ∃ a : s, x⁻¹ * y = a⁻¹ := by
      simp only [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, Subgroup.coe_inv, eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq]
    _ ↔ x⁻¹ * y ∈ s := by simp [exists_inv_mem_iff_exists_mem]

name: leftRel_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem leftRel_eq : ⇑(leftRel s) = fun x y => x⁻¹ * y ∈ s
proof:
:=
  funext₂ <| by
    simp only [eq_iff_iff]
    apply leftRel_apply

name: rightRel_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem rightRel_apply {x y : α} : rightRel s x y ↔ y * x⁻¹ ∈ s
proof:
:=
  calc
    (∃ a : s, (a : α) * y = x) ↔ ∃ a : s, y * x⁻¹ = a⁻¹ := by
      simp only [mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul, Subgroup.coe_inv, eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq]
    _ ↔ y * x⁻¹ ∈ s := by simp [exists_inv_mem_iff_exists_mem]

name: rightRel_eq

name: preimage_image_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem preimage_image_mk (N : Subgroup α) (s : Set α) :
    mk ⁻¹' ((mk : α → α ⧸ N) '' s) = ⋃ x : N, (· * (x : α)) ⁻¹' s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [QuotientGroup.eq, SetLike.exists, exists_prop, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iUnion,
    Set.mem_image]
  exact
    ⟨fun ⟨y, hs, hN⟩ => ⟨_, N.inv_mem hN, by simpa using hs⟩, fun ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ =>
      ⟨x * z, hxz, by simpa using hz⟩⟩

name: preimage_image_mk_eq_iUnion_image

theorem preimage_image_mk_eq_iUnion_image (N : Subgroup α) (s : Set α) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [preimage_image_mk, iUnion_congr_of_surjective (·⁻¹) inv_surjective]
  exact fun x ↦ image_mul_right'

name: preimage_image_mk_eq_mul

theorem preimage_image_mk_eq_mul (N : Subgroup α) (s : Set α) :

proof:
:= by

name: quotientEquivOfEq_mk
statement:
theorem quotientEquivOfEq_mk (h : s = t) (a : α) :
    quotientEquivOfEq h (QuotientGroup.mk a) = QuotientGroup.mk a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: commutator_pi_pi_of_finite
statement:
@[to_additive /
the commutators. -/]
theorem commutator_pi_pi_of_finite {η : Type*} [Finite η] {Gs : η → Type*} [∀ i, Group (Gs i)]
    (H K : ∀ i, Subgroup (Gs i)) : ⁅Subgroup.pi Set.univ H, Subgroup.pi Set.univ K⁆ =
    Subgroup.pi Set.univ fun i => ⁅H i, K i⁆
proof:
:= by
  classical
    apply le_antisymm (commutator_pi_pi_le H K)
    rw [pi_le_iff]
    intro i hi
    rw [map_commutator]
    apply commutator_mono <;>
      · rw [le_pi_iff]
        intro j _hj
        rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        by_cases h : j = i
        · subst h
          simpa using hx
        · simp [h, one_mem]

name: rank_commutator_le_card
statement: lemma rank_commutator_le_card : Group.rank (_root_.commutator G) ≤ Nat.card (commutatorSet G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.rank_congr (commutator_eq_closure G)]
  apply Subgroup.rank_closure_finite_le_nat_card

name: index_center_le_pow
statement: lemma index_center_le_pow : (center G).index ≤ Nat.card (commutatorSet G) ^ Group.rank G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS1, hS2⟩ := Group.rank_spec G
  rw [← hS1, ← Fintype.card_coe, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Finset.coe_sort_coe, ← Nat.card_fun]
  exact Finite.card_le_of_embedding (quotientCenterEmbedding hS2)

name: card_commutatorSet_closureCommutatorRepresentatives
statement:
lemma card_commutatorSet_closureCommutatorRepresentatives :
    Nat.card (commutatorSet (closureCommutatorRepresentatives G)) = Nat.card (commutatorSet G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_commutatorSet_closureCommutatorRepresentatives G]
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.Set.image _ _ (subtype_injective _))

name: card_commutator_closureCommutatorRepresentatives
statement:
lemma card_commutator_closureCommutatorRepresentatives :
    Nat.card (commutator (closureCommutatorRepresentatives G)) = Nat.card (commutator G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_eq_closure G, ← image_commutatorSet_closureCommutatorRepresentatives, ←
    MonoidHom.map_closure, ← commutator_eq_closure]
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.Set.image _ _ (subtype_injective _))

name: rank_closureCommutatorRepresentatives_le
statement:
lemma rank_closureCommutatorRepresentatives_le :
    Group.rank (closureCommutatorRepresentatives G) ≤ 2 * Nat.card (commutatorSet G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_mul]
  exact
    (Subgroup.rank_closure_finite_le_nat_card _).trans
      ((Set.card_union_le _ _).trans
        (add_le_add ((Finite.card_image_le _).trans (Finite.card_range_le _))
          ((Finite.card_image_le _).trans (Finite.card_range_le _))))

name: conj_eq_commutatorElement_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem conj_eq_commutatorElement_mul : MulAut.conj g₁ g₂ = ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ * g₂

name: commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm

name: commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute

name: Commute.commutator_eq

theorem Commute.commutator_eq (h : Commute g₁ g₂) : ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ = 1

name: commutatorElement_one_right
statement:

theorem commutatorElement_one_right : ⁅g, (1 : G)⁆ = 1

name: commutatorElement_one_left

theorem commutatorElement_one_left : ⁅(1 : G), g⁆ = 1

name: commutatorElement_self
statement:

name: commutatorElement_inv

theorem commutatorElement_inv : ⁅g₁, g₂⁆⁻¹ = ⁅g₂, g₁⁆

name: map_commutatorElement
statement:

theorem map_commutatorElement : (f ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ : G') = ⁅f g₁, f g₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [commutatorElement_def, map_mul f, map_inv f]

name: conjugate_commutatorElement
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem conjugate_commutatorElement : g₃ * ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ * g₃⁻¹ = ⁅g₃ * g₁ * g₃⁻¹, g₃ * g₂ * g₃⁻¹⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul (a b c : G) :
    ⁅a * b, c⁆ = a * ⁅b, c⁆ * a⁻¹ * ⁅a, c⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_mul_right_eq_mul_conj
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutatorElement_mul_right_eq_mul_conj (a b c : G) :
    ⁅a, b * c⁆ = ⁅a, b⁆ * b * ⁅a, c⁆ * b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: Commute.commutatorElement_pow_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Commute.commutatorElement_pow_left {a b : G} (h : Commute a ⁅a, b⁆) (n : ℕ) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ^ n = ⁅a ^ n, b⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ', commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul, ← ih,
      (h.pow_right n).eq, mul_inv_cancel_right]

name: Commute.commutatorElement_pow_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Commute.commutatorElement_pow_right {a b : G} (h : Commute b ⁅a, b⁆) (n : ℕ) :
    ⁅a, b⁆ ^ n = ⁅a, b ^ n⁆
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', commutatorElement_mul_right_eq_mul_conj, ←ih,
        (h.pow_right n).right_comm, mul_inv_cancel_right]

name: commutatorElement_inv_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutatorElement_inv_left (a b : G) : ⁅a⁻¹, b⁆ = a⁻¹ * ⁅b, a⁆ * a
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_inv_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutatorElement_inv_right (a b : G) : ⁅a, b⁻¹⁆ = b⁻¹ * ⁅b, a⁆ * b
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: conj_commutatorElement_left_commutatorElement_mul
statement:
theorem conj_commutatorElement_left_commutatorElement_mul (a b c : G) :
    a * ⁅⁅a⁻¹, b⁆, c⁆ * a⁻¹ * c * ⁅⁅c⁻¹, a⁆, b⁆ * c⁻¹ * b * ⁅⁅b⁻¹, c⁆, a⁆ * b⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: conj_commutatorElement_right_commutatorElement_mul
statement:
theorem conj_commutatorElement_right_commutatorElement_mul (a b c : G) :
    b * ⁅a, ⁅b⁻¹, c⁆⁆ * b⁻¹ * c * ⁅b, ⁅c⁻¹, a⁆⁆ * c⁻¹ * a * ⁅c, ⁅a⁻¹, b⁆⁆ * a⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_commutatorElement_conj_mul
statement:
theorem commutatorElement_commutatorElement_conj_mul (a b c : G) :
    ⁅⁅a, b⁆, b * c * b⁻¹⁆ * ⁅⁅b, c⁆, c * a * c⁻¹⁆ * ⁅⁅c, a⁆, a * b * a⁻¹⁆ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_conj_commutatorElement_mul
statement:
theorem commutatorElement_conj_commutatorElement_mul (a b c : G) :
    ⁅a * b * a⁻¹, ⁅c, a⁆⁆ * ⁅c * a * c⁻¹, ⁅b, c⁆⁆ * ⁅b * c * b⁻¹, ⁅a, b⁆⁆ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_mul_left_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutatorElement_mul_left_mul (a b c : G) : ⁅a * b, c⁆ * ⁅c * a, b⁆ * ⁅b * c, a⁆ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutatorElement_mul_right_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutatorElement_mul_right_mul (a b c : G) : ⁅a, b * c⁆ * ⁅b, c * a⁆ * ⁅c, a * b⁆ = 1
proof:

  simp [mul_assoc, commutatorElement_def]

name: commutator_def
statement:
@[to_additive /
instance commutator : Bracket (Subgroup G) (Subgroup G) :=
  ⟨fun H₁ H₂ => closure { g | ∃ g₁ ∈ H₁, ∃ g₂ ∈ H₂, ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ = g }⟩

@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_def (H₁ H₂ : Subgroup G) :
    ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ = closure { g | ∃ g₁ ∈ H₁, ∃ g₂ ∈ H₂, ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ = g }
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: commutator_mem_commutator
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_mem_commutator (h₁ : g₁ ∈ H₁) (h₂ : g₂ ∈ H₂) : ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ ∈ ⁅H₁, H₂⁆
proof:
:=
  subset_closure ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, rfl⟩

name: commutator_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ H₃ ↔ ∀ g₁ ∈ H₁, ∀ g₂ ∈ H₂, ⁅g₁, g₂⁆ ∈ H₃
proof:
:=
  H₃.closure_le.trans
    ⟨fun h a b c d => h ⟨a, b, c, d, rfl⟩, fun h _g ⟨a, b, c, d, h_eq⟩ => h_eq ▸ h a b c d⟩

name: commutator_mono
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_mono (h₁ : H₁ ≤ K₁) (h₂ : H₂ ≤ K₂) : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ ⁅K₁, K₂⁆
proof:
:=
  commutator_le.mpr fun _g₁ hg₁ _g₂ hg₂ => commutator_mem_commutator (h₁ hg₁) (h₂ hg₂)

name: commutator_mono_left
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
theorem commutator_mono_left (h : H₁ ≤ H₂) : ⁅H₁, K⁆ ≤ ⁅H₂, K⁆
proof:
:=
  commutator_mono h le_rfl

name: commutator_mono_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := gcongr)]
theorem commutator_mono_right (h : K₁ ≤ K₂) : ⁅H, K₁⁆ ≤ ⁅H, K₂⁆
proof:
:=
  commutator_mono le_rfl h

name: commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ = ⊥ ↔ H₁ ≤ centralizer H₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff, commutator_le]
  refine forall_congr' fun p =>
    forall_congr' fun _hp => forall_congr' fun q => forall_congr' fun hq => ?_
  rw [mem_bot, commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm, eq_comm]

name: commutator_commutator_eq_bot_of_rotate
statement:
theorem commutator_commutator_eq_bot_of_rotate (h1 : ⁅⁅H₂, H₃⁆, H₁⁆ = ⊥) (h2 : ⁅⁅H₃, H₁⁆, H₂⁆ = ⊥) :
    ⁅⁅H₁, H₂⁆, H₃⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer, commutator_le,
    mem_centralizer_iff_commutator_eq_one] at h1 h2 ⊢
  intro x hx y hy z hz
  trans x * z * ⁅y, ⁅z⁻¹, x⁻¹⁆⁆⁻¹ * z⁻¹ * y * ⁅x⁻¹, ⁅y⁻¹, z⁆⁆⁻¹ * y⁻¹ * x⁻¹
  
  
  · simp [commutatorElement_def, mul_assoc]
  · rw [h1 _ (H₂.inv_mem hy) _ hz _ (H₁.inv_mem hx), h2 _ (H₃.inv_mem hz) _ (H₁.inv_mem hx) _ hy]
    simp [mul_assoc]

name: commutator_comm_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_comm_le : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ ⁅H₂, H₁⁆
proof:
:=
  commutator_le.mpr fun g₁ h₁ g₂ h₂ =>
    commutatorElement_inv g₂ g₁ ▸ ⁅H₂, H₁⁆.inv_mem_iff.mpr (commutator_mem_commutator h₂ h₁)

name: commutator_comm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_comm : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ = ⁅H₂, H₁⁆
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (commutator_comm_le H₁ H₂) (commutator_comm_le H₂ H₁)

name: commutator_self_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_self_eq_bot_iff : ⁅H, H⁆ = ⊥ ↔ IsMulCommutative H
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer, le_centralizer_iff_isMulCommutative]

name: commutator_top_right_eq_bot_iff_le_center
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem commutator_top_right_eq_bot_iff_le_center : ⁅H, (⊤ : Subgroup G)⁆ = ⊥ ↔ H ≤ center G
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer, coe_top, centralizer_univ]

name: commutator_top_left_eq_bot_iff_le_center
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem commutator_top_left_eq_bot_iff_le_center : ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup G), H⁆ = ⊥ ↔ H ≤ center G
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_comm, commutator_top_right_eq_bot_iff_le_center]

name: commutator_center_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem commutator_center_right : ⁅H, center G⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer]

name: commutator_center_left
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem commutator_center_left : ⁅center G, H⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer.mpr <| center_le_centralizer _

name: commutator_def'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm closure_le_normalClosure (normalClosure_le_normal subset_closure)

name: commutator_le_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le_right [h : H₂.Normal] : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ H₂
proof:
:=
  commutator_le.mpr fun g₁ _h₁ g₂ h₂ => H₂.mul_mem (h.conj_mem g₂ h₂ g₁) (H₂.inv_mem h₂)

name: commutator_le_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le_left [H₁.Normal] : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ H₁
proof:
:=
  commutator_comm H₂ H₁ ▸ commutator_le_right H₂ H₁

name: commutator_top_left_le_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_top_left_le_iff : ⁅(⊤ : Subgroup G), H⁆ ≤ H ↔ H.Normal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hle ↦ ⟨fun h hh g ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ commutator_le_right ⊤ H⟩
  exact (H.mul_mem_cancel_right <| H.inv_mem hh).mp <| commutator_le.mp hle g trivial h hh

name: commutator_top_right_le_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_top_right_le_iff : ⁅H, ⊤⁆ ≤ H ↔ H.Normal
proof:
:=
  commutator_comm H ⊤ ▸ commutator_top_left_le_iff

name: le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right : H ≤ normalizer K ↔ ⁅H, K⁆ ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  refine le_normalizer_iff.trans ⟨fun hH ↦ ?_, fun hH h hh k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact commutator_le.mpr fun h hh k hk ↦ mul_mem (hH h hh k hk) (inv_mem hk)
  · exact (mul_mem_cancel_right <| inv_mem hk).mp <| hH <| commutator_mem_commutator hh hk

name: le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_left : H ≤ normalizer K ↔ ⁅K, H⁆ ≤ K
proof:
:=
  commutator_comm H K ▸ le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right

name: commutator_bot_left
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem commutator_bot_left : ⁅(⊥ : Subgroup G), H₁⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  le_bot_iff.mp (commutator_le_left ⊥ H₁)

name: commutator_bot_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem commutator_bot_right : ⁅H₁, ⊥⁆ = (⊥ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
  le_bot_iff.mp (commutator_le_right H₁ ⊥)

name: commutator_le_inf
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le_inf [Normal H₁] [Normal H₂] : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ H₁ ⊓ H₂
proof:
:=
  le_inf (commutator_le_left H₁ H₂) (commutator_le_right H₁ H₂)

name: commutator_eq_bot_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem commutator_eq_bot_of_disjoint [H₁.Normal] [H₂.Normal] (h : Disjoint H₁ H₂) :
    ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  grw [eq_bot_iff, commutator_le_inf, h.eq_bot.le]

name: commutator_le_sup
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le_sup : ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ ≤ H₁ ⊔ H₂
proof:
:=
  commutator_le.mpr <| by grind [mul_assoc, mul_mem, mul_mem_sup, inv_mem]

name: commutator_le_of_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le_of_le (h₁ : K₁ ≤ K) (h₂ : K₂ ≤ K) : ⁅K₁, K₂⁆ ≤ K
proof:
:=
  (commutator_le_sup K₁ K₂).trans (sup_le h₁ h₂)

name: normalizer_commutator_ge_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem normalizer_commutator_ge_left : H₁ ≤ normalizer (⁅H₁, H₂⁆ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_normalizer_closure_iff.mpr
  rintro g hg _ ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩
  apply (mul_mem_cancel_right <| commutator_mem_commutator hg hg₂).mp
  rw [← commutatorElement_mul_left_eq_conj_mul g g₁ g₂]
  exact commutator_mem_commutator (mul_mem hg hg₁) hg₂

name: normalizer_commutator_ge_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem normalizer_commutator_ge_right : H₂ ≤ normalizer (⁅H₁, H₂⁆ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_comm]
  apply normalizer_commutator_ge_left

name: map_commutator
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_commutator (f : G →* G') : map f ⁅H₁, H₂⁆ = ⁅map f H₁, map f H₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [le_antisymm_iff, map_le_iff_le_comap, commutator_le, mem_comap, map_commutatorElement]
  constructor
  · intro p hp q hq
    exact commutator_mem_commutator (mem_map_of_mem _ hp) (mem_map_of_mem _ hq)
  · rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    rw [← map_commutatorElement]
    exact mem_map_of_mem _ (commutator_mem_commutator hp hq)

name: commutator_le_map_commutator
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_le_map_commutator {f : G →* G'} {K₁ K₂ : Subgroup G'} (h₁ : K₁ ≤ H₁.map f)
    (h₂ : K₂ ≤ H₂.map f) : ⁅K₁, K₂⁆ ≤ ⁅H₁, H₂⁆.map f
proof:
:=
  (commutator_mono h₁ h₂).trans (ge_of_eq (map_commutator H₁ H₂ f))

name: commutator_sup_right_of_normal
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_
    (sup_le (commutator_mono_left le_sup_left) (commutator_mono_left le_sup_right))
  have hH : ⁅H, N⁆ ≤ ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := le_sup_left
  have hK : ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ := le_sup_right
  rw [← QuotientGroup.ker_mk' (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆), ← Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff,
    map_commutator, Subgroup.commutator_eq_bot_iff_le_centralizer] at hH hK ⊢
  rw [map_sup]
  exact sup_le hH hK

name: commutator_sup_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_sup_right (H K N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] : ⁅H ⊔ K, N⁆ = ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆
proof:
:= by
  let M := H ⊔ K ⊔ N
  have hHM : H ≤ M := le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_left
  have hKM : K ≤ M := le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_right
  have hNM : N ≤ M := le_sup_right
  have hHNM : ⁅H, N⁆ ≤ M := commutator_le_of_le hHM hNM
  have hKNM : ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ M := commutator_le_of_le hKM hNM
  suffices (⁅H.subgroupOf M, N.subgroupOf M⁆ ⊔ ⁅K.subgroupOf M, N.subgroupOf M⁆).Normal by
    simpa [← map_subtype_inj, map_sup, map_commutator, hHM, hKM, hNM] using
      commutator_sup_right_of_normal (H.subgroupOf M) (K.subgroupOf M) (N.subgroupOf M)
  suffices M ≤ normalizer (⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ : Subgroup G) by
    convert Subgroup.normal_subgroupOf_of_le_normalizer this
    simp [← map_subtype_inj, map_sup, map_commutator, hHM, hKM, hNM, hHNM, hKNM]
  have hHKN : ⁅H, N⁆ ⊔ ⁅K, N⁆ ≤ N := sup_le (commutator_le_right H N) (commutator_le_right K N)
  refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ ?_) ?_
  · grw [le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right, hHKN, ← le_sup_left]
  · grw [le_normalizer_iff_commutator_le_right, hHKN, ← le_sup_right]
  · grw [← inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_sup, ← normalizer_commutator_ge_right,
      ← normalizer_commutator_ge_right, inf_idem]

name: commutator_prod_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem commutator_prod_prod (K₁ K₂ : Subgroup G') :
    ⁅H₁.prod K₁, H₂.prod K₂⁆ = ⁅H₁, H₂⁆.prod ⁅K₁, K₂⁆
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [commutator_le]
    rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩ ⟨q₁, q₂⟩ ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩
    exact ⟨commutator_mem_commutator hp₁ hq₁, commutator_mem_commutator hp₂ hq₂⟩
  · rw [prod_le_iff]
    constructor <;>
      · rw [map_commutator]
        apply commutator_mono <;>
          simp [le_prod_iff, map_map, MonoidHom.fst_comp_inl, MonoidHom.snd_comp_inl,
            MonoidHom.fst_comp_inr, MonoidHom.snd_comp_inr]

proof:
:=
  commutator_le.mpr fun _p hp _q hq i hi => commutator_mem_commutator (hp i hi) (hq i hi)

    rwa [Subgroup.commutator_comm (centralizer (commutator G : Set G))]

          ⟨_, subset_closure <| .inr ⟨_, ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩,
        hg.choose_spec.choose_spec⟩

name: Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal] :
    IsMulCommutative (G ⧸ N) ↔ _root_.commutator G ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hcomm ↦ ?_, fun hGN ↦ ⟨⟨fun x' y' ↦ ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · rw [commutator_eq_normalClosure, ← Subgroup.normalClosure_subset_iff]
    rintro x ⟨p, q, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff, commutatorElement_def]
    simp only [QuotientGroup.mk_mul, QuotientGroup.mk_inv]
    rw [← commutatorElement_def, commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm, mul_comm']
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N x'
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N y'
    rw [← commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm, ← map_commutatorElement, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply,
      QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
    apply hGN
    rw [commutator_eq_closure]
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure (commutator_mem_commutatorSet x y)

name: Subgroup.Normal.commutator_le_of_self_sup_commutative_eq_top
statement:
@[to_additive /
subgroup such that `H ⊔ N = ⊤`, then `N` contains `addCommutator G`. -/]
theorem Subgroup.Normal.commutator_le_of_self_sup_commutative_eq_top {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal]
    {H : Subgroup G} (hHN : N ⊔ H = ⊤) (hH : IsMulCommutative H) : _root_.commutator G ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  
  apply quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le.mp
  
  let φ : H →ₙ* G ⧸ N := MonoidHom.comp (QuotientGroup.mk' N) (Subgroup.subtype H)
  
  apply Function.Surjective.isMulCommutative (f := φ) _ hH
  
  have : Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) ⊤ = ⊤ := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_top, MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
    exact QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N
  rw [MulHom.coe_coe, ← MonoidHom.range_eq_top, MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← Subgroup.map_map, ← this,
    Subgroup.map_eq_map_iff, QuotientGroup.ker_mk', sup_comm, ← hHN, Subgroup.map_top]
  simp

lattice) iff the quotient by it is simple. Additive group analogue of

theorem CommGroup.isSimpleGroup_iff_isCoatom {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] {M : Subgroup G} :

    (hgf : N ≤ Subgroup.comap (g.comp f) O :=
      hf.trans ((Subgroup.comap_mono hg).trans_eq (Subgroup.comap_comap _ _ _)))

name: isConj_of_support_equiv
statement:
theorem isConj_of_support_equiv
    (f : { x // x ∈ (σ.support : Set α) } ≃ { x // x ∈ (τ.support : Set α) })
    (hf : ∀ (x : α) (hx : x ∈ (σ.support : Set α)),
      (f ⟨σ x, apply_mem_support.2 hx⟩ : α) = τ ↑(f ⟨x, hx⟩)) :
    IsConj σ τ
proof:
:= by
  refine isConj_iff.2 ⟨Equiv.extendSubtype f, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul]
  ext x
  simp only [Perm.mul_apply]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ σ.support
  · rw [Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem, Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem]
    · exact hf x (Finset.mem_coe.2 hx)
  · rwa [Classical.not_not.1 ((not_congr mem_support).1 (Equiv.extendSubtype_not_mem f _ _)),
      Classical.not_not.1 ((not_congr mem_support).mp hx)]

name: perm_symm_on_of_perm_on_finset
statement:
theorem perm_symm_on_of_perm_on_finset {s : Finset α} {f : Perm α} (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ∈ s) {y : α}
    (hy : y ∈ s) : f.symm y ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ (x : _) (hx : x ∈ s), y = (fun i (_ : i ∈ s) => f i) x hx :=
    Finset.surj_on_of_inj_on_of_card_le (fun x hx => (fun i _ => f i) x hx) (fun a ha => h a ha)
      (fun a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ heq => (Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq f).mp heq) rfl.ge
  obtain ⟨y2, hy2, rfl⟩ := h0 y hy
  simpa using hy2

  cases nonempty_fintype s
  exact fun x hx =>
    Set.mem_toFinset.mp <|
      perm_symm_on_of_perm_on_finset
        (fun a ha => Set.mem_toFinset.mpr (h (Set.mem_toFinset.mp ha)))

name: perm_mapsTo_inl_iff_mapsTo_inr
statement:
theorem perm_mapsTo_inl_iff_mapsTo_inr {m n : Type*} [Finite m] [Finite n] (σ : Perm (m ⊕ n)) :
    Set.MapsTo σ (Set.range Sum.inl) (Set.range Sum.inl) ↔
      Set.MapsTo σ (Set.range Sum.inr) (Set.range Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
    ( intro h
      classical
        rw [← perm_symm_mapsTo_iff_mapsTo] at h
        intro x
        rcases hx : σ x with l | r)
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h ⟨l, rfl⟩
    grind
  · rintro _; exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
  · rintro _; exact ⟨l, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h ⟨r, rfl⟩
    grind

name: mem_sumCongrHom_range_of_perm_mapsTo_inl
statement:
theorem mem_sumCongrHom_range_of_perm_mapsTo_inl {m n : Type*} [Finite m] [Finite n]
    {σ : Perm (m ⊕ n)} (h : Set.MapsTo σ (Set.range Sum.inl) (Set.range Sum.inl)) :
    σ ∈ (sumCongrHom m n).range
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ x : m ⊕ n, (∃ a : m, Sum.inl a = x) → ∃ a : m, Sum.inl a = σ x := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩; exact h ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have h3 : ∀ x : m ⊕ n, (∃ b : n, Sum.inr b = x) → ∃ b : n, Sum.inr b = σ x := by
    rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩; exact (perm_mapsTo_inl_iff_mapsTo_inr σ).mp h ⟨b, rfl⟩
  let σ₁' := subtypePermOfFintype σ h1
  let σ₂' := subtypePermOfFintype σ h3
  let σ₁ := permCongr (Equiv.ofInjective _ Sum.inl_injective).symm σ₁'
  let σ₂ := permCongr (Equiv.ofInjective _ Sum.inr_injective).symm σ₂'
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_range, Prod.exists]
  use σ₁, σ₂
  rw [Perm.sumCongrHom_apply]
  ext (a | b)
  · rw [Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_symm,
      apply_ofInjective_symm Sum.inl_injective, ofInjective_apply]
    rfl
  · rw [Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inr, permCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_symm,
      apply_ofInjective_symm Sum.inr_injective, ofInjective_apply]
    rfl

name: Disjoint.extendDomain
statement:
theorem Disjoint.extendDomain {p : β → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f : α ≃ Subtype p)
    {σ τ : Perm α} (h : Disjoint σ τ) : Disjoint (σ.extendDomain f) (τ.extendDomain f)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  by_cases pb : p b
  · refine (h (f.symm ⟨b, pb⟩)).imp ?_ ?_ <;>
      · intro h
        rw [extendDomain_apply_subtype _ _ pb, h, apply_symm_apply, Subtype.coe_mk]
  · left
    rw [extendDomain_apply_not_subtype _ _ pb]

name: Disjoint.isConj_mul
statement:
theorem Disjoint.isConj_mul [Finite α] {σ τ π ρ : Perm α} (hc1 : IsConj σ π)
    (hc2 : IsConj τ ρ) (hd1 : Disjoint σ τ) (hd2 : Disjoint π ρ) : IsConj (σ * τ) (π * ρ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := isConj_iff.1 hc1
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := isConj_iff.1 hc2
  have hd1' := coe_inj.2 hd1.support_mul
  have hd2' := coe_inj.2 hd2.support_mul
  rw [coe_union] at *
  have hd1'' := disjoint_coe.2 (disjoint_iff_disjoint_support.1 hd1)
  have hd2'' := disjoint_coe.2 (disjoint_iff_disjoint_support.1 hd2)
  refine isConj_of_support_equiv ?_ ?_
  · refine ((Set.equivOfEq hd1').trans (Equiv.Set.union hd1'')).trans <|
      (Equiv.sumCongr (subtypeEquiv f fun a => ?_) <| subtypeEquiv g fun a => ?_).trans
        ((Set.equivOfEq hd2').trans (Equiv.Set.union hd2'')).symm <;>
      simp only [Set.mem_image, toEmbedding_apply, exists_eq_right, support_conj, coe_map,
        apply_eq_iff_eq]
  intro x hx
  simp only [trans_apply, symm_trans_apply, Set.equivOfEq_apply, Set.equivOfEq_symm_apply,
    Equiv.sumCongr_apply]
  rw [hd1', Set.mem_union] at hx
  rcases hx with hxσ | hxτ
  · rw [mem_coe, mem_support] at hxσ
    rw [Set.union_apply_left, Set.union_apply_left]
    · simp only [subtypeEquiv_apply, Perm.coe_mul, Sum.map_inl, comp_apply,
        Set.union_symm_apply_left, Subtype.coe_mk, apply_eq_iff_eq, coe_inv]
      have h := (hd2 (f x)).resolve_left ?_
      · rw [mul_apply, mul_apply, coe_inv] at h
        rw [h, symm_apply_apply, (hd1 x).resolve_left hxσ]
      · rwa [mul_apply, mul_apply, coe_inv, symm_apply_apply, apply_eq_iff_eq]
    · rwa [Subtype.coe_mk, mem_coe, mem_support]
    · rwa [Subtype.coe_mk, Perm.mul_apply, (hd1 x).resolve_left hxσ, mem_coe,
        apply_mem_support, mem_support]
  · rw [mem_coe, ← apply_mem_support, mem_support] at hxτ
    rw [Set.union_apply_right, Set.union_apply_right]
    · simp only [subtypeEquiv_apply, Perm.coe_mul, Sum.map_inr, comp_apply,
        Set.union_symm_apply_right, Subtype.coe_mk]
      have h := (hd2 (g (τ x))).resolve_right ?_
      · rw [mul_apply, mul_apply, coe_inv] at h
        rw [coe_inv, coe_inv, symm_apply_apply, h, (hd1 (τ x)).resolve_right hxτ]
      · rwa [mul_apply, mul_apply, coe_inv, symm_apply_apply, apply_eq_iff_eq]
    · rwa [Subtype.coe_mk, mem_coe, ← apply_mem_support, mem_support]
    · rwa [Subtype.coe_mk, Perm.mul_apply, (hd1 (τ x)).resolve_right hxτ,
        mem_coe, mem_support]

name: apply_mem_fixedPoints_iff_mem_of_mem_centralizer
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff] at hp
  simp only [Function.mem_fixedPoints_iff]
  rw [← mul_apply, ← hp, mul_apply, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]

name: disjoint_ofSubtype_of_memFixedPoints_self
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_eq_or_eq]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.fixedPoints g
  · right; exact hx
  · left; rw [ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem u hx]

name: support_pow_coprime
statement:
theorem support_pow_coprime {σ : Perm α} {n : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime n (orderOf σ)) :
    (σ ^ n).support = σ.support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_pow_eq_self_of_coprime h
  exact
    le_antisymm (support_pow_le σ n)
      (le_trans (ge_of_eq (congr_arg support hm)) (support_pow_le (σ ^ n) m))

name: ofSubtype_support_disjoint
statement:
lemma ofSubtype_support_disjoint {σ : Perm α} (x : Perm (Function.fixedPoints σ)) :
    _root_.Disjoint x.ofSubtype.support σ.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
  rintro a ha b hb rfl
  rw [mem_support] at ha hb
  exact ha (ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem x (mt Function.mem_fixedPoints_iff.mp hb))

name: disjoint_of_disjoint_support
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  intro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
  specialize h x hx1 x hx2
  rwa [disjoint_self, Finset.bot_eq_empty, support_eq_empty_iff] at h

name: support_closure_subset_union
statement:
lemma support_closure_subset_union (S : Set (Perm α)) :
    ∀ a ∈ closure S, (a.support : Set α) ⊆ ⋃ b ∈ S, b.support
proof:
:= by
  apply closure_induction
  · exact fun x hx ↦ Set.subset_iUnion₂_of_subset x hx subset_rfl
  · simp
  · intro a b ha hb hc hd
    refine (Finset.coe_subset.mpr (support_mul_le a b)).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sup_eq_union, Finset.coe_union, Set.union_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨hc, hd⟩
  · simp only [support_inv, imp_self, implies_true]

name: disjoint_support_closure_of_disjoint_support
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb
  have key1 := support_closure_subset_union S a ha
  have key2 := support_closure_subset_union T b hb
  have key := Set.disjoint_of_subset key1 key2
  simp_rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_left, Set.disjoint_iUnion_right, Finset.disjoint_coe] at key
  exact key h

name: disjoint_closure_of_disjoint_support
proof:
:= by
  apply disjoint_of_disjoint_support
  apply disjoint_support_closure_of_disjoint_support
  exact h

name: mem_range_ofSubtype_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_ofSubtype_iff {p : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p] {g : Perm α} :
    g ∈ (ofSubtype : Perm (Subtype p) →* Perm α).range ↔ (g.support : Set α) ⊆ Set.ofPred p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩ x
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, mem_support_ofSubtype, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact fun ⟨hx, _⟩ ↦ hx
  · intro hg
    refine ⟨g.subtypePerm fun x ↦ ?_, ofSubtype_subtypePerm _ fun x hx ↦ hg (mem_support.mpr hx)⟩
    by_cases hx : g x = x
    · rw [hx]
    · refine iff_of_true (hg ?_) (hg ?_) <;> simpa

name: finite_compl_fixedBy_closure_iff
statement:
theorem finite_compl_fixedBy_closure_iff {S : Set G} :
    (∀ g ∈ closure S, (fixedBy α g)ᶜ.Finite) ↔ ∀ g ∈ S, (fixedBy α g)ᶜ.Finite
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h g hg ↦ h g (subset_closure hg), fun h g hg ↦ by
    refine closure_induction h (by simp) (fun g g' _ _ hg hg' ↦ (hg.union hg').subset ?_)
      (by simp) hg
    simp_rw [← compl_inter, compl_subset_compl, fixedBy_mul]⟩

name: exists_smul_notMem_of_subset_orbit_closure
proof:
:= by
  have key0 : ¬ closure S ≤ stabilizer G T := by
    have ⟨b, hb⟩ := nonempty
    obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := subset hb
    contrapose notMem with h
    exact smul_mem_smul_set_iff.mp ((h σ.2).symm ▸ hb)
  contrapose! key0
  refine (closure_le _).mpr fun σ hσ ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_stabilizer_iff, Set.ext_iff, mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  exact fun a ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ smul_inv_smul σ a ▸ key0 σ hσ (σ⁻¹ • a) h, key0 σ⁻¹ (hS σ hσ) a⟩

name: finite_compl_fixedBy_swap
statement: theorem finite_compl_fixedBy_swap {x y : α} : (fixedBy α (Equiv.swap x y))ᶜ.Finite
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.subset (s := {x, y}) (by simp)
    (compl_subset_comm.mp fun z h ↦ by
      apply Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne <;> rintro rfl <;> simp at h)

name: Equiv.Perm.IsSwap.finite_compl_fixedBy
statement:
theorem Equiv.Perm.IsSwap.finite_compl_fixedBy {σ : Perm α} (h : σ.IsSwap) :
    (fixedBy α σ)ᶜ.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, -, rfl⟩ := h
  exact finite_compl_fixedBy_swap

name: SubmonoidClass.swap_mem_trans
statement:
theorem SubmonoidClass.swap_mem_trans {a b c : α} {C} [SetLike C (Perm α)]
    [SubmonoidClass C (Perm α)] (M : C) (hab : Equiv.swap a b ∈ M)
    (hbc : Equiv.swap b c ∈ M) : Equiv.swap a c ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hab' := eq_or_ne a b
  · exact hbc
  obtain rfl | hac := eq_or_ne a c
  · exact swap_self a ▸ one_mem M
  rw [Equiv.swap_comm, ← swap_mul_swap_mul_swap hab' hac]
  exact mul_mem (mul_mem hbc hab) hbc

name: swap_mem_closure_isSwap
statement:
theorem swap_mem_closure_isSwap {S : Set (Perm α)} (hS : ∀ f ∈ S, f.IsSwap) {x y : α} :
    Equiv.swap x y ∈ closure S ↔ x ∈ orbit (closure S) y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨⟨Equiv.swap x y, h⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_right x y⟩, fun hf ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  have := exists_smul_notMem_of_subset_orbit_closure S {x | Equiv.swap x y ∈ closure S}
    (fun f hf ↦ ?_) (fun z hz ↦ ?_) h ⟨y, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨σ, hσ, a, ha, hσa⟩ := this
    obtain ⟨z, w, hzw, rfl⟩ := hS σ hσ
    have := ne_of_mem_of_not_mem ha hσa
    rw [Perm.smul_def, ne_comm, Equiv.swap_apply_ne_self_iff, and_iff_right hzw] at this
    refine hσa (SubmonoidClass.swap_mem_trans (closure S) ?_ ha)
    obtain rfl | rfl := this <;> simpa [Equiv.swap_comm] using subset_closure hσ
  · obtain ⟨x, y, -, rfl⟩ := hS f hf; rwa [swap_inv]
  · exact orbit_eq_iff.mpr hf ▸ ⟨⟨swap z y, hz⟩, swap_apply_right z y⟩
  · rw [mem_ofPred, Equiv.swap_self]; apply one_mem

name: mem_closure_isSwap
statement:
theorem mem_closure_isSwap {S : Set (Perm α)} (hS : ∀ f ∈ S, f.IsSwap) {f : Perm α} :
    f ∈ closure S ↔ (fixedBy α f)ᶜ.Finite ∧ ∀ x, f x ∈ orbit (closure S) x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ ⟨?_, fun x ↦ mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact finite_compl_fixedBy_closure_iff.mpr (fun f hf ↦ (hS f hf).finite_compl_fixedBy) _ hf
  rintro ⟨fin, hf⟩
  set supp := (fixedBy α f)ᶜ with supp_eq
  suffices h : (fixedBy α f)ᶜ ⊆ supp → f ∈ closure S from h supp_eq.symm.subset
  clear_value supp; clear supp_eq; revert f
  apply fin.induction_on ..
  · rintro f - emp; convert! (closure S).one_mem; ext; by_contra h; exact emp h
  rintro a s - - ih f hf supp_subset
  refine (mul_mem_cancel_left ((swap_mem_closure_isSwap hS).2 (hf a))).1
    (ih (fun b ↦ ?_) fun b hb ↦ ?_)
  · rw [Perm.mul_apply, swap_apply_def]; split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rw [← orbit_eq_iff.mpr (hf b), h1, orbit_eq_iff.mpr (hf a)]; apply mem_orbit_self
    · rw [← orbit_eq_iff.mpr (hf b), h2]; apply hf
    · exact hf b
  · contrapose hb
    simp_rw [notMem_compl_iff, mem_fixedBy, Perm.smul_def, Perm.mul_apply, swap_apply_def,
      apply_eq_iff_eq]
    by_cases hb' : f b = b
    · rw [hb']; split_ifs with h <;> simp only [h]
    simp [show b = a by simpa [hb] using supp_subset hb']

name: mem_closure_isSwap'
statement:
theorem mem_closure_isSwap' {f : Perm α} :
    f ∈ closure {σ : Perm α | σ.IsSwap} ↔ (fixedBy α f)ᶜ.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_closure_isSwap fun _ ↦ id).trans
    (and_iff_left fun x ↦ ⟨⟨Equiv.swap x (f x), ?_⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left x (f x)⟩)
  by_cases h : x = f x
  · rw [← h, Equiv.swap_self]
    apply Subgroup.one_mem
  · exact subset_closure ⟨x, f x, h, rfl⟩

name: closure_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive
statement:
theorem closure_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive [Finite α] {S : Set (Perm α)} (hS : ∀ σ ∈ S, σ.IsSwap)
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Subgroup.closure S) α] : Subgroup.closure S = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [eq_top_iff', mem_closure_isSwap hS, orbit_eq_univ, Set.toFinite]

name: surjective_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive'
statement:
theorem surjective_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive' [Finite α] (S : Set G)
    (hS1 : ∀ σ ∈ S, MulAction.toPermHom G α σ = 1 ∨ Perm.IsSwap (MulAction.toPermHom G α σ))
    (hS2 : Subgroup.closure S = ⊤) [h : MulAction.IsPretransitive G α] :
    Function.Surjective (MulAction.toPermHom G α)
proof:
:= by
  have h : closure ((toPermHom G α '' S) \ {1}) = (toPermHom G α).range := by
    rw [closure_sdiff_one, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, hS2, Subgroup.map_top]
  have := IsPretransitive.of_compHom (α := α) (toPermHom G α).rangeRestrict
  rw [← h] at this
  rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_top, ← h, closure_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive]
  rintro - ⟨⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩, hσ1⟩
  exact (hS1 σ hσ).resolve_left hσ1

name: surjective_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive
statement:
theorem surjective_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive [Finite α] (S : Set G)
    (hS1 : ∀ σ ∈ S, Perm.IsSwap (MulAction.toPermHom G α σ)) (hS2 : Subgroup.closure S = ⊤)
    [h : MulAction.IsPretransitive G α] : Function.Surjective (MulAction.toPermHom G α)
proof:
:=
  surjective_of_isSwap_of_isPretransitive' S (fun σ hσ ↦ Or.inr (hS1 σ hσ)) hS2

name: Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_of_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_of_refl {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, Equiv.refl _) = swap 0 p
proof:
:= by
  simp [Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin, Equiv.permCongr_def, pull_end]

name: Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_of_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_of_one {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, 1) = swap 0 p
proof:
:=
  Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_of_refl p

name: Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_zero {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (e : Perm (Fin n)) :
    Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin.symm (p, e) 0 = p
proof: := by simp [Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin]

name: Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Equiv.Perm.decomposeFin_symm_apply_succ {n : ℕ} (e : Perm (Fin n)) (p : Fin (n + 1))
