name: map_prime
statement:
theorem map_prime (f : S.LocalizationMap N) {m : M} (prime : Prime m)
    (n0 : f m ≠ 0) (nu : ¬ IsUnit (f m)) : Prime (f m)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨n0, nu, fun n₁ n₂ dvd ↦ ?_⟩
  have ⟨⟨m₁, s₁⟩, eq₁⟩ := f.surj n₁
  have ⟨⟨m₂, s₂⟩, eq₂⟩ := f.surj n₂
  have := (f.map_units (s₁ * s₂)).dvd_mul_right.mpr dvd
  rw [Submonoid.mul_def, map_mul, mul_mul_mul_comm, eq₁, eq₂, ← map_mul, f.map_dvd_map] at this
  have ⟨s, hs, dvd⟩ := this
  rw [← mul_assoc] at dvd
  obtain dvd | dvd := prime.dvd_or_dvd dvd
  all_goals have := map_dvd f dvd
  · rw [map_mul, (f.map_units ⟨s, hs⟩).dvd_mul_left, ← eq₁, (f.map_units s₁).dvd_mul_right] at this
    exact .inl this
  · rw [← eq₂, (f.map_units s₂).dvd_mul_right] at this; exact .inr this

name: eq_isUnit_map_mul_irreducible_of_irreducible_map
statement:
theorem eq_isUnit_map_mul_irreducible_of_irreducible_map [WfDvdMonoid M] (f : S.LocalizationMap N)
    {m : M} (hm : Irreducible (f m)) : ∃ u m' : M, IsUnit (f u) ∧ Irreducible m' ∧ m = u * m'
proof:
:= by
  induction m using WfDvdMonoid.induction_on_irreducible with
  | zero => exact (hm.ne_zero f.map_zero).elim
  | unit u hu => exact (hm.not_isUnit (hu.map f)).elim
  | mul a i ha0 hi ha =>
    rw [map_mul, irreducible_mul_iff] at hm
    obtain hia | hai := hm
    · exact ⟨a, i, hia.2, hi, mul_comm ..⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, m', hu, hm', rfl⟩ := ha hai.1
      exact ⟨u * i, m', by simpa using hu.mul hai.2, hm', by ac_rfl⟩

name: uniqueFactorizationMonoid
statement:
theorem uniqueFactorizationMonoid (f : S.LocalizationMap N)
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] : UniqueFactorizationMonoid N
proof:
:=
  have := f.isCancelMulZero
  .of_exists_prime_factors fun n hn ↦ by
    classical
    have ⟨⟨m, s⟩, eq⟩ := f.surj n
    use ((factors m).map f).filter (¬ IsUnit ·)
    rw [Ne, ← (f.map_units s).mul_left_eq_zero, eq] at hn
    refine ⟨fun x hx ↦ ?_, .trans (eq ▸ ?_) ((associated_mul_unit_left _ _ (f.map_units s)))⟩
    · rw [Multiset.mem_filter, Multiset.mem_map] at hx
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hx.1
      exact f.map_prime (prime_of_factor _ hp)
        (mt (fun h ↦ eq_zero_of_zero_dvd <| h ▸ map_dvd f (dvd_of_mem_factors hp)) hn) hx.2
    · exact .trans (.trans (associated_unit_mul_right _ _ <|
        IsUnit.multisetProd_iff.mpr fun x hx ↦ (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hx).2) <| .of_eq <|
        (Multiset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not _).trans (f.toMonoidHom.map_multiset_prod _).symm)
        ((factors_prod (mt (by simp [·]) hn)).map f)

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_isLocalization (N : Type*) [CommSemiring N] [Algebra M N]
    [IsLocalization S N] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid M] : UniqueFactorizationMonoid N
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalization.toLocalizationMap S N).uniqueFactorizationMonoid

name: of_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma of_injective [IsCancelMul M] : Injective (of (M := M))
proof:
:=
  fun m₁ m₂ ↦ by simp [of, ← mk_one_eq_monoidOf_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff']

name: inv_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma inv_mk (m : M) (s : (⊤ : Submonoid M)) : (mk m s)⁻¹ = .mk s ⟨m, Submonoid.mem_top _⟩
proof: := rfl

name: mk_div_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma mk_div_mk (m₁ m₂ : M) (s₁ s₂ : (⊤ : Submonoid M)) :
    mk m₁ s₁ / mk m₂ s₂ = .mk (m₁ * s₂) ⟨s₁ * m₂, Submonoid.mem_top _⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mk_mul]; rfl

name: lift_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma lift_apply (f : M →* G) (x : GrothendieckGroup M) :
    lift f x = f ((monoidOf ⊤).sec x).1 / f ((monoidOf ⊤).sec x).2
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, (monoidOf ⊤).lift_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]; congr

name: surj_pi_of_finite
statement:
theorem surj_pi_of_finite {M N F ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    [CommMonoid M] [CommMonoid N] [FunLike F M N] [MulHomClass F M N] {f : F}
    {S : Submonoid M} (hf : IsLocalizationMap S f) (n : ι → N) :
    ∃ (s : S) (x : ι → M), ∀ i, n i * f s = f (x i)
proof:
:= by
  choose x hx using hf.surj
  have ⟨_⟩ := nonempty_fintype ι
  classical
  refine ⟨∏ i : ι, (x (n i)).2, fun i ↦ (x (n i)).1 * ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, (x (n j)).2, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← univ.mul_prod_erase _ (mem_univ i), S.coe_mul, map_mul, ← mul_assoc, hx, map_mul]

name: pi
statement:
@[to_additive] protected theorem pi {ι : Type*} {M N : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, CommMonoid (M i)] [∀ i, CommMonoid (N i)] (S : Π i, Submonoid (M i))
    {f : Π i, M i → N i} (hf : ∀ i, IsLocalizationMap (S i) (f i)) :
    IsLocalizationMap (Submonoid.pi .univ S) (Pi.map f) where
  map_units m
proof:
:= Pi.isUnit_iff.mpr fun i ↦ (hf i).map_units ⟨_, m.2 i ⟨⟩⟩
  surj z := by
    choose x hx using fun i ↦ (hf i).surj
    exact ⟨⟨fun i ↦ (x i (z i)).1, ⟨_, fun i _ ↦ (x i (z i)).2.2⟩⟩, funext fun i ↦ hx i (z i)⟩
  exists_of_eq {x y} eq := by
    choose c hc using fun i ↦ (hf i).exists_of_eq congr($eq i)
    exact ⟨⟨_, fun i _ ↦ (c i).2⟩, funext hc⟩

name: eq_of_eq
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`AddCommMonoid`s `g : M →+ P` such that `g(S) ⊆ AddUnits P`, `f x = f y → g x = g y`
for all `x y : M`. -/]
theorem eq_of_eq (hg : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (g y)) {x y} (h : f x = f y) : g x = g y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := f.eq_iff_exists.1 h
  rw [← one_mul (g x), ← IsUnit.liftRight_inv_mul (g.domRestrict S) hg c]
  change _ * g c * _ = _
  rw [mul_assoc, ← g.map_mul, hc, mul_comm, mul_inv_left hg, g.map_mul]

name: comp_eq_of_eq
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`S, T` respectively, and `g : M →+ P` such that `g(S) ⊆ T`, `f x = f y`
implies `k (g x) = k (g y)`. -/]
theorem comp_eq_of_eq {T : Submonoid P} {Q : Type*} [CommMonoid Q] (hg : ∀ y : S, g y ∈ T)
    (k : LocalizationMap T Q) {x y} (h : f x = f y) : k (g x) = k (g y)
proof:
:=
  f.eq_of_eq (fun y : S ↦ show IsUnit (k.toMonoidHom.comp g y) from k.map_units ⟨g y, hg y⟩) h

name: lift_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma lift_apply (z) :
    f.lift hg z = g (f.sec z).1 * (IsUnit.liftRight (g.domRestrict S) hg (f.sec z).2)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: lift_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`AddCommMonoid`s `g : M →+ P` such that `g y` is invertible for all `y : S`, the homomorphism
induced from `N` to `P` maps `f x - f y` to `g x - g y` for all `x : M, y ∈ S`. -/]
theorem lift_mk' (x y) :
    f.lift hg (f.mk' x y) = g x * (IsUnit.liftRight (g.domRestrict S) hg y)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (mul_inv hg).2 <|
    f.eq_of_eq hg <| by
      simp_rw [map_mul, sec_spec', mul_assoc, f.mk'_spec, mul_comm]

name: lift_localizationMap_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
`g : M →+ P` for the same submonoid, the homomorphism
induced from `N` to `P` maps `f x - f y` to `g x - g y` for all `x : M, y ∈ S`. -/]
theorem lift_localizationMap_mk' (g : S.LocalizationMap P) (x y) :
    f.lift g.map_units (f.mk' x y) = g.mk' x y
proof:
:=
  f.lift_mk' _ _ _

name: lift_spec
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`AddCommMonoid` map `g : M →+ P` induces a map `f.lift hg : N →+ P` then for all
`z : N, v : P`, we have `f.lift hg z = v ↔ g x = g y + v`, where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that
`z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem lift_spec (z v) : f.lift hg z = v ↔ g (f.sec z).1 = g (f.sec z).2 * v
proof:
:=
  mul_inv_left hg _ _ v

name: lift_spec_mul
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`g : M →+ P` induces a map `f.lift hg : N →+ P` then for all
`z : N, v w : P`, we have `f.lift hg z + w = v ↔ g x + w = g y + v`, where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such
that `z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem lift_spec_mul (z w v) : f.lift hg z * w = v ↔ g (f.sec z).1 * w = g (f.sec z).2 * v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, lift_apply, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_left hg, mul_comm]

name: lift_mk'_spec
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_mk'_spec (x v) (y : S) : f.lift hg (f.mk' x y) = v ↔ g x = g y * v
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.lift_mk' hg]; exact mul_inv_left hg _ _ _

name: lift_mul_right
statement:
@[to_additive
/
map `g : M →+ P` induces a map `f.lift hg : N →+ P` then for all `z : N`, we have
`f.lift hg z + g y = g x`, where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that `z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem lift_mul_right (z) : f.lift hg z * g (f.sec z).2 = g (f.sec z).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_apply, mul_assoc, ← g.domRestrict_apply, IsUnit.liftRight_inv_mul, mul_one]

name: lift_mul_left
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`g : M →+ P` induces a map `f.lift hg : N →+ P` then for all `z : N`, we have
`g y + f.lift hg z = g x`, where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that `z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem lift_mul_left (z) : g (f.sec z).2 * f.lift hg z = g (f.sec z).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, lift_mul_right]

name: lift_eq
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem lift_eq (x : M) : f.lift hg (f x) = g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_spec, ← g.map_mul]; exact f.eq_of_eq hg (by rw [sec_spec', map_mul])

name: lift_eq_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_eq_iff {x y : M × S} :
    f.lift hg (f.mk' x.1 x.2) = f.lift hg (f.mk' y.1 y.2) ↔ g (x.1 * y.2) = g (y.1 * x.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_mk', lift_mk', mul_inv hg]

name: lift_comp
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem lift_comp : (f.lift hg).comp f.toMonoidHom = g
proof: := by ext; exact f.lift_eq hg _

name: lift_of_comp
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem lift_of_comp (j : N →* P) : f.lift (f.isUnit_comp j) = j
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp_rw [lift_spec, j.comp_apply, ← map_mul, toMonoidHom_apply, sec_spec']

name: lift_unique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_unique {j : N →* P} (hj : ∀ x, j (f x) = g x) : f.lift hg = j
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [lift_spec, ← hj, ← hj, ← j.map_mul]
  apply congr_arg
  rw [← sec_spec']

name: lift_id
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem lift_id (x) : f.lift f.map_units x = x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext_iff.1 (f.lift_of_comp <| MonoidHom.id N) x

name: lift_comp_lift
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`k : M →+ Q` for a Submonoid `T ⊆ M`, such that `S ≤ T`, and we have
`l : M →+ A`, the composition of the induced map `f.lift` for `k` with
the induced map `k.lift` for `l` is equal to the induced map `f.lift` for `l` -/]
theorem lift_comp_lift {T : Submonoid M} (hST : S ≤ T) {Q : Type*} [CommMonoid Q]
    (k : LocalizationMap T Q) {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] {l : M →* A}
    (hl : ∀ w : T, IsUnit (l w)) :
    (k.lift hl).comp (f.lift (map_units k ⟨_, hST ·.2⟩)) =
    f.lift (hl ⟨_, hST ·.2⟩)
proof:
:= .symm <|
  lift_unique _ _ fun x ↦ by rw [← toMonoidHom_apply, ← MonoidHom.comp_apply,
    MonoidHom.comp_assoc, lift_comp, lift_comp]

name: lift_comp_lift_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_comp_lift_eq {Q : Type*} [CommMonoid Q] (k : LocalizationMap S Q)
    {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] {l : M →* A} (hl : ∀ w : S, IsUnit (l w)) :
    (k.lift hl).comp (f.lift k.map_units) = f.lift hl
proof:
:=
  lift_comp_lift f le_rfl k hl

name: lift_left_inverse
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
from `P` to `N` induced by `f` is left inverse to the hom from `N` to `P` induced by `k`. -/]
theorem lift_left_inverse {k : LocalizationMap S P} (z : N) :
    k.lift f.map_units (f.lift k.map_units z) = z
proof:
:=
  (DFunLike.congr_fun (lift_comp_lift_eq f k f.map_units) z).trans (lift_id f z)

name: lift_surjective_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_surjective_iff :
    Function.Surjective (f.lift hg) ↔ ∀ v : P, ∃ x : M × S, v * g x.2 = g x.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H v
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := H v
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := f.surj z
    use x
    rw [← hz, f.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq.2 hx, lift_mk', mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (g ↑x.2),
      ← MonoidHom.domRestrict_apply, IsUnit.mul_liftRight_inv (g.domRestrict S) hg, mul_one]
  · intro H v
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := H v
    use f.mk' x.1 x.2
    rw [lift_mk', mul_inv_left hg, mul_comm, ← hx]

name: lift_injective_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_injective_iff :
    Function.Injective (f.lift hg) ↔ ∀ x y, f x = f y ↔ g x = g y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H x y
    constructor
    · exact f.eq_of_eq hg
    · intro h
      rw [← f.lift_eq hg, ← f.lift_eq hg] at h
      exact H h
  · intro H z w h
    obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := f.surj z
    obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := f.surj w
    rw [← f.mk'_sec z, ← f.mk'_sec w]
    exact (mul_inv f.map_units).2 ((H _ _).2 <| (mul_inv hg).1 h)

name: map_eq
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_eq (x) : f.map hy k (f x) = k (g x)
proof:
:=
  f.lift_eq (fun y ↦ k.map_units ⟨g y, hy y⟩) x

name: map_comp
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_comp : (f.map hy k).comp f.toMonoidHom = k.toMonoidHom.comp g
proof:
:=
  f.lift_comp fun y ↦ k.map_units ⟨g y, hy y⟩

name: map_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_mk' (x) (y : S) : f.map hy k (f.mk' x y) = k.mk' (g x) ⟨g y, hy y⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [map, lift_mk', mul_inv_left]
  change k (g x) = k (g y) * _
  rw [mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul]
  exact (k.mk'_mul_cancel_left (g x) ⟨g y, hy y⟩).symm

name: map_spec
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`AddCommMonoid` homomorphism `g : M →+ P` induces a `f.map hy k : N →+ Q`, then for all `z : N`,
`u : Q`, we have `f.map hy k z = u ↔ k (g x) = k (g y) + u` where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that
`z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem map_spec (z u) : f.map hy k z = u ↔ k (g (f.sec z).1) = k (g (f.sec z).2) * u
proof:
:=
  f.lift_spec (fun y ↦ k.map_units ⟨g y, hy y⟩) _ _

name: map_mul_right
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`AddCommMonoid` homomorphism `g : M →+ P` induces a `f.map hy k : N →+ Q`, then for all `z : N`,
we have `f.map hy k z + k (g y) = k (g x)` where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that
`z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem map_mul_right (z) : f.map hy k z * k (g (f.sec z).2) = k (g (f.sec z).1)
proof:
:=
  f.lift_mul_right (fun y ↦ k.map_units ⟨g y, hy y⟩) _

name: map_mul_left
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`AddCommMonoid` homomorphism `g : M →+ P` induces a `f.map hy k : N →+ Q`, then for all `z : N`,
we have `k (g y) + f.map hy k z = k (g x)` where `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that
`z + f y = f x`. -/]
theorem map_mul_left (z) : k (g (f.sec z).2) * f.map hy k z = k (g (f.sec z).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, f.map_mul_right]

name: map_id
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_id (z : N) : f.map (fun y ↦ show MonoidHom.id M y ∈ S from y.2) f z = z
proof:
:=
  f.lift_id z

name: map_comp_map
statement:
@[to_additive
/
of the induced maps equals the map of localizations induced by `l ∘ g`. -/]
theorem map_comp_map {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] {U : Submonoid A} {R} [CommMonoid R]
    (j : LocalizationMap U R) {l : P →* A} (hl : ∀ w : T, l w ∈ U) :
    (k.map hl j).comp (f.map hy k) =
    f.map (fun x ↦ show l.comp g x ∈ U from hl ⟨g x, hy x⟩) j
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change j _ * _ = j (l _) * _
  rw [mul_inv_left, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_right]
  change j _ * j (l (g _)) = j (l _) * _
  rw [← map_mul j, ← map_mul j, ← l.map_mul, ← l.map_mul]
  refine k.comp_eq_of_eq hl j ?_
  rw [map_mul k, map_mul k, sec_spec', mul_assoc, map_mul_right]

name: map_map
statement:
@[to_additive
/
of the induced maps equals the map of localizations induced by `l ∘ g`. -/]
theorem map_map {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] {U : Submonoid A} {R} [CommMonoid R]
    (j : LocalizationMap U R) {l : P →* A} (hl : ∀ w : T, l w ∈ U) (x) :
    k.map hl j (f.map hy k x) = f.map (fun x ↦ show l.comp g x ∈ U from hl ⟨g x, hy x⟩) j x
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← f.map_comp_map (k := k) hy j hl]
  simp only [MonoidHom.coe_comp, comp_apply]

name: map_injective_of_surjOn_or_injective
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem map_injective_of_surjOn_or_injective
    (or : (S : Set M).SurjOn g T ∨ Injective k) (hg : Injective g) :
    Injective (f.map hy k)
proof:
:= fun z w hizw ↦ by
  set i := f.map hy k
  have ifkg (a : M) : i (f a) = k (g a) := f.map_eq hy a
  have ⟨z', w', x, hxz, hxw⟩ := surj₂ f z w
  have : k (g z') = k (g w') := by rw [← ifkg, ← ifkg, ← hxz, ← hxw, map_mul, map_mul, hizw]
  obtain surj | inj := or
  · have ⟨⟨c, hc'⟩, eq⟩ := k.exists_of_eq this
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := surj hc'
    simp_rw [← map_mul, hg.eq_iff] at eq
    rw [← (f.map_units x).mul_left_inj, hxz, hxw, f.eq_iff_exists]
    exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, eq⟩
  · apply (f.map_units x).mul_right_cancel
    rw [hxz, hxw, hg (inj this)]

name: map_surjective_of_surjOn
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem map_surjective_of_surjOn (surj : (S : Set M).SurjOn g T)
    (hg : Surjective g) : Surjective (f.map hy k)
proof:
:= fun z ↦ by
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨t, ht⟩, rfl⟩ := k.mk'_surjective z
  obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := surj ht
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg y
  use f.mk' x ⟨s, hs⟩
  rw [map_mk']

name: map_injective_of_injective
statement:
@[to_additive /
submonoid `S ⊆ M`, the induced monoid homomorphism from the localization of `M` at `S`
to the localization of `P` at `g S`, is injective. -/]
theorem map_injective_of_injective (hg : Injective g) (k : LocalizationMap (S.map g) Q) :
    Injective (map f (apply_coe_mem_map g S) k)
proof:
:=
  f.map_injective_of_surjOn_or_injective _ (.inl <| Set.surjOn_image ..) hg

name: map_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive /
submonoid `S ⊆ M`, the induced monoid homomorphism from the localization of `M` at `S`
to the localization of `P` at `g S`, is surjective. -/]
theorem map_surjective_of_surjective (hg : Surjective g) (k : LocalizationMap (S.map g) Q) :
    Surjective (map f (apply_coe_mem_map g S) k)
proof:
:=
  f.map_surjective_of_surjOn _ (Set.surjOn_image ..) hg

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_apply {k : LocalizationMap S P} {x} :
    f.mulEquivOfLocalizations k x = f.lift k.map_units x
proof: := rfl

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_symm_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_symm_apply {k : LocalizationMap S P} {x} :
    (f.mulEquivOfLocalizations k).symm x = k.lift f.map_units x
proof: := rfl

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_symm_eq_mulEquivOfLocalizations
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_symm_eq_mulEquivOfLocalizations {k : LocalizationMap S P} :
    (k.mulEquivOfLocalizations f).symm = f.mulEquivOfLocalizations k
proof: := rfl

name: ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_apply {k : N ≃* P} (x) :
    f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k x = k (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_eq {k : N ≃* P} :
    (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k).toMonoidHom = k.toMonoidHom.comp f.toMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: symm_comp_ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem symm_comp_ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_apply {k : N ≃* P} (x) :
    k.symm (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k x) = f x
proof: := k.symm_apply_apply (f x)

name: symm_comp_ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_apply'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem symm_comp_ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_apply' {k : P ≃* N} (x) :
    k (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k.symm x) = f x
proof: := k.apply_symm_apply (f x)

name: ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_eq_iff_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_eq_iff_eq {k : N ≃* P} {x y} :
    f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k x = y ↔ f x = k.symm y
proof:
:=
  k.toEquiv.eq_symm_apply.symm

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv
statement:
@[to_additive addEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv (k : LocalizationMap S P) :
    f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations (f.mulEquivOfLocalizations k) = k
proof:
:=
  toMonoidHom_injective <| f.lift_comp k.map_units

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv_apply
statement:
@[to_additive addEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv_apply]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv_apply {k : LocalizationMap S P} {x} :
    f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations (f.mulEquivOfLocalizations k) x = k x
proof: := by simp

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_left_inv
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_left_inv (k : N ≃* P) :
    f.mulEquivOfLocalizations (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k) = k
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext _ _ fun x ↦ DFunLike.ext_iff.1 (f.lift_of_comp k.toMonoidHom) x

name: mulEquivOfLocalizations_left_inv_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfLocalizations_left_inv_apply {k : N ≃* P} (x) :
    f.mulEquivOfLocalizations (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k) x = k x
proof: := by simp

name: ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_id
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_id : f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations (MulEquiv.refl N) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext; rfl

name: ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_comp
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofMulEquivOfLocalizations_comp {k : N ≃* P} {j : P ≃* Q} :
    (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations (k.trans j)).toMonoidHom =
      j.toMonoidHom.comp (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations k).toMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  ext; rfl

name: ofMulEquivOfDom_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem ofMulEquivOfDom_apply {k : P ≃* M} (H : T.map k.toMonoidHom = S) (x) :
    f.ofMulEquivOfDom H x = f (k x)
proof: := rfl

name: ofMulEquivOfDom_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofMulEquivOfDom_eq {k : P ≃* M} (H : T.map k.toMonoidHom = S) :
    (f.ofMulEquivOfDom H).toMonoidHom = f.toMonoidHom.comp k.toMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: ofMulEquivOfDom_comp_symm
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofMulEquivOfDom_comp_symm {k : P ≃* M} (H : T.map k.toMonoidHom = S) (x) :
    f.ofMulEquivOfDom H (k.symm x) = f x
proof:
:=
  congr_arg f <| k.apply_symm_apply x

name: ofMulEquivOfDom_comp
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofMulEquivOfDom_comp {k : M ≃* P} (H : T.map k.symm.toMonoidHom = S) (x) :
    f.ofMulEquivOfDom H (k x) = f x
proof: := congr_arg f <| k.symm_apply_apply x

name: ofMulEquivOfDom_id
statement:
theorem ofMulEquivOfDom_id :
    f.ofMulEquivOfDom
        (show S.map (MulEquiv.refl M).toMonoidHom = S from
          Submonoid.ext fun x ↦ ⟨fun ⟨_, hy, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ hy, fun h ↦ ⟨x, h, rfl⟩⟩) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext; rfl

name: mulEquivOfMulEquiv_eq_map_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfMulEquiv_eq_map_apply {k : LocalizationMap T Q} {j : M ≃* P}
    (H : S.map j.toMonoidHom = T) (x) :
    f.mulEquivOfMulEquiv k H x =
      f.map (fun y : S ↦ show j.toMonoidHom y ∈ T from H ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem j y.2) k x
proof: := rfl

name: mulEquivOfMulEquiv_eq_map
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfMulEquiv_eq_map {k : LocalizationMap T Q} {j : M ≃* P}
    (H : S.map j.toMonoidHom = T) :
    (f.mulEquivOfMulEquiv k H).toMonoidHom =
      f.map (fun y : S ↦ show j.toMonoidHom y ∈ T from H ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem j y.2) k
proof: := rfl

name: mulEquivOfMulEquiv_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfMulEquiv_eq {k : LocalizationMap T Q} {j : M ≃* P} (H : S.map j.toMonoidHom = T)
    (x) :
    f.mulEquivOfMulEquiv k H (f x) = k (j x)
proof:
:=
  f.map_eq (fun y : S ↦ H ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem j y.2) _

name: mulEquivOfMulEquiv_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfMulEquiv_mk' {k : LocalizationMap T Q} {j : M ≃* P} (H : S.map j.toMonoidHom = T)
    (x y) :
    f.mulEquivOfMulEquiv k H (f.mk' x y) = k.mk' (j x) ⟨j y, H ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem j y.2⟩
proof:
:=
  f.map_mk' (fun y : S ↦ H ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem j y.2) _ _

name: of_mulEquivOfMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem of_mulEquivOfMulEquiv_apply {k : LocalizationMap T Q} {j : M ≃* P}
    (H : S.map j.toMonoidHom = T) (x) :
    f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations (f.mulEquivOfMulEquiv k H) x = k (j x)
proof:
:=
  Submonoid.LocalizationMap.ext_iff.1 (f.mulEquivOfLocalizations_right_inv (k.ofMulEquivOfDom H)) x

name: of_mulEquivOfMulEquiv
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem of_mulEquivOfMulEquiv {k : LocalizationMap T Q} {j : M ≃* P} (H : S.map j.toMonoidHom = T) :
    (f.ofMulEquivOfLocalizations (f.mulEquivOfMulEquiv k H)).toMonoidHom =
      k.toMonoidHom.comp j.toMonoidHom
proof:
:=
  MonoidHom.ext <| f.of_mulEquivOfMulEquiv_apply H

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_apply (x) : mulEquivOfQuotient f x = (monoidOf S).lift f.map_units x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_mk' (x y) : mulEquivOfQuotient f ((monoidOf S).mk' x y) = f.mk' x y
proof:
:=
  (monoidOf S).lift_mk' _ _ _

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_mk (x y) : mulEquivOfQuotient f (mk x y) = f.mk' x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_monoidOf_mk'_apply]; exact mulEquivOfQuotient_mk' _ _

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_monoidOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_monoidOf (x) : mulEquivOfQuotient f (monoidOf S x) = f x
proof: := by simp

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_mk' (x y) :
    (mulEquivOfQuotient f).symm (f.mk' x y) = (monoidOf S).mk' x y
proof:
:=
  f.lift_mk' (monoidOf S).map_units _ _

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_mk (x y) : (mulEquivOfQuotient f).symm (f.mk' x y) = mk x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_monoidOf_mk'_apply]; exact mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_mk' _ _

name: mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_monoidOf
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mulEquivOfQuotient_symm_monoidOf (x) : (mulEquivOfQuotient f).symm (f x) = monoidOf S x
proof:
:=
  f.lift_eq (monoidOf S).map_units _

name: mk_le_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_le_mk : mk a₁ a₂ ≤ mk b₁ b₂ ↔ ↑b₂ * a₁ ≤ a₂ * b₁
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mk_lt_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_lt_mk : mk a₁ a₂ < mk b₁ b₂ ↔ ↑b₂ * a₁ < a₂ * b₁
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: LocalizationMap.subsingleton
statement:
theorem LocalizationMap.subsingleton (f : LocalizationMap S N) (h : 0 ∈ S) : Subsingleton N where
  allEq a b
proof:
:= by
    rw [← f.mk'_sec a, ← f.mk'_sec b, f.eq]
    exact ⟨⟨0, h⟩, by simp only [zero_mul]⟩

name: LocalizationMap.subsingleton_iff
statement: theorem LocalizationMap.subsingleton_iff (f : LocalizationMap S N) : Subsingleton N ↔ 0 ∈ S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ have ⟨c, eq⟩ := f.exists_of_eq (Subsingleton.elim (f 0) (f 1))
    by rw [mul_zero, mul_one] at eq; exact eq ▸ c.2, f.subsingleton⟩

name: LocalizationMap.nontrivial
statement: theorem LocalizationMap.nontrivial (f : LocalizationMap S N) (h : 0 ∉ S) : Nontrivial N
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial, f.subsingleton_iff]

name: LocalizationMap.map_zero
statement: protected theorem LocalizationMap.map_zero (f : LocalizationMap S N) : f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨ms, eq⟩ := f.surj 0
  rw [← zero_mul, map_mul, ← eq, zero_mul, mul_zero]

name: IsLocalizationMap.map_zero
statement:
protected theorem IsLocalizationMap.map_zero {F} [FunLike F M N] [MulHomClass F M N] {f : F}
    (hf : IsLocalizationMap S f) : f 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  LocalizationMap.map_zero ⟨MulHomClass.toMulHom f, hf⟩

name: mk_zero
statement: theorem mk_zero (x : S) : mk 0 (x : S) = 0
proof: := OreLocalization.zero_oreDiv' _

name: liftOn_zero
statement: theorem liftOn_zero {p : Type*} (f : M → S → p) (H) : liftOn 0 f H = f 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_zero 1, liftOn_mk]

name: LocalizationMap.sec_zero_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LocalizationMap.sec_zero_fst {f : LocalizationMap S N} : f (f.sec 0).fst = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LocalizationMap.sec_spec', mul_zero]

name: lift
statement:
lemma lift₀_def (f : LocalizationMap S N) (g : M →*₀ P) (hg : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (g y)) :
    ⇑(f.lift₀ g hg) = f.lift (g := g) hg
proof: := rfl

name: lift
statement:
lemma lift₀_apply (f : LocalizationMap S N) (g : M →*₀ P) (hg : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (g y)) (x) :
    f.lift₀ g hg x = g (f.sec x).1 * (IsUnit.liftRight (g.domRestrict S) hg (f.sec x).2)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: isCancelMulZero
statement: theorem isCancelMulZero (f : LocalizationMap S N) [IsCancelMulZero M] : IsCancelMulZero N
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isCancelMulZero_iff_forall_isRegular, Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _),
    ← Commute.isRightRegular_iff (Commute.all _)]
  intro n hn
  have ⟨ms, eq⟩ := f.surj n
  refine (eq ▸ f.map_isRegular (isCancelMulZero_iff_forall_isRegular.mp ‹_› ?_)).2.of_mul
  refine fun h ↦ hn ?_
  rwa [h, map_zero, (f.map_units _).mul_left_eq_zero] at eq

name: map_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem map_eq_zero_iff (f : LocalizationMap S N) {m : M} : f m = 0 ↔ ∃ s : S, s * m = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← f.map_zero, eq_iff_exists, mul_zero]

name: mk'_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk'_eq_zero_iff (f : LocalizationMap S N) (m : M) (s : S) :
    f.mk' m s = 0 ↔ ∃ s : S, s * m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (f.map_units s).mul_left_inj, mk'_spec, zero_mul, map_eq_zero_iff]

name: mk'_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem mk'_zero (f : LocalizationMap S N) (s : S) : f.mk' 0 s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq, zero_mul, f.map_zero]

name: nonZeroDivisors_le_comap
statement:
theorem nonZeroDivisors_le_comap (f : LocalizationMap S N) :
    nonZeroDivisors M ≤ (nonZeroDivisors N).comap f
proof:
:= by
  refine fun m hm ↦ nonZeroDivisorsRight_eq_nonZeroDivisors (M₀ := N) ▸ fun n h0 ↦ ?_
  have ⟨ms, eq⟩ := f.surj n
  rw [← (f.map_units ms.2).mul_left_eq_zero, mul_right_comm, eq, ← map_mul, map_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, mul_right_mem_nonZeroDivisorsRight_eq_zero_iff hm.2] at h0
  rwa [← (f.map_units ms.2).mul_left_eq_zero, eq, map_eq_zero_iff]

name: map_nonZeroDivisors_le
statement:
theorem map_nonZeroDivisors_le (f : LocalizationMap S N) :
    (nonZeroDivisors M).map f ≤ nonZeroDivisors N
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr f.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap

name: noZeroDivisors
statement: theorem noZeroDivisors (f : LocalizationMap S N) [NoZeroDivisors M] : NoZeroDivisors N
proof:
:= by
  refine noZeroDivisors_iff_forall_mem_nonZeroDivisors.mpr fun n hn ↦ ?_
  have ⟨ms, eq⟩ := f.surj n
  have hs : ms.1 ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hn (by rwa [h, f.map_zero, (f.map_units _).mul_left_eq_zero] at eq)
  exact And.left <| mul_mem_nonZeroDivisors.mp
    (eq ▸ f.map_nonZeroDivisors_le ⟨_, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hs, rfl⟩)

name: r_eq_r'
statement:
@[to_additive
/
expressed equivalently as an infimum (see `AddLocalization.r`) or explicitly
(see `AddLocalization.r'`). -/]
theorem r_eq_r' : r S = r' S
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (sInf_le fun _ ↦ ⟨1, by simp⟩) <|
    le_sInf fun b H ⟨p, q⟩ ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨t, ht⟩ ↦ by
      rw [← one_mul (p, q), ← one_mul (x, y)]
      refine b.trans (b.mul (H (t * y)) (b.refl _)) ?_
      convert! b.symm (b.mul (H (t * q)) (b.refl (x, y))) using 1
      dsimp only [Prod.mk_mul_mk, Submonoid.coe_mul] at ht ⊢
      simp_rw [mul_assoc, ht, mul_comm y q]

name: r_iff_exists
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem r_iff_exists {x y : M × S} : r S x y ↔ ∃ c : S, ↑c * (↑y.2 * x.1) = c * (x.2 * y.1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [r_eq_r' S, r', Con.rel_mk]

name: r_iff_oreEqv_r
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem r_iff_oreEqv_r {x y : M × S} : r S x y ↔ (OreLocalization.oreEqv S M).r x y
proof:
:= by
  simp +instances only [r_iff_exists, Subtype.exists, exists_prop, OreLocalization.oreEqv,
    smul_eq_mul, Submonoid.mk_smul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, e⟩
    exact ⟨_, mul_mem hu x.2.2, u * y.2, by rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← e], mul_right_comm _ _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, v, e₁, e₂⟩
    exact ⟨u, hu, by rw [← mul_assoc, e₂, mul_right_comm, ← e₁, mul_assoc, mul_comm y.1]⟩

name: mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {a c : M} {b d : S} : mk a b = mk c d ↔ r S ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp +instances only [mk, OreLocalization.oreDiv_eq_iff, r_iff_oreEqv_r, OreLocalization.oreEqv]

name: mk_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_mul (a c : M) (b d : S) : mk a b * mk c d = mk (a * c) (b * d)
proof:
:=
  mul_comm b d ▸ OreLocalization.oreDiv_mul_oreDiv

name: mk_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_one : mk 1 (1 : S) = 1
proof: := OreLocalization.one_def

name: mk_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_pow (n : ℕ) (a : M) (b : S) : mk a b ^ n = mk (a ^ n) (b ^ n)
proof:
:=
  OreLocalization.oreDiv_pow _ _ _ <| .all _ _

name: mk_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_prod {ι} (t : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) (s : ι → S) :
    ∏ i ∈ t, mk (f i) (s i) = mk (∏ i ∈ t, f i) (∏ i ∈ t, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on <;> simp [mk_one, Finset.prod_insert, *, mk_mul]

name: ndrec_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem ndrec_mk {p : Localization S → Sort u} (f : ∀ (a : M) (b : S), p (mk a b)) (H) (a : M)
    (b : S) : (rec f H (mk a b) : p (mk a b)) = f a b
proof: := rfl

name: liftOn_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem liftOn_mk {p : Sort u} (f : M → S → p) (H) (a : M) (b : S) :
    liftOn (mk a b) f H = f a b
proof: := rfl

name: ind
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator, cases_eliminator)]
theorem ind {p : Localization S → Prop} (H : ∀ y : M × S, p (mk y.1 y.2)) (x) : p x
proof:
:=
  rec (fun a b ↦ H (a, b)) (fun _ ↦ rfl) x

name: induction_on
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim)]
theorem induction_on {p : Localization S → Prop} (x) (H : ∀ y : M × S, p (mk y.1 y.2)) : p x
proof:
:=
  ind H x

name: liftOn
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem liftOn₂_mk {p : Sort*} (f : M → S → M → S → p) (H) (a c : M) (b d : S) :
    liftOn₂ (mk a b) (mk c d) f H = f a b c d
proof: := rfl

name: induction_on
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim)]
theorem induction_on₂ {p : Localization S → Localization S → Prop} (x y)
    (H : ∀ x y : M × S, p (mk x.1 x.2) (mk y.1 y.2)) : p x y
proof:
:=
  induction_on x fun x ↦ induction_on y <| H x

name: induction_on
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim)]
theorem induction_on₃ {p : Localization S → Localization S → Localization S → Prop} (x y z)
    (H : ∀ x y z : M × S, p (mk x.1 x.2) (mk y.1 y.2) (mk z.1 z.2)) : p x y z
proof:
:=
  induction_on₂ x y fun x y ↦ induction_on z <| H x y

name: one_rel
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem one_rel (y : S) : r S 1 (y, y)
proof: := fun _ hb ↦ hb y

name: r_of_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem r_of_eq {x y : M × S} (h : ↑y.2 * x.1 = ↑x.2 * y.1) : r S x y
proof:
:=
  r_iff_exists.2 ⟨1, by rw [h]⟩

name: mk_self
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_self (a : S) : mk (a : M) a = 1
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← mk_one, mk_eq_mk_iff]
  exact one_rel a

name: mk_self_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma mk_self_mk (a : M) (haS : a ∈ S) : mk a ⟨a, haS⟩ = 1
proof:
:=
  mk_self ⟨a, haS⟩

name: mkHom_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simps) /
def mkHom : M × S →* Localization S where
  toFun x := mk x.1 x.2
  map_one' := mk_one
  map_mul' _ _ := (mk_mul ..).symm

@[to_additive]
lemma mkHom_surjective : Surjective (mkHom (S := S))
proof: := by rintro ⟨x, y⟩; exact ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩

name: smul_mk
statement:
theorem smul_mk [SMul R M] [IsScalarTower R M M] (c : R) (a b) :
    c • (mk a b : Localization S) = mk (c • a) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, mk, ← OreLocalization.smul_one_oreDiv_one_smul, OreLocalization.oreDiv_smul_oreDiv]
  change (c • 1) • a /ₒ (b * 1) = _
  rw [smul_assoc, one_smul, mul_one]

name: map_one
statement:
@[to_additive] protected theorem map_one {F : Type*} [FunLike F M N] [MulHomClass F M N]
    {f : F} (hf : IsLocalizationMap S f) : f 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hf.map_units 1).mul_right_inj, mul_one]
  exact (map_mul ..).symm.trans congr(f $(mul_one _))

name: mulEquiv_comp
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem mulEquiv_comp {f : M → N} (hf : IsLocalizationMap S f)
    {E} [EquivLike E N P] [MulEquivClass E N P] (e : E) : IsLocalizationMap S (e ∘ f) where
  map_units x
proof:
:= (hf.map_units x).map e
  surj y := let e : N ≃* P := e
    have ⟨x, eq⟩ := hf.surj (e.symm y)
    ⟨x, e.symm.injective (by simpa [e])⟩
  exists_of_eq eq := hf.exists_of_eq (EquivLike.injective e eq)

name: toMonoidHom_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toMonoidHom_injective : Injective (toMonoidHom : LocalizationMap S N → M →* N)
proof:
:=
  fun f g ↦ by cases f; congr! with eq; ext; exact congr($eq _)

name: toMonoidHom_apply
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma toMonoidHom_apply (f : LocalizationMap S N) (x : M) :
    f.toMonoidHom x = f x
proof: := rfl

name: ext
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := ext)]
theorem ext {f g : LocalizationMap S N} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : f = g
proof: := DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: map_units
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_units (f : LocalizationMap S N) (y : S) : IsUnit (f y)

name: surj
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem surj (f : LocalizationMap S N) (z : N) : ∃ x : M × S, z * f x.2 = f x.1

name: exists_of_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem exists_of_eq (f : LocalizationMap S N) {x y : M} : f x = f y → ∃ c : S, c * x = c * y

name: surj
statement:
@[to_additive
/
such that `f z' - f d = z` and `f w' - f d = w`. -/]
theorem surj₂ (f : LocalizationMap S N) (z w : N) : ∃ z' w' : M, ∃ d : S,
    (z * f d = f z') ∧ (w * f d = f w')
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨a, ha⟩ := surj f z
  let ⟨b, hb⟩ := surj f w
  refine ⟨a.1 * b.2, a.2 * b.1, a.2 * b.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp_rw [mul_def, map_mul, ← ha]
    exact (mul_assoc z _ _).symm
  · simp_rw [mul_def, map_mul, ← hb]
    exact mul_left_comm w _ _

name: eq_iff_exists
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eq_iff_exists (f : LocalizationMap S N) {x y} :
    f x = f y ↔ ∃ c : S, c * x = c * y
proof:
:= Iff.intro f.2.3
  fun ⟨c, h⟩ ↦ by
    replace h := congr_arg f h
    rw [map_mul, map_mul] at h
    exact (f.map_units c).mul_right_inj.mp h

name: sec_spec
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem sec_spec {f : LocalizationMap S N} (z : N) :
    z * f (f.sec z).2 = f (f.sec z).1
proof: := Classical.choose_spec <| f.surj z

name: sec_spec'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem sec_spec' {f : LocalizationMap S N} (z : N) :
    f (f.sec z).1 = f (f.sec z).2 * z
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, sec_spec]

name: mul_inv_left
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`w, z : N` and `y ∈ S`, we have `w - f y = z ↔ w = f y + z`. -/]
theorem mul_inv_left {f : M →* N} (h : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (f y)) (y : S) (w z : N) :
    w * (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) h y)⁻¹ = z ↔ w = f y * z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact Units.inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) h y)

name: mul_inv_right
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`w, z : N` and `y ∈ S`, we have `z = w - f y ↔ z + f y = w`. -/]
theorem mul_inv_right {f : M →* N} (h : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (f y)) (y : S) (w z : N) :
    z = w * (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) h y)⁻¹ ↔ z * f y = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, mul_inv_left h, mul_comm, eq_comm]

name: mul_inv
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
`f(S) ⊆ AddUnits N`, for all `x₁ x₂ : M` and `y₁, y₂ ∈ S`, we have
`f x₁ - f y₁ = f x₂ - f y₂ ↔ f (x₁ + y₂) = f (x₂ + y₁)`. -/]
theorem mul_inv {f : M →* N} (h : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (f y)) {x₁ x₂} {y₁ y₂ : S} :
    f x₁ * (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) h y₁)⁻¹ =
        f x₂ * (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) h y₂)⁻¹ ↔
      f (x₁ * y₂) = f (x₂ * y₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_inv_right h, mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (f y₂), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_left h, mul_comm x₂,
    f.map_mul, f.map_mul]

name: inv_inj
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`f(S) ⊆ AddUnits N`, for all `y, z ∈ S`, we have `- (f y) = - (f z) → f y = f z`. -/]
theorem inv_inj {f : M →* N} (hf : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (f y)) {y z : S}
    (h : (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) hf y)⁻¹ =
      (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) hf z)⁻¹) : f y = f z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one (f y), eq_comm, ← mul_inv_left hf y (f z) 1, h]
  exact Units.inv_mul (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) hf z)⁻¹

name: inv_unique
statement:
@[to_additive
/
`f(S) ⊆ AddUnits N`, for all `y ∈ S`, `- (f y)` is unique. -/]
theorem inv_unique {f : M →* N} (h : ∀ y : S, IsUnit (f y)) {y : S} {z : N} (H : f y * z = 1) :
    (IsUnit.liftRight (f.domRestrict S) h y)⁻¹ = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul _⁻¹, Units.val_mul, mul_inv_left]
  exact H.symm

name: map_right_cancel
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_right_cancel {x y} {c : S} (h : f (c * x) = f (c * y)) :
    f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, map_mul] at h
  let ⟨u, hu⟩ := f.map_units c
  rw [← hu] at h
  exact (Units.mul_right_inj u).1 h

name: map_left_cancel
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_left_cancel {x y} {c : S} (h : f (x * c) = f (y * c)) :
    f x = f y
proof:
:=
  f.map_right_cancel (c := c) <| by rw [mul_comm _ x, mul_comm _ y, h]

name: mk'_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma mk'_mul (x₁ x₂ : M) (y₁ y₂ : S) : f.mk' (x₁ * x₂) (y₁ * y₂) = f.mk' x₁ y₁ * f.mk' x₂ y₂
proof:
:= by
  refine (mul_inv_left f.map_units _ _ _).2 ?_
  simp only [map_mul, coe_mul, toMonoidHom_apply, mk', IsUnit.liftRight, Units.liftRight,
    MonoidHom.domRestrict_apply, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]
  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm (f x₁), mul_left_comm, mul_mul_mul_comm (f y₁)]
  simp

name: mk'_one
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_one (x) : f.mk' x (1 : S) = f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk', map_one]
  exact mul_one _

name: mk'_sec
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)
/
we have that if `x : M, y ∈ S` are such that `z + f y = f x`, then `f x - f y = z`. -/]
theorem mk'_sec (z : N) : f.mk' (f.sec z).1 (f.sec z).2 = z
proof:
:=
  show _ * _ = _ by rw [← sec_spec, mul_inv_left, mul_comm]; dsimp

name: mk'_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_surjective (z : N) : ∃ (x : _) (y : S), f.mk' x y = z
proof:
:=
  ⟨(f.sec z).1, (f.sec z).2, f.mk'_sec z⟩

name: mk'_spec
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_spec (x) (y : S) : f.mk' x y * f y = f x
proof:
:=
  show _ * _ * _ = _ by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (f y), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_left, mul_comm]; dsimp

name: mk'_spec'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_spec' (x) (y : S) : f y * f.mk' x y = f x
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, mk'_spec]

name: eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq {x} {y : S} {z} : z = f.mk' x y ↔ z * f y = f x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ by rw [H, mk'_spec], fun H ↦ by rwa [mk', mul_inv_right]⟩

name: mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul {x} {y : S} {z} : f.mk' x y = z ↔ f x = z * f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq, eq_comm]

name: mk'_eq_iff_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_iff_eq {x₁ x₂} {y₁ y₂ : S} :
    f.mk' x₁ y₁ = f.mk' x₂ y₂ ↔ f (y₂ * x₁) = f (y₁ * x₂) where
  mp H
proof:
:= by
    rw [map_mul f, map_mul f, f.mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul.1 H, ← mul_assoc, mk'_spec', mul_comm (f x₂)]
  mpr H := by
    rw [mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul, mk', mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (f y₁), ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul f, mul_comm x₂,
      ← H, ← mul_comm x₁, map_mul f, mul_inv_right f.map_units, toMonoidHom_apply]

name: mk'_eq_iff_eq'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_iff_eq' {x₁ x₂} {y₁ y₂ : S} :
    f.mk' x₁ y₁ = f.mk' x₂ y₂ ↔ f (x₁ * y₂) = f (x₂ * y₁)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [f.mk'_eq_iff_eq, mul_comm]

name: eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem eq {a₁ b₁} {a₂ b₂ : S} :
    f.mk' a₁ a₂ = f.mk' b₁ b₂ ↔ ∃ c : S, ↑c * (↑b₂ * a₁) = c * (a₂ * b₁)
proof:
:=
  f.mk'_eq_iff_eq.trans <| f.eq_iff_exists

name: eq'
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem eq' {a₁ b₁} {a₂ b₂ : S} :
    f.mk' a₁ a₂ = f.mk' b₁ b₂ ↔ Localization.r S (a₁, a₂) (b₁, b₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.eq, Localization.r_iff_exists]

name: eq_iff_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eq_iff_eq (g : LocalizationMap S P) {x y} : f x = f y ↔ g x = g y
proof:
:=
  f.eq_iff_exists.trans g.eq_iff_exists.symm

name: mk'_eq_iff_mk'_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_iff_mk'_eq (g : LocalizationMap S P) {x₁ x₂} {y₁ y₂ : S} :
    f.mk' x₁ y₁ = f.mk' x₂ y₂ ↔ g.mk' x₁ y₁ = g.mk' x₂ y₂
proof:
:=
  f.eq'.trans g.eq'.symm

name: exists_of_sec_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive
/
and `y₁ ∈ S`, if `x₂ : M, y₂ ∈ S` are such that `(f x₁ - f y₁) + f y₂ = f x₂`, then there exists
`c ∈ S` such that `x₁ + y₂ + c = x₂ + y₁ + c`. -/]
theorem exists_of_sec_mk' (x) (y : S) :
    ∃ c : S, ↑c * (↑(f.sec <| f.mk' x y).2 * x) = c * (y * (f.sec <| f.mk' x y).1)
proof:
:=
  f.eq_iff_exists.1 <| f.mk'_eq_iff_eq.1 <| (mk'_sec _ _).symm

name: mk'_eq_of_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_of_eq {a₁ b₁ : M} {a₂ b₂ : S} (H : ↑a₂ * b₁ = ↑b₂ * a₁) :
    f.mk' a₁ a₂ = f.mk' b₁ b₂
proof:
:=
  f.mk'_eq_iff_eq.2 <| H ▸ rfl

name: mk'_eq_of_eq'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_of_eq' {a₁ b₁ : M} {a₂ b₂ : S} (H : b₁ * ↑a₂ = a₁ * ↑b₂) :
    f.mk' a₁ a₂ = f.mk' b₁ b₂
proof:
:=
  f.mk'_eq_of_eq <| by simpa only [mul_comm] using H

name: mk'_cancel
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_cancel (a : M) (b c : S) :
    f.mk' (a * c) (b * c) = f.mk' a b
proof:
:=
  mk'_eq_of_eq' f (by rw [Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_comm (b : M), mul_assoc])

name: mk'_eq_of_same
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_eq_of_same {a b} {d : S} :
    f.mk' a d = f.mk' b d ↔ ∃ c : S, c * a = c * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk'_eq_iff_eq', map_mul, map_mul, ← eq_iff_exists f]
  exact (map_units f d).mul_left_inj

name: mk'_self'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mk'_self' (y : S) : f.mk' (y : M) y = 1
proof:
:=
  show _ * _ = _ by rw [mul_inv_left, mul_one]; dsimp

name: mk'_self
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mk'_self (x) (H : x ∈ S) : f.mk' x ⟨x, H⟩ = 1
proof: := mk'_self' f ⟨x, H⟩

name: mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul (x₁ x₂) (y : S) : f x₁ * f.mk' x₂ y = f.mk' (x₁ * x₂) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk'_one, ← mk'_mul, one_mul]

name: mk'_mul_eq_mk'_of_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_mul_eq_mk'_of_mul (x₁ x₂) (y : S) : f.mk' x₂ y * f x₁ = f.mk' (x₁ * x₂) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul]

name: mul_mk'_one_eq_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mul_mk'_one_eq_mk' (x) (y : S) : f x * f.mk' 1 y = f.mk' x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul, mul_one]

name: mk'_mul_cancel_right
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem mk'_mul_cancel_right (x : M) (y : S) : f.mk' (x * y) y = f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_mk'_one_eq_mk', map_mul, mul_assoc, mul_mk'_one_eq_mk', mk'_self', mul_one]

name: mk'_mul_cancel_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk'_mul_cancel_left (x) (y : S) : f.mk' ((y : M) * x) y = f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, mk'_mul_cancel_right]

name: isUnit_comp
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isUnit_comp (j : N →* P) (y : S) : IsUnit (j.comp f.toMonoidHom y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Units.map j <| IsUnit.liftRight (f.toMonoidHom.domRestrict S) f.map_units y, show j _ = j _ from
      congr_arg j (IsUnit.coe_liftRight (f.toMonoidHom.domRestrict S) f.map_units _)⟩

name: epic_of_localizationMap
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  obtain ⟨⟨m, s⟩, hn : n * f s = f m⟩ := f.surj n
  replace h (a) : j (f a) = k (f a) := congr($h a)
  exact ((f.map_units s).map j).mul_left_inj.mp <| by rw [← j.map_mul, h, ← k.map_mul, hn, h m]

name: mk_one_eq_monoidOf_mk
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_one_eq_monoidOf_mk (x) : mk x 1 = monoidOf S x
proof: := rfl

name: mk_eq_monoidOf_mk'_apply
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_eq_monoidOf_mk'_apply (x y) : mk x y = (monoidOf S).mk' x y
proof:
:=
  show _ = _ * _ from
    (Submonoid.LocalizationMap.mul_inv_right (monoidOf S).map_units _ _ _).2 <| by
      dsimp
      rw [← mk_one_eq_monoidOf_mk, ← mk_one_eq_monoidOf_mk, mk_mul x y y 1, mul_comm y 1]
      conv => rhs; rw [← mul_one 1]; rw [← mul_one x]
      exact mk_eq_mk_iff.2 (Con.symm _ <| (Localization.r S).mul (Con.refl _ (x, 1)) <| one_rel _)

name: mk_eq_monoidOf_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_eq_monoidOf_mk' : mk = (monoidOf S).mk'
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ ↦ funext fun _ ↦ mk_eq_monoidOf_mk'_apply _ _

name: liftOn_mk'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem liftOn_mk' {p : Sort u} (f : M → S → p) (H) (a : M) (b : S) :
    liftOn ((monoidOf S).mk' a b) f H = f a b
proof: := by rw [← mk_eq_monoidOf_mk', liftOn_mk]

name: liftOn
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem liftOn₂_mk' {p : Sort*} (f : M → S → M → S → p) (H) (a c : M) (b d : S) :
    liftOn₂ ((monoidOf S).mk' a b) ((monoidOf S).mk' c d) f H = f a b c d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_monoidOf_mk', liftOn₂_mk]

name: mk_left_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_left_injective (b : s) : Injective fun a => mk a b
proof:
:= fun c d h => by
  simpa [mk_eq_mk_iff, r_iff_exists] using h

name: mk_eq_mk_iff'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff' : mk a₁ a₂ = mk b₁ b₂ ↔ ↑b₂ * a₁ = a₂ * b₁
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mk_eq_mk_iff, r_iff_exists, mul_left_cancel_iff, exists_const]

name: Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_iff_bijective
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_iff_bijective {S : Submonoid G}
    [FunLike F G M] [MulHomClass F G M] {f : F} :
    S.IsLocalizationMap f ↔ Bijective f where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨fun g g' eq ↦ ?_, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
    · have ⟨c, eq⟩ := h.exists_of_eq eq
      exact mul_left_cancel eq
    · have ⟨x, eq⟩ := h.surj m
      use x.1 / x.2
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, map_mul, ← eq, mul_assoc, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, h.map_one, mul_one]
  mpr h := let e : G ≃* M := ⟨Equiv.ofBijective f h, map_mul f⟩
  { map_units _ := (Group.isUnit _).map e
    surj m := have ⟨g, eq⟩ := h.2 m
      ⟨⟨g, 1⟩, congr(m * $e.map_one).trans <| (mul_one _).trans eq.symm⟩
    exists_of_eq eq := by simp [h.1 eq] }

name: Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_id
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_id (S : Submonoid G) :
    S.IsLocalizationMap (@id G)
proof:
:=
  S.isLocalizationMap_iff_bijective (f := MulHom.id _).mpr bijective_id

name: Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_of_group
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_of_group {S : Submonoid M}
    {f : M → G} (hf : f.Injective) (surj : ∀ g : G, ∃ x : M, ∃ y ∈ S, g = f x / f y) :
    S.IsLocalizationMap f where
  map_units _
proof:
:= Group.isUnit _
  surj g := have ⟨x, y, hy, eq⟩ := surj g; ⟨⟨x, y, hy⟩, by simp [eq]⟩
  exists_of_eq eq := by simp [hf eq]

name: AddSubmonoid.isLocalizationMap_nat_int
statement:
theorem AddSubmonoid.isLocalizationMap_nat_int (S : AddSubmonoid ℕ) (hS : S ≠ ⊥) :
    S.IsLocalizationMap ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ)
proof:
:=
  S.isLocalizationMap_of_addGroup (fun _ _ ↦ Int.natCast_inj.mp) fun z ↦ by
    obtain ⟨z, rfl | rfl⟩ := z.eq_nat_or_neg
    · exact ⟨z, 0, zero_mem _, by lia⟩
    have ⟨n, hnS, hn0⟩ := S.bot_or_exists_ne_zero.resolve_left hS
    have key : z < n * (z / n + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ _ <| Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
    exact ⟨(z / n + 1) * n - z, (z / n + 1) * n, nsmul_mem hnS _, by lia⟩

name: AddSubmonoid.isLocalizationMap_top_nat_int
statement:
theorem AddSubmonoid.isLocalizationMap_top_nat_int :
    (⊤ : AddSubmonoid ℕ).IsLocalizationMap ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ)
proof:
:=
  AddSubmonoid.isLocalizationMap_nat_int _ top_ne_bot

name: injective_iff
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem injective_iff (f : LocalizationMap S N) :
    Injective f ↔ ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ S → IsRegular x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _), IsLeftRegular,
    Injective, LocalizationMap.eq_iff_exists, exists_imp, Subtype.forall]
  exact forall₂_comm

name: top_injective_iff
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem top_injective_iff (f : (⊤ : Submonoid M).LocalizationMap N) :
    Injective f ↔ IsCancelMul M
proof:
:= by
  simp [injective_iff, isCancelMul_iff_forall_isRegular]

name: map_isRegular
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem map_isRegular (f : LocalizationMap S N) {m : M}
    (hm : IsRegular m) : IsRegular (f m)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr fun n₁ n₂ eq ↦ ?_
  have ⟨ms₁, eq₁⟩ := f.surj n₁
  have ⟨ms₂, eq₂⟩ := f.surj n₂
  rw [← (f.map_units (ms₁.2 * ms₂.2)).mul_left_inj, Submonoid.coe_mul]
  replace eq := congr($eq * f (ms₁.2 * ms₂.2))
  simp_rw [mul_assoc] at eq
  rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc n₁, eq₁, ← mul_assoc n₂, mul_right_comm n₂, eq₂] at eq ⊢
  simp_rw [← map_mul, eq_iff_exists] at eq ⊢
  simp_rw [mul_left_comm _ m] at eq
  exact eq.imp fun _ ↦ (hm.1 ·)

name: isCancelMul
statement: @[to_additive] theorem isCancelMul (f : LocalizationMap S N) [IsCancelMul M] : IsCancelMul N
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isCancelMul_iff_forall_isRegular, Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _),
    ← Commute.isRightRegular_iff (Commute.all _)]
  intro n
  have ⟨ms, eq⟩ := f.surj n
  exact (eq ▸ f.map_isRegular (isCancelMul_iff_forall_isRegular.mp ‹_› ms.1)).2.of_mul

name: subsingleton_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[to_additive] theorem subsingleton_of_subsingleton (f : LocalizationMap S N) [Subsingleton M] :
    Subsingleton N where
  allEq x y
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨mx, sx, rfl⟩ := f.mk'_surjective x
    obtain ⟨my, sy, rfl⟩ := f.mk'_surjective y
    exact congr(f.mk' $(Subsingleton.elim ..) $(Subsingleton.elim ..))

statement:
@[to_additive
/
another additive group extends in a unique way to a homomorphism from `G`.

Note that since `IsFreeAddGroup.lift` is expressed as a bijection, it already
expresses the universal property. -/]
theorem unique_lift (f : Generators G → H) : ∃! F : G →* H, ∀ a, F (of a) = f a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [funext_iff] using! lift.symm.bijective.existsUnique f

name: ofLift

/
a given type, then it is free. Here, the universal property is expressed as in `IsFreeAddGroup.lift`
and its properties. -/]
lemma ofLift {G : Type u} [Group G] (X : Type u) (of : X → G)
    (lift : ∀ {H : Type u} [Group H], (X → H) ≃ (G →* H))
    (lift_of : ∀ {H : Type u} [Group H], ∀ (f : X → H) (a), lift f (of a) = f a) :
    IsFreeGroup G
proof:
:=
  (FreeGroupBasis.ofLift X of lift lift_of).isFreeGroup

name: ofUniqueLift

@[to_additive
/
a given type, then it is free. Here the universal property is expressed as in
`IsFreeAddGroup.unique_lift`. -/]
lemma ofUniqueLift {G : Type u} [Group G] (X : Type u) (of : X → G)
    (h : ∀ {H : Type u} [Group H] (f : X → H), ∃! F : G →* H, ∀ a, F (of a) = f a) :
    IsFreeGroup G
proof:
:=
  (FreeGroupBasis.ofUniqueLift X of h).isFreeGroup

statement:
@[to_additive /
def Red : List (α × Bool) → List (α × Bool) → Prop :=

@[to_additive (attr := refl)]
theorem Red.refl : Red L L
proof:

name: Step.length
statement:
@[to_additive /
there are words `w₃ w₄` and letter `x` such that `w₁ = w₃ + x + (-x) + w₄` and `w₂ = w₃w₄` -/]
theorem Step.length : ∀ {L₁ L₂ : List (α × Bool)}, Step L₁ L₂ → L₂.length + 2 = L₁.length
  | _, _, @Red.Step.not _ L1 L2 x b => by rw [List.length_append, List.length_append]; rfl

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]

name: Step.not_rev
statement:

theorem Step.not_rev {x b} : Step (L₁ ++ (x, !b) :: (x, b) :: L₂) (L₁ ++ L₂)

  cases b <;> exact Step.not

theorem Step.cons_not {x b} : Red.Step ((x, b) :: (x, !b) :: L) L

name: Step.cons_not_rev

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem Step.cons_not_rev {x b} : Red.Step ((x, !b) :: (x, b) :: L) L
proof:

name: Step.append_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.append_left : ∀ {L₁ L₂ L₃ : List (α × Bool)}, Step L₂ L₃ → Step (L₁ ++ L₂) (L₁ ++ L₃)
  | _, _, _, Red.Step.not => by rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.append_assoc]; constructor

@[to_additive]

name: Step.cons
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.cons {x} (H : Red.Step L₁ L₂) : Red.Step (x :: L₁) (x :: L₂)
proof:
:=
  @Step.append_left _ [x] _ _ H

name: Step.append_right
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.append_right : ∀ {L₁ L₂ L₃ : List (α × Bool)}, Step L₁ L₂ → Step (L₁ ++ L₃) (L₂ ++ L₃)
  | _, _, _, Red.Step.not => by simp

@[to_additive]

name: not_step_nil
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem not_step_nil : ¬Step [] L
proof:
:= by
  generalize h' : [] = L'
  intro h
  rcases h with - | ⟨L₁, L₂⟩
  simp at h'

name: Step.cons_left_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.cons_left_iff {a : α} {b : Bool} :
    Step ((a, b) :: L₁) L₂ ↔ (∃ L, Step L₁ L ∧ L₂ = (a, b) :: L) ∨ L₁ = (a, ! b) :: L₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · generalize hL : ((a, b) :: L₁ : List _) = L
    rintro @⟨_ | ⟨p, s'⟩, e, a', b'⟩ <;> simp_all
  · rintro (⟨L, h, rfl⟩ | rfl)
    · exact Step.cons h
    · exact Step.cons_not

name: not_step_singleton
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem not_step_singleton : ∀ {p : α × Bool}, ¬Step [p] L
  | (a, b) => by simp [Step.cons_left_iff, not_step_nil]

@[to_additive]

name: Step.cons_cons_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.cons_cons_iff : ∀ {p : α × Bool}, Step (p :: L₁) (p :: L₂) ↔ Step L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual [Step.cons_left_iff, iff_def, or_imp]

name: Step.append_left_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.append_left_iff : ∀ L, Step (L ++ L₁) (L ++ L₂) ↔ Step L₁ L₂
  | [] => by simp
  | p :: l => by simp [Step.append_left_iff l, Step.cons_cons_iff]

@[to_additive]

name: Step.diamond_aux
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.diamond_aux :
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ L₃ L₄ : List (α × Bool)} {x1 b1 x2 b2},
      L₁ ++ (x1, b1) :: (x1, !b1) :: L₂ = L₃ ++ (x2, b2) :: (x2, !b2) :: L₄ →
        L₁ ++ L₂ = L₃ ++ L₄ ∨ ∃ L₅, Red.Step (L₁ ++ L₂) L₅ ∧ Red.Step (L₃ ++ L₄) L₅
  | [], _, [], _, _, _, _, _, H => by injections; subst_vars; simp
  | [], _, [(x3, b3)], _, _, _, _, _, H => by injections; subst_vars; simp
  | [(x3, b3)], _, [], _, _, _, _, _, H => by injections; subst_vars; simp
  | [], _, (x3, b3) :: (x4, b4) :: tl, _, _, _, _, _, H => by
    injections; subst_vars; right; exact ⟨_, Red.Step.not, Red.Step.cons_not⟩
  | (x3, b3) :: (x4, b4) :: tl, _, [], _, _, _, _, _, H => by
    injections; subst_vars; right; simpa using ⟨_, Red.Step.cons_not, Red.Step.not⟩
  | (x3, b3) :: tl, _, (x4, b4) :: tl2, _, _, _, _, _, H =>
    let ⟨H1, H2⟩
proof:
:= List.cons.inj H
    match Step.diamond_aux H2 with
    | Or.inl H3 => Or.inl <| by simp [H1, H3]
    | Or.inr ⟨L₅, H3, H4⟩ => Or.inr ⟨_, Step.cons H3, by simpa [H1] using Step.cons H4⟩

name: Step.diamond
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.diamond :
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ L₃ L₄ : List (α × Bool)},
      Red.Step L₁ L₃ → Red.Step L₂ L₄ → L₁ = L₂ → L₃ = L₄ ∨ ∃ L₅, Red.Step L₃ L₅ ∧ Red.Step L₄ L₅
  | _, _, _, _, Red.Step.not, Red.Step.not, H => Step.diamond_aux H

@[to_additive]

name: Step.to_red
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Step.to_red : Step L₁ L₂ → Red L₁ L₂
proof:
:=
  ReflTransGen.single

name: church_rosser
statement:
@[to_additive
  /
  to `w2` and `w3` respectively, then there is a word `w4` such that `w2` and `w3` reduce to `w4`
  respectively. This is also known as Newman's diamond lemma. -/]
theorem church_rosser : Red L₁ L₂ → Red L₁ L₃ → Join Red L₂ L₃
proof:
:=
  Relation.church_rosser fun _ b c hab hac =>
    match b, c, Red.Step.diamond hab hac rfl with
    | b, _, Or.inl rfl => ⟨b, by rfl, by rfl⟩
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨d, hbd, hcd⟩ => ⟨d, ReflGen.single hbd, hcd.to_red⟩

name: cons_cons
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem cons_cons {p} : Red L₁ L₂ → Red (p :: L₁) (p :: L₂)
proof:
:=
  ReflTransGen.lift (List.cons p) (fun _ _ => Step.cons) L₁ L₂

name: cons_cons_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem cons_cons_iff (p) : Red (p :: L₁) (p :: L₂) ↔ Red L₁ L₂
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (by
      generalize eq₁ : (p :: L₁ : List _) = LL₁
      generalize eq₂ : (p :: L₂ : List _) = LL₂
      intro h
      induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on generalizing L₁ L₂ with
      | refl =>
        subst_vars
        cases eq₂
        constructor
      | head h₁₂ h ih =>
        subst_vars
        obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
        rw [Step.cons_left_iff] at h₁₂
        rcases h₁₂ with (⟨L, h₁₂, rfl⟩ | rfl)
        · exact (ih rfl rfl).head h₁₂
        · exact (cons_cons h).tail Step.cons_not_rev)
    cons_cons

name: append_append_left_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem append_append_left_iff : ∀ L, Red (L ++ L₁) (L ++ L₂) ↔ Red L₁ L₂
  | [] => Iff.rfl
  | p :: L => by simp [append_append_left_iff L, cons_cons_iff]

@[to_additive]

name: append_append
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem append_append (h₁ : Red L₁ L₃) (h₂ : Red L₂ L₄) : Red (L₁ ++ L₂) (L₃ ++ L₄)
proof:
:=
  (h₁.lift (fun L => L ++ L₂) fun _ _ => Step.append_right).trans ((append_append_left_iff _).2 h₂)

name: to_append_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem to_append_iff : Red L (L₁ ++ L₂) ↔ ∃ L₃ L₄, L = L₃ ++ L₄ ∧ Red L₃ L₁ ∧ Red L₄ L₂
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (by
      generalize eq : L₁ ++ L₂ = L₁₂
      intro h
      induction h generalizing L₁ L₂ with
      | refl => exact ⟨_, _, eq.symm, by rfl, by rfl⟩
      | tail hLL' h ih =>
        obtain @⟨s, e, a, b⟩ := h
        rcases List.append_eq_append_iff.1 eq with (⟨s', rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨e', rfl, rfl⟩)
        · have : L₁ ++ (s' ++ (a, b) :: (a, not b) :: e) =
            L₁ ++ s' ++ (a, b) :: (a, not b) :: e := by simp
          rcases ih this with ⟨w₁, w₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩
          exact ⟨w₁, w₂, rfl, h₁, h₂.tail Step.not⟩
        · have : s ++ (a, b) :: (a, not b) :: e' ++ L₂ =
            s ++ (a, b) :: (a, not b) :: (e' ++ L₂) := by simp
          rcases ih this with ⟨w₁, w₂, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩
          exact ⟨w₁, w₂, rfl, h₁.tail Step.not, h₂⟩)
    fun ⟨_, _, Eq, h₃, h₄⟩ => Eq.symm ▸ append_append h₃ h₄

name: nil_iff
statement: theorem nil_iff : Red [] L ↔ L = []
proof:
:=
  reflTransGen_iff_eq fun _ => Red.not_step_nil

name: singleton_iff
statement: theorem singleton_iff {x} : Red [x] L₁ ↔ L₁ = [x]
proof:
:=
  reflTransGen_iff_eq fun _ => not_step_singleton

name: cons_nil_iff_singleton
statement:
@[to_additive
  /
  reduces to `-x`. -/]
theorem cons_nil_iff_singleton {x b} : Red ((x, b) :: L) [] ↔ Red L [(x, not b)]
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h => by
      have h₁ : Red ((x, not b) :: (x, b) :: L) [(x, not b)] := cons_cons h
      have h₂ : Red ((x, not b) :: (x, b) :: L) L := ReflTransGen.single Step.cons_not_rev
      let ⟨L', h₁, h₂⟩ := church_rosser h₁ h₂
      rw [singleton_iff] at h₁
      subst L'
      assumption)
    fun h => (cons_cons h).tail Step.cons_not

name: red_iff_irreducible
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem red_iff_irreducible {x1 b1 x2 b2} (h : (x1, b1) ≠ (x2, b2)) :
    Red [(x1, !b1), (x2, b2)] L ↔ L = [(x1, !b1), (x2, b2)]
proof:
:= by
  apply reflTransGen_iff_eq
  generalize eq : [(x1, not b1), (x2, b2)] = L'
  intro L h'
  cases h'
  simp only [List.cons_eq_append_iff, List.cons.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, and_false,
    List.nil_eq_append_iff, exists_const, or_self, or_false, List.cons_ne_nil] at eq
  rcases eq with ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  simp at h

name: inv_of_red_of_ne
statement:
@[to_additive /
reduces to `y + w₂`, then `w₁` reduces to `-x + y + w₂`. -/]
theorem inv_of_red_of_ne {x1 b1 x2 b2} (H1 : (x1, b1) ≠ (x2, b2))
    (H2 : Red ((x1, b1) :: L₁) ((x2, b2) :: L₂)) : Red L₁ ((x1, not b1) :: (x2, b2) :: L₂)
proof:
:= by
  have : Red ((x1, b1) :: L₁) ([(x2, b2)] ++ L₂) := H2
  rcases to_append_iff.1 this with ⟨_ | ⟨p, L₃⟩, L₄, eq, h₁, h₂⟩
  · simp [nil_iff] at h₁
  · cases eq
    change Red (L₃ ++ L₄) ([(x1, not b1), (x2, b2)] ++ L₂)
    apply append_append _ h₂
    have h₁ : Red ((x1, not b1) :: (x1, b1) :: L₃) [(x1, not b1), (x2, b2)] := cons_cons h₁
    have h₂ : Red ((x1, not b1) :: (x1, b1) :: L₃) L₃ := Step.cons_not_rev.to_red
    rcases church_rosser h₁ h₂ with ⟨L', h₁, h₂⟩
    rw [red_iff_irreducible H1] at h₁
    rwa [h₁] at h₂

name: length_le
statement:
@[to_additive
/

name: sizeof_of_step
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := deprecated "Should not be needed." (since := "2026-04-10"))]
theorem sizeof_of_step : ∀ {L₁ L₂ : List (α × Bool)},
    Step L₁ L₂ → sizeOf L₂ < sizeOf L₁
  | _, _, @Step.not _ L1 L2 x b => by
    induction L1 with
    | nil =>
      rw [nil_append, nil_append, cons.sizeOf_spec, cons.sizeOf_spec]
      lia
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      dsimp
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_left ih _

@[to_additive]

name: length
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem length (h : Red L₁ L₂) : ∃ n, L₁.length = L₂.length + 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | tail _h₁₂ h₂₃ ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨n, eq⟩
    exists 1 + n
    simp [Nat.mul_add, eq, (Step.length h₂₃).symm, add_assoc]

name: antisymm
statement:

name: equivalence_join_red
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem equivalence_join_red : Equivalence (Join (@Red α))
proof:
:=
  equivalence_join_reflTransGen fun _ b c hab hac =>
    match b, c, Red.Step.diamond hab hac rfl with
    | b, _, Or.inl rfl => ⟨b, by rfl, by rfl⟩
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨d, hbd, hcd⟩ => ⟨d, ReflGen.single hbd, ReflTransGen.single hcd⟩

name: join_red_of_step

theorem join_red_of_step (h : Red.Step L₁ L₂) : Join Red L₁ L₂

  exact le_join_of_refl L₁ L₂ h.to_red

name: eqvGen_step_iff_join_red
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eqvGen_step_iff_join_red : EqvGen Red.Step L₁ L₂ ↔ Join Red L₁ L₂
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      have : EqvGen (Join Red) L₁ L₂ := h.mono fun _ _ => join_red_of_step
      equivalence_join_red.eqvGen_iff.1 this)
    (join_le_of_equivalence_of_le (Relation.EqvGen.is_equivalence _)
      (reflTransGen_le_of_equivalence_of_le (Relation.EqvGen.is_equivalence _) EqvGen.rel) L₁ L₂)

name: IsReduced.nil
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem IsReduced.nil : IsReduced ([] : List (α × Bool))
proof: := isChain_nil

name: IsReduced.singleton
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem IsReduced.singleton {a : α × Bool} : IsReduced [a]
proof: := isChain_singleton a

name: isReduced_cons_cons
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem isReduced_cons_cons {a b : (α × Bool)} :
    IsReduced (a :: b :: L) ↔ (a.1 = b.1 → a.2 = b.2) ∧ IsReduced (b :: L)
proof: := isChain_cons_cons

name: IsReduced.not_step
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsReduced.not_step (h : IsReduced L₁) : ¬ Red.Step L₁ L₂
proof:
:= fun step ↦ by
  induction step
  simp [IsReduced] at h

name: IsReduced.of_forall_not_step
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsReduced.of_forall_not_step :
    ∀ {L₁ : List (α × Bool)}, (∀ L₂, ¬ Red.Step L₁ L₂) → IsReduced L₁
  | [], _ => .nil
  | [a], _ => .singleton
  | (a₁, b₁) :: (a₂, b₂) :: L₁, hL₁ => by
    rw [isReduced_cons_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, .of_forall_not_step fun L₂ step ↦ hL₁ _ step.cons⟩
    rintro rfl
    symm
    rw [← Bool.ne_not]
    rintro rfl
    exact hL₁ L₁ <| .not (L₁ := [])

@[to_additive]

name: isReduced_iff_not_step
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isReduced_iff_not_step : IsReduced L₁ ↔ ∀ L₂, ¬ Red.Step L₁ L₂ where
  mp h _
proof:
:= h.not_step
  mpr := .of_forall_not_step

name: induction_on
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator)]
protected lemma induction_on {motive : FreeGroup α → Prop} (z : FreeGroup α) (one : motive 1)
    (of : ∀ x, motive <| of x) (inv_of : ∀ x, motive (.of x) → motive (.of x)⁻¹)
    (mul : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x * y)) : motive z
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn z fun L ↦ L.recOn one fun ⟨x, b⟩ _tl ih ↦
    b.recOn (mul _ _ (inv_of _ <| of x) ih) (mul _ _ (of x) ih)

name: ext_hom
statement:
lemma ext_hom {M : Type*} [Monoid M] (f g : FreeGroup α →* M) (h : ∀ a, f (of a) = g (of a)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have this (x) : f (of x)⁻¹ = g (of x)⁻¹ := by
    trans f (of x)⁻¹ * f (of x) * g (of x)⁻¹
    · simp_rw [mul_assoc, h, ← _root_.map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, _root_.map_one, mul_one]
    · simp_rw [← _root_.map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, _root_.map_one, one_mul]
  induction x <;> simp [*]

name: Red.exact

    _ ↔ Join Red L₁ L₂ := eqvGen_step_iff_join_red

name: range_lift_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem range_lift_le {s : Subgroup β} (H : Set.range f ⊆ s) : (lift f).range ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨⟨L⟩, rfl⟩
  exact List.recOn L s.one_mem fun ⟨x, b⟩ tl ih ↦
    Bool.recOn b (by simpa using s.mul_mem (s.inv_mem <| H ⟨x, rfl⟩) ih)
      (by simpa using s.mul_mem (H ⟨x, rfl⟩) ih)

name: range_lift_eq_closure
statement:

theorem range_lift_eq_closure : (lift f).range = Subgroup.closure (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (range_lift_le Subgroup.subset_closure)
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨FreeGroup.of a, by simp only [lift_apply_of]⟩

name: closure_range_of
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /
is, the additive subgroup closure of the set of generators equals `⊤`. -/]
theorem closure_range_of (α) :
    Subgroup.closure (Set.range (FreeGroup.of : α → FreeGroup α)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_lift_eq_closure, lift_of_eq_id]
  exact MonoidHom.range_eq_top.2 Function.surjective_id

name: map.id

name: map.id'
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map.id' (x : FreeGroup α) : map (fun z => z) x = x
proof:
:=
  map.id x

name: map.comp
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map.comp {γ : Type w} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (x) :
    map g (map f x) = map (g ∘ f) x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨L⟩; simp [Function.comp_def]

name: map.of
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map.of {x} : map f (of x) = of (f x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map.unique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map.unique (g : FreeGroup α →* FreeGroup β)
    (hg : ∀ x, g (FreeGroup.of x) = FreeGroup.of (f x)) :
    ∀ {x}, g x = map f x
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨L⟩
  exact List.recOn L g.map_one fun ⟨x, b⟩ t (ih : g (FreeGroup.mk t) = map f (FreeGroup.mk t)) =>
    Bool.recOn b
      (show g ((FreeGroup.of x)⁻¹ * FreeGroup.mk t) =
          FreeGroup.map f ((FreeGroup.of x)⁻¹ * FreeGroup.mk t) by
        simp [g.map_mul, g.map_inv, hg, ih])
      (show g (FreeGroup.of x * FreeGroup.mk t) =
          FreeGroup.map f (FreeGroup.of x * FreeGroup.mk t) by simp [g.map_mul, hg, ih])

name: map_eq_lift
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_eq_lift : map f = lift (of ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp

name: range_map
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem range_map : (map f).range = Subgroup.closure (of '' Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_eq_lift, range_lift_eq_closure, Set.range_comp]

name: map_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive /
then the induced map on their additive free groups is also surjective. -/]
theorem map_surjective (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Function.Surjective (map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidHom.range_eq_top, range_map, hf.range_eq, Set.image_univ, closure_range_of]

name: map_injective
statement:
@[to_additive /
then the induced map on their additive free groups is also injective. -/]
theorem map_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective (map f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : IsEmpty α
  · exact Function.injective_of_subsingleton _
  · rw [Function.injective_iff_hasLeftInverse]
    use map (Function.invFun f)
    simp [Function.LeftInverse, map.comp, Function.invFun_comp hf]

name: map_bijective
statement:
@[to_additive /
then the induced map on their additive free groups is also bijective. -/]
theorem map_bijective (hf : Function.Bijective f) : Function.Bijective (map f)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨map_injective hf.injective, map_surjective hf.surjective⟩

name: freeGroupCongr_refl
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem freeGroupCongr_refl : freeGroupCongr (Equiv.refl α) = MulEquiv.refl _
proof:
:=

name: freeGroupCongr_symm
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem freeGroupCongr_symm {α β} (e : α ≃ β) : (freeGroupCongr e).symm = freeGroupCongr e.symm
proof:

name: freeGroupCongr_trans
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem freeGroupCongr_trans {α β γ} (e : α ≃ β) (f : β ≃ γ) :
    (freeGroupCongr e).trans (freeGroupCongr f) = freeGroupCongr (e.trans f)
proof:
:=
  MulEquiv.ext <| map.comp _ _

name: prod_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_mk : prod (mk L) = List.prod (L.map fun x => cond x.2 x.1 x.1⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: prod.of
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod.of {x : α} : prod (of x) = x
proof:
:=

name: prod.unique
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod.unique (g : FreeGroup α →* α) (hg : ∀ x, g (FreeGroup.of x) = x) {x} : g x = prod x
proof:

name: prod_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_surjective : Function.Surjective (prod : FreeGroup α →* α)
proof:
:=

name: lift_eq_prod_map
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem lift_eq_prod_map {β : Type v} [Group β] {f : α → β} {x} : lift f x = prod (map f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_unique (prod.comp (map f)) (by simp), MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]

name: sum_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_mk : sum (mk L) = List.sum (L.map fun x => cond x.2 x.1 (-x.1))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: sum.of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum.of {x : α} : sum (of x) = x
proof:
:=
  @prod.of _ (_) _

name: sum.map_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum.map_mul : sum (x * y) = sum x + sum y
proof:
:=
  (@prod (Multiplicative _) _).map_mul _ _

name: sum.map_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum.map_one : sum (1 : FreeGroup α) = 0
proof:
:=
  (@prod (Multiplicative _) _).map_one

name: sum.map_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum.map_inv : sum x⁻¹ = -sum x
proof:
:=
  (prod : FreeGroup (Multiplicative α) →* Multiplicative α).map_inv _

name: map_pure
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem map_pure (f : α → β) (x : α) : f <$> (pure x : FreeGroup α) = pure (f x)
proof:
:=
  map.of

name: map_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_one (f : α → β) : f <$> (1 : FreeGroup α) = 1
proof:

  (map f).map_one

theorem map_mul (f : α → β) (x y : FreeGroup α) : f <$> (x * y) = f <$> x * f <$> y

proof:

name: pure_bind

@[to_additive]
theorem pure_bind (f : α → FreeGroup β) (x) : pure x >>= f = f x
proof:
:=
  lift_apply_of

name: one_bind

name: inv_bind
