name: isCyclicallyReduced_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isCyclicallyReduced_iff :
    IsCyclicallyReduced L ↔
    IsReduced L ∧ ∀ a ∈ L.getLast?, ∀ b ∈ L.head?, a.1 = b.1 → a.2 = b.2
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isCyclicallyReduced_cons_append_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isCyclicallyReduced_cons_append_iff {a b : α × Bool} :
    IsCyclicallyReduced (b :: L ++ [a]) ↔
    IsReduced (b :: L ++ [a]) ∧ (a.1 = b.1 → a.2 = b.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCyclicallyReduced_iff, List.getLast?_concat]
  simp

name: nil
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
protected theorem nil : IsCyclicallyReduced ([] : List (α × Bool))
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsCyclicallyReduced]

name: singleton
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
protected theorem singleton {x : (α × Bool)} : IsCyclicallyReduced [x]
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsCyclicallyReduced]

name: isReduced
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isReduced (h : IsCyclicallyReduced L) : IsReduced L

name: flatten_replicate
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem flatten_replicate (h : IsCyclicallyReduced L) (n : ℕ) :
    IsCyclicallyReduced (List.replicate n L).flatten
proof:
:= by match n, L with
  | 0, _ => simp
  | n + 1, [] => simp
  | n + 1, (head :: tail) =>
    rw [isCyclicallyReduced_iff, IsReduced, List.isChain_flatten (by simp)]
    refine ⟨⟨by simpa [IsReduced] using h.isReduced, List.isChain_replicate_of_rel _ h.2⟩,
      fun _ ha _ hb ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Option.mem_def, List.getLast?_flatten_replicate (h := by simp +arith)] at ha
    rw [Option.mem_def, List.head?_flatten_replicate (h := by simp +arith)] at hb
    exact h.2 _ ha _ hb

name: IsReduced.append_flatten_replicate_append
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsReduced.append_flatten_replicate_append (h₁ : IsCyclicallyReduced L₂)
    (h₂ : IsReduced (L₁ ++ L₂ ++ L₃)) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
  IsReduced (L₁ ++ (List.replicate n L₂).flatten ++ L₃)
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  | 0 => contradiction
  | n + 1 =>
    if h : L₂ = [] then simp_all else
    have h' : (replicate (n + 1) L₂).flatten ≠ [] := by simp [h]
    refine IsReduced.append_overlap ?_ ?_ (hn := h')
    · rw [replicate_succ, flatten_cons, ← append_assoc]
      refine IsReduced.append_overlap (h₂.infix ⟨[], L₃, by simp⟩) ?_ h
      rw [← flatten_cons, ← replicate_succ]
      exact (h₁.flatten_replicate _).isReduced
    · rw [replicate_succ', flatten_concat]
      refine IsReduced.append_overlap ?_ (h₂.infix ⟨L₁, [], by simp⟩) h
      rw [← flatten_concat, ← replicate_succ']
      exact (h₁.flatten_replicate _).isReduced

name: nil
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
protected theorem nil : reduceCyclically ([] : List (α × Bool)) = []
proof: := by simp [reduceCyclically]

name: singleton
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
protected theorem singleton {a : α × Bool} : reduceCyclically [a] = [a]
proof:
:= by
  simp [reduceCyclically]

name: cons_append
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem cons_append {a b : α × Bool} (L : List (α × Bool)) :
    reduceCyclically (a :: (L ++ [b])) =
    if b.1 = a.1 ∧ (!b.2) = a.2 then reduceCyclically L else a :: L ++ [b]
proof:
:= by
  simp [reduceCyclically]

name: isCyclicallyReduced
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isCyclicallyReduced (h : IsReduced L) : IsCyclicallyReduced (reduceCyclically L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L using List.bidirectionalRec
  case nil => simp
  case singleton => simp
  case cons_append a l b ih =>
    rw [reduceCyclically.cons_append]
    split
    case isTrue => exact ih (h.infix ⟨[a], [b], rfl⟩)
    case isFalse h' =>
      rw [isCyclicallyReduced_cons_append_iff]
      exact ⟨h, by simpa using h'⟩

name: conjugator.nil
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
protected theorem conjugator.nil : conjugator ([] : List (α × Bool)) = []
proof: := by simp [conjugator]

name: conjugator.singleton
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
protected theorem conjugator.singleton {a : α × Bool} : conjugator [a] = []
proof: := by simp [conjugator]

name: conjugator.cons_append
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem conjugator.cons_append {a b : α × Bool} (L : List (α × Bool)) :
    conjugator (a :: (L ++ [b])) = if b.1 = a.1 ∧ (!b.2) = a.2 then a :: conjugator L else []
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjugator]

name: conj_conjugator_reduceCyclically
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem conj_conjugator_reduceCyclically (L : List (α × Bool)) :
    conjugator L ++ reduceCyclically L ++ invRev (conjugator L) = L
proof:
:= by
  induction L using List.bidirectionalRec
  case nil => simp
  case singleton => simp
  case cons_append a l b eq =>
    rw [reduceCyclically.cons_append, conjugator.cons_append]
    split
    case isTrue h =>
      nth_rw 4 [← eq]
      simp [invRev, h.1.symm, h.2.symm]
    case isFalse => simp

name: reduce_flatten_replicate_succ
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce_flatten_replicate_succ (h : IsReduced L) (n : ℕ) :
    reduce (List.replicate (n + 1) L).flatten = conjugator L ++
    (List.replicate (n + 1) (reduceCyclically L)).flatten ++ invRev (conjugator L)
proof:
:= by
  induction n
  case zero =>
    simpa [← append_assoc, conj_conjugator_reduceCyclically, ← isReduced_iff_reduce_eq]
  case succ n ih =>
    rw [replicate_succ, flatten_cons, ← reduce_append_reduce_reduce, ih, h.reduce_eq]
    nth_rewrite 1 [← conj_conjugator_reduceCyclically L]
    have {L₁ L₂ L₃ L₄ L₅ : List (α × Bool)} : reduce (L₁ ++ L₂ ++ invRev L₃ ++ (L₃ ++ L₄ ++ L₅)) =
        reduce (L₁ ++ (L₂ ++ L₄) ++ L₅) := by
      apply reduce.sound
      repeat rw [← mul_mk]
      rw [← inv_mk]
      group
    rw [this, ← flatten_cons, ← replicate_succ, ← isReduced_iff_reduce_eq]
    apply IsReduced.append_flatten_replicate_append (hn := by simp)
    · exact isCyclicallyReduced h
    · rwa [conj_conjugator_reduceCyclically]

name: reduce_flatten_replicate
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce_flatten_replicate (h : IsReduced L) (n : ℕ) :
    reduce (List.replicate n L).flatten = if n = 0 then [] else conjugator L ++
    (List.replicate n (reduceCyclically L)).flatten ++ invRev (conjugator L)
proof:
:=
  match n with
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => reduce_flatten_replicate_succ h n

name: startsWith.ne_one
statement:
theorem startsWith.ne_one {w : α × Bool} (g : FreeGroup α) (h : g ∈ FreeGroup.startsWith w) :
    g ≠ 1
proof: := fun h1 ↦ by simp [h1, startsWith, FreeGroup.toWord_one] at h

name: startsWith.disjoint_iff_ne
statement:
@[simp]
lemma startsWith.disjoint_iff_ne {w w' : α × Bool} :
    Disjoint (startsWith w) (startsWith w') ↔ w ≠ w'
proof:
:= by
  simp_all only [ne_eq, startsWith, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff,
    Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, Option.some.injEq]
  exact Iff.intro (fun h ↦ h (mk [w]) (by simp)) (by grind)

name: startsWith.Injective
statement: lemma startsWith.Injective : @startsWith α _ |>.Injective
proof:
:= fun a b h ↦ by
  simp only [startsWith, Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h
  simpa using h (mk [a])

name: startsWith_mk_mul
statement:
theorem startsWith_mk_mul {w : α × Bool} (g : FreeGroup α)
    (h : ¬ g ∈ startsWith (w.1, !w.2)) : mk [w] * g ∈ startsWith w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hC : 0 < g.toWord.length
  · simp only [startsWith, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, getElem?_pos, Option.some.injEq,
      Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq, not_and, Bool.not_eq_not, toWord_mul, toWord_mk, reduce.cons,
      reduce_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, reduce_toWord, hC] at *
    rw [show g.toWord = g.toWord.head (by grind) :: g.toWord.tail by grind]
    grind
  · simp_all [startsWith]

name: startsWith.smul_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma startsWith.smul_def {w : α × Bool} {g : startsWith w} {x : X} : g • x = g.val • x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Orbit.duplicate
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    set l := g.toWord with hl
    have h : (⟨g, hg⟩ : startsWith w) = ⟨mk g.toWord, by simp [g.mk_toWord, hg]⟩ := by
      simp [g.mk_toWord]
    match l with
    | [] => simp [← hl, startsWith] at hg
    | [a] =>
      simp_rw [h, ← hl, show a = w by simpa [← hl, startsWith] using hg, startsWith.smul_def,
        inv_smul_smul]
      exact Or.inr rfl
    | a :: b :: l =>
      have ha : a = w := by simpa [← hl, startsWith] using hg
      have h1 := isReduced_cons_cons.mp (hl ▸ isReduced_toWord)
      refine Or.inl (Set.mem_biUnion (x := b) (by grind) ?_)
      simp_rw [h, ← hl, ha, ← List.singleton_append (l := b :: l), ← mul_mk, startsWith.smul_def,
        mul_smul, inv_smul_smul]
      exact ⟨⟨mk (b :: l), by simp [startsWith, h1.2.reduce_eq]⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨-, ⟨w', rfl⟩, -, ⟨hw, rfl⟩, ⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩ | rfl)
    · exact ⟨mk [w] • g • x, ⟨⟨mk [w] * g, startsWith_mk_mul g
        ((startsWith.disjoint_iff_ne.mpr hw).notMem_of_mem_left hg)⟩,
        mul_smul (mk [w]) g x⟩, inv_smul_smul (mk [w]) (g • x)⟩
    · exact ⟨mk [w] • i, ⟨⟨mk [w], rfl⟩, rfl⟩, inv_smul_smul (mk [w]) i⟩

name: ext_functor
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext_functor {G} [Groupoid.{v} G] [IsFreeGroupoid G] {X : Type v} [Group X]
    (f g : G ⥤ CategoryTheory.SingleObj X) (h : ∀ (a b) (e : a ⟶ b), f.map (of e) = g.map (of e)) :
    f = g

name: treeHom_eq
statement: theorem treeHom_eq {a : G} (p : Path (root T) a) : treeHom T a = homOfPath T p
proof:
:= by
  rw [treeHom, Unique.default_eq]

name: treeHom_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem treeHom_root : treeHom T (root' T) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  
    _root_.trans
    (treeHom_eq T Path.nil) rfl

name: loopOfHom_eq_id
statement:
theorem loopOfHom_eq_id {a b : Generators G} (e) (H : e ∈ wideSubquiverSymmetrify T a b) :
    loopOfHom T (of e) = 𝟙 (root' T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopOfHom, ← Category.assoc, IsIso.comp_inv_eq, Category.id_comp]
  rcases H with H | H
  · rw [treeHom_eq T (Path.cons default ⟨Sum.inl e, H⟩), homOfPath]
    rfl
  · rw [treeHom_eq T (Path.cons default ⟨Sum.inr e, H⟩), homOfPath]
    simp only [IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc, treeHom]

name: endIsFree
statement: lemma endIsFree : IsFreeGroup (End (root' T))
proof:
:=
  IsFreeGroup.ofUniqueLift ((wideSubquiverEquivSetTotal <| wideSubquiverSymmetrify T)ᶜ : Set _)
    (fun e => loopOfHom T (of e.val.hom))
    (by
      intro X _ f
      let f' : Labelling (Generators G) X := fun a b e =>
        if h : e ∈ wideSubquiverSymmetrify T a b then 1 else f ⟨⟨a, b, e⟩, h⟩
      rcases unique_lift f' with ⟨F', hF', uF'⟩
      refine ⟨F'.mapEnd _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · suffices ∀ {x y} (q : x ⟶ y), F'.map (loopOfHom T q) = (F'.map q : X) by
          rintro ⟨⟨a, b, e⟩, h⟩
          simp only [Functor.mapEnd, DFunLike.coe, this, hF']
          exact dite_eq_right h
        intro x y q
        suffices ∀ {a} (p : Path (root T) a), F'.map (homOfPath T p) = 1 by
          simp only [this, treeHom, comp_as_mul, inv_as_inv, loopOfHom, inv_one, mul_one,
            one_mul, Functor.map_inv, Functor.map_comp]
        intro a p
        induction p with
        | nil => rw [homOfPath, F'.map_id, id_as_one]
        | cons p e ih =>
          rw [homOfPath, F'.map_comp, comp_as_mul, ih, mul_one]
          rcases e with ⟨e | e, eT⟩
          · rw [hF']
            exact dite_eq_left (Or.inl eT)
          · rw [F'.map_inv, inv_as_inv, inv_eq_one, hF']
            exact dite_eq_left (Or.inr eT)
      · intro E hE
        ext x
        suffices (functorOfMonoidHom T E).map x = F'.map x by
          simpa only [loopOfHom, functorOfMonoidHom, IsIso.inv_id, treeHom_root,
            Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using! this
        congr
        apply uF'
        intro a b e
        change E (loopOfHom T _) = dite _ _ _
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [loopOfHom_eq_id T e h, ← End.one_def, E.map_one]
        · exact hE ⟨⟨a, b, e⟩, h⟩)

name: path_nonempty_of_hom
statement:
theorem path_nonempty_of_hom {G} [Groupoid.{u, u} G] [IsFreeGroupoid G] {a b : G} :
    Nonempty (a ⟶ b) → Nonempty (Path (symgen a) (symgen b))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p⟩
  rw [← @WeaklyConnectedComponent.eq (Generators G), eq_comm, ← FreeGroup.of_injective.eq_iff, ←
    mul_inv_eq_one]
  let X := FreeGroup (WeaklyConnectedComponent <| Generators G)
  let f : G → X := fun g => FreeGroup.of (WeaklyConnectedComponent.mk g)
  let F : G ⥤ CategoryTheory.SingleObj.{u} (X : Type u) := SingleObj.differenceFunctor f
  change (F.map p) = ((@CategoryTheory.Functor.const G _ _ (SingleObj.category X)).obj ()).map p
  congr; ext
  rw [Functor.const_obj_map, id_as_one, differenceFunctor_map, @mul_inv_eq_one _ _ (f _)]
  apply congr_arg FreeGroup.of
  apply (WeaklyConnectedComponent.eq _ _).mpr
  exact ⟨Hom.toPath (Sum.inr (by assumption))⟩

name: reduce_nil
statement: @[to_additive (attr := simp)] lemma reduce_nil : reduce ([] : List (α × Bool)) = []
proof: := rfl

name: reduce_singleton
statement: @[to_additive] lemma reduce_singleton (s : α × Bool) : reduce [s] = [s]
proof: := rfl

name: reduce.cons
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem reduce.cons (x) :
    reduce (x :: L) =
      List.casesOn (reduce L) [x] fun hd tl =>
        if x.1 = hd.1 ∧ x.2 = not hd.2 then tl else x :: hd :: tl
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reduce_replicate
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem reduce_replicate (n : ℕ) (x : α × Bool) :
    reduce (.replicate n x) = .replicate n x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [reduce]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.replicate_succ, reduce.cons, ih]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n => simp [List.replicate_succ]

name: reduce.red
statement:
@[to_additive /
  maximal reduction. -/]
theorem reduce.red : Red L (reduce L)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => constructor
  | cons hd1 tl1 ih =>
    dsimp
    revert ih
    generalize htl : reduce tl1 = TL
    intro ih
    cases TL with
    | nil => exact Red.cons_cons ih
    | cons hd2 tl2 =>
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with h
      · cases hd1
        cases hd2
        cases h
        dsimp at *
        subst_vars
        apply Red.trans (Red.cons_cons ih)
        exact Red.Step.cons_not_rev.to_red
      · exact Red.cons_cons ih

name: reduce.not
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce.not {p : Prop} :
    ∀ {L₁ L₂ L₃ : List (α × Bool)} {x b}, reduce L₁ = L₂ ++ (x, b) :: (x, !b) :: L₃ → p
  | [], L2, L3, _, _ => fun h => by cases L2 <;> injections
  | (x, b) :: L1, L2, L3, x', b' => by
    dsimp
    cases r : reduce L1 with
    | nil =>
      dsimp; intro h
      exfalso
      have
proof:
:= congr_arg List.length h
      grind
    | cons hd tail =>
      obtain ⟨y, c⟩ := hd
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with h <;> intro H
      · rw [H] at r
        exact @reduce.not _ L1 ((y, c) :: L2) L3 x' b' r
      rcases L2 with (_ | ⟨a, L2⟩)
      · injections; subst_vars
        simp at h
      · refine @reduce.not _ L1 L2 L3 x' b' ?_
        rw [List.cons_append] at H
        injection H with _ H
        rw [r, H]

name: reduce.min
statement:
@[to_additive /
  reduction of a word only reduces to itself. -/]
theorem reduce.min (H : Red (reduce L₁) L₂) : reduce L₁ = L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction H with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ H1 H2 =>
    obtain ⟨L4, L5, x, b⟩ := H1
    exact reduce.not H2

name: reduce.idem
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /
  reduction of a word is the maximal reduction of the word. -/]
theorem reduce.idem : reduce (reduce L) = reduce L
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| reduce.min reduce.red

name: reduce.Step.eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce.Step.eq (H : Red.Step L₁ L₂) : reduce L₁ = reduce L₂

name: Red.reduce_right
statement:
@[to_additive /
theorem reduce.eq_of_red (H : Red L₁ L₂) : reduce L₁ = reduce L₂ :=
  let ⟨_L₃, HR13, HR23⟩ := Red.church_rosser reduce.red (Red.trans H reduce.red)
  (reduce.min HR13).trans (reduce.min HR23).symm

alias red.reduce_eq := reduce.eq_of_red

alias freeAddGroup.red.reduce_eq := FreeAddGroup.reduce.eq_of_red

@[to_additive]
theorem Red.reduce_right (h : Red L₁ L₂) : Red L₁ (reduce L₂)
proof:
:=
  reduce.eq_of_red h ▸ reduce.red

name: Red.reduce_left
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Red.reduce_left (h : Red L₁ L₂) : Red L₂ (reduce L₁)
proof:
:=
  (reduce.eq_of_red h).symm ▸ reduce.red

name: reduce.sound
statement:
@[to_additive /
  have a common maximal reduction. This is the proof that the function that sends an element of the
  free group to its maximal reduction is well-defined. -/]
theorem reduce.sound (H : mk L₁ = mk L₂) : reduce L₁ = reduce L₂
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_L₃, H13, H23⟩ := Red.exact.1 H
  (reduce.eq_of_red H13).trans (reduce.eq_of_red H23).symm

name: reduce.exact
statement:
@[to_additive /
  element in the additive free group. -/]
theorem reduce.exact (H : reduce L₁ = reduce L₂) : mk L₁ = mk L₂
proof:
:=
  Red.exact.2 ⟨reduce L₂, H ▸ reduce.red, reduce.red⟩

name: reduce.self
statement:
@[to_additive /
  free group. -/]
theorem reduce.self : mk (reduce L) = mk L
proof:
:=
  reduce.exact reduce.idem

name: reduce.rev
statement:
@[to_additive /
  maximal reduction of `w₁`. -/]
theorem reduce.rev (H : Red L₁ L₂) : Red L₂ (reduce L₁)
proof:
:=
  (reduce.eq_of_red H).symm ▸ reduce.red

name: mk_toWord
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mk_toWord : ∀ {x : FreeGroup α}, mk (toWord x) = x
proof: := by rintro ⟨L⟩; exact reduce.self

name: toWord_injective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toWord_injective : Function.Injective (toWord : FreeGroup α → List (α × Bool))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨L₁⟩ ⟨L₂⟩; exact reduce.exact

name: toWord_inj
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_inj {x y : FreeGroup α} : toWord x = toWord y ↔ x = y
proof:
:=
  toWord_injective.eq_iff

name: toWord_mk
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_mk : (mk L₁).toWord = reduce L₁
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: toWord_of
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_of (a : α) : (of a).toWord = [(a, true)]
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: reduce_toWord
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem reduce_toWord : ∀ x : FreeGroup α, reduce (toWord x) = toWord x
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨L⟩
  exact reduce.idem

name: toWord_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_one : (1 : FreeGroup α).toWord = []
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: toWord_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toWord_mul (x y : FreeGroup α) : toWord (x * y) = reduce (toWord x ++ toWord y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_toWord (x := x), ← mk_toWord (x := y)]
  simp

name: toWord_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toWord_pow (x : FreeGroup α) (n : ℕ) :
    toWord (x ^ n) = reduce (List.replicate n x.toWord).flatten
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_toWord (x := x)]
  simp

name: toWord_eq_nil_iff
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_eq_nil_iff {x : FreeGroup α} : x.toWord = [] ↔ x = 1
proof:
:=
  toWord_injective.eq_iff' toWord_one

name: reduce_invRev
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce_invRev {w : List (α × Bool)} : reduce (invRev w) = invRev (reduce w)
proof:
:= by
  apply reduce.min
  rw [← red_invRev_iff, invRev_invRev]
  apply Red.reduce_left
  have : Red (invRev (invRev w)) (invRev (reduce (invRev w))) := reduce.red.invRev
  rwa [invRev_invRev] at this

name: toWord_inv
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_inv (x : FreeGroup α) : x⁻¹.toWord = invRev x.toWord
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨L⟩
  rw [quot_mk_eq_mk, inv_mk, toWord_mk, toWord_mk, reduce_invRev]

name: toWord_of_pow
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_of_pow (a : α) (n : ℕ) : (of a ^ n).toWord = List.replicate n (a, true)
proof:
:= by
  rw [of, pow_mk, List.flatten_replicate_singleton, toWord]
  exact reduce_replicate _ _

name: toWord_of_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem toWord_of_zpow (a : α) (n : ℤ) :
    (of a ^ n).toWord = List.replicate n.natAbs (a, decide (0 ≤ n))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hn : 0 ≤ n
  · lift n to ℕ using hn
    simp
  · rw [zpow_eq_inv_pow_natAbs _ (le_of_lt hn)]
    simp [FreeGroup.invRev, hn]

name: reduce_append_reduce_reduce
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce_append_reduce_reduce : reduce (reduce L₁ ++ reduce L₂) = reduce (L₁ ++ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toWord_mk (L₁ := L₁ ++ L₂), ← mul_mk, toWord_mul, toWord_mk, toWord_mk]

name: reduce_cons_reduce
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce_cons_reduce (a : α × Bool) : reduce (a :: reduce L) = reduce (a :: L)
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: reduce_invRev_left_cancel
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem reduce_invRev_left_cancel : reduce (invRev L ++ L) = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [← toWord_mk, ← mul_mk, ← inv_mk]

name: toWord_mul_sublist
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma toWord_mul_sublist (x y : FreeGroup α) : (x * y).toWord <+ x.toWord ++ y.toWord
proof:
:= by
  refine Red.sublist ?_
  have : x * y = FreeGroup.mk (x.toWord ++ y.toWord) := by
    rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk, FreeGroup.mk_toWord, FreeGroup.mk_toWord]
  rw [this]
  exact FreeGroup.reduce.red

name: Red.enum.sound
statement: theorem Red.enum.sound (H : L₂ ∈ List.filter (Red L₁) (List.sublists L₁)) : Red L₁ L₂
proof:
:=
  of_decide_eq_true (@List.of_mem_filter _ _ L₂ _ H)

name: Red.enum.complete
statement: theorem Red.enum.complete (H : Red L₁ L₂) : L₂ ∈ Red.enum L₁
proof:
:=
  List.mem_filter_of_mem (List.mem_sublists.2 <| Red.sublist H) (decide_eq_true H)

name: IsReduced.reduce_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsReduced.reduce_eq (h : IsReduced L) : reduce L = L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.red_iff_eq]
  exact reduce.red

name: IsReduced.of_reduce_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsReduced.of_reduce_eq (h : reduce L = L) : IsReduced L
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsReduced, List.isChain_iff_forall_rel_of_append_cons_cons]
  rintro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ⟨y₁, y₂⟩ l₁ l₂ hl rfl
  rw [eq_comm, ← Bool.ne_not]
  rintro rfl
  exact reduce.not (h.trans hl)

name: isReduced_iff_reduce_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isReduced_iff_reduce_eq : IsReduced L ↔ reduce L = L where
  mp h
proof:
:= h.reduce_eq
  mpr := .of_reduce_eq

name: isReduced_toWord
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isReduced_toWord {x : FreeGroup α} : IsReduced x.toWord
proof:
:= by
  simp [isReduced_iff_reduce_eq]

name: toWord_mk_mul_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toWord_mk_mul_eq (a : α) (b : Bool) (x : FreeGroup α) :
    (mk [⟨a, b⟩] * x).toWord =
      if x.toWord.head? = some ⟨a, !b⟩ then x.toWord.tail else ⟨a, b⟩ :: x.toWord
proof:
:= by
  simp [toWord_mul]
  cases x.toWord
  · simp
  · simp [Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq]
    grind

name: toWord_mul_mk_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem toWord_mul_mk_eq (a : α) (b : Bool) (x : FreeGroup α) :
    (x * mk [⟨a, b⟩]).toWord =
      if x.toWord.getLast? = some ⟨a, !b⟩ then x.toWord.dropLast else x.toWord.concat ⟨a, b⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [show x * mk [⟨a, b⟩] = ((mk [⟨a, b⟩])⁻¹ * x⁻¹)⁻¹ by simp, toWord_inv]
  simp [invRev, toWord_mk_mul_eq]
  split_ifs <;> simp <;> grind

name: idxOf_toWord_of_mul_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem idxOf_toWord_of_mul_eq {a : α} (x : FreeGroup α) {b : α × Bool} (hb₁ : b.1 ≠ a) :
    (of a * x).toWord.idxOf b =
      if x.toWord.head? = some (a, false) then x.toWord.idxOf b - 1 else x.toWord.idxOf b + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [of, toWord_mk_mul_eq, Bool.not_true]
  split_ifs with h
  · have : x.toWord ≠ [] := by grind
    rw [List.head?_eq_some_head this, Option.some.injEq] at h
    exact List.idxOf_tail_of_head_ne this (by simp [h, Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq, hb₁.symm])
  · grind

name: idxOf_toWord_mul_of_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem idxOf_toWord_mul_of_eq {a : α} (x : FreeGroup α) {b : α × Bool} (hb₁ : b.1 ≠ a)
    (hb₂ : b ∈ x.toWord) : (x * of a).toWord.idxOf b = x.toWord.idxOf b
proof:
:= by
  rw [of, toWord_mul_mk_eq]
  split_ifs
  · refine List.IsPrefix.idxOf_eq_of_mem (List.dropLast_prefix _) ?_
    exact List.mem_dropLast_of_mem_of_ne_getLast? hb₂ (by grind)
  · grind

name: eq_of_of_zpow_eq_of_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eq_of_of_zpow_eq_of_zpow {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) {n m : ℤ} (h : of a ^ n = of b ^ m) :
    n = 0 ∧ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [← toWord_inj, hab] at h
  lia

name: eq_of_of_pow_eq_of_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem eq_of_of_pow_eq_of_pow {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) {n m : ℕ} (h : of a ^ n = of b ^ m) :
    n = 0 ∧ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← Int.natCast_eq_zero] using eq_of_of_zpow_eq_of_zpow hab h

name: one_ne_of
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem one_ne_of (a : α) : 1 ≠ of a
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq α; ne_of_apply_ne toWord <| by simp

name: of_ne_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem of_ne_one (a : α) : of a ≠ 1
proof: := one_ne_of _ |>.symm

name: norm_inv_eq
statement:
@[to_additive /
def norm (x : FreeGroup α) : ℕ :=
  x.toWord.length

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem norm_inv_eq {x : FreeGroup α} : norm x⁻¹ = norm x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm, toWord_inv, invRev_length]

name: norm_eq_zero
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem norm_eq_zero {x : FreeGroup α} : norm x = 0 ↔ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [norm, List.length_eq_zero_iff, toWord_eq_nil_iff]

name: norm_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem norm_one : norm (1 : FreeGroup α) = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: norm_of
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem norm_of (a : α) : norm (of a) = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: norm_mk_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem norm_mk_le : norm (mk L₁) ≤ L₁.length
proof:
:=
  reduce.red.length_le

name: norm_mul_le
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem norm_mul_le (x y : FreeGroup α) : norm (x * y) ≤ norm x + norm y
proof:
:=
  calc
    norm (x * y) = norm (mk (x.toWord ++ y.toWord)) := by rw [← mul_mk, mk_toWord, mk_toWord]
    _ ≤ (x.toWord ++ y.toWord).length := norm_mk_le
    _ = norm x + norm y := List.length_append

name: norm_of_pow
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem norm_of_pow (a : α) (n : ℕ) : norm (of a ^ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm, toWord_of_pow, List.length_replicate]

name: norm_of_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem norm_of_zpow (a : α) (n : ℤ) : norm (of a ^ n) = n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm, toWord_of_zpow, List.length_replicate]

name: norm_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem norm_surjective [Nonempty α] : Function.Surjective (norm (α := α))
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨a⟩ := ‹Nonempty α›
  exact Function.RightInverse.surjective <| norm_of_pow a

name: powSaturated_iff_npow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem powSaturated_iff_npow {H : Submonoid G} :
    PowSaturated H ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : G), g ^ n ∈ H → n = 0 ∨ g ∈ H
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: saturated_iff_zpow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem saturated_iff_zpow {H : Subgroup G} :
    H.PowSaturated ↔ ∀ (n : ℤ) (g : G), g ^ n ∈ H → n = 0 ∨ g ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h n g hgn ↦ ?_, fun h n g hgn ↦ by simpa using h n g (by simpa using hgn)⟩
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := n.eq_nat_or_neg <;> simpa using h (by simpa using hgn)

name: ker_saturated
statement:
theorem ker_saturated {A₁ A₂ : Type*} [AddGroup A₁] [AddMonoid A₂] [IsAddTorsionFree A₂]
    (f : A₁ →+ A₂) : f.ker.NSMulSaturated
proof: := by simp [NSMulSaturated, or_comm]

name: coe_center
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem coe_center : ↑(center G) = Set.center G
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: center_toSubmonoid
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem center_toSubmonoid : (center G).toSubmonoid = Submonoid.center G
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_center_iff
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simps!) /
def centerCongr (e : G ≃* H) : center G ≃* center H := Submonoid.centerCongr e

/
@[to_additive (attr := simps!)
/
def centerToMulOpposite : center G ≃* center Gᵐᵒᵖ := Submonoid.centerToMulOpposite

variable {G}

@[to_additive]
theorem mem_center_iff {z : G} : z ∈ center G ↔ ∀ g, g * z = z * g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Semigroup.mem_center_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: map_center_le_center
proof:
:=
  Set.image_center_subset hf

name: comap_center_le_center
proof:
:=
  Set.preimage_center_subset hf

name: map_center_eq
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem map_center_eq {F} [EquivLike F G H] [MulEquivClass F G H] (f : F) :
    map f (center G) = center H
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective (Set.image_center_eq f)

name: _root_.CommGroup.center_eq_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem _root_.CommGroup.center_eq_top {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] : center G = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff']
  intro x
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  intro y
  exact mul_comm y x

name: center_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem center_eq_top_iff : center G = ⊤ ↔ IsMulCommutative G
proof:
:= by
  simp [eq_top_iff', isMulCommutative_iff, mem_center_iff, eq_comm]

name: center_eq_top
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem center_eq_top [hG : IsMulCommutative G] : center G = ⊤
proof:
:=
    center_eq_top_iff.mpr hG

name: center_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem center_prod : center (G × H) = prod (center G) (center H)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective Set.center_prod

name: center_pi
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem center_pi {η : Type*} {G : η → Type*} [Π i, Group (G i)] :
    center (Π i, G i) = pi .univ fun i ↦ center (G i)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.coe_injective Set.center_pi

name: normal_of_le_center
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma normal_of_le_center {H : Subgroup G} (hH : H ≤ Subgroup.center G) : H.Normal
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a ha b ↦ by simpa [mem_center_iff.mp (hH ha) b]⟩

name: center_le_normalizer
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem center_le_normalizer (s : Set G) : center G ≤ normalizer s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y
  simp [← mem_center_iff.mp hx y]

name: eq_of_left_mem_center
statement: theorem eq_of_left_mem_center {g h : M} (H : IsConj g h) (Hg : g ∈ Set.center M) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨u, hu⟩; rwa [← u.mul_left_inj, Hg.comm u]

name: eq_of_right_mem_center
statement: theorem eq_of_right_mem_center {g h : M} (H : IsConj g h) (Hh : h ∈ Set.center M) : g = h
proof:
:=
  (H.symm.eq_of_left_mem_center Hh).symm

name: mk_bijOn
statement:
theorem mk_bijOn (G : Type*) [Group G] :
    Set.BijOn ConjClasses.mk (↑(Subgroup.center G)) (noncenter G)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun g hg ↦ ?_, fun x hx y _ H ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [mem_noncenter, Set.compl_def, Set.mem_ofPred, Set.not_nontrivial_iff]
    intro x hx y hy
    simp only [mem_carrier_iff_mk_eq, mk_eq_mk_iff_isConj] at hx hy
    rw [hx.eq_of_right_mem_center hg, hy.eq_of_right_mem_center hg]
  · rw [mk_eq_mk_iff_isConj] at H
    exact H.eq_of_left_mem_center hx
  · rintro ⟨g⟩ hg
    refine ⟨g, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_noncenter, Set.compl_def, Set.mem_ofPred, Set.not_nontrivial_iff] at hg
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
    intro h
    rw [← mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul]
    refine hg ?_ mem_carrier_mk
    rw [mem_carrier_iff_mk_eq]
    apply mk_eq_mk_iff_isConj.mpr
    rw [isConj_comm, isConj_iff]
    exact ⟨h, rfl⟩

name: Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top

name: Subgroup.isSimpleGroup_iff
statement:

    IsSimpleGroup ↥H ↔ H ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ H' ≤ H, (H'.subgroupOf H).Normal → H' = ⊥ ∨ H' = H
proof:
:= by

name: isSimpleGroup_of_surjective
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem isSimpleGroup_of_surjective {H : Type*} [Group H] [IsSimpleGroup G] [Nontrivial H]
    (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsSimpleGroup H
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H iH => by
    refine (iH.comap f).eq_bot_or_eq_top.imp (fun h => ?_) fun h => ?_
    · rw [← map_bot f, ← h, map_comap_eq_self_of_surjective hf]
    · rw [← comap_top f] at h

name: _root_.MulEquiv.isSimpleGroup

name: closure_le_centralizer_centralizer

    simpa only [mem_iInf, mem_centralizer_singleton_iff, eq_comm (a := x * _)] using! hx

name: center_eq_iInf
proof:

  · refine fun hh g ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> rintro rfl

    · simpa using hh _ rfl

name: IsCyclic.exists_generator

name: isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top

name: Subgroup.isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top

protected theorem Subgroup.isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top [Group α] (H : Subgroup α) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top]
  simp_rw [← map_subtype_inj, Subgroup.map_top,
    H.range_subtype, MonoidHom.map_zpowers, Subtype.exists, coe_subtype, exists_prop]

@[to_additive]
theorem MonoidHom.map_cyclic [h : IsCyclic G] (σ : G →* G) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ g : G, σ g = g ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hG⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := G)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hG (σ h)
  refine ⟨m, fun g => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hG g
  rw [map_zpow, ← hm, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul']

name: Subgroup.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_prime_card
statement:

theorem Subgroup.eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_prime_card
    (H : Subgroup G) [hp : Fact (Nat.card G).Prime] : H = ⊥ ∨ H = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite G := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero hp.1.ne_zero
  have := card_subgroup_dvd_card H
  rwa [Nat.dvd_prime hp.1, ← eq_bot_iff_card, card_eq_iff_eq_top] at this

name: zpowers_eq_top_of_prime_card
statement:
theorem zpowers_eq_top_of_prime_card {p : ℕ}
    [hp : Fact p.Prime] (h : Nat.card G = p) {g : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) : zpowers g = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have := (zpowers g).eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_prime_card
  rwa [zpowers_eq_bot, or_iff_right hg] at this

name: mem_zpowers_of_prime_card
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mem_zpowers_of_prime_card {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (h : Nat.card G = p) {g g' : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) : g' ∈ zpowers g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [zpowers_eq_top_of_prime_card h hg, Subgroup.mem_top]

name: mem_powers_of_prime_card
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mem_powers_of_prime_card {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (h : Nat.card G = p) {g g' : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) : g' ∈ Submonoid.powers g
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite G := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (h ▸ hp.1.ne_zero)
  rw [mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers]
  exact mem_zpowers_of_prime_card h hg

name: powers_eq_top_of_prime_card
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [mem_powers_of_prime_card h hg]

name: isCyclic_of_prime_card
statement:
theorem isCyclic_of_prime_card {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (h : Nat.card α = p) : IsCyclic α
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite α := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (h ▸ hp.1.ne_zero)
  have : Nontrivial α := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (h ▸ hp.1.one_lt)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : α, g ≠ 1 := exists_ne 1
  exact ⟨g, fun g' ↦ mem_zpowers_of_prime_card h hg⟩

name: isCyclic_of_card_dvd_prime
statement:
theorem isCyclic_of_card_dvd_prime {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (h : Nat.card α ∣ p) : IsCyclic α
proof:
:= by
  rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hp.out).mp h with h | h
  · exact @isCyclic_of_subsingleton α _ (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp h).1
  · exact isCyclic_of_prime_card h

name: isCyclic_of_surjective
statement:

theorem isCyclic_of_surjective {F : Type*} [hH : IsCyclic G']
    [FunLike F G' G] [MonoidHomClass F G' G] (f : F) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    IsCyclic G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hH
  refine ⟨f x, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hf a
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx a
  exact ⟨n, (map_zpow _ _ _).symm⟩

    fun _ ↦ isCyclic_of_surjective e.symm e.symm.surjective⟩

name: orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_powers

name: orderOf_eq_card_of_zpowers_eq_top

name: exists_pow_ne_one_of_isCyclic
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem exists_pow_ne_one_of_isCyclic [G_cyclic : IsCyclic G]
    {k : ℕ} (k_pos : k ≠ 0) (k_lt_card_G : k < Nat.card G) : ∃ a : G, a ^ k ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite G := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt k_lt_card_G)
  rcases G_cyclic with ⟨a, ha⟩
  use a
  contrapose! k_lt_card_G
  convert! orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one k_pos.bot_lt k_lt_card_G
  rw [← Nat.card_zpowers, eq_comm, card_eq_iff_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  exact fun x _ ↦ ha x

name: Infinite.orderOf_eq_zero_of_forall_mem_zpowers

name: Subgroup.isCyclic_of_le

lemma Subgroup.isCyclic_of_le {H H' : Subgroup G} (h : H ≤ H') [IsCyclic H'] : IsCyclic H

name: Subgroup.le_zpowers_iff
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem Subgroup.le_zpowers_iff (g : G) (H : Subgroup G) :
    H ≤ Subgroup.zpowers g ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, H = Subgroup.zpowers (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (H.isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top).mp (isCyclic_of_le h)
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := mem_zpowers_iff.mp <| h (mem_zpowers x)
    obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg k
    · exact ⟨n, by rw [zpow_natCast]⟩
    · exact ⟨n, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact zpowers_le_of_mem <| npow_mem_zpowers g k

name: IsCyclic.card_pow_eq_one_le
statement:
@[to_additive IsAddCyclic.card_nsmul_eq_zero_le]
theorem IsCyclic.card_pow_eq_one_le [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] [IsCyclic α] {n : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n) :
    #{a : α | a ^ n = 1} ≤ n
proof:
:=
  let ⟨g, hg⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := α)
  calc
    #{a : α | a ^ n = 1} ≤
        #(zpowers (g ^ (Fintype.card α / Nat.gcd n (Fintype.card α))) : Set α).toFinset := by
      gcongr
      intro x hx
      let ⟨m, hm⟩ := show x ∈ Submonoid.powers g from mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers.2 <| hg x
      refine Set.mem_toFinset.2 ⟨(m / (Fintype.card α / Nat.gcd n (Fintype.card α)) : ℕ), ?_⟩
      dsimp only at ⊢ hm
      rw [zpow_natCast, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left', hm]
      refine Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right (gcd_pos_of_pos_left (Fintype.card α) hn0) ?_
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _), ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
          ← orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hg]
      exact orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one <| by simpa [pow_mul, hm] using (mem_filter.1 hx).2
    _ ≤ n := by
      let ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right n (Fintype.card α)
      have hm0 : 0 < m :=
        Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hm0 => by
          rw [hm0, mul_zero, Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff] at hm
          exact hm.elim' 1
      simp only [Set.toFinset_card, SetLike.coe_sort_coe]
      rw [Fintype.card_zpowers, orderOf_pow g, orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hg,
        Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      nth_rw 2 [hm]; nth_rw 3 [hm]
      rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hn0), gcd_mul_left_left, hm,
        Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hm0]
      exact le_of_dvd hn0 (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)

name: IsCyclic.exists_monoid_generator
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsCyclic.exists_monoid_generator [Finite α] [IsCyclic α] :
    ∃ x : α, ∀ y : α, y ∈ Submonoid.powers x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_powers_iff_mem_zpowers]
  exact IsCyclic.exists_generator

name: IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard [h : IsCyclic α] : ∃ g : α, orderOf g = Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h.exists_generator
  use g
  rw [← card_zpowers g, (eq_top_iff' (zpowers g)).mpr hg]
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.Set.univ α)

name: MulDistribMulAction.toMonoidHomZModOfIsCyclic_apply
statement:
theorem MulDistribMulAction.toMonoidHomZModOfIsCyclic_apply {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [IsCyclic G]
    [MulDistribMulAction M G] {n : ℕ} (hn : Nat.card G = n) (m : M) (g : G) (k : ℤ)
    (h : toMonoidHomZModOfIsCyclic G M hn m = k) : m • g = g ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MulDistribMulAction.toMonoidHom_apply,
    (MulDistribMulAction.toMonoidHom G m).map_cyclic.choose_spec g, zpow_eq_zpow_iff_modEq]
  apply Int.ModEq.of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr (orderOf_dvd_natCard g))
  rwa [hn, ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff]

name: IsCyclic.unique_zpow_zmod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsCyclic.unique_zpow_zmod (ha : ∀ x : α, x ∈ zpowers a) (x : α) :
    ∃! n : ZMod (Fintype.card α), x = a ^ n.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := ha x
  refine ⟨n, (?_ : a ^ n = _), fun y (hy : a ^ n = _) ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← zpow_natCast, zpow_eq_zpow_iff_modEq, orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers ha,
      Int.modEq_comm, Int.modEq_iff_add_fac, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← ZMod.intCast_eq_iff]
  · rw [← zpow_natCast, zpow_eq_zpow_iff_modEq, orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers ha,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff] at hy
    simp [hy]

name: IsCyclic.image_range_orderOf
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsCyclic.image_range_orderOf (ha : ∀ x : α, x ∈ zpowers a) :
    Finset.image (fun i => a ^ i) (range (orderOf a)) = univ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [_root_.image_range_orderOf, Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr ha, Set.toFinset_univ]

name: IsCyclic.image_range_card
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsCyclic.image_range_card (ha : ∀ x : α, x ∈ zpowers a) :
    Finset.image (fun i => a ^ i) (range (Nat.card α)) = univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers ha, IsCyclic.image_range_orderOf ha]

name: IsCyclic.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := G)
  specialize h g
  subst hGcard
  rw [pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq, orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hg,
    ← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at h
  simpa [ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id'] using h

name: exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle_of_two_lt_ncard
statement:
theorem exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle_of_two_lt_ncard
    {s : Set α} (hs : 2 < ncard s) :
    ∃ g ∈ stabilizer (Perm α) s, g.IsThreeCycle
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_lt_ncard_iff] at hs
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, hab, hac, hbc⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨swap a b * swap a c, ?_, isThreeCycle_swap_mul_swap_same hab hac hbc⟩
  rw [mem_stabilizer_set_iff_subset_smul_set s.toFinite, subset_smul_set_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  aesop

name: exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle
statement:
theorem exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle
    (s : Set α) (hα : 4 < Nat.card α) :
    ∃ g ∈ stabilizer (Perm α) s, g.IsThreeCycle
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 2 (ncard s) with hs | hs
  · exact exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle_of_two_lt_ncard hs
  · have := ncard_add_ncard_compl s
    rw [← stabilizer_compl]
    exact exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle_of_two_lt_ncard (by grind)

name: alternatingGroup_le_of_isPreprimitive
statement:
theorem alternatingGroup_le_of_isPreprimitive (h4 : 4 < Nat.card α)
    (G : Subgroup (Perm α)) [hG' : IsPreprimitive G α] {s : Set α}
    (hG : stabilizer (Perm α) s ⊓ alternatingGroup α ≤ G) :
    alternatingGroup α ≤ G
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg3⟩ := exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle s h4
  
  apply alternatingGroup_le_of_isPreprimitive_of_isThreeCycle_mem hG' hg3
  exact hG ⟨hg, IsThreeCycle.mem_alternatingGroup hg3⟩

name: stabilizer.surjective_toPerm
statement:
theorem stabilizer.surjective_toPerm {s : Set α} (hs : sᶜ.Nontrivial) :
    Function.Surjective (toPerm : stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s → Perm s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : ∃ k : Perm α, IsSwap k ∧ _root_.Disjoint s k.support := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := hs
    use Equiv.swap a b
    rw [swap_isSwap_iff]; aesop
  obtain ⟨k, hk_swap, hk_support⟩ := this
  have hks : k • s = s := by
    rw [← mem_stabilizer_iff, mem_stabilizer_set_iff_smul_set_subset s.toFinite]
    intro _
    simp only [mem_smul_set]
    rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    convert! hx
    rw [Perm.smul_def, ← Perm.notMem_support]
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hk_support) hx
  intro g
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (sign g) with hsg | hsg
  · use! Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g
    · simp [mem_alternatingGroup, hsg]
    · rw [mem_stabilizer_iff, Submonoid.mk_smul]
      exact ofSubtype_mem_stabilizer g
    · aesop
  · use! Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g * k
    · simp [mem_alternatingGroup, hk_swap.sign_eq, hsg]
    · rw [mem_stabilizer_iff, Submonoid.mk_smul, mul_smul, hks, ofSubtype_mem_stabilizer]
    · ext x
      suffices k x = x by simp [this]
      rw [Set.disjoint_left] at hk_support
      rw [← notMem_support]
      exact hk_support x.prop

name: stabilizer_isPreprimitive
statement:
theorem stabilizer_isPreprimitive {s : Set α} (hs : (sᶜ : Set α).Nontrivial) :
    IsPreprimitive (stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s) s
proof:
:=
  isPreprimitive_stabilizer_of_surjective s (stabilizer.surjective_toPerm hs)

name: stabilizer_subgroup_isPreprimitive
statement:
theorem stabilizer_subgroup_isPreprimitive {s : Set α} (hsc : sᶜ.Nontrivial)
    {G : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)} (hG : stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s ≤ G) :
    IsPreprimitive (stabilizer G s) s

name: stabilizer_ne_top
statement:
theorem stabilizer_ne_top {s : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hsc : sᶜ.Nontrivial) :
    stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨b, hb, c, hc, hbc⟩ := hsc
  suffices ∃ g, g ∉ stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s by contrapose! this; simp [this]
  use ⟨Equiv.swap a b * Equiv.swap a c, by aesop⟩
  simp_rw [mem_stabilizer_set, Subgroup.mk_smul, mul_smul, Perm.smul_def]
  grind

name: exists_mem_stabilizer_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_stabilizer_smul_eq (hα : 4 ≤ Nat.card α) {t : Set α} :
    ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ g ∈ stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) t, g • a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · use 1
    simpa
  by_cases ht : 2 < t.ncard
  · rw [← Set.ncard_pair hab] at ht
    replace ht := Set.sdiff_nonempty_of_ncard_lt_ncard ht
    obtain ⟨c, hct, hc⟩ := ht
    simp only [mem_insert_iff, not_or] at hc
    refine ⟨⟨swap c a * swap a b, by simp [hab, hc.1]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [mem_stabilizer_set' t.toFinite, Subgroup.mk_smul, Perm.smul_def, coe_mul]
      grind
    · simp only [Subgroup.mk_smul, Perm.smul_def, coe_mul]
      grind
  · have := ncard_add_ncard_compl t
    obtain ⟨c, d, hc, hd, hcd⟩ := (one_lt_ncard_iff tᶜ.toFinite).mp (by grind)
    refine ⟨⟨swap a b * swap c d, by simp [hab, hcd]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [mem_stabilizer_set' t.toFinite, Subgroup.mk_smul, Perm.smul_def, coe_mul]
      grind
    · simp only [Subgroup.smul_def, Perm.smul_def, Perm.coe_mul]
      grind

name: subgroup_eq_top_of_isPreprimitive
statement:
theorem subgroup_eq_top_of_isPreprimitive (h4 : 4 < Nat.card α)
    (G : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)) [hG' : IsPreprimitive G α] {s : Set α}
    (hG : stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s ≤ G) :
    G = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg3⟩ := exists_mem_stabilizer_isThreeCycle s h4
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← Subgroup.map_subtype_le_map_subtype, Subgroup.map_top, Subgroup.range_subtype]
  
  apply alternatingGroup_le_of_isPreprimitive_of_isThreeCycle_mem _ hg3
  · use ⟨g, hg3.mem_alternatingGroup⟩
    simpa only [SetLike.mem_coe, Subgroup.subtype_apply, and_true] using hG hg
  · let φ := (alternatingGroup α).subtype.subgroupMap G
    let f : α →ₑ[φ] α := {
      toFun := id
      map_smul' _ _ := rfl }
    rwa [← isPreprimitive_congr (f := f) ((alternatingGroup α).subtype.subgroupMap_surjective G)
      Function.bijective_id]

name: subsingleton_of_ssubset_compl_of_stabilizer_alternatingGroup_le
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_ssubset_compl_of_stabilizer_alternatingGroup_le
    {s B : Set α} {G : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)}
    (hs : s.Nontrivial) (hB_ss_sc : B ⊂ sᶜ) (hG : stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s ≤ G)
    (hB : IsBlock G B) :
    B.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  apply hB.subsingleton_of_ssubset_of_stabilizer_le hB_ss_sc
  intro g
  obtain ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, rfl⟩ := alternatingGroup.stabilizer.surjective_toPerm (by rwa [compl_compl]) g
  rw [stabilizer_compl] at hk
  exact ⟨⟨⟨k, hG hk⟩, by aesop⟩, rfl⟩

name: isCoatom_stabilizer_of_ncard_lt_ncard_compl
proof:
:= by
  have := ncard_add_ncard_compl s
  have h1 : sᶜ.Nontrivial := by
    rw [← one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h0.nonempty.ncard_pos hs
  have hα : 4 < Nat.card α := by
    rw [← Set.one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial] at h0
    grind
  
  
  use stabilizer_ne_top h0.nonempty h1
  
  intro G hG
  suffices IsPreprimitive G α from subgroup_eq_top_of_isPreprimitive hα G hG.le
  
  have := G.isPretransitive_of_stabilizer_lt hG
    (exists_mem_stabilizer_smul_eq (Nat.le_of_succ_le hα))
  apply IsPreprimitive.mk
  
  intro B hB
  rw [IsTrivialBlock, or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro hB'
  suffices sᶜ ⊆ B by
    apply hB.eq_univ_of_card_lt
    have : sᶜ.ncard ≤ B.ncard := ncard_le_ncard this
    grind
  
  /- Step 1 : `sᶜ` is not a block.
       This uses that `s.ncard  < sᶜ.ncard`.
       In the equality case, it is possible that `B = sᶜ` is a block:
       in that case, `G` would be a wreath product,
       this is case (b) of the O'Nan-Scott classification
       of maximal subgroups of the alternating group. -/
  have not_isBlock_sc : ¬ IsBlock G sᶜ := fun hsc ↦ by
    apply compl_ne_univ.mpr h0.nonempty 
    apply hsc.eq_univ_of_card_lt
    grind
  
  have hB_not_le_sc (B : Set α) (hB : IsBlock G B) (hBsc : B ⊆ sᶜ) :
      B.Subsingleton :=
    IsBlock.subsingleton_of_ssubset_compl_of_stabilizer_alternatingGroup_le h0
      (hBsc.ssubset_of_ne (by aesop)) 
      hG.le hB
  
  have hB_not_le_s (B : Set α) (hB : IsBlock G B) (hBs : B ⊆ s) :
      B.Subsingleton :=
    have : IsPreprimitive (stabilizer G s) s :=
      stabilizer_subgroup_isPreprimitive h1 hG.le
    hB.subsingleton_of_stabilizer_lt_of_subset hB_not_le_sc hG hBs
  
  suffices IsMultiplyPretransitive (↥(alternatingGroup α)) α (s.ncard + 1) by
    have : ¬ B ⊆ s := fun h ↦ hB' (hB_not_le_s B hB h)
    have : ¬ B ⊆ sᶜ := fun h ↦ hB' (hB_not_le_sc B hB h)
    apply hB.compl_subset_of_stabilizer_le_of_not_subset_of_not_subset_compl
      hG.le <;> grind
  have := isMultiplyPretransitive α
  apply isMultiplyPretransitive_of_le (n := Nat.card α - 2) _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  grind

name: isCoatom_stabilizer_singleton
statement:
theorem isCoatom_stabilizer_singleton (h3 : 3 ≤ Nat.card α)
    {s : Set α} (h : s.Nonempty) (h1 : s.Subsingleton) :
    IsCoatom (stabilizer (alternatingGroup α) s)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial α := by
    rw [← Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial]
    grind
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  rw [Subsingleton.eq_singleton_of_mem h1 ha, stabilizer_singleton]
  have : IsPreprimitive (alternatingGroup α) α :=
    alternatingGroup.isPreprimitive_of_three_le_card α h3
  apply IsPreprimitive.isCoatom_stabilizer_of_isPreprimitive

name: isCoatom_stabilizer
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_add_ncard_compl s, two_mul, ne_eq, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff] at hs
  wlog hs' : ncard s < ncard sᶜ
  · rw [← stabilizer_compl]
    apply this h1 <;> rw [compl_compl] <;> grind
  · by_cases h0' : s.Nontrivial
    · apply isCoatom_stabilizer_of_ncard_lt_ncard_compl h0' hs'
    · simp only [not_nontrivial_iff] at h0'
      apply isCoatom_stabilizer_singleton _ h0 h0'
      rw [← ncard_add_ncard_compl s]
      rw [← ncard_pos] at h0 h1
      grind

name: alternatingGroup_le_of_normal
statement:
theorem alternatingGroup_le_of_normal
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] (hα : 5 ≤ Nat.card α)
    {N : Subgroup (Perm α)} [N.Normal] (ntN : Nontrivial N) :
    alternatingGroup α ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← alternatingGroup.commutator_perm_eq hα]
  have : IsPreprimitive (Perm α) (Set.powersetCard α 2) := by
    apply Set.powersetCard.isPreprimitive_perm <;> grind
  classical
  apply iwasawaStructure_two.commutator_le
  exact fixedPoints_ne_univ_of_faithfulSMul (by norm_num) (by grind)

name: normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_six
statement:
theorem normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_six
    (hα : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) (hα' : Nat.card α ≠ 6)
    {N : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)} [N.Normal] :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← ne_eq, ← Subgroup.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot]
  intro hN
  have : IsPreprimitive (alternatingGroup α) (Set.powersetCard α 3) := by
    refine Set.powersetCard.isPreprimitive_alternatingGroup (by norm_num) ?_ ?_
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hα
    · simpa using hα'
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_top (by simpa using hα)]
  apply iwasawaStructure_three.commutator_le
  exact fixedPoints_ne_univ_of_faithfulSMul (by norm_num) (by grind)

name: mem_map_kleinFour_ofSubtype
statement:
theorem mem_map_kleinFour_ofSubtype {s : Finset α} (hs : s.card = 4) (k : alternatingGroup α) :
    k ∈ (kleinFour s).map (ofSubtype s) ↔
      (k : Perm α).support ⊆ s ∧ ((k : Perm α) = 1 ∨ (k : Perm α).cycleType = {2, 2})
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Nat.card s = 4 := by simpa
  by_cases hk : (k : Perm α).support ⊆ s
  · obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := (mem_range_ofSubtype_iff s k).mpr hk
    simp_rw [and_iff_right hk, Subgroup.mem_map, ofSubtype_inj, existsAndEq, and_true,
      ← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hs]
    simp [cycleType_ofSubtype, coe_ofSubtype, map_eq_one_iff _ Perm.ofSubtype_injective]
  · simp_rw [hk, false_and, iff_false]
    contrapose! hk
    exact (mem_range_ofSubtype_iff s k).mp (Subgroup.map_le_range _ _ hk)

name: map_kleinFour_conj
statement:
theorem map_kleinFour_conj (s : Finset α) (hs : s.card = 4) (g : alternatingGroup α) :
    (kleinFour _).map (ofSubtype (g • s)) = MulAut.conj g • ((kleinFour s).map (ofSubtype s))
proof:
:= by
  rcases g with ⟨g, hg⟩
  ext ⟨k, hk⟩
  simp_rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, mem_map_kleinFour_ofSubtype hs,
    Subgroup.mk_smul, MulAut.smul_def, MulAut.inv_apply, MulAut.conj_symm_apply, Subgroup.coe_mul,
    Subgroup.coe_inv, ← ConjAct.toConjAct_inv_smul, Equiv.Perm.support_toConjAct_eq_smul_support,
    mem_map_kleinFour_ofSubtype (s := g • s) (by simpa), Finset.subset_smul_finset_iff,
    ConjAct.toConjAct_smul, cycleType_conj, mul_inv_eq_one, mul_eq_left]

name: normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_eight
statement:
theorem normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_eight
    (hα : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) (hα' : Nat.card α ≠ 8)
    {N : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)} [N.Normal] :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← ne_eq, ← Subgroup.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot]
  intro hN
  have : IsPreprimitive (alternatingGroup α) (Set.powersetCard α 4) := by
    apply Set.powersetCard.isPreprimitive_alternatingGroup (by norm_num) <;> grind
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_top hα]
  apply (iwasawaStructure_four hα).commutator_le
  exact fixedPoints_ne_univ_of_faithfulSMul (by norm_num) (by grind)

name: normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top
statement:
theorem normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top
    (hα : 5 ≤ Nat.card α)
    {N : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)} [N.Normal] :
    N = ⊥ ∨ N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hα' : Nat.card α = 6
  · apply normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_eight hα (by grind)
  · apply normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_card_ne_six hα hα'

name: isSimpleGroup
statement:
theorem isSimpleGroup (hα : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) :
    IsSimpleGroup (alternatingGroup α) where
  exists_pair_ne
proof:
:= by
    rw [← _root_.nontrivial_iff]
    refine nontrivial_of_three_le_card ?_
    simpa using le_trans (by norm_num) hα
  eq_bot_or_eq_top_of_normal H _ := normal_subgroup_eq_bot_or_eq_top hα

name: _root_.Equiv.Perm.IsThreeCycle.alternating_normalClosure
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `alternatingGroup.isSimpleGroup` instead." (since := "2026-04-28")]
theorem _root_.Equiv.Perm.IsThreeCycle.alternating_normalClosure
    (h5 : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) {f : Perm α} (hf : IsThreeCycle f) :
    normalClosure ({⟨f, hf.mem_alternatingGroup⟩} : Set (alternatingGroup α)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : IsSimpleGroup (alternatingGroup α) := isSimpleGroup h5
  apply normalClosure_normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top.resolve_left
  simp [hf.ne_one]

theorem normalClosure_finRotate_five : normalClosure ({⟨finRotate 5,

name: mem_kleinFour_of_order_two_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_alternatingGroup, sign_of_cycleType] at hg0
  have h1 : g.cycleType.sum ≤ 4 := by
    rw [sum_cycleType, ← hα4, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact g.support.card_le_univ
  have h2 : ∀ k ∈ g.cycleType, k = 2 := by
    intro k hk
    have hk4 := (Multiset.le_sum_of_mem hk).trans h1
    have hk1 := one_lt_of_mem_cycleType hk
    interval_cases k
    · rfl
    · rw [← lcm_cycleType, Multiset.lcm_dvd] at hg
      exact Nat.prime_eq_prime_of_dvd_pow Nat.prime_three Nat.prime_two (hg 3 hk)
    · contrapose! hg0
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hk
      rw [ht, Multiset.sum_cons, add_le_iff_nonpos_right, le_zero_iff,
        Multiset.sum_eq_zero_iff, ← Multiset.eq_replicate_card] at h1
      have h : 0 ∉ g.cycleType := Nat.not_succ_lt_self ∘ one_lt_of_mem_cycleType
      replace h : t = 0 := by simpa [h1 ▸ ht, Multiset.mem_replicate] using h
      simp [ht, h, Units.ext_iff]
  rw [← Multiset.eq_replicate_card] at h2
  rw [h2, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, ← Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le two_pos] at h1
  interval_cases g.cycleType.card <;> simp [h2, Units.ext_iff] at hg0 ⊢

name: card_of_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem card_of_card_eq_four (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    Nat.card (alternatingGroup α) = 12
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial α := by
    rw [← Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial, hα4]
    simp
  rw [nat_card_alternatingGroup, hα4]
  decide

name: card_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem card_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) (S : Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)) :
    Nat.card S = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [Sylow.card_eq_multiplicity, card_of_card_eq_four hα4]
  have : 12 = 2 ^ 2 * 3 := by simp
  rw [this, Nat.factorization_mul_apply_of_coprime (by decide), Nat.factorization_pow,
    Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Nat.prime_two.factorization_self,
    Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (by decide)]
  simp

name: coe_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem coe_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four
    (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) (S : Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)) :
    (S : Set (alternatingGroup α)) =
      {1} ∪ {g : alternatingGroup α | (g : Perm α).cycleType = {2, 2}}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Set.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (fun k hk ↦ ?_) ?_
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (IsPGroup.iff_orderOf.mp S.isPGroup') ⟨k, hk⟩
    replace hn : (orderOf (k : Perm α)) = 2 ^ n := by simpa using hn
    convert! mem_kleinFour_of_order_two_pow hα4 k.2 hn.dvd
    simp
  · 
    simp_rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    refine (card_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four hα4 S).trans_ge ?_
    rw [Nat.card_eq_card_toFinset, Set.toFinset_union, Set.toFinset_singleton, Set.toFinset_ofPred]
    apply (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans
    rw [Finset.card_singleton, AlternatingGroup.card_of_cycleType, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hα4]
    decide

name: two_sylow_eq_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem two_sylow_eq_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four
    (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) (S : Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)) :
    S = kleinFour α
proof:
:= by
  rw [kleinFour, ← Subgroup.closure_insert_one,
    ← Set.singleton_union, ← coe_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four hα4]
  exact S.closure_eq.symm

name: subsingleton_two_sylow
statement:
theorem subsingleton_two_sylow (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    Subsingleton (Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)) where
  allEq S T
proof:
:= by
    rw [Sylow.ext_iff]
    simp [two_sylow_eq_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4]

name: characteristic_kleinFour
statement:
theorem characteristic_kleinFour (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    (kleinFour α).Characteristic
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S : Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)⟩ := Sylow.nonempty (G := alternatingGroup α)
  have _ := subsingleton_two_sylow hα4
  rw [← two_sylow_eq_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4 S]
  exact Sylow.characteristic_of_subsingleton _

name: normal_kleinFour
statement:
theorem normal_kleinFour (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    (kleinFour α).Normal
proof:
:= by
  have _ := characteristic_kleinFour hα4
  apply Subgroup.normal_of_characteristic

name: kleinFour_card_of_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem kleinFour_card_of_card_eq_four (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    Nat.card (kleinFour α) = 4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S : Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)⟩ := Sylow.nonempty (G := alternatingGroup α)
  rw [← two_sylow_eq_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4 S, card_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four hα4 S]

name: coe_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S : Sylow 2 (alternatingGroup α)⟩ := Sylow.nonempty (G := alternatingGroup α)
  rw [← two_sylow_eq_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4 S]
  exact coe_two_sylow_of_card_eq_four hα4 S

name: exponent_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four
statement:
theorem exponent_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    Monoid.exponent (kleinFour α) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have : Monoid.exponent (kleinFour α) ∣ 2 := by
    rw [Monoid.exponent_dvd]
    rintro ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, hg'⟩
    simp only [Subgroup.orderOf_mk, orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one]
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4] at hg'
    rcases hg' with hg' | hg'
    · convert! one_pow _
      simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Subgroup.mk_eq_one] using hg'
    · convert! pow_orderOf_eq_one g
      rw [← Equiv.Perm.lcm_cycleType, hg']
      simp
  rw [Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_two] at this
  apply Or.resolve_left this
  rw [Monoid.exp_eq_one_iff, ← Finite.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton,
    kleinFour_card_of_card_eq_four hα4]
  decide

name: kleinFour_isKleinFour
statement:
theorem kleinFour_isKleinFour (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    IsKleinFour (kleinFour α) where
  card_four
proof:
:= kleinFour_card_of_card_eq_four hα4
  exponent_two := exponent_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4

name: kleinFour_eq_commutator
statement:
theorem kleinFour_eq_commutator (hα4 : Nat.card α = 4) :
    kleinFour α = commutator (alternatingGroup α)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : (kleinFour α).Normal := normal_kleinFour hα4
  have : Nat.card (alternatingGroup α ⧸ kleinFour α) = 3 := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_left_inj (a := Nat.card (kleinFour α))]
    · rw [← Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup]
      rw [card_of_card_eq_four hα4, kleinFour_card_of_card_eq_four hα4]
    rw [kleinFour_card_of_card_eq_four hα4]; simp
  have comm_le : commutator (alternatingGroup α) ≤ kleinFour α := by
    rw [← Subgroup.Normal.quotient_commutative_iff_commutator_le]
    exact (isCyclic_of_prime_card this).isMulCommutative
  have comm_ne_bot : commutator (alternatingGroup α) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [ne_eq, commutator_eq_bot_iff_center_eq_top,
      center_eq_bot (le_of_eq hα4.symm)]
    apply @bot_ne_top _ _ _ ?_
    rw [Subgroup.nontrivial_iff, ← Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial,
      card_of_card_eq_four hα4]
    simp
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := Or.resolve_left (Subgroup.bot_or_exists_ne_one _) comm_ne_bot
  suffices hk22 : (k : Equiv.Perm α).cycleType = {2, 2} by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ comm_le
    intro g hg
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4,
      Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hg
    rcases hg with ⟨rfl⟩ | hg
    · exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · rw [← hg, ← Equiv.Perm.isConj_iff_cycleType_eq, isConj_iff] at hk22
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hk22
      rw [← MulAut.conjNormal_apply, Subtype.coe_inj] at hc
      simp only [commutator, ← hc]
      let fc : MulAut (alternatingGroup α) := MulAut.conjNormal c
      suffices (⊤ : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)) =
        Subgroup.map fc.toMonoidHom (⊤ : Subgroup (alternatingGroup α)) by
        rw [this, ← Subgroup.map_commutator]
        refine Subgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ hk
      simp
  have hk2 := comm_le hk
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_kleinFour_of_card_eq_four hα4,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hk2
  exact hk2.resolve_left hk'

name: odd_of_centralizer_le_alternatingGroup
statement:
theorem odd_of_centralizer_le_alternatingGroup (h : Subgroup.centralizer {g} ≤ alternatingGroup α)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ g.cycleType) :
    Odd i
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleType_def g, Multiset.mem_map] at hi
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hi
  rw [← Finset.mem_def] at hc
  suffices sign c = 1 by
    rw [IsCycle.sign _, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, ← Int.units_ne_iff_eq_neg] at this
    · rw [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, comp_apply]
      exact fun h ↦ this h.neg_one_pow
    · rw [mem_cycleFactorsFinset_iff] at hc
      exact hc.left
  apply h
  rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff]
  exact Equiv.Perm.self_mem_cycle_factors_commute hc

name: map_subtype_of_cycleType
statement:
theorem map_subtype_of_cycleType (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    ({g | (g : Perm α).cycleType = m} : Finset (alternatingGroup α)).map (Embedding.subtype _) =
      if Even (m.sum + m.card) then ({g | g.cycleType = m} : Finset (Perm α)) else ∅
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hm
  · ext g
    simp_rw [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_filter_univ, Embedding.coe_subtype, Subtype.exists,
      mem_alternatingGroup, exists_and_left, exists_prop, exists_eq_right_right,
      and_iff_left_iff_imp]
    intro hg
    rw [sign_of_cycleType, hg, Even.neg_one_pow hm]
  · rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro g hg
    simp_rw [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_filter_univ, Embedding.coe_subtype, Subtype.exists,
      mem_alternatingGroup, exists_and_left, exists_prop, exists_eq_right_right] at hg
    rcases hg with ⟨hg, hs⟩
    rw [g.sign_of_cycleType, hg, neg_one_pow_eq_one_iff_even (by simp)] at hs
    contradiction

name: card_of_cycleType_mul_eq
statement:
theorem card_of_cycleType_mul_eq (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    #{g : alternatingGroup α |  g.val.cycleType = m} *
        ((Fintype.card α - m.sum)! * m.prod * (∏ n ∈ m.toFinset, (m.count n)!)) =
          if ((m.sum ≤ Fintype.card α ∧ ∀ a ∈ m, 2 ≤ a) ∧ Even (m.sum + Multiset.card m))
          then (Fintype.card α)!
          else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_map, map_subtype_of_cycleType, apply_ite Finset.card,
    Finset.card_empty, ite_mul, zero_mul]
  simp only [and_comm (b := Even _)]
  rw [ite_and, Equiv.Perm.card_of_cycleType_mul_eq]

name: card_of_cycleType
statement:
theorem card_of_cycleType (m : Multiset ℕ) :
    #{g : alternatingGroup α | (g : Equiv.Perm α).cycleType = m} =
      if (m.sum ≤ Fintype.card α ∧ ∀ a ∈ m, 2 ≤ a) ∧ Even (m.sum + Multiset.card m) then
        (Fintype.card α)! /
          ((Fintype.card α - m.sum)! *
            (m.prod * (∏ n ∈ m.toFinset, (m.count n)!)))
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hm
  · 
    rw [← Finset.card_map, map_subtype_of_cycleType, ite_eq_left hm.2,
      Equiv.Perm.card_of_cycleType α m, ite_eq_left hm.1, mul_assoc]
  · 
    rw [← Finset.card_map, map_subtype_of_cycleType]
    rw [apply_ite Finset.card, Finset.card_empty]
    split_ifs with hm'
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.card_of_cycleType, ite_eq_right]
      obtain hm | hm := not_and_or.mp hm
      · exact hm
      · contradiction
    · rfl

name: card_of_cycleType_singleton
statement:
lemma card_of_cycleType_singleton {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hα : n ≤ card α) :
    #{g : alternatingGroup α | g.val.cycleType = {n}} =
      if Odd n then (n - 1)! * (choose (card α) n) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_map, map_subtype_of_cycleType, apply_ite Finset.card]
  simp only [Multiset.sum_singleton, Multiset.card_singleton, Finset.card_empty]
  simp_rw [← Nat.not_odd_iff_even, Nat.odd_add_one, not_not,
    Perm.card_of_cycleType_singleton hn hα]

name: card_le_of_centralizer_le_alternating
statement:
theorem card_le_of_centralizer_le_alternating (h : Subgroup.centralizer {g} ≤ alternatingGroup α) :
    Fintype.card α ≤ g.cycleType.sum + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hm
  replace hm : 2 + g.cycleType.sum ≤ Fintype.card α := by lia
  suffices 1 < Fintype.card (Function.fixedPoints g) by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Fintype.exists_pair_of_one_lt_card this
    suffices sign (kerParam g ⟨swap a b, 1⟩) ≠ 1 from
      this (h (kerParam_range_le_centralizer (Set.mem_range_self _)))
    simp [sign_kerParam_apply_apply, hab]
  rwa [card_fixedPoints g, Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le, Nat.le_sub_iff_add_le]
  rw [sum_cycleType]
  exact Finset.card_le_univ _

name: count_le_one_of_centralizer_le_alternating
statement:
theorem count_le_one_of_centralizer_le_alternating
    (h : Subgroup.centralizer {g} ≤ alternatingGroup α) :
    ∀ i, g.cycleType.count i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one, Equiv.Perm.cycleType_def]
  rw [Multiset.nodup_map_iff_inj_on g.cycleFactorsFinset.nodup]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← Finset.mem_def]
  by_contra! ⟨c, hc, d, hd, hm, hm'⟩
  let τ : Equiv.Perm g.cycleFactorsFinset := Equiv.swap ⟨c, hc⟩ ⟨d, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := Equiv.Perm.Basis.nonempty g
  have hτ : τ ∈ range_toPermHom' g := fun x ↦ by
    by_cases hx : x = ⟨c, hc⟩
    · rw [hx, Equiv.swap_apply_left]; exact hm.symm
    by_cases hx' : x = ⟨d, hd⟩
    · rw [hx', Equiv.swap_apply_right]; exact hm
    · rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hx hx']
  set k := toCentralizer a ⟨τ, hτ⟩ with hk
  suffices hsign_k : k.val.sign = -1 by
    apply units_ne_neg_self (1 : ℤˣ)
    rw [← hsign_k, h (toCentralizer a ⟨τ, hτ⟩).prop]
  /- to prove that `hsign_k : sign k = -1` below,
  we could prove that it is the product of the transpositions with disjoint supports
  [(g ^ n) (a c), (g ^ n) (a d)], for 0 ≤ n < c.support.card,
  which are in odd number by `odd_of_centralizer_le_alternatingGroup`,
  but it will be sufficient to observe that `k ^ 2 = 1`
  (which implies that `k.cycleType` is of the form (2,2,…))
  and to control its support. -/
  have hk_cT : k.val.cycleType = Multiset.replicate k.val.cycleType.card 2 := by
    rw [Multiset.eq_replicate_card, ← pow_prime_eq_one_iff, ← Subgroup.coe_pow,
      ← Subgroup.coe_one, Subtype.coe_inj, hk, ← map_pow]
    convert! MonoidHom.map_one _
    rw [← Subtype.coe_inj]
    apply Equiv.swap_mul_self
  rw [sign_of_cycleType, hk_cT]
  simp only [Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, Multiset.card_replicate, pow_add,
    even_two, Even.mul_left, Even.neg_pow, one_pow, one_mul]
  apply Odd.neg_one_pow
  apply odd_of_centralizer_le_alternatingGroup h
  have : (k : Perm α).cycleType.card * 2 = (k : Perm α).support.card := by
    rw [← sum_cycleType, hk_cT]
    simp
  have that : Multiset.card (k : Perm α).cycleType = (c : Perm α).support.card := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_left_inj (a := 2) (by simp), this]
    simp only [hk, toCentralizer, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, card_ofPermHom_support]
    have H : (⟨c, hc⟩ : g.cycleFactorsFinset) ≠ ⟨d, hd⟩ := Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mp hm'
    simp only [τ, support_swap H]
    rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [mem_singleton, H, not_false_eq_true]),
      Finset.sum_singleton, hm, mul_two]
  rw [that]
  simp only [cycleType_def, Multiset.mem_map]
  exact ⟨c, hc, by simp only [Function.comp_apply]⟩

name: OnCycleFactors.kerParam_range_eq_centralizer_of_count_le_one
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ kerParam_range_le_centralizer hx, fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [kerParam_range_eq, Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.coe_subtype,
    Subtype.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right]
  use hx
  ext c : 2
  rw [← Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one, cycleType_def,
    Multiset.nodup_map_iff_inj_on (cycleFactorsFinset g).nodup] at h_count
  exact h_count _ (by simp) _ c.prop (mem_range_toPermHom_iff.mp (by simp) c)

name: centralizer_le_alternating_iff
statement:
theorem centralizer_le_alternating_iff :
    Subgroup.centralizer {g} ≤ alternatingGroup α ↔
      (∀ c ∈ g.cycleType, Odd c) ∧ Fintype.card α ≤ g.cycleType.sum + 1 ∧
        ∀ i, g.cycleType.count i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetLike.le_def]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨odd_of_centralizer_le_alternatingGroup h,
      card_le_of_centralizer_le_alternating h,
      count_le_one_of_centralizer_le_alternating h⟩
  · rintro ⟨h_odd, h_fixed, h_count⟩ x hx
    rw [← kerParam_range_eq_centralizer_of_count_le_one h_count] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨y, uv⟩, rfl⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp hx
    rw [mem_alternatingGroup, sign_kerParam_apply_apply (g := g) y uv]
    convert! mul_one _
    · apply Finset.prod_eq_one
      rintro ⟨c, hc⟩ _
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (uv _).prop
      rw [← hk, map_zpow]
      convert! one_zpow k
      rw [IsCycle.sign, Odd.neg_one_pow, neg_neg]
      · apply h_odd
        rw [cycleType_def, Multiset.mem_map]
        exact ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      · rw [mem_cycleFactorsFinset_iff] at hc
        exact hc.left
    · suffices y = 1 by simp [this]
      have := card_fixedPoints g
      exact card_support_le_one.mp <| le_trans (Finset.card_le_univ _) (by lia)

name: mem_commutatorSet_alternatingGroup
statement: theorem mem_commutatorSet_alternatingGroup : g ∈ commutatorSet (alternatingGroup α)
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_commutatorSet_of_isConj_sq
  apply alternatingGroup.isThreeCycle_isConj h5 hg
  simpa [sq] using hg.isThreeCycle_sq

name: mem_commutator_alternatingGroup
statement: theorem mem_commutator_alternatingGroup : g ∈ commutator (alternatingGroup α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [commutator_eq_closure]
  apply Subgroup.subset_closure
  exact hg.mem_commutatorSet_alternatingGroup h5

name: alternatingGroup.commutator_perm_le
statement:
theorem alternatingGroup.commutator_perm_le :
    commutator (Perm α) ≤ alternatingGroup α
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_eq_closure, closure_le, Set.subset_def, mem_commutatorSet_iff,
    SetLike.mem_coe, mem_alternatingGroup, forall_exists_index]
  rintro _ p q rfl
  simp [map_commutatorElement, commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_commute, Commute.all]

name: commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_top
statement:
theorem commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_top (h5 : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) :
    commutator (alternatingGroup α) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  suffices closure {b : alternatingGroup α | (b : Perm α).IsThreeCycle} = ⊤ by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← this, Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro b hb
    exact hb.mem_commutator_alternatingGroup h5
  rw [← closure_three_cycles_eq_alternating]
  exact Subgroup.closure_closure_coe_preimage

name: commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_self
statement:
theorem commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_self (h5 : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) :
    ⁅alternatingGroup α, alternatingGroup α⁆ = alternatingGroup α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Subgroup.map_subtype_commutator, commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_top h5,
    Subgroup.map_top, Subgroup.range_subtype]

name: alternatingGroup.commutator_perm_eq
statement:
theorem alternatingGroup.commutator_perm_eq (h5 : 5 ≤ Nat.card α) :
    commutator (Perm α) = alternatingGroup α
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm alternatingGroup.commutator_perm_le
  rw [← commutator_alternatingGroup_eq_self h5]
  exact commutator_mono le_top le_top

name: _root_.AddAction.stabilizerEquivStabilizer_compTriple
statement:
theorem _root_.AddAction.stabilizerEquivStabilizer_compTriple
    {G : Type*} [AddGroup G] {α : Type*} [AddAction G α]
    {g h k : G} {a b c : α} {hg : b = g +ᵥ a} {hh : c = h +ᵥ b} {hk : c = k +ᵥ a} (H : k = h + g) :

name: ofStabilizer.conjMap_bijective
statement:

theorem ofStabilizer.conjMap_bijective : Function.Bijective (conjMap hg)

  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
    simp only [Subtype.mk_eq_mk]
    apply (MulAction.injective g)
    rwa [← SetLike.coe_eq_coe, conjMap_apply] at hxy

name: ofStabilizer.snoc_last
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem ofStabilizer.snoc_last {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n ↪ ofStabilizer G a) :

name: exists_smul_of_last_eq
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma exists_smul_of_last_eq [IsPretransitive G α] {n : ℕ} (a : α) (x : Fin n.succ ↪ α) :
    ∃ (g : G) (y : Fin n ↪ ofStabilizer G a), g • x = ofStabilizer.snoc y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgx⟩ := exists_smul_eq G (x (Fin.last n)) a
  have H : ∀ i, Fin.Embedding.init (g • x) i ∈ ofStabilizer G a := fun i ↦ by
    simp only [mem_ofStabilizer_iff,
      Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← hgx, ← smul_apply, ne_eq]
    suffices Fin.Embedding.init (g • x) i = (g • x) i.castSucc by
      simp [this]
    simp [Fin.Embedding.init, Fin.init_def]
  use g, (Fin.Embedding.init (g • x)).codRestrict (ofStabilizer G a) H
  ext i
  rcases Fin.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last i with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl⟩
  · simpa [ofStabilizer.snoc] using!
      Subtype.ext_iff.mp <| Function.Embedding.codRestrict_apply _ _ H i
  · simpa only [smul_apply, ofStabilizer.snoc, Fin.Embedding.snoc_last]

    intro g h

  refine le_antisymm (le_of_le_of_eq (this _) ?_) (this _)

name: coe_smul

name: stabilizer_coe
statement:
@[to_additive addAction_stabilizer_coe]

proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp [mem_stabilizer_iff, ← Subtype.coe_inj, ← coe_inj]

name: addAction_faithful
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · contrapose h with h
    have : ∃ a, (g +ᵥ a : α) ≠ a := by simpa [Equiv.ext_iff] using h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this
    obtain ⟨s, has, has'⟩ := exists_mem_notMem hn hα (Ne.symm ha)
    rw [Equiv.ext_iff, not_forall]
    use s
    contrapose has'
    simp only [AddAction.toPerm_apply, coe_one, id_eq] at has'
    rw [← has']
    simpa [← mem_coe_iff]
  · simp only [Equiv.ext_iff, AddAction.toPerm_apply] at h ⊢
    simp [Subtype.ext_iff, Finset.ext_iff, mem_vadd_finset, h]

name: faithfulVAdd
proof:
:= by
  rw [faithfulVAdd_iff]
  intro g hg
  apply AddAction.toPerm_injective (α := G) (β := α)
  rw [AddAction.toPerm_zero, ← addAction_faithful hn hα]
  exact Perm.ext_iff.mpr hg

name: mulAction_faithful
statement:
theorem mulAction_faithful (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hα : n < ENat.card α) {g : G} :
    toPerm g = (1 : Perm (powersetCard α n)) ↔ toPerm g = (1 : Perm α)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · contrapose h with h
    have : ∃ a, (g • a : α) ≠ a := by simpa [Equiv.ext_iff] using h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this
    obtain ⟨s, has, has'⟩ := exists_mem_notMem hn hα (Ne.symm ha)
    rw [Equiv.ext_iff, not_forall]
    use s
    contrapose! has'
    simp only [toPerm_apply, coe_one, id_eq] at has'
    rw [← has']
    simpa only [coe_smul, smul_mem_smul_finset_iff, ← mem_coe_iff]
  · simp only [Equiv.ext_iff, toPerm_apply] at h ⊢
    simp [Subtype.ext_iff, Finset.ext_iff, mem_smul_finset, h]

name: faithfulSMul
statement:
theorem faithfulSMul (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hα : n < ENat.card α) [FaithfulSMul G α] :
    FaithfulSMul G (powersetCard α n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [faithfulSMul_iff]
  intro g hg
  apply toPerm_injective (α := G) (β := α)
  rw [toPerm_one, ← mulAction_faithful hn hα]
  exact Perm.ext_iff.mpr hg

  obtain ⟨f : Fin n ↪ α, hf⟩ :=
    Function.Embedding.exists_of_card_eq_finset (by rw [hs, Fintype.card_fin])

name: mulActionHom_compl_mulActionHom_compl
statement:
theorem mulActionHom_compl_mulActionHom_compl :
    (mulActionHom_compl G α <| (n.add_comm m).trans hm).comp
    (mulActionHom_compl G α hm) = .id G
proof:
:= by
  ext s a
  change a ∈ (mulActionHom_compl G α _).comp (mulActionHom_compl G α hm) s ↔ a ∈ s
  simp [MulActionHom.comp_apply, mem_mulActionHom_compl]

name: mulActionHom_compl_bijective
